jobs.title: Etämyyjä (2000-6000€/kk)
jobs.excerpt: Toimisto siellä, missä sä jo oot Puhelinmyyntiä ja ajanvarausta suomalaisille yrityksille.
jobs.description:
Toimisto siellä, missä sä jo oot

Puhelinmyyntiä ja ajanvarausta suomalaisille yrityksille. Kotona Suomessa tai oman arjen keskellä ulkomailla.

Asutko maalla, jossa lähin työpaikkakeskittymä on kaupan ilmoitustaulu? Etsitkö työtä, joka sopisi paremmin perhearkeen? Tai oletko jo muuttanut lämpimään ja haluaisit tehdä töitä suomeksi?

Me Graftilla etsimme puhelinmyyjiä ja ajanvaraajia yhteistyöyrityksillemme etätöihin. Monessa projektissa sijaintia enemmän merkitsee se, että saat asiakkaaseen yhteyden, kuuntelet ja viet keskustelua eteenpäin.

Kokeneille tekijöille löytyy mahdollisuuksia hyödyntää osaamistaan. Osassa tehtävistä pääsee alkuun myös ilman aiempaa myyntikokemusta, kun halua oppia ja tehdä töitä löytyy.

Mitä siellä puhelimessa tehdään?

Riippuu projektista. Voit esimerkiksi:

  • Myydä tuotteita tai palveluita ja tehdä kaupat puhelimessa.

  • Sopia asiakastapaamisia myyntiedustajille.

  • Kartoittaa asiakkaan tarpeita ja etsiä niihin sopivaa ratkaisua.

Asiakkaina voi olla yrityksiä tai kuluttajia. Sun ei tarvitse hakuvaiheessa tietää, mikä tehtävä sopisi parhaiten. Sitä varten me jutellaan.

Hyvä myyjä tarvitsee myös hyvän paikan tehdä töitä.

Meidän tiimin tausta on suoramyynnissä. Tiedetään, miltä tuntuu soittaa tuotteesta, johon uskoo, ja miten paljon kunnollinen perehdytys, toimivat työvälineet ja tiimin tuki vaikuttavat tekemiseen.

Siksi tutustumme yhteistyöyrityksiimme, niiden tuotteisiin, ansiomalleihin ja arkeen ennen kuin etsimme niille tekijöitä. Haluamme tietää, millaiseen paikkaan olemme sua suosittelemassa.

Jos olet uusi alalla, tarvitset kunnon alun ja tukea oppimiseen. Jos kokemusta on jo kertynyt, haluamme löytää paikan, jossa pääset käyttämään osaamistasi ja kehittymään lisää.

Puhutaan rahasta.

Ansiot ovat useimmiten vahvasti provisiopohjaisia. Se tarkoittaa, että omat tulokset vaikuttavat suoraan siihen, mitä tienaat.

Kuukausiansiot liikkuvat tyypillisesti 2 000–6 000 eurossa, mutta vaihtelu on suurta. Projektilla, työmäärällä, kokemuksella ja omilla tuloksilla on merkitystä. Kyse ei ole taatusta kuukausipalkasta.

Käydään ennen etenemistä läpi, mistä palkkio muodostuu, milloin se maksetaan ja millaista tekemistä eri ansiotasoihin pääseminen edellyttää. Saat myös tietää, millaisella sopimuksella työ tehdään.

Etänä, mutta yhteydessä porukkaan.

Tarvitset tietokoneen, toimivan netin ja rauhallisen paikan, jossa voit puhua asiakkaiden kanssa. Työ tehdään suomeksi ja pääosin Suomen työpäivän aikana.

Työajat ja tuntimäärät riippuvat projektista. Osa tehtävistä sopii kokoaikaiseen tekemiseen, osassa on enemmän joustoa esimerkiksi koulupäivien ajaksi. Katsotaan yhdessä, mikä sopii sun arkeen ja projektin tarpeisiin.

Jos asut ulkomailla, kerro siitä heti hakemuksessa. Kaikkia tehtäviä ei voi tehdä kaikista maista, joten selvitetään sulle sopivat vaihtoehdot alusta asti.

Millainen tyyppi tässä pärjää?

Sun ei tarvitse olla porukan äänekkäin tai keksiä vastausta kaikkeen.

Tarvitset kiinnostusta ihmisiin, uskallusta avata keskustelu ja kykyä kuunnella. Myös pitkäjänteisyydestä on hyötyä: kaikki eivät vastaa, jokainen ei osta, ja seuraavaan puheluun pitää silti lähteä hyvällä otteella.

Etätyössä omaa päivää pitää osata viedä eteenpäin. Tukea saa ja pitää pyytää, mutta kukaan ei istu vieressä käynnistämässä jokaista soittoa.

Jos olet jo tehnyt puhelinmyyntiä tai ajanvarausta, kerro siitä meille. Meitä kiinnostaa, missä olet hyvä ja mitä toivot seuraavalta paikalta.

Miten homma etenee?

1. Sä haet. Kerrot vähän itsestäsi, kokemuksestasi ja siitä, millaista työtä etsit.

2. Me jutellaan. Käydään läpi sun toiveet, vahvuudet ja käytännön asiat. Saat kysyä meiltä ihan yhtä lailla.

3. Katsotaan sopiva projekti. Kerromme yrityksestä, työstä, ansiomallista ja sopimuksesta. Sä päätät, kiinnostaako mahdollisuus.

4. Valmistaudutaan yhdessä. Autamme sua valmistautumaan yrityksen haastatteluun ja olemme mukana prosessin seuraavissa vaiheissa.

Sopimus tehdään suoraan yhteistyöyrityksen kanssa. Meihin voit olla yhteydessä myös aloittamisen jälkeen.

Kiinnostuitko?

Laita hakemus tulemaan. Kerro, missä päin maailmaa olet, millaista kokemusta sulla on ja kuinka paljon haluaisit tehdä töitä.

Ei haittaa, vaikka sopivan projektin nimi ei olisi vielä tiedossa. Etsitään sitä yhdessä.

Töitä on paljon. Me etsitään sulle se, jota kannattaa tehdä.

Graft – work worth doing.

jobs.title: Director Commercial Strategy and Procurement - RID00255
jobs.excerpt: Red Nucleus is hiring a Director, Commercial Strategy & Procurement to protect and grow the value of every deal we win.
jobs.description:
Red Nucleus is hiring a Director, Commercial Strategy & Procurement to protect and grow the value of every deal we win.

You will be our commercial authority when we engage pharmaceutical and life sciences procurement teams. You will lead targeted, high-stakes negotiations, shape pricing and deal structure, and defend margin across our full service portfolio while preserving the client relationships behind it. You will also train our Business Development and Sales teams to navigate procurement with confidence.

You will work closely with Business Development, Finance, Legal, and Delivery leadership to make sure our commercial agreements support sustainable growth, profitability, and execution excellence.

Responsibilities:

Lead Commercial Negotiations

  • Partner with Sales leads to execute targeted negotiations with client procurement teams, optimizing pricing, rate structures, and commercial terms across MSAs, SOWs, and long-term engagements.
  • Act as Red Nucleus' commercial procurement subject matter expert on complex and high-value negotiations, including multi-year agreements and bundled or cross-divisional engagements.
  • Protect and enhance deal-level gross margin, ensuring pricing recommendations align with financial targets and long-term growth strategy.
  • Address unfavorable procurement-driven terms such as rate compression, excessive risk transfer, onerous indemnities, and payment terms. Maintain a solution-oriented, partnership mindset and collaborate with Legal and Finance as needed.

Shape Contract Structure, Risk, and Governance

  • Serve as the key resource for procurement and commercial negotiation inquiries and escalations, giving internal stakeholders expert guidance.
  • Support the development and maintenance of negotiation standards, playbooks, and guardrails that balance speed, flexibility, and risk management.
  • Advise internal teams on procurement engagement, negotiation strategy, and commercial risk, working with Legal on contractual interpretation and risk matters.
  • Collaborate with Legal, Risk, Finance, Insurance, and Technology to ensure proposed terms align with company policies and business objectives.

Articulate Value and Partner with the Business

  • Work with Business Development and Division leadership to reinforce our value proposition during negotiations, especially under procurement-led cost pressure.
  • Translate complex, high-value services into defensible pricing rationales. These include strategic consulting, medical communications, value & evidence, learning & development, and technology-enabled offerings.
  • Advise on alternative pricing structures, such as blended rates, retainers, phased engagements, and outcome-based components, that align client needs with profitability goals.
  • Bridge Legal, Finance, and commercial teams to keep decision-making aligned.

Align Financial and Strategic Priorities

  • Partner with Finance to evaluate deal economics, pricing scenarios, margin thresholds, and long-term revenue impact.
  • Track and report on negotiation outcomes, including pricing trends, margin performance, procurement concessions, and risk exposure.
  • Identify patterns in pharmaceutical procurement behavior and recommend strategic responses that strengthen our commercial model.

Build Sales Capability

  • Develop and deliver training for Business Development and Sales teams on pharmaceutical and life sciences procurement processes, buyer expectations, and effective engagement strategies.
  • Coach Sales teams on navigating procurement discussions, answering pricing objections, and reinforcing value throughout the buying process.
  • Share best practices that help teams anticipate procurement challenges and negotiate with confidence.
  • Partner with Sales leadership to strengthen procurement knowledge and negotiation effectiveness across the organization.

Skills and Experience:

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain Management, Life Sciences, or a related field. Equivalent professional experience is an asset.
  • 5 to 10 years of experience in contract negotiation, strategic sourcing, commercial contracting, procurement-facing roles, or complex B2B services environments.
  • 3 to 5 years of pharmaceutical or life sciences procurement experience, with a strong understanding of internal procurement processes, vendor engagement, and commercial buying cycles. Most of your procurement experience should be in the pharmaceutical or life sciences industry.
  • A record of negotiating successfully with sophisticated enterprise procurement organizations while preserving pricing integrity and client relationships.
  • Experience working with commercial, sales, Finance, and Legal teams on complex negotiations.
  • Strong knowledge of pharmaceutical procurement processes, commercial contract principles, risk allocation, and commercial terms in services-based agreements.
  • Skill at balancing firmness and collaboration in negotiation.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, including margin mechanics, pricing strategy, and commercial value.
  • The ability to articulate the value of services in clear, business-focused language.
  • The ability to train and coach sales teams on procurement processes and negotiation strategy.
  • Excellent communication, relationship-building, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Executive presence and the confidence to engage senior client stakeholders and internal leadership.
  • Comfort in fast-paced, growth-oriented environments, and the organization to manage multiple complex negotiations at once.

Preferred

  • Experience in professional services, life sciences consulting, healthcare, biotech, pharma, or technology-enabled services.
  • Experience across both procurement and commercial or sales functions, with an understanding of buyer and seller perspectives.
  • Experience developing procurement engagement strategies, negotiation playbooks, or commercial training materials.
  • Professional certifications in procurement, contract management, or commercial negotiation (such as CPSM or CIPS). These are an asset but not required.

Diversity, equity and inclusion are valued at Red Nucleus and we believe we have a shared responsibility to provide equal opportunity and foster an inclusive spirit. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, religion, caste, sexual orientation, gender, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

To learn more about working at Red Nucleus, please visit Careers | Red Nucleus.

jobs.title: Director, M&A Business Development
jobs.excerpt: Job Description: Director, M&A Business Development Vertus Group THE COMPANY The Vertus Group is a division of Constellation Software Inc.
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Director, M&A Business Development

Vertus Group

THE COMPANY

The Vertus Group is a division of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU), operating under Gary Jonas Computing Ltd. Constellation is the global leader in acquiring, managing, and growing vertical market software (VMS) companies. With over 1,500 portfolio companies across 140+ verticals and employing over 65,000 associates, Constellation has built its reputation on a disciplined buy-and-hold acquisition philosophy, operational excellence, and long-term value creation.

Vertus focuses on identifying, evaluating, and acquiring high-quality VMS businesses across North America. Our portfolio includes companies such as Magnusmode (assistive technology for neurodiverse individuals), Lean Industries (disputed transaction resolution), and PxPlus Technologies. We operate with the autonomy and agility of a small team backed by the scale and stability of one of the world’s most successful software acquirers.

POSITION

We are seeking a Director, M&A Business Development to build and lead the top of our acquisition funnel. This is a high-impact, sourcing-heavy role: you will be responsible for identifying, researching, and qualifying vertical market software companies as potential acquisition targets across North America. You will own the pipeline from initial identification through to the pre-qualification stage, at which point deals are advanced for deeper evaluation.

This is not a traditional corporate development or investment banking role. You will operate as an entrepreneurial pipeline architect and deal hunter—combining enterprise-level outreach skills with the analytical rigor of private equity and the relationship-building instincts of a founder-whisperer. You will leverage AI-powered tools and modern CRM platforms to build and manage a large-scale, data-driven pipeline that consistently surfaces high-quality opportunities.

You will report directly to the Senior Director, M&A and manage one direct report. The base salary for this role is in the range of $75,000 - $85,000 USD.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Build, own, and optimize a large-scale M&A prospect pipeline using HubSpot and/or Salesforce. Maintain disciplined tracking of all outreach, conversations, and deal progression from first touch through pre-qualification.
  • Proactively identify vertical market software companies across North America through proprietary research, referral channel development, industry mapping, database mining, and AI-driven prospecting tools (e.g., Grata, Cyndx, SourceScrub).
  • Initiate and cultivate relationships with software company founders, owners, and CEOs who may be considering an ownership transition. Navigate sensitive conversations around legacy, succession, employee continuity, and timing with empathy and discretion. Position Vertus as a trusted long-term home for their business. Craft personalized outreach that earns a first conversation, then nurture those relationships over months and years. Many founders are not ready to sell today, and consistent, value-adding follow-up is what makes Vertus their first call when they are.
  • Build and maintain relationships with intermediaries—M&A advisors, accountants, lawyers, industry associations, and Constellation portfolio leaders—who can provide warm introductions to founders.
  • Conduct initial screening of targets against Constellation’s acquisition criteria, including financial profile, market positioning, customer concentration, competitive landscape, and growth trajectory. Prepare structured Target Account Plans for qualified opportunities.
  • Leverage AI tools across the business development lifecycle—research automation, outreach personalization, pipeline analytics, competitive intelligence, and reporting—to increase throughput and quality of deal flow.
  • Develop deep expertise in specific VMS verticals. Monitor industry trends, M&A activity, and competitive dynamics to inform sourcing strategy and prioritize target segments.
  • Maintain rigorous CRM hygiene and produce regular pipeline reports, conversion analytics, and market insights for leadership.
  • Manage and develop one direct report. Set clear expectations, coach on outreach and research skills, and build a high-performing sourcing function.

JOB QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 7+ years in business development, corporate development, or deal sourcing roles, with meaningful exposure to M&A transactions in the software or technology sector.
  • Direct experience at a PE firm, PE-backed portfolio company, or serial acquirer. Candidates who have sourced or facilitated exits for founder-owned software businesses in the $5M to $15M revenue range are particularly well-suited.
  • Demonstrated enterprise sales or enterprise-level outreach experience—you understand complex sales cycles, stakeholder mapping, and consultative relationship building (preferred).
  • Strong understanding of SaaS business models, recurring revenue metrics (ARR, churn, NRR), and vertical market software dynamics.
  • Proven ability to build and manage large-scale pipelines using HubSpot and/or Salesforce. You treat CRM as a strategic asset, not an administrative burden.
  • Hands-on experience leveraging AI tools in business development workflows—research, outreach, analytics, or productivity. You are an early adopter who actively seeks competitive advantage through technology.
  • Ability to read and interpret financial statements, assess basic valuation metrics, and screen targets against defined acquisition criteria.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills. You can engage a founder in a cold email and hold your own in a boardroom conversation.
  • A proven track record of earning the trust of founders, owners, or senior executives navigating high-stakes personal and financial decisions. You can point to relationships you have cultivated over years that led to transactions, partnerships, or referrals. You listen more than you pitch, follow through on every commitment, and convey genuine respect for what founders have built.
  • You thrive with autonomy. You are resourceful, persistent, and comfortable building processes from scratch in a lean environment.

Business Unit:

Corporate Club - M&A

Scheduled Weekly Hours:

40

Number of Openings Available:

1

Worker Type:

Regular

More About Jonas Software:

Jonas Software is a leading provider of enterprise management software solutions, serving a wide range of vertical markets including hospitality, healthcare, construction, education, personal care, fitness, leisure, moving and legal services, to name a few. Within these markets, Jonas is comprised of over 65 distinct brands, each a respected leader in its domain.

Jonas’ vision is to be the branded global leader across these verticals and to be recognized by customers and industry stakeholders as the trusted provider of “Software for Life.” We are committed to technology, product innovation, quality, and exceptional customer service.

Jonas Software supports over 60,000 customers in more than 30 countries. We employ over 6,000 skilled professionals, including industry experts and technology specialists. Across our broader network, we support a global workforce of more than 30,000 employees.

Headquartered in Canada, Jonas Software has a global footprint with offices around the world. We’re a 100% owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc., based in Toronto, publicly listed on the TSX (CSU.TO), and a member of the S&P/TSX 60 Index.

jobs.excerpt: Do you enjoy solving large-scale challenges?  Would you like to develop cloud computing and AI hardware of the next generation?
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy solving large-scale challenges?

Would you like to develop cloud computing and AI hardware of the next generation?

Come join our Cloud Technology Product Group!

The Hardware, Infrastructure, and Virtualization Engineering(HIVE) Product Line drives technical advancements in Akamai's core hardware platforms, firmware, and virtualization layers, reshaping platform infrastructure and ensuring Akamai remains influential in future technological developments. We partner with Hardware Engineering and OEM/ODM manufacturers to design, qualify, and scale reliable, efficient, and secure platforms from concept to global deployment.

Partner with the best

In this role, you will create and enhance server platforms tailored for cloud workloads and AI inference configurations. You will lead server lifecycle efforts while addressing performance, cost, maintenance, firmware standardization, and platform virtualization objectives effectively.

As a Product Manager Senior, you will be responsible for:

  • Leading product lifecycle for CDN, Compute, or GPU platforms from PRDs through roadmap development, prioritization, and global server fleet launches.
  • Productizing OEM/ODM server configurations by evaluating CPU/GPU, PCIe, NIC, and storage trade-offs to reduce provisioning latency and standardize architectures.
  • Partnering with kernel and firmware engineers to define requirements like BIOS/UEFI, BMC/IPMI, drivers and push for resolution of hardware-software integration bottlenecks.
  • Driving firmware standardization, automated preemptive issue detection, and component audits to reduce operational toil and enable resilient platform infrastructure.
  • Managing virtualization layers and hypervisor release coordination including KVM stack and OS upgrades to minimize qualification overhead and friction across teams.
  • Developing business models and financial analysis for core platform innovations, balancing power, thermals, performance, BOM, and schedule goals.
  • Managing legacy EOL server replacements and tenant capacity migration evaluating relevant compliance requirements.
  • Aligning cross-functional software, performance, kernel, firmware, and supply chain teams early, establishing fast-track qualification workflows and telemetry standards for rapid PoCs and seamless production retrofitting.

Do what you love

To be successful in this role you will:

  • Have 12+ years in relevant product management/development with hardware, firmware, QEMU, Linux kernel lifecycle, and virtualization layers.
  • Have excellent understanding of fleet management and connected Compute architectures.
  • Demonstrate deep understanding of GPU/accelerated compute and their contributions to AI, HPC, and disaggregated architectures.
  • Bring proven experience standardizing reusable hardware architecture models (ODM/OEM server configurations) to reduce manual provisioning latency and operational toil.
  • Demonstrate ability to understand, define, and communicate the value of highly technical cloud products.
  • Have deep relationship-building skills and proven experience collaborating with technology partners.

About us

At Akamai, we make life better for billions of people, trillions of times a day.
Whether you're streaming live events, scrolling social media, watching your favorite series, or managing your savings, we're the engine behind the scenes. We provide the world's most distributed platform from Cloud to Edge to help the giants of the digital world work faster and stay more secure, making the internet a better experience for everyone.

Our focus is simple:

Cloud and Edge: Running apps closer to users for instant performance.
Security: Neutralizing threats before they ever reach your data.
Content Delivery: Scaling the world's biggest moments without a glitch.
AI: Enabling our customers to build, secure, and scale AI apps on the world's most distributed cloud platform.

At Akamai, we don't just support the internet; we power and protect it, because behind every great digital experience is a massive hidden challenge. And we're the ones who solve it. When millions of people hit play or pay, Akamai ensures it just works.

Benefits at Akamai: We support your health, well-being, finances, and life beyond work. See our benefits.

FlexBase adapts to your job's needs

Akamai's FlexBase program is yet another way we show our commitment to providing employees with an exceptional workplace experience. It's not about telling employees where to work; it's about supporting employees to do their best work.

We trust our incredible employees to work in ways that suit them best: at home, in an office, or a combination of both.

Connect with us on social and see what life at Akamai is like!

Compensation

Akamai is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. For US based candidates only - the base salary for this position ranges from $139,300 - $250,700/year; a candidate’s salary is determined by various factors including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, certifications and location. Compensation for candidates outside the US will vary. The compensation package may also include incentive compensation opportunities in the form of annual bonus or incentives, equity awards and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP). Akamai provides industry-leading benefits including healthcare, 401K savings plan, company holidays, vacation (in the form of PTO), sick time, family friendly benefits including parental leave and an employee assistance program including a focus on mental and financial wellness; Eligibility requirements apply.

About CG Oncology, Inc.

Are you ready to make a difference in the world and become part of our patient-centered team that is focused on Attacking Bladder Cancer for a Better Tomorrow? At CG Oncology, we believe that by having exceptionally talented individuals on our team who share our passion and enjoy working together, we can truly achieve our Vision and Mission to benefit patients around the world.

Every day we are making significant advancements across our multiple pipelines and are growing rapidly to meet the needs of our patients who cannot afford to wait to benefit from our novel immunotherapies. Please review this job posting and our Values and if they resonate with you and are what you expect from your organization and team, then we would like to hear from you.

About the role

CG Oncology is seeking a Director of Patient Experience marketing to design and lead our patient engagement initiatives across the pre-launch, launch and post-launch lifecycle.

The Director, Patient Marketing will lead the development and execution of the patient and caregiver strategy for cretostimogene as CG Oncology prepares for its first commercial launch in non-muscle invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC).

This individual will be responsible for building a differentiated, insight-driven patient experience that helps patients and caregivers understand their disease, navigate treatment decisions, access therapy, and successfully move through the treatment journey.

The Director, Patient Marketing will initially focus on launch readiness in high-risk BCG-unresponsive NMIBC while simultaneously helping shape the patient strategy and market-development approach for potential future indications, including intermediate-risk NMIBC.

As a senior member of the Marketing organization, this leader will work closely with HCP Marketing, Patient Services, Market Access, Sales, Medical Affairs, Commercial Operations, Insights & Analytics, Regulatory, Legal, Compliance and external agency partners.

The ideal candidate combines strategic marketing leadership with a deep understanding of oncology patient journeys and the ability to translate patient insights into highly effective programs and experiences.

Essential Functions

Patient Strategy & Launch Readiness

  • Develop and own the integrated patient and caregiver strategy for cretostimogene.
  • Translate the overall brand strategy into a clear patient strategy, including objectives, strategic imperatives, priorities and measures of success.
  • Lead patient launch readiness across disease education, branded communications, digital engagement, patient support and treatment-experience initiatives.
  • Develop the patient value proposition, positioning, messaging and creative strategy in partnership with the broader brand team.

Patient Journey & Experience

  • Develop and continually refine a comprehensive NMIBC patient journey from diagnosis through treatment and follow-up.
  • Identify the critical behavioral, emotional and practical barriers affecting treatment decisions.
  • Understand how patients and caregivers perceive disease severity, recurrence, progression risk and available treatment alternatives.

Patient Insights & Segmentation

  • Build a deep understanding of patients, caregivers and their treatment decision-making process through primary and secondary research.
  • Lead development of actionable patient segmentation and patient personas.
  • Identify differences in needs, motivations and behaviors across relevant NMIBC patient populations.

Disease Education & Market Development

  • Lead development of patient-facing NMIBC disease education initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to improve patient understanding of recurrence, progression risk and treatment options.
  • Develop programs that help patients have more informed discussions with their urologists and care teams.
  • Partner with Medical Affairs and advocacy organizations on appropriate disease-awareness initiatives.

Patient Services & Access Partnership

  • Serve as the primary Marketing partner to Patient Services.
  • Help define the desired patient experience from prescription/treatment decision through access and treatment initiation.
  • Partner on the design of patient onboarding, education and support resources.

Patient Advocacy

  • Partner with Medical Affairs, Corporate Affairs and other internal stakeholders to develop the company's patient advocacy strategy.
  • Establish productive relationships with relevant bladder cancer patient organizations and advocacy groups.
  • Incorporate advocacy and patient-community insights into commercial planning.

Cross-Functional Launch Leadership

  • Represent Patient Marketing on appropriate cretostimogene launch workstreams.
  • Partner closely with HCP Marketing to deliver an integrated brand strategy.
  • Collaborate with Sales and field leadership to understand patient-related barriers observed within urology practices.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business administration or a related field or equivalent years of experience required. MBA or other graduate degree preferred.
  • Ten (10+) years marketing experience with 7+ in patient and consumer marketing.
  • Experience working in pharmaceutical brand marketing.
  • Oncology experience strongly preferred; urology, bladder cancer or other physician-administered oncology experience highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated experience preparing for and/or executing a pharmaceutical product launch.
  • Experience developing patient strategy, segmentation, positioning, messaging and omnichannel programs.
  • Strong understanding of the oncology patient journey and treatment decision-making process.
  • Experience partnering with Patient Services, Market Access and patient advocacy organizations.
  • Understanding of reimbursement and access considerations affecting patients receiving physician-administered therapies.
  • Experience leading agencies and managing significant marketing budgets.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively within Regulatory, Legal and Compliance requirements.
  • Up to 20-25% travel required.

jobs.excerpt: Job Description: ServiceNow ITOM Architect Company: Altera Health (A Harris Computer Business) Location: India (Remote / Hybrid) Function: AI & Automation — Engineering About the Role We are looking for a ServiceNow ITOM Expert to join our AI and Tools Automation team.
jobs.description:
Job Description: ServiceNow ITOM Architect

Company: Altera Health (A Harris Computer Business)
Location: India (Remote / Hybrid)
Function: AI & Automation — Engineering

About the Role

We are looking for a ServiceNow ITOM Expert to join our AI and Tools Automation team. You will own the design, implementation, and evolution of our IT Operations Management capabilities on ServiceNow — spanning Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, CMDB governance, and AI-powered auto-remediation workflows. You will be a technical authority who can work independently, integrate ITOM deeply with monitoring platforms like LogicMonitor, AppDynamics, SentryOne, and drive intelligent, self-healing IT operations across a complex healthcare IT environment.

This is not a configuration role — we need someone who architects, engineers, and leads.

Key Responsibilities

ITOM Architecture & Technical Leadership

  • Own the end-to-end architecture and roadmap for ServiceNow ITOM capabilities — Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, CMDB, and Health Log Analytics (HLA)
  • Define platform standards, integration patterns, and governance models for ITOM across the organization
  • Lead technical design reviews, contribute to architectural decisions, and represent ITOM in cross-functional planning
  • Independently investigate, debug, and resolve complex ITOM platform issues — from MID Server failures to CMDB reconciliation conflicts — without escalation
  • Identify opportunities to consolidate, automate, and modernize legacy monitoring and event workflows

Discovery & CMDB Governance

  • Design and maintain ServiceNow Discovery patterns — horizontal, vertical, and cloud discovery across on-prem, Azure, and hybrid environments
  • Own CMDB health — deduplication, reconciliation rules, CI relationships, data certification, and lifecycle management
  • Build and enforce CMDB governance frameworks that ensure accuracy, completeness, and audit readiness
  • Manage Service Mapping — application service discovery, dependency mapping, and business service modeling aligned to healthcare IT operations
  • Design CI class structures, identification and reconciliation rules, and IRE (Identification and Reconciliation Engine) policies

Event Management & AIOps

  • Architect and manage the Event Management pipeline — connector configuration, alert ingestion, event correlation rules, and suppression logic
  • Configure and tune Health Log Analytics (HLA) for log-based anomaly detection and noise reduction
  • Build intelligent alert correlation and deduplication rules to reduce alert fatigue and accelerate MTTR
  • Design event-to-incident promotion workflows with smart routing, priority assignment, and SLA alignment
  • Integrate LogicMonitor as a primary event source — mapping LM alert payloads to ServiceNow event schema, managing thresholds, and ensuring bidirectional status synchronization

Auto-Remediation & Intelligent Workflows

  • Design and build auto-heal workflows that trigger automated remediation actions in response to ITOM events — owning the architectural principle that condition-determination logic belongs in the monitoring layer (LogicMonitor), with ServiceNow executing remediation based on clean, pre-evaluated signals
  • Build Flow Designer and Integration Hub workflows for automated incident response, CI status updates, and cross-platform orchestration
  • Develop spoke integrations and REST/MID-based connectors for third-party tools
  • Implement safety checks and precondition validations within remediation flows to prevent unintended actions in production environments
  • Continuously improve auto-remediation coverage and reliability through feedback loops with the monitoring team

MID Server & Integration Engineering

  • Own MID Server architecture — deployment topology, cluster configuration, upgrades, health monitoring, and failover
  • Design and maintain integration architecture between ServiceNow and external platforms — LogicMonitor, Azure Monitor, Kubernetes, and other operational tools
  • Build and maintain REST, SOAP, and scripted integrations using Integration Hub, Scripted REST APIs, and Import Sets
  • Manage credentials, connection pooling, and secure credential storage using ServiceNow Credential Vault

AI-Augmented Engineering

  • Actively use AI tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent) as a core part of the engineering workflow — for scripting, debugging, documentation, and solution design
  • Leverage AI to accelerate complex problem-solving — generating Business Rules, Flow Designer logic, Scripted REST endpoints, and Groovy/JavaScript-based scripts faster and with higher quality
  • Use AI to explore and prototype new ITOM automation patterns and self-healing use cases
  • Stay current with ServiceNow’s native AI/ML capabilities — Predictive Intelligence, NLU, and Virtual Agent — and assess their applicability to the team’s operational goals

Azure & Cloud Integration

  • Deep understanding of Azure platform as it relates to ITOM — Azure Monitor, Azure Arc, Log Analytics Workspaces, Event Grid, and resource tagging models
  • Architect cloud discovery and service mapping for Azure-hosted workloads — VMs, AKS clusters, PaaS services, and resource groups
  • Integrate Azure-native alerting and telemetry into the ServiceNow Event Management pipeline
  • Understand Azure RBAC and Entra ID as they apply to MID Server service accounts, API integrations, and CMDB data sources

GitHub & Development Practices

  • Operate confidently in GitHub — maintain ITOM configuration as code where possible, manage update sets through version control, and use GitHub Actions for deployment automation
  • Document integration designs, flow logic, and architectural decisions clearly and maintain them in source control
  • Apply software engineering discipline to ServiceNow scripting — clean code, peer review, and regression testing before deployment to production

Platform Governance & Mentorship

  • Own the ITOM module’s platform health — upgrades, deprecation planning, performance tuning, and licensing awareness
  • Define and enforce development standards for ITOM scripting, flow design, and integration work
  • Mentor developers (such as Kamalesh) working on ITOM-adjacent tasks and conduct structured code and configuration reviews
  • Contribute to organization-wide ITSM/ITOM alignment — ensuring CMDB, Event Management, and incident workflows operate as a cohesive system

Required Skills & Experience

  • 10+ years of ServiceNow experience, with 4+ years specialized in ITOM — Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, CMDB
  • Expert-level knowledge of MID Server architecture, deployment, and troubleshooting
  • Deep proficiency in ServiceNow scripting — JavaScript, Business Rules, Script Includes, Scripted REST APIs, Scheduled Jobs
  • Strong command of Flow Designer and Integration Hub
  • Proven experience building event-driven auto-remediation workflows at production scale
  • Deep, hands-on Azure platform knowledge — Monitor, Arc, Log Analytics, Event Grid, Entra ID; able to architect cloud ITOM integrations independently
  • Experience integrating LogicMonitor or comparable monitoring platforms (Dynatrace, Datadog, SCOM) with ServiceNow Event Management
  • GitHub proficiency — branching, PRs, Actions-based CI/CD, and managing ServiceNow config artifacts in source control
  • Strong independent debugging skills — able to own and resolve complex, multi-system issues without escalation
  • Demonstrated fluency with AI tools in day-to-day engineering — uses AI to solve problems, generate scripts, and prototype solutions
  • Excellent communication skills — can represent ITOM architecture decisions clearly to non-technical stakeholders

Good to Have

  • Experience with Health Log Analytics (HLA) and log-based AIOps
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes / AKS monitoring and CMDB integration for containerized workloads
  • Knowledge of ServiceNow Predictive Intelligence and ML-based alert correlation
  • Exposure to ITSM modules (Incident, Change, Problem) and their integration touchpoints with ITOM
  • Familiarity with LogicMonitor platform internals — DataSources, alert payloads, Groovy scripting
  • Understanding of healthcare IT environments and compliance considerations
  • ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist — ITOM certification
  • Experience with Virtual Agent or NLU for ITOM self-service scenarios

Who You Are

  • An ITOM engineer who treats the platform as a product — not a tool to configure, but a system to architect and own
  • Deeply self-sufficient — you debug across MID Servers, CMDB reconciliation logs, Flow Designer execution histories, and REST payloads without waiting to be unblocked
  • You use AI as a natural extension of your engineering toolkit — it makes you faster and sharper
  • You hold strong architectural opinions and can defend them clearly — including knowing where logic belongs (monitoring layer vs. remediation layer)
  • Comfortable working in a lean, fast-moving team where you are the ITOM domain authority
  • A collaborative mentor who raises the engineering bar across adjacent team members
  • You care about data quality in the CMDB the same way a data engineer cares about pipeline reliability

Working with communities and local talents, together with the world’s most respected chefs, designers and artists, Belmond continues its purpose of perpetuating the legendary art of travel. jobs.description:
🚨 Urgent Hiring. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. The selection process may take up to 4 weeks, but early applicants are strongly encouraged.

Do You Turn Great Creative Direction Into Finished, On-Style Product Art?

At Hadley Designs, we believe that learning should be enjoyable, engaging, and screen-free. Millions of parents and teachers trust our beautifully designed, developmentally aligned educational tools to help children grow and thrive. As a fast-growing, family-founded brand, we are on a mission to make learning meaningful for families around the world, and we are looking for an early-career illustrator who wants to spend their days making the art that goes into our products.

We are seeking a Junior Product Illustrator to work hand-in-hand with our Chief Creative Officer, taking her creative direction and carrying it through to finished, production-ready product art. This is a maker's seat, not a template-and-layout role. If you love to draw, you have a genuine eye for cute, playful, kid-friendly design, and you want to grow your craft inside a brand that ships beautiful products every month, this is a rare opportunity to build your portfolio while doing work that reaches millions of families.

About Hadley Designs

Hadley Designs is redefining early education with creativity and purpose. Every product we create is hand-drawn and teacher-designed, crafted with care to build confidence and connection. Our screen-free tools help families and teachers make learning fun and meaningful, nurturing curiosity and creativity in children.

Our Mission: We design screen-free products that parents can trust to help their children learn, grow, and reach their full potential. We create beautifully designed, developmentally sound tools that replace noise and distraction with connection, curiosity, and real learning.

Our Vision: We aim to build the most trusted children's brand in the world, present in millions of homes, reshaping how families learn, connect, and grow. Our products will be so widely used and passed down that generations of children will grow up learning from them and choose them again for their own families.

Role Overview

As our Junior Product Illustrator, your one job is to turn the Chief Creative Officer's vision into finished, on-style product art, so Hadley Designs launches new products faster and our creative capacity is multiplied, not capped by a single set of hands. The CCO sets the tone, the style, and the strategy; you carry the hands-on execution, creating new artwork, completing sets in an established style, and building each concept out to production-ready. This is a deliberately early-career seat for someone with real illustration talent who wants to keep growing that craft. You will not be expected to arrive as a seasoned art director. You will be expected to draw well, learn our style quickly, take direction cleanly, and finish the last mile of the creative so the CCO can stay focused on setting direction rather than executing it.

Key Responsibilities

Original Illustration & Artwork

  • Create new artwork and complete sets in Hadley Designs' established style across our product lines.
  • Draw and illustrate original elements like characters, motifs, patterns, and scenes that fit our cute, kid-friendly aesthetic.

Product Design Execution

  • Turn the CCO's concepts and creative direction into finished, production-ready product designs.
  • Carry a design from initial handoff through final build-out without kicking work back up the chain.

Creative Production Support

  • Own the execution offload (variations, building out a design across a full set, and file prep) that frees the CCO's hands.
  • Prepare print and production files to spec, and build mockups and product previews for listings.

Style Consistency

  • Keep every piece on-style and on-brand across the full product set.
  • Maintain the living style-reference so the look stays consistent as the catalog grows.

As-needed: occasional ad-ops support (A+ content, storefront updates, CMYK ad images) and revisions on existing product lines. This is secondary support, not the core of the role.

How Success Is Measured

First-pass approval rate: the share of deliverables the CCO accepts with no major rework. This is how we measure "on-style" objectively.

New original art created: the volume of original artwork generated to feed the product pipeline.

Sets / SKUs completed: finished design sets shipped per month. The speed lever.

On-time delivery: the share of assigned pieces delivered by the agreed deadline.

  • Framework-to-finish independence: the share of projects carried from CCO handoff to production-ready without kicking work back up.

Requirements

Who You Are

You are an early-career illustrator with genuine drawing talent and a real eye for cute, playful, kid-friendly design. You love to make art and you want to keep doing exactly that. This is the work you want to grow in, not a stepping stone into something else. You take creative direction cleanly, you learn a style fast, and you can carry a piece all the way to finished without needing it handed back to you. You thrive in a remote, fast-moving environment where new products ship every month, and you are excited to build your portfolio inside a brand that reaches millions of families.

Must-haves

  • A portfolio of original illustration work that shows a cute, playful, kid-friendly or product-design sensibility.
  • Working proficiency in Adobe Illustrator for native illustration (not just file handling or layout).
  • Ability to match and extend an existing art style, completing a set so new pieces sit naturally alongside the originals.
  • Strong ability to take written and verbal creative direction and turn it into finished work.
  • Reliability on deadlines while managing several pieces at once.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience preparing print / production files to spec.
  • Familiarity with the children's, educational, or consumer-product space.
  • Comfort with lightweight project tools (Notion, ClickUp) and file organization.
  • Note: this is an entry-level maker's role. We are not looking for a senior art director or a veteran illustrator. We are looking for real talent early in its arc, with the interest and hunger to grow.

Benefits

Why You'll Love Working Here

  • Impact: Your work will directly impact how families experience learning through the Hadley Designs brand.
  • Culture: Join a passionate, mission-driven team that values trust, creativity, and collaboration.
  • Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom of a remote role with flexible working hours.
  • Growth: Learn directly from our Chief Creative Officer and build a portfolio of shipped, real-world product work.
  • Remote-first work environment
  • Paid time off and holidays
  • Access to learning resources and professional development
  • Free access to Hadley Designs products
  • Regular interaction with leadership, including the CEO and CCO
  • Stability from a decade as a family-founded, mission-driven brand

Apply Today

If you're ready to make a meaningful impact in a growing company that's shaping the future of learning, apply now to join the Hadley Designs team as our Junior Product Illustrator. Help us create a lasting impact on families, educators, and children worldwide.

P.S: If you don't hear from us within four weeks of your application, please consider that as our decision to move forward with other candidates, but we truly appreciate your interest in Hadley Designs.

ROLE SUMMARY

The Senior Manager, (MCCS), within the Medical and Scientific Communications Capabilities Hub (MSCCH) in the Global & US Medical Science Communications (US & Global MSC) Organization is responsible for independently developing and reviewing, complex and innovative global medical content end-to-end within a specific therapeutic area (Internal Medicine/ Specialty Care/ Vaccines/ Oncology), including abstracts, manuscripts, congress posters/presentations, graphical abstracts, systematic literature reviews, plain language summaries, slide decks, medical education resources, social media, infographics, video, multi-media and other types of external-facing medical content.


ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • The Senior Manager will independently develop and review all complex and innovative medical affairs content, including abstracts, manuscripts, congress posters/presentations, graphical abstracts, systematic literature reviews, plain language summaries, slide decks, medical education resources, social media, infographics, video, multi-media and other types of external-facing medical content for an assigned area with limited supervision, serving as a subject matter expert.
  • Independent communication, writing and development of drafts includes researching, organizing, compiling, interpreting and quality check of various types of technical and/or medical information, with the ability to handle complex publications and content deliverables.
  • Review of drafts includes checking content pieces developed by other team members for clarity, perspective, accuracy, appropriateness for target audience, and overall quality, in line with all applicable guidelines and internal checklists.
  • Ensure training on relevant tools and processes, including new generative AI technology platforms, that ensure efficient and compliant execution of all medical affairs content.
  • Train other team members on processes, overall writing and presentation skills, and ability to adhere to quality standards.
  • Provide solutions to authors for any of the projects led by self and collaborate with other teams to drive these solutions (Graphics, Compliance agency, Statistics teams, etc.).
  • Maintain strong working relationships and open communication with stakeholders and cross functional teams, including representing the team at the Scientific Publication Committee Meetings.
  • Ensure delivery of all projects within expected timelines while adhering to all quality and compliance requirements for medical content.
  • Provide subject matter expertise on a breadth of medical content types, stay abreast of industry best practices / trends, and drive innovation for cutting-edge medical communication strategies including digital, dynamic, interactive, and modular formats.
  • Ensure training on relevant tools and processes, including new generative AI technology platforms, that ensure efficient and compliant execution of all medical affairs content.
  • Track the progress of all projects and resolve any issues/problems with guidance from the Team Lead.
  • Identify and train to become an expert on new tools/skills for content creation representing the latest trends in the. Ensure training across the broader MCCS team.
  • Serves as therapeutic area & product expert and functional subject matter expert (innovative publications & medical content) and role model for MCCS team
  • Develop and maintain repositories to enable effective transfer of TA knowledge. Contribute to development of internal process documents such as checklists, process maps, etc.

Basic Qualifications

· Advanced scientific degree, (eg, MRes, MPharm, MSc, PhD, PharmD, MBBS/MD, MSc, MPH)

· 7-14 years of experience in Writing/Developing Medical content for the pharmaceutical industry, academic settings, CRO, or biotech company

· Ability to lead and execute a project end-to-end

· Strong interpersonal skills to quickly build rapport and credibility with team members, authors and key external stakeholders cross culturally/regionally to drive solutions ahead.

· Effective English verbal and written communication with flexibility to be clear, consistent, compliant, and appropriate for a variety of settings.

· Demonstrated ability to lead projects independently and engage diverse stakeholders.

· Understand the applications of technology to medical content development.

Preferred Qualifications

· Experience in creating and developing medical content

· ISMPP-CMPP®

· Multimedia and omnichannel experience

· Rapid adoption of new digital content, technology, and resources

· Global experience (either work or education)

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.


We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose. We move with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart.


About the Role

We are seeking a Senior SharePoint Developer to join our team. As a Senior SharePoint Developer, you will design, build, and modernize scalable SharePoint Online and Microsoft 365 solutions that help clinical research teams work more efficiently, securely, and with confidence. This position plays a key role in solution design, application modernization, process automation, and enterprise governance, and it supports the digital tools that keep clinical research operations running smoothly.


You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams, follow enterprise security and change-management standards, and contribute from requirements gathering through production support. Responsibilities include delivering SharePoint Online and Microsoft 365 solutions, modernizing SPFx applications, and building integrations and automation, with opportunities to deepen your expertise and influence how technology supports study outcomes.


You'll join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through modern SharePoint development, process automation, and system integration. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Senior SharePoint Developer can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research.

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and support scalable SharePoint Online and Microsoft 365 solutions.
  • Develop and modernize SharePoint solutions using SPFx, TypeScript, React, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and Fluent UI.
  • Build Power Apps and Power Automate solutions that digitize and automate business processes.
  • Develop integrations using Microsoft Graph, SharePoint REST APIs, PnP PowerShell, Node.js, custom connectors, and Azure services.
  • Design and implement SharePoint sites, lists, libraries, content types, metadata, permissions, navigation, and information architecture.
  • Upgrade and modernize existing SPFx solutions to supported and current versions, addressing dependency, compatibility, security, and performance requirements.
  • Troubleshoot complex application, integration, authentication, performance, deployment, and production issues.
  • Produce solution designs, technical specifications, deployment documentation, and support procedures.
  • Ensure solutions comply with enterprise security, governance, SDLC, change-management, and quality requirements.

You'll thrive in this role if you bring

  • Strengths in SharePoint Online and Microsoft 365, SharePoint Framework (SPFx), and Power Apps and Power Automate.
  • An interest in working in regulated or life-sciences environments, where solution quality and governance are essential.
  • The ability to collaborate across teams, manage stakeholders, and communicate clearly.
  • A quality-driven mindset with strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
  • Comfort working with Git, Azure DevOps, CI/CD concepts, and Agile development.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline (Mathematics, Science, Engineering, Computing, etc.) or a related study, or equivalent project-related experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in SharePoint, proven experience developing and supporting enterprise SharePoint Online and Microsoft 365 solutions.
  • Strong hands-on experience with SPFx and modern SharePoint development, including upgrading existing SPFx solutions to newer supported versions.
  • Experience in SharePoint governance, administration, and archival solutions, including content lifecycle management, retention, migration, and legacy SharePoint decommissioning.
  • Strong experience with TypeScript, React, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and Node.js.
  • Experience developing business solutions using Power Apps and Power Automate.
  • Experience with Microsoft Graph, REST APIs, authentication, integrations, and Microsoft 365 and Azure services.
  • Experience modernizing or migrating legacy SharePoint applications to SharePoint Online.
  • Experience across the full development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex SharePoint, SPFx, integration, authentication, and performance issues.
  • Experience with Agile development, Git and Azure DevOps, release management, and technical documentation.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with relevant Azure services.
  • Experience working in regulated or life-sciences environments.

About CG Oncology, Inc.

Are you ready to make a difference in the world and become part of our patient-centered team that is focused on Attacking Bladder Cancer for a Better Tomorrow? At CG Oncology, we believe that by having exceptionally talented individuals on our team who share our passion and enjoy working together, we can truly achieve our Vision and Mission to benefit patients around the world.

Every day we are making significant advancements across our multiple pipelines and are growing rapidly to meet the needs of our patients who cannot afford to wait to benefit from our novel immunotherapies. Please review this job posting and our Values and if they resonate with you and are what you expect from your organization and team, then we would like to hear from you.

About the role

The Regional Business Director, Southwest is a remote, field-based leadership role covering the Southwest region. The preferred candidate must reside within reasonable driving distance of a major metropolitan hub such asDallas, Houston, Austin, TX or Arizonato support efficient access to key accounts, field team oversight, and regional travel.

CG Oncology is seeking a high-impact Regional Business Director to lead regional commercialization efforts and drive launch excellence for Cretostimogene. This leader will build, develop, and hold accountable a high-performing team of Uro-Oncology Key Account Managers (UKAMs) to deliver regional revenue and business objectives and achieve incentive compensation plan targets in alignment with national strategy.

The Regional Business Director operates as a regional commercial operator — accountable for sales performance, strategic account execution, cross-functional enterprise management and alignment, and disciplined resource stewardship. This role requires deep expertise in complex healthcare ecosystems, including IDNs/Academic, private equity-backed networks, large physician groups, and buy-and-bill environments.

Reporting to the Associate Vice President of Sales, the RBD will design and execute regional business plans, mobilize enterprise stakeholders to accelerate market adoption, and ensure compliant, patient-centric commercialization. This is a critical leadership role responsible for delivering launch performance, strengthening strategic customer partnerships, and building sustainable regional growth in a high-visibility, startup first-commercial-launch environment.

Essential Functions

I. Commercial Performance & Incentive Accountability

  • Achieve Launch Excellence as defined by the Launch Scorecard.
  • Achieve or exceed annual (and/or quarterly and mid-year) regional sales goals.
  • Achieve regional incentive compensation plan targets and drive balanced quota attainment across all Uro-Onc Key Account Managers (UKAMs).
  • Ensure disciplined execution of quarterly, bi-annual and annual incentive plans aligned to national strategy and ethical commercialization standards.
  • Monitor performance analytics, pipeline strength, and territory execution to proactively mitigate underperformance.
  • Participate in the development and implementation of national and regional sales strategy and tactics.
  • Inform the organization of market trends, competitive intelligence, risks, and opportunities impacting launch success.

II. Strategic Account & Market Leadership

  • Develop, present, and execute quarterly regional business plans with clear, measurable objectives aligned to national priorities and strategic plan.
  • Collaborate with HSDs and all field-facing roles to develop and execute large healthcare systems, Private Equity, IDN/Academic, VA/DoD, and Top LUGPA strategic account plans.
  • Align enterprise account strategies with local market execution and leadership.
  • Lead and mobilize pull-through execution meetings with market stakeholders to ensure strategic alignment with accountability.
  • Facilitate strategic engagement between CG Oncology ELT/senior stakeholders and key regional accounts.
  • Inform and influence Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs).
  • Develop customer-specific segmentation, strategic roadmaps, and account plans for all targeted accounts.
  • Intellectual curiosity; build and maintain strong, long-term customer partnerships that drive sustainable regional growth.

III. Talent Acquisition, Development & Performance Leadership

  • Recruit, hire, onboard, and develop a high-performing team of Uro-Onc Key Account Managers.
  • Establish clear roles, responsibilities, performance metrics, and expectations consistent with regional and national objectives.
  • Provide ongoing coaching, performance assessments, and structured feedback to optimize team effectiveness.
  • Execute disciplined performance management, including differentiation of high and low performers.
  • Lead responsible compensation planning, including merit increases, salary adjustments, promotions, and incentive payout governance.
  • Plan and execute Regional Sales Meetings to reinforce strategy, culture, and execution discipline.

IV. Cross-Functional Enterprise Mindset & Collaboration

  • Ensure strong collaboration and partnership with HSDs, FAMs, Market Access, Medical Affairs, Marketing, Operations, and other enterprise stakeholders.
  • Drive alignment between regional execution and national commercial objectives.
  • Establish and maintain effective regional communication channels.
  • Influence cross-functional partners to accelerate launch adoption and remove execution barriers.

V. Financial & Operational Stewardship

  • Develop and manage the assigned regional operational budget.
  • Optimize resource allocation to maximize return on investment.
  • Maintain disciplined territory planning and operational execution.
  • Ensure compliance with all financial, regulatory, and company policies.

VI. Values-Based & Compliant Leadership

  • Serve as a role model for compliant behavior consistent with CG Oncology’s mission, vision, and values.
  • Model high-touch, influential relationship management for team members.
  • Inspire and motivate individuals and teams around a shared launch vision.
  • Lead through change and ambiguity with resilience and accountability.
  • Uphold the highest standards of ethical commercialization and patient-centric engagement.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in related field.
  • Minimum of 10 years of pharmaceutical sales and marketing experience is necessary.
  • Must be willing to travel up to 75% inclusive of overnights to meet with customers, internal stakeholders, relevant conferences, and other CG specific events.
  • Candidates should possess at least 5 years of notable experience in sales leadership.
  • Biotech or pharmaceutical US marketplace launch experience required.
  • Exhibit substantial expertise in overseeing and optimizing the management of regional accounts, ensuring strategic alignment and operational excellence across all levels.
  • Demonstrated exceptional skills in achieving consensus and fostering strategic collaborations with stakeholders from multiple functions.
  • Proven track record in cultivating talent and driving the professional advancement of team members through strategic mentorship and targeted development initiatives.
  • Demonstrated expertise in recruiting, attracting, and nurturing high-caliber sales professionals.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset; resourceful, resilient, and motivated by working in a small-company environment with high visibility, high freedom and high responsibility.
  • Exceptional communication and collaboration skills; able to flex between strategic framing and hands-on execution.

Work Authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

Please note that CG Oncology does not accept unsolicited information and/or resumes from search firms or agencies for our job postings. Any resumes or client information submitted to our careers page or any employee of CG Oncology by any search firm or agency without an applicable contract in place will become the property of CG Oncology and no fee(s) will be paid.

Total Rewards

CG Oncology offers very competitive and comprehensive Total Rewards, helping to support and reward our global team of high-performing employees focused on developing bladder-saving therapeutics for patients afflicted with bladder cancer.

  • ANNUAL PERFORMANCE/MERIT REVIEWS

Well-Being Benefits

In addition to our Total Rewards, CG Oncology offers a variety of Well-Being Benefits to meet the majority of the needs of our unique and growing workforce. These benefits are designed to support our team to achieve a healthy balance between work and their personal lives to remain refreshed, engaged, and creating an environment where each person can find a deeper meaning and purpose in their work.

Well-Being Benefits eligibility begins the 1st of the month after hire. Overview

Build the Future

At McGraw Hill, we are dedicated to delivering digital learning experiences that transform education for learners and educators. We are seeking a Senior Manager of Strategic Sourcing to join our Global Procurement team.

How can you make an impact?

The Senior Manager, Strategic Sourcing is responsible for setting and leading sourcing strategies for enterprise services categories that directly impact operating capacity, cost structure, and delivery outcomes. This role serves as a senior sourcing partner and works closely with Technology, HR, Finance, Legal, and business stakeholders to translate service demand into commercially disciplined sourcing and contracting outcomes.

Category scope includes, but is not limited to, marketing and agency services, HR-related services, fleet and mobility, facilities-adjacent services, application development and maintenance (ADM), IT outsourcing (ITO), consulting and advisory services, and contingent labor. The Manager leads sourcing events and negotiations, manages supplier relationships, and ensures sourcing activities comply with procurement governance and risk standards.

Success is demonstrated through disciplined commercial outcomes at the portfolio level, sustained strategic supplier performance, executive stakeholder confidence in service delivery, and consistent execution of sourcing processes across assigned categories.

We have two openings for this position to join our Global Procurement team. This role works remotely from a home office, this is a critical position for supporting the Strategic Sourcing organization. This position may travel 3-4 times per year for in-person meetings. This role is open to applicants authorized to work for any employer in the United States.

What you will be doing:

Category Strategy & Market Insight

  • Set multi-year corporate services category or sub-category strategies aligned to enterprise delivery models and operating priorities, incorporating market rate trends and supplier capabilities, review and approve category and sub-category strategies developed by team members.

Commercial & Negotiation Capability

  • Lead the most complex, high-value negotiations for agreements, including master services agreements, enterprise rate cards, SOW structures, volume discounts, and commercial protections in partnership with Legal.

Analytical & Financial Acumen

  • Direct the financial and rate analyses that drive sourcing decisions; review and approve savings, cost avoidance, and value logic to ensure it is credible and tracked.
  • Own rate governance and compliance to contracted terms across the professional services portfolio, partnering with Finance to align results to budgets and forecasts.

Risk, Governance & Compliance

  • Identify and mitigate portfolio-level risks related to labor classification, supplier dependency and concentration, delivery performance, and contract compliance; escalate material risks to senior leadership with recommended mitigations.
  • Ensure sourcing activities across the portfolio comply with procurement governance, labor policies, and documentation requirements; contribute to the development and refinement of those policies and standards.

Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead, coach, and develop sourcing team members, which may include Managers and Analysts; set clear expectations, manage performance, and hold team members accountable to execution standards for professional services sourcing. .

  • Strong analytical capability, including rate benchmarking and cost modeling; ability to challenge assumptions and defend recommendations with senior leadership.
  • In-depth knowledge of procurement governance and labor-related risk considerations, ability to apply and help shape policy.

Why work for us?

The work you do at McGraw Hill will be work that matters. We are collectively designing content that will build the future of education. Play your part and experience a sense of fulfillment that will inspire you to even greater heights.

  • Build product-level and industry-level unit economics frameworks that combine revenue, usage, cloud, and support cost data to show where business cases are strong or deteriorating, and flag products, industries, or contracts that need attention

  • Zero-defect and principles-first mindset
  • Excellent communication, presentation and facilitation skills with a proven ability to work collaboratively & influence across all levels of leadership

Preferred Qualifications

Esta posición no está enfocada en el desarrollo de software full-time ni requiere un nivel Senior de programación Java. Sin embargo, es indispensable contar con experiencia laboral real programando, así como con la madurez profesional, iniciativa y criterio técnico necesarios para investigar problemas, formular hipótesis, proponer soluciones y dar seguimiento a los incidentes.

Buscamos a una persona que vaya más allá de ejecutar instrucciones o escalar tickets, que disfrute entender cómo funcionan los sistemas y tenga interés en ampliar sus conocimientos en integraciones empresariales, seguridad, infraestructura y tecnología financiera.

Ubicación: México.

Modalidad: 100% remota.

Seniority: Intermedio, con experiencia profesional en Java.

Idioma: Inglés intermedio conversacional requerido para comunicación y soporte a clientes.

Requerimientos
Principales responsabilidades

  • Brindar soporte y asesoría técnica a equipos de ingeniería de clientes nacionales e internacionales durante la configuración, implementación y operación de integraciones tecnológicas.
  • Participar en la modernización de servicios web hacia APIs, acompañando a los clientes durante la transición y adopción de los nuevos mecanismos de integración.
  • Investigar incidentes técnicos mediante el análisis de logs, trazas, código Java, peticiones y mensajes de error.
  • Identificar si el origen de una falla corresponde a la aplicación, configuración del cliente, conectividad, cifrado o infraestructura.
  • Orientar a los equipos técnicos de los clientes en el consumo de servicios, configuración de conexiones y resolución de problemas de integración.
  • Aplicar conocimientos de programación Java para comprender el comportamiento de los servicios, identificar defectos y facilitar su resolución.
  • Realizar pruebas técnicas que permitan validar hipótesis, reproducir errores y comprobar el funcionamiento de las integraciones.
  • Coordinar la atención de problemas con equipos internos de desarrollo, arquitectura, infraestructura, seguridad y cumplimiento regulatorio.
  • Organizar sesiones técnicas con las áreas involucradas cuando la resolución de un incidente requiera conocimientos especializados.
  • Dar seguimiento a los problemas asignados hasta su resolución, manteniendo una comunicación clara y oportuna con los clientes.
  • Documentar hallazgos, causas de incidentes, soluciones y procedimientos técnicos.
  • Identificar oportunidades de mejora y automatización de procesos.


¿Qué tipo de retos técnicos encontrarás?
Durante tu participación en el proyecto, podrás enfrentarte a situaciones como:

  • Problemas de comunicación entre aplicaciones: investigar por qué un cliente no logra establecer comunicación con un servicio, diferenciando problemas de conectividad, configuración y errores de aplicación.
  • Errores en peticiones HTTP/HTTPS: identificar las diferencias entre un timeout, un error 404 u otros códigos de respuesta, determinando las posibles causas y acciones necesarias.
  • Problemas de cifrado y descifrado: analizar situaciones en las que los sistemas no logran procesar correctamente información cifrada, aplicando fundamentos de criptografía simétrica y asimétrica.
  • Análisis de logs y código Java: investigar el comportamiento de los servicios para determinar dónde se origina una falla y orientar su resolución.
  • Configuraciones de integración: asesorar a clientes cuyos equipos técnicos presentan dificultades para consumir APIs, configurar servicios web o establecer conexiones.
  • Incidentes de infraestructura y conectividad: identificar cuándo un problema está relacionado con VPN, redes, arquitectura o servicios en la nube y coordinar su atención con las áreas correspondientes.
  • Integraciones financieras: acompañar a clientes que requieren orientación técnica relacionada con sistemas de pagos y canalizar consultas regulatorias hacia los equipos especializados.


No tendrás que resolver todos los problemas por tu cuenta, pero sí deberás contar con el criterio técnico necesario para investigarlos, identificar su posible origen y movilizar a las áreas correspondientes hasta encontrar una solución.

Requirements

Experiencia y conocimientos indispensables

  • Experiencia laboral real en programación Java, preferentemente de 2 a 3 años o experiencia equivalente que demuestre los conocimientos requeridos.
  • Haber participado directamente en el desarrollo, mantenimiento o corrección de componentes de software utilizando Java.
  • Capacidad para leer, interpretar y analizar código Java.
  • Experiencia investigando errores, resolviendo defectos de software o diagnosticando problemas técnicos.
  • Fundamentos del funcionamiento y consumo de APIs y WebServices.
  • Comprensión del funcionamiento de peticiones HTTP y HTTPS.
  • Conocimiento de códigos de respuesta HTTP y capacidad para diferenciar errores de aplicación, problemas de conexión y timeouts.
  • Fundamentos de cifrado simétrico y asimétrico, incluyendo la comprensión de los procesos de cifrado y descifrado.
  • Capacidad para interpretar logs, trazas y mensajes de error.
  • Habilidad para realizar troubleshooting de manera estructurada, formular hipótesis y validar posibles causas de un problema.
  • Inglés intermedio conversacional, con capacidad para participar en llamadas y comunicarse con equipos técnicos de clientes internacionales.


Conocimientos y experiencia deseables

  • Experiencia en soporte de aplicaciones, soporte técnico especializado o soporte de segundo nivel (L2).
  • Experiencia en integraciones Host-to-Host (H2H).
  • Conocimientos de APIs REST y WebServices SOAP.
  • Manejo de herramientas para pruebas y diagnóstico de APIs, como Postman o similares.
  • Conocimientos de SFTP y mecanismos de intercambio de información entre sistemas.
  • Fundamentos de bases de datos y SQL.
  • Conocimientos básicos de redes, VPN y conectividad.
  • Nociones de arquitectura de software e infraestructura en la nube.
  • Experiencia con herramientas de gestión de tickets e incidentes.
  • Experiencia brindando asesoría técnica a clientes empresariales.
  • Conocimiento del sector financiero, plataformas de pagos electrónicos o SPEI.
  • Conocimientos de automatización de procesos.
  • Interés o experiencia en desarrollo de agentes de inteligencia artificial.


No es indispensable contar con experiencia previa en integraciones H2H, sistemas de pagos o desarrollo de agentes de IA. Valoramos especialmente tu experiencia práctica en Java, tus fundamentos técnicos y tu capacidad para aprender y resolver problemas.

Habilidades y competencias

  • Pensamiento analítico y razonamiento técnico.
  • Autonomía para investigar problemas sin depender exclusivamente de procedimientos preestablecidos.
  • Capacidad para formular hipótesis, realizar pruebas e interpretar resultados.
  • Proactividad e iniciativa para buscar soluciones.
  • Madurez profesional y sentido de responsabilidad sobre los incidentes asignados.
  • Comunicación efectiva con clientes y equipos de ingeniería.
  • Capacidad para explicar conceptos técnicos de manera clara y estructurada.
  • Liderazgo transversal y capacidad para coordinar actividades con diferentes áreas, sin necesidad de tener personal a cargo.
  • Criterio para reconocer cuándo un problema requiere la intervención de un especialista.
  • Orientación al servicio y empatía con el cliente.
  • Curiosidad tecnológica y disposición para adquirir nuevos conocimientos.


¿Qué podrás aprender y desarrollar en esta posición?

  • Integraciones tecnológicas empresariales y mecanismos de comunicación Host-to-Host (H2H).
  • Modernización de servicios web hacia arquitecturas de integración basadas en APIs.
  • Diagnóstico de incidentes en plataformas financieras y sistemas de pagos electrónicos.
