  • Proven success improving organic rankings, website traffic, and qualified lead generation.
  • Strong knowledge of technical SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, and content optimization.
  • Hands-on experience with GA4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar tools.
  • Experience managing Google Ads and paid social media campaigns.
  • Familiarity with WordPress, Webflow, or other CMS platforms.
  • Understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO), landing pages, and lead generation funnels.
  • Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to translate data into actionable improvements.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple campaigns and meet deadlines.

  • Experience with Looker Studio and advanced marketing reporting.
  • Certifications in Google Ads, Google Analytics, HubSpot, or SEO.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You take ownership of marketing performance and focus on measurable results.
  • You understand how SEO, paid advertising, content, and conversion optimization work together.
  • You can independently develop strategies, execute campaigns, and analyze performance.
  • You’re proactive about identifying growth opportunities and testing improvements.
  • You stay informed about search engine updates and emerging AI-powered marketing trends.
  • You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with remote teams.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing GA4, Google Search Console, and advertising dashboards to evaluate traffic, keyword rankings, and lead generation performance. You’ll investigate SEO opportunities, optimize paid campaigns, update website content, or improve landing page conversions.

You may also configure marketing automation workflows, analyze campaign results, and collaborate with sales or development teams to implement improvements.

In short: You’ll manage SEO, paid advertising, analytics, and marketing automation to generate qualified leads and drive measurable business growth.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Success in this role will be measured through:

jobs.excerpt: Cargo: Líder de Economías Propias Tipo de contrato: Contratista Independiente Internacional Organización: Amazon Frontlines Ubicación laboral: Remoto, base en Ecuador (viajes frecuentes a territorio amazónico) Ciudad/País: Ecuador Reporta a: Director de Programas Sobre Amazon Frontlines: Amazon Frontlines (amazonfrontlines.
jobs.description:
Cargo: Líder de Economías Propias

Tipo de contrato: Contratista Independiente Internacional

Organización: Amazon Frontlines

Ubicación laboral: Remoto, base en Ecuador (viajes frecuentes a territorio amazónico)

Ciudad/País: Ecuador

Reporta a: Director de Programas

Sobre Amazon Frontlines:

Amazon Frontlines (amazonfrontlines.org) es una organización sin fines de lucro 501(c)(3) con sede en la región amazónica del Ecuador. Amazon Frontlines combate la crisis climática asegurando la gestión indígena de la selva amazónica. Construimos poder junto a líderes indígenas para conformar un baluarte de resistencia en toda la Amazonía alta, trabajando juntos en lo profundo del bosque, en nuestro centro de organización en el noreste de Ecuador y en los espacios de poder a nivel mundial. Nuestra misión se guía por un compromiso con la conservación ambiental y el empoderamiento de las comunidades indígenas a través de alianzas y prácticas sostenibles.

Descripción del puesto:

Para los pueblos A’i Cofán, Siona, Siekopai y Waorani, defender el territorio también significa poder vivir bien en él. Cuando las familias no encuentran en su territorio los medios para sostener su vida, crece la presión del extractivismo, la dependencia de economías externas y la migración de los jóvenes, y con ellas se debilitan la cultura, la vida organizativa y la selva.

Para responder a este desafío, Amazon Frontlines está construyendo el área de Economías Propias, un área emergente que busca trabajar junto con los pueblos indígenas para que la selva siga en pie y la cultura viva y que esto sea la base de una vida digna para las familias y comunidades. El área se organiza en tres ejes: Economías para la reproducción biocultural, Economías para la autonomía familiar y comunitaria y Economías para la sostenibilidad política y territorial. Desde estos ejes se impulsan la soberanía alimentaria, iniciativas productivas y comerciales gestionadas por las propias comunidades y/o asociaciones, con un rol protagónico de las mujeres y jóvenes, y recursos propios que fortalezcan la autonomía de las nacionalidades y sus organizaciones.

El/la Líder de Economías Propias será responsable del direccionamiento estratégico, la planificación y gestión integral del área, en coherencia con las prioridades de Amazon Frontlines y la Alianza Ceibo, y las visiones, necesidades y potencialidades de las nacionalidades y sus territorios.

Trabajará transversalmente con las coordinaciones regionales, las áreas programáticas y de soporte de Amazon Frontlines y las instancias directivas y técnicas de la Alianza Ceibo. Asimismo, impulsará alianzas estratégicas que fortalezcan las iniciativas económicas territoriales.

Se requiere una persona con visión estratégica y sensibilidad intercultural, capaz de traducir estrategias en planes, presupuestos y resultados concretos, respetando las estructuras de gobierno propio, los tiempos y las decisiones de los pueblos indígenas.

Responsabilidades específicas

Iniciativas económicas en territorio

  • Sistematizar las iniciativas económicas acompañadas por Amazon Frontlines y la Alianza Ceibo, identificando logros, desafíos y aprendizajes.
  • Fortalecer la soberanía alimentaria mediante sistemas productivos tradicionales, diversidad de semillas y conocimientos asociados.
  • Promover iniciativas basadas en conocimientos tradicionales y el uso sostenible de productos del bosque, fortaleciendo la transmisión intergeneracional de saberes.
  • Acompañar iniciativas productivas y comerciales, desde la producción y el valor agregado hasta el acceso a mercados justos.
  • Fortalecer las capacidades organizativas, administrativas y financieras para la gestión autónoma de iniciativas y la reinversión de recursos propios, incluyendo fondos comunitarios.
  • Impulsar iniciativas que generen recursos propios para las organizaciones indígenas y la Alianza Ceibo, fortaleciendo su autonomía, gobernanza y defensa territorial.
  • Promover las economías propias como alternativa al extractivismo, evitando impactos territoriales y conflictos internos, asegurando una distribución justa de beneficios y respetando las decisiones colectivas.
  • Impulsar tecnologías apropiadas para el acceso a agua segura, energía y conectividad, en articulación con la línea de agua y solar.

Dirección estratégica y planificación

  • Orientar el desarrollo del área, asegurando la coherencia de sus intervenciones, alianzas y decisiones con las prioridades institucionales y territoriales.
  • Liderar los planes y presupuestos anuales, concertando prioridades, metas y acciones con las coordinaciones Norte, Centro-Sur y Perú y la Alianza Ceibo.
  • Concertar los planes con el Directorio de la Alianza Ceibo y sustentar los requerimientos presupuestarios ante la Dirección de Programas y las instancias correspondientes de Amazon Frontlines.

Seguimiento, evaluación y gestión del conocimiento

  • Traducir las orientaciones estratégicas en metas e indicadores, asegurando su implementación, seguimiento y evaluación.
  • Coordinar con ambas organizaciones la programación, monitoreo y evaluación de las acciones de campo.
  • Comunicar avances, resultados, desafíos y aprendizajes a las instancias directivas, facilitando la toma de decisiones y la transparencia.

Articulación y transversalización

  • Articular con la Dirección de Programas, la Dirección Ejecutiva y el Directorio de la Alianza Ceibo las economías propias con las demás líneas de trabajo: educación propia, agua y solar, defensa territorial y comunicación.
  • Promover la incorporación transversal del enfoque de economías propias, facilitando acuerdos y acciones conjuntas entre las áreas de ambas organizaciones.
  • Integrar criterios de equidad de género y participación intergeneracional en la planificación, presupuestación, implementación y evaluación de iniciativas.

Alianzas y movilización de recursos

  • Gestionar alianzas con universidades, ONG, empresas, mercados, gobiernos locales y otros actores estratégicos.
  • Liderar el diseño técnico de propuestas basadas en el potencial biocultural y las prioridades territoriales.
  • Coordinar con Recaudación de Fondos la identificación de oportunidades de financiamiento, formulación de propuestas y relaciones con donantes, aportando insumos técnicos, programáticos y presupuestarios para propuestas y reportes.

Gestión de riesgos y fortalecimiento institucional

  • Anticipar riesgos institucionales, financieros, operativos y territoriales, promoviendo medidas de mitigación y ajustes estratégicos.
  • Impulsar la incorporación del enfoque de economías propias en la identidad, estructura, agenda e instrumentos de gestión de ambas organizaciones.

Perfil requerido

Formación académica y experiencia profesional

  • Título de tercer nivel en Ciencias Sociales, Económicas o Ambientales.
  • Deseable formación de cuarto nivel en Administración de Empresas, Gestión de Proyectos, Cooperación Internacional, Desarrollo Territorial o afines.
  • Mínimo 5 años de experiencia en dirección, coordinación o gestión de programas y proyectos de desarrollo económico, fortalecimiento organizativo o iniciativas productivas sostenibles.
  • Experiencia con pueblos y nacionalidades indígenas y organizaciones de base, de segundo y/o tercer grado, preferentemente en la Amazonía.
  • Experiencia en planificación estratégica y operativa, gestión presupuestaria, gestión de equipos y evaluación de resultados.
  • Experiencia en gestión de alianzas con universidades, ONG, empresas, mercados, gobiernos locales y organismos de cooperación.
  • Experiencia en identificación de oportunidades económicas, cadenas de valor, desarrollo de mercados e iniciativas productivas y comerciales.
  • Experiencia en formulación de propuestas y movilización de recursos para programas e iniciativas territoriales.

Competencias y habilidades

  • Visión estratégica para orientar procesos institucionales, establecer prioridades y articular líneas programáticas.
  • Capacidad para facilitar el diálogo, construir acuerdos y armonizar prioridades entre diferentes actores.
  • Capacidad para traducir estrategias en planes, presupuestos, metas e indicadores SMART.
  • Capacidad para identificar oportunidades económicas basadas en el patrimonio biocultural, los conocimientos tradicionales y las visiones de vida de las nacionalidades.
  • Habilidad para identificar oportunidades de financiamiento y construir propuestas técnicas y estratégicas.
  • Capacidad para promover el trabajo colaborativo, la construcción colectiva y acompañar equipos multidisciplinarios.
  • Capacidad para integrar la equidad de género y la participación intergeneracional en la gestión de iniciativas.
  • Idiomas: español nativo o equivalente. Inglés deseable.

Competencias personales

  • Sensibilidad intercultural y respeto por las estructuras de gobierno propio, los tiempos y las decisiones de los pueblos indígenas.
  • Escucha activa, diálogo, construcción de consensos e interlocución política e institucional.
  • Pensamiento crítico, estratégico y adaptación a contextos complejos.
  • Orientación a la colaboración y al aprendizaje institucional.
  • Iniciativa, autonomía y capacidad para resolver problemas.
  • Integridad, transparencia y compromiso con los derechos colectivos y la autodeterminación indígena.

Lugar de trabajo:

La posición estará basada en Ecuador, con disponibilidad para realizar viajes frecuentes a los territorios de las nacionalidades en la Amazonía ecuatoriana y viajes ocasionales a Perú, según las necesidades del área.

Amazon Frontlines es un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades y no discrimina por motivos de raza, nacionalidad, etnia, religión, creencias políticas, edad, género, orientación sexual o clase social. En línea con nuestro compromiso con la diversidad, alentamos especialmente a postular a personas de pueblos indígenas y comunidades afrodescendientes.

Business Intelligence Developer (Power BI & GIS) – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Business Intelligence Developer to build advanced analytics solutions, dashboards, and reporting systems that help utility organizations make smarter infrastructure decisions.

This is a highly technical role focused on transforming time-series, geospatial, and asset data into scalable Power BI dashboards, automated reporting systems, and actionable business insights. You’ll work with modern Microsoft technologies, GIS platforms, and cloud infrastructure to deliver solutions that improve operational visibility and decision-making.

If you’re passionate about data visualization, geospatial analytics, and solving complex business problems through data, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Business Intelligence & Dashboard Development

  • Design and develop advanced Power BI dashboards and reports.
  • Build scalable data models for large operational datasets.
  • Transform complex time-series, geospatial, and asset data into meaningful visualizations.
  • Develop automated reporting solutions that support business decision-making.
  • Optimize dashboard performance, usability, and reliability.

Data Modeling & Analytics

  • Build robust data models using:
    • SQL
    • Python
    • Power BI
  • Analyze complex operational datasets and generate actionable insights.
  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reporting integrity.
  • Support advanced analytics across multiple business functions.

GIS & Geospatial Analytics

  • Develop reporting solutions using Esri GIS.
  • Integrate geospatial datasets into Power BI reporting.
  • Create visualizations that support infrastructure planning and asset management.
  • Help simplify complex utility and engineering concepts into user-friendly reporting.

Azure & System Integrations

  • Develop cloud-based reporting solutions using:
    • Microsoft Azure
    • Microsoft Fabric
  • Build integrations using APIs and cloud services.
  • Maintain scalable reporting infrastructure.
  • Support automation and data synchronization across business systems.

Collaboration & Product Development

  • Collaborate with product, engineering, and business teams.
  • Translate technical requirements into scalable reporting solutions.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of reporting platforms.
  • Support UI and reporting enhancements using design specifications.

What Success Looks Like

  • High-quality dashboards are delivered on schedule.
  • Reporting systems remain reliable and scalable.
  • Backlog tickets and feature requests are resolved efficiently.
  • Stakeholders confidently use reporting to support decision-making.
  • Existing systems are continuously improved to meet evolving client needs.
  • Complex infrastructure data becomes easy to understand and act upon.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You enjoy solving complex analytical problems.
  • You’re comfortable working with large, structured datasets.
  • You can simplify technical information into meaningful business insights.
  • You enjoy combining geospatial analytics with business intelligence.
  • You’re curious, detail-oriented, and continuously looking for better solutions.
  • You’re motivated by building products that create measurable real-world impact.

Required Experience & Skills

Experience

  • Advanced proficiency with Power BI.
  • Strong experience using:
    • SQL
    • Python
    • Business Intelligence tools
  • Proven experience developing dashboards and automated reporting solutions.
  • Experience working with:
    • Time-series data
    • Geospatial data
    • Asset management datasets
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear reporting solutions.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Esri GIS (strongly preferred).
  • Familiarity with:
    • Microsoft Azure
    • Microsoft Fabric
    • API integrations
  • Experience within:
    • Water infrastructure
    • Utilities
    • Engineering
  • Experience with:
    • React
    • Blazor
  • Interest in using data to improve public infrastructure and utility operations.

Tech Stack

  • Power BI
  • Esri GIS
  • Microsoft Azure
  • Microsoft Fabric
  • SQL
  • Python
  • Reporting Hub
  • IconMaps
  • Figma
  • ClickUp
  • REST APIs

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Build and optimize Power BI dashboards.
  • Analyze time-series and geospatial datasets.
  • Develop SQL queries and Python scripts for reporting.
  • Integrate GIS data into business intelligence solutions.
  • Collaborate with engineering and product teams.
  • Resolve feature requests and improve reporting systems.
  • Test and deploy dashboard updates.
  • Continuously improve data quality, automation, and performance.

In short: You’ll transform complex infrastructure and geospatial data into intuitive dashboards and reporting solutions that help utility organizations make better operational and investment decisions.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Number of dashboards successfully delivered.
  • Feature requests and backlog items completed.
  • On-time project delivery.
  • Dashboard performance and reliability.
  • Stakeholder adoption and satisfaction.
  • Reporting accuracy and usability.
  • Continuous improvement of reporting systems.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Work on meaningful projects that support critical public infrastructure.
  • Combine business intelligence, GIS, cloud technologies, and advanced analytics.
  • Opportunity to work with modern Microsoft technologies and geospatial platforms.
  • Direct impact on how cities and utility organizations make infrastructure decisions.
  • Career progression into:
    • Senior BI Developer
    • Data Analytics Lead
    • Solutions Architect
    • Data Engineering Manager

Interview Process

  1. Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Technical Interview
  4. Technical Assessment
  5. Final Interview
  6. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

After submitting your application, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record a short 3–5 minute Intro Video. This is the first step in our hiring process and can be completed whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of multiple screening calls, you’ll have one opportunity to introduce yourself, discuss your experience with Power BI, SQL, Python, GIS, and Azure technologies, and explain how you’ve transformed complex datasets into actionable dashboards and reporting solutions. You’ll also have the opportunity to highlight your analytical thinking, technical problem-solving skills, and experience building scalable business intelligence solutions. Your video will be reviewed by the hiring team before moving forward to the technical interview.

You can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it—only your final version will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after applying.

Apply Now

If you’re passionate about business intelligence, geospatial analytics, and building data solutions that drive smarter infrastructure decisions, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help transform complex data into meaningful insights that create real-world impact.

Who we are

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Renewals are the core of a SaaS company's revenue. You own renewal targets for Samsara's Digital Mid-Market segment: setting customers up for success while maximising financial results. On every deal that means minimising attrition, locking in the best terms, spotting growth opportunities, feeding insights back to the business and closing 36-month renewals.

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center.   • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

In this role, you will:

  • Own 60+ renewals per quarter from end-to-end and exceed sales targets
  • Follow a structured scenario-based forecasting methodology
  • Engage with customers to identify and mitigate renewal risk and drive platform adoption at scale
  • Work cross-functionally with sales teams to solve problems and ensure a successful, smooth renewal
  • Contribute to an exceptional team environment that motivates the team to perform at its best
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

  • Business fluency in German (spoken and written).
  • 2+ years of full-cycle closing sales experience, ideally with mid-sized businesses in a high-transaction environment.

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. Job Title: Digital Marketing Manager (B2B)

About the Role

Our client is seeking a results-driven Digital Marketing Manager (B2B) to lead and scale the company’s marketing strategy across paid, organic, outbound, and brand channels.

This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on execution and is ideal for a growth-minded marketer who thrives in fast-paced environments, understands modern B2B marketing trends, and can drive measurable pipeline and revenue impact.

The Digital Marketing Manager will own the full marketing funnel — from demand generation and lead nurturing to brand positioning and performance optimization — ensuring consistent growth, high-quality lead flow, and strong brand visibility.

The ideal candidate is analytical, creative, execution-focused, and comfortable balancing strategy with day-to-day campaign management.

Responsibilities

Strategy & Marketing Leadership

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive B2B marketing strategy aligned with company growth goals
    • Own the marketing funnel end-to-end, from awareness and demand generation through lead nurturing and conversion
    • Partner closely with leadership and sales teams to align marketing initiatives with revenue objectives
    • Build, manage, and mentor high-performing marketing resources, agencies, or contractors as needed
    • Identify scalable growth opportunities across acquisition, retention, and brand channels

Campaign Management & Growth Execution

  • Lead and optimize multi-channel marketing campaigns across paid media, SEO, outbound, email marketing, social media, partnerships, and content
    • Manage budgets and allocate spend strategically to maximize ROI and efficiency
    • Oversee campaign messaging, positioning, and creative direction to maintain brand consistency
    • Launch and manage performance-driven campaigns focused on pipeline growth and customer acquisition
    • Test new acquisition channels, campaign structures, audiences, and messaging to improve results

Analytics, Optimization & Reporting

  • Track and analyze campaign performance metrics including CAC, CPL, ROAS, conversion rates, traffic, MQLs, SQLs, and revenue attribution
    • Build dashboards and reports using platforms such as HubSpot, Google Analytics, Looker Studio, or other analytics tools
    • Use data-driven insights to refine targeting, messaging, budget allocation, and campaign strategy
    • Present actionable recommendations and performance updates to leadership regularly
    • Continuously optimize campaigns through A/B testing and experimentation

Content, Branding & Messaging

  • Collaborate with content, design, and technical teams to ensure cohesive execution across channels
    • Guide messaging strategy and brand positioning to strengthen market visibility and engagement
    • Support content initiatives including blogs, landing pages, outbound messaging, and campaign assets
    • Ensure all marketing efforts align with brand voice, customer pain points, and business objectives

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with sales teams to improve lead quality, funnel conversion, and campaign alignment
    • Coordinate with operations and product stakeholders to ensure marketing supports business priorities
    • Contribute to broader growth strategy discussions and go-to-market initiatives

What Makes You a Perfect Fit

  • Strategic thinker who connects marketing execution to business outcomes
    • Hands-on operator comfortable managing campaigns and optimizing performance directly
    • Data-driven marketer who thrives on experimentation, testing, and continuous improvement
    • Creative storyteller capable of building compelling brand and campaign messaging
    • Strong communicator and collaborative leader who works effectively across teams

Required Experience & Skills

  • Proven experience in B2B marketing leadership roles such as Head of Marketing, Growth Lead, or Senior Marketing Manager
    • Demonstrated success driving measurable growth through paid ads, outbound marketing, SEO, and organic channels
    • Strong understanding of modern B2B marketing tools and platforms including LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, Meta Ads, HubSpot, analytics tools, and outbound systems
    • Experience balancing strategic planning with hands-on execution
    • Strong analytical mindset with experience interpreting performance data and optimizing campaigns accordingly
    • Excellent leadership, communication, and project management skills

Preferred Experience & Skills

  • Experience leading marketing functions in B2B service-based, SaaS, or professional industries
    • Background in account-based marketing (ABM) or performance-driven demand generation
    • Familiarity with CRM and automation platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or Marketo
    • Experience managing cross-functional marketing teams or external agencies
    • Strong branding, storytelling, and positioning capabilities
    • Experience scaling marketing systems in high-growth environments

What Does a Typical Day Look Like?

A Digital Marketing Manager’s day is a mix of strategic planning, campaign execution, and performance analysis. You will:

  • Review campaign dashboards and optimize active marketing initiatives
    • Collaborate with leadership, sales, and content teams to align priorities and messaging
    • Launch and refine campaigns across paid and organic channels
    • Monitor lead flow, pipeline quality, and funnel conversion performance
    • Test new acquisition ideas, audience segments, creatives, and messaging strategies
    • Analyze campaign data and prepare actionable reports and recommendations

In essence: you are responsible for driving pipeline growth, strengthening brand visibility, and ensuring marketing efforts generate measurable business impact.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs) and Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs)
    • Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) and Marketing ROI
    • Website traffic and conversion rate growth
    • Lead-to-opportunity and opportunity-to-customer conversion rates

• Paid campaign performance and ROAS

  • Brand visibility, engagement, and audience growth across channels

Interview Process

  • Application Review – Assessment of experience and role alignment
    • Initial Interview – Discussion of background, marketing expertise, and growth mindset
    • Technical Interview – Deep dive into strategy, campaign management, analytics, and execution capabilities
    • Final Interview – Leadership and culture fit discussion with the client team

• Offer & Background Verification

jobs.description:
Why Dechra?

At Dechra, you'll have the opportunity to work on innovative therapies that address meaningful unmet needs in veterinary medicine. You'll join a collaborative, science-driven environment where your expertise will directly influence the development of transformative treatments for companion animals around the world.

Job Purpose

The Biotherapeutics Innovation (BTI) team at Dechra discovers and develops novel therapeutic proteins for important diseases in veterinary species, with an initial focus on companion animals. BTI combines external technology partnerships with internal scientific and development expertise to advance differentiated, species-specific monoclonal antibody therapies for dogs and cats.

The Senior Principal Scientist is responsible for developing and applying clinical development and efficacy strategy across assigned BTI programs from candidate nomination through global regulatory approval. The role provides experienced scientific, clinical, operational and regulatory leadership across the development lifecycle, ensuring evidence-generation plans are robust, clinically relevant, feasible to deliver and aligned with requirements in the US, EU, and other key markets.

The role operates with a high level of independence, leads complex development questions, and provides broad input across multiple programs. It works with internal functions and external experts to translate disease understanding, clinical practice needs and program objectives into practical development strategies, study designs and regulatory evidence plans.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Clinical Development Strategy: Develop and apply integrated clinical development and efficacy strategies for assigned biotherapeutic programs, including proof-of-concept, dose selection, pilot and pivotal field studies.

  • Scientific and Clinical Leadership: Provide experienced input on disease biology, target product profile, clinical relevance, endpoints, comparators, inclusion criteria, dose rationale, translational evidence and benefit-risk considerations.

  • Study Design and Oversight: Lead the design and oversight of preclinical PK/PD and proof-of-concept studies, pilot studies and pivotal field efficacy studies, ensuring they are scientifically robust, clinically meaningful, proportionate to risk and feasible to deliver.

  • Program and Decision Support: Provide clear recommendations to support development decisions, issue resolution, risk management, project planning and progression of candidates through stage gates.

  • Regulatory Strategy and Submissions: Lead clinical and efficacy contributions to regulatory strategy, agency interactions and submissions, including NADA, Marketing Authorisation and Product Licence dossiers, in collaboration with Regulatory Affairs and other functions.

  • External Partner and Expert Engagement: Select and work with CROs, laboratories, investigators, referral centres, academic partners, consultants and KOLs to strengthen study design, delivery, endpoint selection, data interpretation and development strategy.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership:Align Clinical Operations, Statistics, Data Management, Clinical Supply, CMC, Discovery, Regulatory Affairs, QA, Safety and Procurement on evidence requirements, study plans, risks, decisions and documentation.

  • Capability Development:Mentor colleagues, share expertise, and contribute to improved clinical development approaches, standards, templates, disease models, endpoints and ways of working across BTI and Dechra R&D.

Essential Qualifications Experience :

  • DVM, VMD, or equivalent veterinary degree, or an advanced scientific qualification (MSc, PhD, Diplomate, Board Certification, or equivalent) in Veterinary Medicine, Pharmacology, Immunology, Biomedical Sciences, Animal Sciences, or a related discipline.

  • Significant experience developing clinical and efficacy strategies within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, animal health, or related research environments.

  • Demonstrated success designing, leading and interpreting proof-of-concept, dose-ranging, pilot, and pivotal studies.

  • Experience working with CROs, clinical investigators, laboratories, academic collaborators, consultants and external partners.

  • Strong understanding of global regulatory requirements, including FDA-CVM, EMA-CVMP, UK-VMD, VICH GCP and GLP principles.

  • Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, scientific leadership and decision-making skills.

jobs.excerpt: About Us Flourish and Thrive Labs is a woman-owned and led consulting firm specializing in public health solutions.
jobs.description:
About Us

Flourish and Thrive Labs is a woman-owned and led consulting firm specializing in public health solutions. Our team, composed of former public health officials, works with state and local health departments across the country, building resilient public health operating systems. We pride ourselves on being different, holding ourselves to high ethical standards, and taking care of each other.

We view our company as an urban neighborhood—a diverse group of individuals coming together to live and work, embracing the beauty in that diversity. We are a wacky bunch who are intent on spreading joy! (We just mailed out stickers to over 200 local health health professionals because we felt they could use more joy!)

As Salesforce, Microsoft, Snowflake, and AWS partners, we specialize in technology implementation with a strong people focus. We combine this with strategic planning, data analysis, coaching, and facilitation to effectively support local public health department staff.

Our core values are:

  • People First
  • Focus on Capacity Building
  • Belief in Continuous Experimentation
  • By Public Heath; For Public Health
  • We Do What Is Right. Always.

We're seeking passionate, joyful individuals who align with our ethos of being different and making a difference.

WE ARE LOOKING FOR A TEAM MEMBER WITH PUBLIC HEALTH EXPERIENCE (LOCAL/ TRIBAL/ STATE/ FEDERAL).

About Consulting at F&T Labs

If you're new to consulting, we want to help you understand what makes F&T Labs different and why our approach might be perfect for you. We know transitioning from government and non-profit to consulting can be a big step, but we've designed our work environment to blend the best of both worlds.

First, let's talk about how we work. Unlike traditional consulting firms, we hire you for a role, not a specific project. This means you can contribute to various initiatives that match your expertise and interests. Think of it as bringing your public health superpowers to different challenges where they're needed most.

We believe in measuring what matters. While many consulting firms focus on billable hours, we care about the quality and impact of your work. Time sheets don't measure your success with us – it's measured by the meaningful solutions you help create for our clients and their communities.

Yes, we have utilization targets (consulting speak for how much of your time is spent on client work), but we view these as guideposts rather than strict rules. They help us ensure we're making a sustainable impact while maintaining a healthy business. These targets are meant to motivate, not to create stress.

One of the most dynamic aspects of consulting is its natural rhythm. Some weeks might be bustling with activity, while others might be quieter. We embrace these ebbs and flows because they create space for both intense, focused work and time for learning, reflection, and personal growth. This is part of our philosophy that work and life shouldn't be at odds – they should be integrated in a sustainable and energizing way.

At our core, we're built on a simple belief: when our team members flourish, our clients flourish, and ultimately, communities thrive. That's why we've created an environment that supports your growth, values your expertise, and understands that the best solutions come from people who feel empowered and energized by their work.

If you're passionate about public health and excited about the possibility of expanding your impact through consulting, we'd love to talk with you. Your experience in public health is valuable, and we're here to help you apply it in new and meaningful ways.

Notice

No 3rd Party Recruiters. No Phone Calls. We are unable to do informational interviews at this moment. Candidates who call or schedule a "coffee chat" will be considered disqualified.

Solutions Analyst / Business Analyst

WE ARE LOOKING FOR A TEAM MEMBER WITH GOVERNMENT PUBLIC HEALTH EXPERIENCE, IDEALLY IN ENVIRONMENTAL HEALTH AT A LOCAL HEALTH DEPARTMENT. IF YOU HAVE THAT EXPERIENCE, PLEASE ENSURE IT IS CLEAR ON YOUR RESUME.

Compensation Note: If a salary range is listed for this position, please note that we will offer at the starting point of the band. We cover 100% of your health insurance!

Role Overview

We're seeking a Solutions Analyst who deeply understands how public health departments work and can translate that understanding into technology solutions that actually fit their needs. This role goes beyond gathering requirements. It requires immersing yourself in the workflows, challenges, and realities of public health practice, then figuring out how technology can make things better.

We're especially interested in candidates who have worked in environmental health programs at a local health department. You know what it's like to manage inspections, track permits, navigate compliance workflows, and juggle the reporting demands that come with environmental health. That firsthand experience will shape how you approach every solution you design.

This is a role for someone who naturally translates needs into action. You're the person who listens to a health department director describe their frustrations and can see the solution taking shape. You're the one who watches staff navigate a clunky process and immediately starts thinking about how it could work better. You take the messy, complex reality of public health operations and turn it into clear direction for a technical team to build against. If you've ever found yourself thinking "I know exactly what they need, I just need to explain it in a way the developers will understand," this role is for you.

You'll work on our PH360 platform and various client initiatives, serving as the critical bridge between what health departments need and what our technical teams build. Your lived experience in governmental public health will help you ask the right questions, spot the real problems behind stated requests, and advocate for solutions that work in the real world.

We're looking for someone who thinks holistically about problems, can synthesize input from multiple stakeholders, and isn't afraid to push back when a proposed solution doesn't quite fit. As a consulting firm, we value candidates who are passionate and eager to dive into the work. While this role focuses on solutions analysis, you may also contribute your unique talents to other firm initiatives.

How You'll Work

You'll join an Agile Release Train (ART) that follows SAFe principles. This means:

  • Program Increment (PI) Planning: You'll participate in quarterly planning sessions, helping shape the roadmap based on your understanding of client needs.
  • Sprint Collaboration: You'll work in two-week sprints with daily standups, regular backlog refinement, and sprint retrospectives.
  • Cross-functional Teams: You'll collaborate closely with developers, architects, and QA analysts to ensure solutions meet the real need.
  • Continuous Discovery: You'll maintain ongoing conversations with clients and stakeholders to refine your understanding of their challenges.

Key Responsibilities

  • Immerse yourself in client workflows to understand how public health staff actually do their work, with particular depth in environmental health programs
  • Identify pain points, inefficiencies, and opportunities that clients may not have articulated
  • Synthesize input from multiple stakeholders into coherent solution recommendations
  • Translate complex public health processes into clear user stories and acceptance criteria
  • Lead discovery sessions and workshops with health department staff
  • Serve as the voice of the client within our technical teams
  • Develop process flows, documentation, and visual aids that communicate the "why" behind solutions
  • Challenge assumptions and push back when proposed solutions don't fit client realities

Experience Required

  • 2+ years working in governmental public health (local, state, federal, or tribal)
  • Demonstrated ability to understand complex systems and workflows
  • Strong facilitation and stakeholder engagement skills
  • Experience translating between technical and non-technical audiences
  • Self-motivated with strong initiative
  • Adaptability in dynamic environments
  • Comfort working with AI tools and large language models

Strongly Preferred

  • Direct experience in environmental health programs at a local health department (e.g., inspections, permitting, compliance, complaint response)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with agile methodologies
  • Familiarity with user story development and acceptance criteria writing
  • Familiarity with Salesforce or similar platforms
  • Background in process improvement or system implementation
  • Understanding of public health data systems and reporting requirements (e.g., environmental health tracking, inspection databases)
  • Experience with discovery techniques (journey mapping, interviews, observation)

Notice

Must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship. Willingness to adhere to our no-drug workplace policy. You must agree to undergo eVerify for employment status at hiring.

No 3rd Party Recruiters. No Phone Calls. We are unable to do informational interviews at this moment. Candidates who call or schedule a "coffee chat" will be disqualified.

The Associate Director, Government Pricing & Gross-to-Net Operations serves as CG Oncology's subject matter expert for U.S. government pricing and reimbursement programs and the operational owner for Gross-to-Net (GTN) forecasting processes. The role leads execution of government pricing operations, GTN forecasting support, compliance, financial reporting, and process optimization. This position partners cross-functionally with Market Access, Finance, Commercial Analytics, Legal, Compliance, Accounting, Supply Chain, Patient Services, Distribution, Medical Affairs, and external vendors to ensure accurate government pricing calculations, compliant reporting, and effective support of commercialization and launch-readiness activities.

As CG Oncology continues to grow and commercialize its oncology portfolio, this role will lead government pricing execution across federal and state programs and serve as the day-to-day operational owner of GTN forecasting, GTN model maintenance, assumption management, variance analysis, and GTN reporting while strengthening operational controls and implementing scalable systems and processes that support long-term organizational growth.

Essential Functions

Government Pricing Operations

  • Maintain government pricing methodologies, assumptions, calculation documentation, and supporting procedures.

Gross-to-Net Forecasting, Financial Planning & Commercial Support

  • Lead the day-to-day operation and maintenance of the Gross-to-Net forecasting process, including model maintenance, methodology documentation, assumption management, version control, scenario analyses, and routine forecast updates.
  • Evaluate government pricing and GTN impacts associated with commercial contracting strategies, pricing decisions, channel strategy, patient support programs, distribution arrangements, and business development initiatives.

  • Partner with Business Analytics, own to validate and challenge payer mix, site-of-care mix, channel mix, and analog assumptions used in GTN forecasts.

  • Prepare GTN forecast packages, variance analyses, executive summaries, and management reports that communicate key drivers, risks, opportunities, and forecast movements.
  • Coordinate GTN data collection and assumption refresh activities across Business Analytics, Distribution, Patient Services, Contracting, Finance, Accounting, and Market Access.

Compliance, Audit & Risk Management

  • Maintain audit-ready documentation supporting government pricing methodologies and reporting.

  • Experience supporting Annual Operating Plan (AOP), Long Range Plan (LRP), quarterly forecast updates, and month-end close processes.
  • Strong understanding of payer mix dynamics, site-of-care economics, specialty distribution, specialty pharmacy / specialty distributor operations, 340B exposure, patient support programs, and government pricing implications.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex cross-functional forecasting and operational processes involving Finance, Accounting, Business Analytics, Market Access, Patient Services, Distribution, and external vendors

jobs.description:
ELESSAR SYSTEMS INC.

Training. Left of Launch.

POSITION DESCRIPTION

Chief Technology Officer (CTO), Elessar Systems

Join a talented founding team and lead the technical strategy, engineering delivery, and security of an AI-enabled defense training platform built to protect communities and critical infrastructure.

Position Summary

Elessar is hiring a Chief Technology Officer to own the technical strategy, engineering execution, and commercial readiness of Q2 Holodeck™. This is a hands-on executive role for someone who wants to do more than manage backlogs and sit in architecture reviews. You will take a working, sophisticated platform — real-time multiplayer simulation, AI-driven NPC decision agents, deterministic scoring, and automated after-action reporting — and transform it into a secure, supportable, commercially deployed product. You will lead the 12-week commercial release, build the technical team, own the security posture, and set the architecture for the next 24 months of growth.

You will join a small, talented team of technologists, operators, trainers, and business builders. The decisions you make will be visible. Your work will directly determine what Elessar can promise customers, when it can deliver, and how the product scales. The role is designed for a senior technical leader who is execution-oriented, intellectually honest about risk and remaining work, and energized by the challenge of building a company around genuinely differentiated technology.

About Elessar and Q2 Holodeck™

Elessar is a defense technology company commercializing Q2 Holodeck™, a browser-based, AI/ML-driven, scenario-based training and decision-rehearsal platform. Q2 Holodeck™ helps security, force-protection, and first-responder personnel identify a drone threat, select a lawful and effective response, and coordinate across agencies before a real event occurs. The platform is built to serve defense, homeland security, law enforcement, critical infrastructure, and allied markets.

Our immediate commercial objective is straightforward: release a verified product, land the first paying pilots, and convert those pilots into annual subscriptions and enterprise deployments. The CTO is the person who makes that sequence possible.

What Makes This Opportunity Different

  • Real technology, not a whiteboard. You will lead a platform with working, production-bound code — 75,000+ lines of Go, a live simulation engine, 26 operational scenarios, 93 documented system requirements, and a 24-month roadmap.
  • Direct access and real authority. You will work alongside the CEO, customers, operators, and sales executives — not filtered through layers of product management. You make architecture, security, and delivery decisions.
  • Equity. Your compensation includes possible equity participation in Elessar alongside a competitive base.
  • Founding executive. You will have direct influence over hiring, culture, and strategy as Elessar scales from pilot to enterprise.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Technology Strategy and Architecture (20%). Own the roadmap, translate customer and commercial requirements into engineering priorities, and make and document decisions on platform design, technical debt, integrations, and deployment profiles (cloud, air-gapped, edge).
  • Commercial Release Execution (25%). Lead the 12-week release from funded kickoff to signed pilot acceptance. Establish the delivery baseline, assign accountable owners, manage dependencies, and release against demonstrated security, functional, operational, and customer acceptance criteria. No untested claims ship.
  • Engineering Leadership and Team Building (20%). Recruit, develop, and coordinate software engineering, platform operations, QA, security, and AI/data capabilities. Manage contractors and technology partners. Establish a disciplined software development lifecycle — requirements traceability, code review, automated testing, CI/CD, controlled releases, and clear ownership.
  • Security and Reliability (15%). Own identity and access controls, tenant isolation, secrets management, monitoring, incident response, backup, recovery, and customer-specific assurance requirements. Lead the company toward FedRAMP-compatible and enterprise security posture.
  • AI and Data Engineering (10%). Govern document ingestion, scenario generation, source provenance, retrieval quality, model evaluation, and human review workflows. Preserve the integrity of deterministic simulation behavior and scoring independently of advisory AI layers.
  • Customer and Commercial Support (10%). Participate in technical discovery, demonstrations, proposals, integration planning, and customer assurance reviews. Ensure every commercial commitment reflects tested capabilities and supported configurations. Help Sales close by being the credible technical voice in the room.

Key Performance Objectives

OBJECTIVE - Baseline established

HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED - Requirements, implemented functionality, outstanding work, staffing, costs, and release-blocking risks reconciled and documented

HORIZON - Month 1

OBJECTIVE - Release candidate delivered

HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED - Approved instructor and participant workflows, scenario content, scoring, AAR, and operational controls demonstrated on a stable, pinned build

HORIZON - Weeks 8–10

OBJECTIVE - G1 pilot accepted

HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED - Signed pilot acceptance from a real customer for an explicitly named capacity and configuration; all SRD exceptions visible and dispositioned

HORIZON - Month 3

OBJECTIVE - Team and process in place

HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED - Release owner named; QA, security, and AI leads identified or contracted; CI/CD and controlled-release discipline operational

HORIZON - Month 3

OBJECTIVE - G2 infrastructure qualified

HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED - Shared data, tenant isolation, observability, recovery, and increased capacity operational and tested

HORIZON - Month 6

OBJECTIVE - Enterprise posture achieved

HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED - Enterprise identity, individual learning records, grounded AI assistance, and security certification readiness complete

HORIZON - Month 12

OBJECTIVE - Platform expanded

HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED - LMS integrations, disconnected/air-gapped deployment, and expanded capacity and content commercially supported

HORIZON - Month 24

Requirements

Qualifications

Required

  • Master’s degree or higher in computer science, engineering, mathematics, data science, or a closely related STEM discipline — or equivalent demonstrated experience at scale.
  • Ten or more years of relevant professional experience in software engineering, architecture, or technical leadership.
  • Prior executive experience at the VP of Engineering, VP of Technology, or CTO level, with accountability for strategy, delivery, staffing, and budgets.
  • Demonstrated success taking software from development or pilot stage into supported commercial operation — including real customers, real security reviews, and real SLAs.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary teams spanning software engineering, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, QA, and AI/data systems.
  • Proven ability to translate business objectives into funded technology roadmaps, measurable delivery commitments, and clear executive reporting.
  • Strong architectural and engineering judgment across cloud applications, real-time systems, APIs, databases, and distributed services.
  • Practical knowledge of application security, DevSecOps, reliability engineering, automated testing, incident management, and AI governance.
  • U.S. citizenship and willingness to complete any customer-required background or security process.

Preferred

  • Experience with simulation, training platforms, or enterprise learning systems.
  • Experience delivering products to government, defense, or public-safety customers — including navigating FedRAMP, ATO processes, or STIG compliance.
  • Familiarity with Go, React/TypeScript, Azure, WebSocket-based real-time systems, LMS interoperability (SCORM/xAPI), and offline or edge deployments.

· Active security clearance.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Execution orientation. Drives toward accepted outcomes — not activity. Knows the difference between code merged and requirement verified.
  • Technical honesty. Reports remaining work, risk, and cost accurately. Never overpromises to leadership or customers to protect a schedule.
  • Commercial instinct. Understands that the product’s purpose is a paying customer, not an elegant architecture. Balances engineering quality with delivery urgency.
  • Team builder. Recruits well, develops people, and creates accountability without bureaucracy.
  • Security judgment. Treats security as a customer requirement, not an afterthought. Knows what a government customer will ask and answers it before they do.
  • Clear communication. Explains technical trade-offs to executives, customers, and engineers without losing precision or patience.
  • Customer partnership. Engages with buyers during the sales cycle, earns technical credibility in discovery, and ensures that what Sales promises is what engineering supports.

Benefits

Compensation and Growth

  • Base salary. Competitive; commensurate with experience and provided during the interview process.
  • Equity. Equity participation in Elessar; structure and terms provided during the interview process.
  • Career growth. The CTO is a founding executive. As Elessar scales from first pilots to enterprise contracts and recurring revenue, the role grows in scope, team size, and market influence. Strong performers will have direct influence over company strategy, hiring, and product direction.

Working Conditions

  • Travel. Approximately 20–30% for customer engagements, demonstrations, security reviews, and industry events.
  • Remote work. This is a remote role requiring dependable availability, disciplined communication, and proactive coordination with a distributed team.
  • Security and confidentiality. Employment is contingent on appropriate background review and execution of confidentiality, intellectual-property, and company policy documents.
  • Performance environment. This is an accountable, results-oriented role in an early-stage company. Priorities will evolve as customer evidence, funding, and market opportunities develop. The CTO is expected to adapt and lead through that change.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Elessar, a subsidiary of Q2IMPACT™, is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on any characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Reasonable accommodations are available to applicants and employees with disabilities upon request.

jobs.title: Chief of Staff (BBS971)
jobs.excerpt: We're looking for a Chief of Staff to work directly with the CEO of a fast-growing company.
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Chief of Staff to work directly with the CEO of a fast-growing company. You will be the CEO's right hand, owning the operating rhythm, driving cross-functional initiatives, supporting decisions, and protecting the CEO's time, so the CEO can focus on what only the CEO can do.

The goal is leverage, not busyness. As a company grows, the CEO becomes the bottleneck for priorities, follow-through, and decisions. A good chief of staff removes that bottleneck. You will keep the leadership team aligned on what matters, make sure important commitments get done, bring decisions forward with a recommendation instead of a question, and take on special projects that need a trusted owner. You do not need to be the salesperson, the lawyer, or the product manager. You do need strong judgment, a bias for follow-through, and the confidence to tell a CEO "we said this was a priority and it still hasn't happened." The role starts with building core systems and grows into much broader ownership as you learn how the CEO thinks and as the company scales. If you are a systems-minded operator who asks good questions and gets things done, this role is a strong fit.

Why You'll Want to Join

  • You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)
  • Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy
  • Observance of Holidays per company guidelines
  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • This role requires availability during US business hours
  • Work directly with the CEO of a growing company, with a real seat close to the decisions
  • A role that is built to grow as you do, with a clear plan to hand lower-value work to others as the company scales

What You'll Work On

Operating Rhythm and Priorities

  • Run the company's operating rhythm, including weekly planning, leadership meetings, and regular reviews
  • Track company priorities and goals, and keep the leadership team aligned on what matters most
  • Agree with the CEO on the three outcomes that would make each week successful, and help hold the week to them

Cross-Functional Initiatives and Follow-Through

  • Drive important initiatives across teams, making sure each has a clear owner, timeline, next action, and known blockers
  • Track commitments and follow-ups from meetings and from partners, vendors, customers, and team members, and make sure they get done
  • Flag what is overdue, what has stalled, and what needs the CEO to move forward

Decision Support and Special Projects

  • Bring decisions to the CEO with the situation, the realistic options, your recommendation, and the decision needed
  • Run a decision queue so the CEO can clear accumulated decisions in a short session instead of being interrupted all day
  • Own research, analysis, and special projects that need a trusted, capable owner
  • Prepare briefings, updates, and materials for leadership and key stakeholders

CEO Time and Communications

  • Help design how the CEO's time is used by asking whether the CEO needs to be in a meeting, whether someone else could handle it, or whether it can be resolved asynchronously
  • Protect time for planning, strategy, and key relationships, and treat it like real meetings
  • Triage the CEO's inbox and surface only what needs the CEO's response or decision
  • Prepare the CEO for important meetings with context and goals, and follow up with decisions, commitments, and next actions

Learning the CEO and the Business

  • Learn the CEO's preferences and decision patterns, and build a living operating playbook covering scheduling, communication, priorities, approvals, and what to escalate
  • Ask whether each piece of direction is a one-time exception or a standing rule, and record the answer
  • Learn the company's offering, customers, and strategy well enough to represent it accurately and recognize what matters
  • Regularly ask what the CEO is doing that someone else could do, and propose processes that remove that work

Requirements

What You Bring

  • Experience as a chief of staff, senior operator, or strategy and operations lead supporting a founder or CEO, with a record of building systems and not only completing tasks
  • Strong judgment about what needs the CEO and what you can handle, and the confidence to push back when priorities slip
  • Proven follow-through across many people and teams, chasing commitments without being asked
  • Project management skills and the ability to drive work across functions without formal authority
  • Analytical ability and clear, concise writing that turns messy information into a short, useful update
  • Curiosity and willingness to ask questions, including ones you feel you should already know the answer to
  • Discretion with confidential and commercial information
  • Comfort using AI tools and tracking and collaboration tools to work faster
  • Excellent written and spoken English
  • Available to work full-time during US business hours

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting a founder or CEO at a small, fast-growing company
  • Background in operations, strategy, consulting, or program management
  • Experience building operating playbooks, trackers, and decision processes
  • Experience running leadership meetings, goal-setting cycles, or company planning

How to Apply

Please include:

  1. Your updated resume
  2. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, describing your chief of staff or senior operations experience, and walking through a system or process you built to keep a leader's priorities and commitments on track

Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

If you want to build the systems and judgment that let a CEO focus on what only they can do, and you want a role that grows as you prove yourself, this role gives you the access and the direct impact to do your best work.

Benefits

Application Process Overview

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

  1. Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
  2. Video Introduction - Record a video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
  3. Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
  4. Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team
  5. Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
  6. Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
  7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
  8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations. We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

jobs.excerpt: Tiger Analytics is a leading advanced analytics consulting firm and a trusted partner to several Fortune 100 companies, helping them unlock business value through data.
jobs.description:
Tiger Analytics is a leading advanced analytics consulting firm and a trusted partner to several Fortune 100 companies, helping them unlock business value through data. Our consultants bring deep expertise in Data Science, Machine Learning, and AI, and our impact and industry leadership have been recognized by leading research firms, including Forrester and Gartner.

Role Overview – Senior Manager, Data & AI

The Senior Manager, Data & AI will lead the Data Engineering, Business Intelligence, and AI teams supporting a manufacturing business, driving the development of trusted data assets, actionable insights, and intelligent solutions. Reporting to the Senior Director, Data, this role will own end-to-end delivery across the Data & AI portfolio, working closely with data leads and managers to drive execution across multiple workstreams.

Beyond delivery leadership, the role will serve as a strategic and hands-on partner to the Senior Director, Data, contributing to data strategy, technology direction, roadmap planning, new initiatives, and internal consulting. The ideal candidate will bring a strong blend of technical expertise and leadership experience across Data Engineering, BI, and AI, with a proven track record of delivering large-scale programs using platforms such as SAP S/4HANA, SAP Datasphere, Microsoft Azure, Snowflake, and Databricks.

Responsibilities

  • Strategy and planning: partner with the Senior Director, Data on the Data & AI roadmap, annual plan, new initiatives, business cases and budget.
  • Consulting and technology direction: advise business leaders on data and AI solutions; guide architecture, platform and vendor decisions.
  • Team leadership: lead and develop the Data Engineering, BI and AI teams, and coordinate data leads and managers on scope, standards and timelines.
  • Delivery: own end-to-end delivery of large-scale programs on time, on budget and to quality, managing risks, dependencies and partners.
  • Data engineering: oversee pipelines and platforms from SAP S/4HANA (CDS views, SLT) into Datasphere, Azure (ADF, Synapse, SQL Server), Snowflake and Databricks.
  • BI and analytics: drive consistent KPIs, semantic models and self-service reporting across business functions.
  • AI and ML: scale AI use cases such as forecasting, predictive maintenance and quality analytics into production with MLOps.
  • Governance: ensure data quality, security, compliance and responsible AI across the portfolio.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Statistics or a related field.
  • 15+ years in data and analytics, including 5+ years leading multi-disciplinary teams across data engineering, BI and AI/ML.
  • Proven record of leading large-scale data, BI and AI programs end to end, with budgets, multiple teams and external partners.
  • Hands-on background in data engineering, data warehousing and data modeling (dimensional and lakehouse patterns).
  • Strong experience with our tech stack: SAP S/4HANA, SLT, SAP Datasphere, SAP BDC, Microsoft Azure, SQL Server, ADF, Synapse, Snowflake and Databricks.
  • Practical experience with Microsoft Azure data services: Azure Data Factory, Synapse Analytics and SQL Server.
  • Delivery experience on Snowflake and Databricks, including performance and cost management.
  • Experience working closely with a senior data leader (Director or above) on strategy, planning, initiative shaping and stakeholder consulting.
  • Strong program management skills across agile and hybrid delivery, including risk, dependency and vendor management.
  • Excellent communication and the ability to explain data and AI choices to executives and plant-floor users alike.

Benefits

Significant career development opportunities exist as the company grows. The position offers a unique opportunity to be part of a small, fast-growing, challenging and entrepreneurial environment, with a high degree of individual responsibility.

Tiger Analytics provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law.

Our Opportunity:

Building on Purdue University's mission to provide greater access to affordable, high-quality education, Purdue University Global is a public, nonprofit institution offering a world-class education online. Purdue Global delivers personalized online education tailored to the unique needs of adults who have work or life experience beyond the classroom, enabling them to develop essential academic and professional skills with the support and flexibility they need to achieve their career goals.

The Senior Financial Analyst will provide support to Purdue University Global.

Job Summary:

The Senior Financial Analyst is responsible to design and prepare financial analysis and modeling related to academic or business strategic initiatives, proposals, and other ad hoc data requests. The Senior Financial Analyst assembles, analyzes, summarizes, and forecasts financial, economic and other data and oversees and reports on unique funding plans for programmatic initiatives. This role determines strategies for managing resources to capitalize on funding opportunities, advance priority initiatives, and identify operational efficiencies and presents findings and Analysis in formats appropriate for senior and executive management. The Senior Financial Analyst participates on project teams and committees to bring financial and data analysis leadership and perspective to the team and may mentor other staff to increase their skills.

The Senior Financial Analyst serves as the liaison between the accounting and finance functions that support Purdue Global and various departments and schools within the university. This position reports directly to the AVP of Finance & Business Operations and includes a virtual work location.

What to expect in this role:

  • Day-to-day financial reporting and analysis for assigned functional areas:

    • Under general supervision, is responsible for financial analysis forecasting, and budgetary processes

    • Research and resolve Business Unit(s) inquiries for assigned functional areas.

    • Routine communication with Supervisors relating to financial close, issues, and deliverables

    • Responsible for month-end, quarter-end and year-end close for assigned functional areas

    • Research and prepare variance analysis and explanations.

    • Complete and submit PG Consolidation & Reporting Deliverables

    • Responsible for the preparation and analysis of the periodic management reporting of financial results for assigned functional areas

    • Prepare journal entries related to assigned functional responsibilities

    • Provides decision support across all business units

    • Provides support for Board of Directors Reporting

    • Develop and maintain Annual budget and Quarterly Forecast

    • Responsible for ROI analysis of functional areas and special projects

    • Prepare all Financial Reporting requirements package

    • Perform account reconciliations, account analysis, accrual calculations, and other related accounting schedules as needed

    • Provide financial and operation advise - both routine as well as ad-hoc - to Senior Management

    • Prepare all Financial Reporting requirements package

    • Provides decision support across all business units

    • Responds to financial inquiries and requests such as, but not limited to, audited financials, approved budgets, ad hoc or special reports, or forecasts.

    • Prepares and processes month-end, quarter-end and year-end closes by collecting data, analyzing, and investigating variances, and summarizing data and trends.

    • Prepares and analyzes periodic management reporting of financial results for assigned functional areas (support center P&Ls).

  • Special Projects:

    • Responsible for performing special projects to improve process efficiency and performance

    • Cross train as back-ups for other staff in the case of emergencies

    • Increases productivity by automating applications, eliminating duplications, and coordinating information requirements

    • Other duties as assigned to accomplish the objectives of the finance department.

Experience:

Required:

  • 4-5 years as a financial analyst with FP&A, budgeting and financial analysis experience

  • Strong or Advanced skills in Excel

Preferred:

  • Experience with SAP or other Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system

  • Advanced proficiency in business applications, especially spreadsheets

  • Advanced knowledge of financial, data management, and reporting systems

  • Knowledge of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) and Governmental Accounting Standards Board (GASB) requirements

What we're looking for:

  • Strong project management skills and ability to contribute to or lead part of a multi-functional team

  • Must be able to perform all of the relevant duties of the position with only general supervision and prioritize work to meet multiple deadlines.

  • Must have advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office programs, specifically Excel and Powerpoint as well as Google applications such as Gmail, Chat, Meet and shared drives.

  • Experience with SAP, Oracle or related financial systems is helpful, but not required.

  • Detail-oriented and able to perform in a high-pressure, changing environment. Ability to adapt quickly and learn new tasks independently.

  • Advanced professional interpersonal and written/verbal communication skills, including ability to prepare materials for and clearly and effectively communicate information to internal and external audiences and executive management

  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion.

  • Capable of building strong working relationships across teams, departments and Schools.

Additional Information:

  • Target salary is $87,900. Learn more about our Benefits Here!

  • Please note that this is a remote position.

  • Purdue will not sponsor employment authorization for this position.

  • This is a U.S.-based position. This position is open to candidates who reside and are authorized to work in the United States.

  • A background check is required for employment in this position.

  • We ask that our remote employees have access to a reliable internet connection and a dedicated, properly equipped workspace that is free of distractions. You may wish to review the Purdue Virtual Meeting Professional Standards.

  • FLSA: Exempt (Not Eligible for Overtime) This position is generally classified as exempt unless a non-exempt classification is required by applicable state law.

  • Purdue Global is an EO/EA employer. Our goal is to recruit and retain talent from a broad pool of applicants. Purdue Global celebrates a variety of perspectives, experiences, and skills to support a success-focused environment for employees and students. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. All are encouraged to apply.

The Associate Director will play a key role in procurement technology implementation and optimization, supplier negotiations, and the development of scalable processes that enhance spend visibility, compliance, and organizational effectiveness.
