About the Role

Millions of people rely on digital maps every day to navigate, to discover, to find their way. But maps are only as accurate as the data behind them, and data is only as trustworthy as the people who verify it. Your knowledge of Mexico's geography, local landmarks, and how people actually navigate your region is something no algorithm can fully replicate. That local intelligence is what makes maps genuinely useful.

Why This Matters

Accurately verified mapping data prevents real-world navigation errors. Your verification work ensures that:

  • Users can discover trusted businesses and cultural landmarks with confidence

  • Communities can navigate with accurate, culturally-informed geographic intelligence

  • Geographic data quality scales across millions of locations and thousands of data variations

At scale, this is infrastructure work. Every verified data point contributes to how billions of people interact with geographic information globally.

What You'll Do

Core Responsibilities

Structured Quality Audits on Spatial Datasets

  • Conduct detailed, methodical evaluations of geographic and business data entries using advanced mapping platforms and GIS-standard evaluation tools

  • Assess spatial data points (coordinates, boundaries, locations) for accuracy and consistency across multiple authoritative sources

  • Verify business information (names, hours, categories, contact details, service offerings) against primary and secondary sources

  • Evaluate cultural and regional context—ensuring data reflects how Mexicans actually navigate, describe, and interact with their geographic environment

Cross-Reference Complex Data Against Authoritative Sources

  • Compare business, geographic, and cultural data entries across multiple authoritative sources (official registries, local government databases, business directories, street-level verification)

  • Identify discrepancies where data conflicts across sources (e.g., conflicting addresses, outdated hours, category misclassifications)

  • Apply critical thinking to determine which source is most reliable and document reasoning transparently

Rigorous Framework Application

  • Apply detailed, multi-dimensional evaluation frameworks with consistency and precision across dozens of geographic, business, and cultural data variations

  • Understand the intent behind evaluation guidelines and apply them contextually—knowing when to follow rules strictly and when to apply judgment

Work Across Diverse Task Types

  • Be flexible and adaptable across varied evaluation tasks: Maps (location data, boundaries), News (geo-relevant content accuracy), Audio (transcription and context verification), Relevance (data-to-query matching), and emerging task types

  • Quickly learn new task specifications and apply them with the same rigor

Provide Structured Feedback for Algorithm Improvement

  • Articulate clear, actionable feedback that helps refine mapping algorithms and improve geographic intelligence

  • Explain not just what is wrong, but why it matters for real-world navigation and discovery

  • Suggest data corrections that are specific, evidence-based, and prioritize the most impactful improvements

Why join the project:

  • Structured onboarding: Access comprehensive evaluation guidelines, detailed reference materials, and practical examples before your first live assessment

  • Direct feedback and growth: Receive performance assessments tied to quality metrics so you can refine your evaluation precision

  • Intellectually rigorous work: Each evaluation requires methodical reasoning, framework interpretation, and structured discrepancy analysis.

Mandatory Qualifications

Language Proficiency

  • Professional fluency in both English and Spanish (native or near-native proficiency required in both languages)

  • Must be able to read and write formal evaluations clearly and precisely in English

  • Must understand Spanish-language geographic, business, and cultural context

  • Must be comfortable with technical terminology in both languages

Geographic and Residency Requirements

  • Current residency in Mexico for the last 5 consecutive years (required to ensure authentic, current geographic knowledge)

  • Deep, lived knowledge of Mexico's geography—including major cities, regional landmarks, state and municipal boundaries, and less-prominent areas

  • Current understanding of how people in your region actually navigate, speak about locations, and describe directions (colloquial usage, cultural references, regional variations)

Analytical and Problem-Solving Capability

  • Advanced analytical thinking: demonstrated ability to break down complex geographic and business information into component parts, analyze each critically, and synthesize findings

  • Methodical problem-solving: comfort with systematic approaches to identifying and resolving data discrepancies; ability to think through multiple hypotheses

  • Attention to detail: capacity to spot inconsistencies, errors, and anomalies across large datasets without losing focus

Evaluation Framework Mastery

  • Comfort with rigorous guideline interpretation: ability to understand detailed evaluation frameworks, ask clarifying questions, and apply them consistently across diverse scenarios

  • Consistency under complexity: capacity to maintain consistent standards while handling dozens of variations in geographic, business, and cultural data

  • Documentation discipline: willingness to articulate reasoning clearly in writing, so that your decisions can be audited and learned from

Task Flexibility

  • Openness to working across diverse task types (Maps, News, Audio, Relevance, and emerging domains)

  • Ability to learn new task specifications quickly and apply them with the same rigor as established tasks

  • Adaptability to shifting priorities and project needs

Technical Literacy

  • Comfortable learning and using mapping platforms and data evaluation interfaces

  • Able to navigate web-based tools, upload files, and troubleshoot basic technical issues

  • No programming experience required; willingness to learn new tools is essential

﻿

Technical Requirements

  • Stable, reliable internet connection (minimum 5 Mbps download/upload recommended)

  • Quiet, distraction-free workspace for focused evaluation work

jobs.description:
Get To Know Us!

WebTPA, a GuideWell Company, is a healthcare third-party administrator with over 30+ years of experience building unique benefit solutions and managing customized health plans.

What is your impact?

The RN Case Manager primary responsibility is to create, implement, and monitor treatment plans to assist patients/members in meeting their healthcare goals. You would use knowledge of healthcare and social services to assess needs and provide interdisciplinary care options in treatment planning for the member. This would include understanding the member's healthcare benefits and healthcare best practices needed for effective treatment planning.

What Will You Be Doing:

  • Case Management process includes assessing the member’s health status and care coordination needs. Can include inpatient review and discharge planning, as well as possible outpatient management.
  • Contact with patient, family, physicians, additional health care providers, and community resources. Contact with provider business offices and with the employer/client may also be required.
  • Identification of alternative treatment plans, which would have to be approved by all parties. These alternative care plans will be based on quality care within cost containment guidelines, allowing available claims dollars to be used in the most judicious manner possible.
  • Assessment of the clinical status and resultant sequela to coordinate the most appropriate service to meet the individual’s health care needs. The Case Manager will then monitor the health status and the impact of the treatment plan for each client. The Case Manager will be responsible for altering the care plan as deemed appropriate by the dynamic, ever-changing client needs.
  • Identification of services, resources, providers, and facilities that could best serve members in a timely and cost-effective manner, to promote optimum value for the client and reimbursement source.
  • Development and implementation of Case Management goals, both short and long term, with documented care plans.
  • Utilize technology/resources to evaluate the cost-effectiveness of the elected treatment plan, pre-implementation and post-implementation. This outcome measurement will be used in determining the effective results and in establishing future patient-centered care plans.
  • Accurate and timely reporting as deemed appropriate by each client member.
  • Medical record review to determine medical necessity of requested services.
  • Interpreting individual health plans and authorizing/coordinating care in accordance with plan provisions.

What You Must Have:

  • 5+ years related work experience with a professional background in clinical nursing and patient assessment.
  • Related Bachelor’s degree or additional related equivalent work experience
  • Graduate of an accredited school of nursing
  • RN - Registered Nurse - State Licensure
  • Knowledgeable in medical terminology, reasonable and necessary treatment plans, delivery quality health care services and cost containment practices.
  • Ability to collaborate with cross-operational areas within the organization.

What We Prefer:

  • (CCM) Certified Case Manager
  • Active California RN State licensure.
  • Active Compact State Licensure in good standing.
  • Prior experience in utilization management or case management preferred, preferably within the managed care environment
  • Intensive care or higher-acuity patient experience preferred.
  • Knowledge of managed care in a self-funded employer population is preferred.
  • Ability to identify problems such as underutilization or overutilization of services
  • Ability to promote and maintain quality care through analysis

What We Can Offer YOU!

To support your wellbeing, comprehensive benefits are offered. As a WebTPA employee, you will have access to:

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and global travel health insurance
  • Income protection benefits: life insurance, Short- and long-term disability programs
  • Leave programs to support personal circumstances
  • Retirement Savings Plan includes employer contribution and employer match
  • Paid time off, volunteer time off, and 11 holidays
  • Additional voluntary benefits available and a comprehensive wellness program

Employee benefits are designed to align with federal and state employment laws. Benefits may vary based on the state in which work is performed. Benefits for interns and part-time employees may differ.

General Physical Demands:

Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally to move objects. Jobs are sedentary if traversing activities are required only occasionally.

We are an Equal Employment Opportunity employer committed to cultivating a work experience where everyone feels like they belong and can perform at their best in pursuit of our mission. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment.

jobs.title: Field Clinical Specialist
jobs.excerpt: ABOUT ORGANOX: OrganOx is a commercial stage organ technology company dedicated to developing technologies to improve outcomes for patients with acute or chronic organ failure.
jobs.description:
ABOUT ORGANOX:

OrganOx is a commercial stage organ technology company dedicated to developing technologies to improve outcomes for patients with acute or chronic organ failure. The company was established as a spin out of the University of Oxford in 2008 and is now part of the Terumo Group. OrganOx is a pioneer in normothermic machine perfusion (NMP). It's flagship platform, the metra®, is available for use in the U.S., Europe, Canada, and Australia. It has been utilized in over 7,000 liver transplants to date to keep donor livers in a metabolically active state outside the body enabling longer preservation times and functional assessment of the organ prior to transplant, leading to an increased number of organs available for transplant. Founded in 1921, Terumo Corporation (TSE:4543) strives to fulfil its mission of “Contributing to Society through Healthcare” by providing a comprehensive range of solutions in the fields of therapeutic procedures, hospital operations, and life sciences in more than 160 countries and regions.

Position Summary

The Field Clinical Specialist will be responsible for the training, support and adoption of OrganOx’s products. This includes teaching and training users in the correct manner to ensure our products are used safely and effectively - for the preservation of organs prior to transplant.

They are the first point of contact for the customer and maintain the relationship with the relevant clinical transplant teams. The role is home based but will require frequent travel to allocated transplantation centres (40%-60%) for on-site training, support or review meetings. They will partake in the 24/7 on-call rota (including weekends and holidays) for on-site or remote support.

The Field Clinical Specialist will be responsible for promoting the benefits of OrganOx’s products with customers, facilitating the sharing of customer experiences to support adoption of OrganOx products and for arranging user groups to facilitate shared learning. The Field Clinical Specialist should develop an in-depth knowledge of machine perfusion and published articles, including NMP, HMP and NRP to facilitate this.

The Field Clinical Specialist will track the account performance, clinical progression, supports forecasting of system usage and consumables set allocation. They ensure customer data are maintained in the relevant database and all regulatory customer consent is collected and documented. They will support the Commercial management team in prospecting and generating new customer leads and actively support commercial projects.

The Field Clinical Specialist will work with all relevant functional teams in OrganOx. They ensure all service-related problems are resolved according to customer and contractual expectations. They will own and support customer complaint and feedback recording and provide information to the OrganOx Quality and Regulatory team. They will report product related feedback to the relevant design and engineering colleagues.

This is a remote position in the UK with regular travel across Europe.

Listed below are the major responsibilities of the role and a brief description of some of the key tasks to be performed. This list is not totally exhaustive.

Major Responsibilities

Under direction from the VP Commercial, Europe the Field Clinical Specialist will be responsible for:

Training and Support

  • Train and support transplant teams in the use of the OrganOx metra. Ensure that all users understand the operation modes on the device (with and without an organ in place).
  • Ensure that all centres and teams remain competent in the use of the device by a process of in-person follow-up on a regular basis. Ensure that existing and new team members are trained and certified.
  • Contribute towards a 24-hour, 7 days a week on-call technical support rota, ensuring that there is always a Clinical Specialist available to deal and resolve enquiries.
  • Ensure that all calls are logged, and any outstanding issues are followed up and resolved. Collect all information and disseminate to team members and other users as appropriate.

Adoption of OrganOx Products

  • Establish and maintain customer relationships, sharing best practice to support adoption of the metra. Develop adoption strategies and materials to showcase the benefits of the metra. Present these materials and strategies to customers.
  • Identify and develop "champions" of the technology at each customer site.
  • Identify relevant customer contacts, record and maintain customer database in accordance with data protection regulations.
  • Identify potential new users of OrganOx products and work with the commercial management on preparing the supply offer. Document market leads and projects in the relevant database and track the progress accurately
  • Work with transplant teams to collect data on organs perfused and preserved on the metra to build up a database of product performance and use.
  • Help to collect information about organ transplantation in general, the preferences and needs of individual units and the status of competing technologies.
  • Maintain the database of procedures carried out per centre, the types of organs transplanted and the cases where the metra has been used.
  • Support user group meetings to facilitate shared learning and best practice.

Support for Research and Development, Quality and Sales & Marketing Functions

  • Report any issues or feedback reported with the metra to the Quality team, ensuring prompt completion of follow-up actions.
  • Assist marketing personnel in understanding the marketplace, utilising knowledge of customers, hospitals, working practices etc.
  • Maintain accurate records of all training procedures.
  • Evaluate the quality of training delivered as an ongoing and cumulative process.
  • Provide a report on the status of each centre with respect to the installation and training procedures.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Maintaining good laboratory practice, adhering to SOPs and ensuring excellent record keeping. Treat animal and human tissue with due care and in accordance with SOPs and policies.
  • Continued professional development, for example studying medical journals to ensure your knowledge of the transplantation and medical device field is current.
  • Adhere to the letter and spirit of OrganOx’s Code of Conduct and all other company policies

Requirements

Skills & Experience

  • Demonstrable experience in a clinical or healthcare science environment (essential)
  • Experience in training users of medical devices (essential)
  • Able to provide support during surgical procedures (essential)
  • Broad knowledge and experience of working in operating theatres, recovery units and intensive care units (essential)
  • Excellent interpersonal and presentation skills, and the ability to work with customers of varying background and abilities (essential)
  • Ability to understand scientific publications in detail to develop an in-depth knowledge of machine perfusion, including competing technologies (HMP, NRP) (essential)
  • Friendly, approachable and customer focused approach to work (essential)
  • Be able to travel regularly within the UK and Europe, and elsewhere as required (essential)
  • Analytical approach to problem solving (essential)
  • Good technical, manual and dexterity skills (essential)
  • Ability to work alone (essential)
  • Willing to work long and unpredictable hours (essential)
  • Experience working in a laboratory (desirable)
  • Conversant in medical terminology and an understanding of systems and processes within the human body (desirable)
  • Up to date with new techniques and developments for the promotion and maintenance of good practice (desirable)
  • Prepared to accept a high degree of responsibility (desirable)
  • Highly observant of people and procedures (desirable)
  • Computer literate and familiar with MS Office suite (desirable)

Qualifications

  • A minimum of BSc in a relevant field (science, health) or have significant equivalent experience (essential)
  • Full drivers licence (desirable)

Benefits

At OrganOx, we value innovation, evidence, integrity, teamwork, respect, and passion. We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, including healthcare and retirement plans. We support work-life balance and provide opportunities for ongoing professional development.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation race, or any other characteristics protected by law.

jobs.excerpt: Manager of Technical Accounting (Remote) Seattle Search Group is partnering with a publicly traded, technology-driven organization seeking a Manager of Technical Accounting to join its growing finance team.
jobs.description:
Manager of Technical Accounting (Remote)

Seattle Search Group is partnering with a publicly traded, technology-driven organization seeking a Manager of Technical Accounting to join its growing finance team. This is an excellent opportunity for a technically strong accounting professional looking to expand their expertise in revenue recognition, technical accounting research, SEC reporting support, and public company accounting.

This position is fully remote within the United States and offers exposure to complex transactions, international operations, and executive-level visibility.

Position Overview

The Manager of Technical Accounting will play a key role in researching and documenting technical accounting matters, evaluating customer contracts under ASC 606, supporting SEC reporting activities, and partnering with cross-functional teams to ensure compliance with U.S. GAAP and public company reporting requirements.

The ideal candidate is a self-starter who enjoys solving complex accounting issues, drafting technical accounting memos, and working independently in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Accounting

  • Research and analyze complex accounting matters under U.S. GAAP.
  • Prepare technical accounting memos and position papers for significant transactions.
  • Evaluate and implement new accounting standards and pronouncements.
  • Assist in maintaining and enhancing company accounting policies and procedures.
  • Partner with leadership and external auditors on technical accounting matters.

Revenue Recognition (ASC 606)

  • Review customer contracts and amendments to determine appropriate revenue recognition treatment.
  • Analyze performance obligations, variable consideration, contract modifications, and allocation methodologies.
  • Prepare revenue recognition analyses and supporting documentation.
  • Collaborate with legal, sales, operations, and finance teams during contract review processes.
  • Support and enhance internal controls related to revenue recognition.

SEC Reporting & Financial Reporting

  • Assist with quarterly and annual SEC reporting activities, including Forms 10-Q and 10-K.
  • Support preparation of financial statement footnotes and disclosures.
  • Prepare supporting schedules, tie-outs, and audit-ready workpapers.
  • Assist with earnings release support and non-GAAP reporting analyses.

Internal Controls & Compliance

  • Support SOX compliance and internal control documentation.
  • Participate in control testing and remediation efforts.
  • Assist external auditors during quarterly reviews and annual audits.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.
  • CPA strongly preferred.
  • 4-7+ years of progressive accounting experience.
  • Public accounting experience with a Big 4 or large regional firm strongly preferred.
  • Experience with ASC 606 revenue recognition.
  • Experience drafting technical accounting memos and researching U.S. GAAP.
  • Exposure to SEC reporting and public company environments.
  • Strong Excel skills and experience working with ERP systems.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.

Preferred Experience

  • Public company accounting and reporting experience.
  • Technology, software, aerospace, telecommunications, manufacturing, or other complex revenue environments.
  • Multi-entity and international accounting exposure.
  • Experience working with SOX controls and external auditors.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base salary approximately $140,000+-
  • Equity participation.
  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Limited travel requirements.
  • Strong opportunity for long-term career growth and advancement within the accounting organization.

Seattle Search Group is conducting this search on a confidential basis. Qualified candidates are encouraged to apply for immediate consideration.

jobs.title: Purchasing Planning Manager
jobs.excerpt: Position Summary: The Planning Manager is a leadership role responsible for the overall strategy, direction, and execution of the inventory planning function across all stocked product categories, including Wallcovering, Fabric, Furnishings, and carpet.
jobs.description:
Position Summary:

The Planning Manager is a leadership role responsible for the overall strategy, direction, and execution of the inventory planning function across all stocked product categories, including Wallcovering, Fabric, Furnishings, and carpet. This role is accountable for leading the team, developing world-class demand forecasts, optimizing inventory investment and ensuring product availability to support sales growth and maximize working capital efficiency. The Manager drives continuous improvement in planning processes and tools, manages key vendor relationships strategically, and serves as the primary liaison between Planning and senior leadership from Procurement, Category Management Team (CMT), Sales, and Operations. Expect high-level strategic thinking, decisive team leadership, and ultimate accountability for overall inventory health.

Key Responsibilities:

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Inventory Planners and Senior Planners.

  • Set team strategy, goals, and priorities, and monitor progress toward overall inventory objectives.

  • Oversee performance management, coaching, and training of team members, fostering a culture of high performance and accuracy.

  • Responsible for distributing information to the team from upper management.

Inventory Strategy & Demand Planning

  • Responsible for setting and maintaining the overall inventory investment strategy across all assigned product categories.

  • Direct the development of robust, rolling demand forecasts using advanced historical sales data (30/60/90-day trends), seasonal patterns, and project pipeline inputs.

  • Establish, audit, and maintain core inventory parameters (reorder points, safety stock) across the team to minimize risk and optimize working capital.

  • Proactively monitor and manage inventory health metrics, including aged inventory exposure, stockout risks, and overstock situations.

Supply Chain & Vendor Management

  • Oversee the strategic partnership with key wallcovering, fabric, and furnishing vendors to secure supply and negotiate optimal production schedules and order quantities.

  • Lead the coordination with Purchasing teams to determine buy quantities, replenishment timing, and mitigate high-risk supply disruptions.

  • Directly manage the review of supplier performance for delivery and service level, implementing necessary improvement plans.

  • Manage inventory exposure across key mills and suppliers.

Reporting, Analysis & Process Improvement

  • Design, develop, and maintain advanced inventory performance dashboards and weekly health reports for senior leadership.

  • Oversee the monitoring of forecast accuracy and bias across the team, implementing corrective actions to forecasting models and planning tools.

  • Identify, champion, and implement strategic improvements to planning tools, processes, and reporting capabilities across the organization.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Serve as the primary inventory planning partner to the Category Management Team (CMT) to align buying strategies and uphold product & vendor goals.

  • Partner with sales teams to incorporate customer demand insights and upcoming project requirements.

  • Collaborate with warehouse and operations teams to manage stock allocation and replenishment, including coordinating transport of goods.

  • And other duties as assigned.

Requirements

Abilities/Key Competencies/Skills:

  • Proven experience leading and mentoring a team in a complex planning or supply chain environment.

  • Expert-level demand forecasting and inventory planning experience with experience analyzing large SKU assortments.

  • Advanced proficiency in ERP/inventory systems (e.g., Oracle) and data analysis tools (Advanced Excel/Google Sheets data analysis skills with Pivot tables, Forecast modeling, Data visualization) required.

  • Exceptional strategic thinking, critical problem-solving skills, and the ability to contribute innovative ideas.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present complex data and strategy clearly to executive leadership and focus on a high customer service level.

  • Deep understanding of core inventory metrics (Weeks of Supply, Sell-through, Safety stock, Forecast accuracy).

  • Detail-oriented & High level of accuracy.

  • Curiosity and willingness to learn and grow within the organization.

  • Knowledge and experience with using Asana as a project management tool (Preferred).

Fabric, Wallcovering and Furnishing Planning Knowledge (Preferred):

  • Maintain a comprehensive working knowledge of wallcovering, fabric, and furnishing constructions, mill production processes, and supply chains in order to effectively manage inventory planning for assigned product categories as well as provide informed guidance to cross-functional partners.

  • Expertise in fabric and wallcovering yardage planning and managing product colorways/SKUs.

  • Deep awareness of vendor production lead times and knowledge of inventory challenges in stocked wallcovering, fabric, and furnishings.

  • Possess expert knowledge of mill MOQ’s and price break structures, leveraging this insight to optimize order quantities and support high-level cost negotiations with vendors when appropriate.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

The Planning Manager is accountable for the overall performance of the Inventory Planning team, optimizing the company's inventory investment, and maximizing product availability.

  • Overall Forecast Accuracy & Bias: Measures the aggregate effectiveness of the team's demand forecasting.

  • Inventory Investment Efficiency: Tracks inventory dollars relative to revenue and working capital goals.

  • Aged Inventory Reduction: Measures strategic management and minimization of slow-moving or obsolete inventory.

  • In-Stock Rate & Stockout Rate: Measures overall product availability and service level performance across core categories.

  • Weeks of Supply Optimization: Measures success in maintaining inventory within targeted strategic levels.

  • Team Development & Process Leadership: Measures effectiveness in mentoring planners, strengthening planning capabilities, and maintaining consistent planning processes across the team.

Experience/Certifications/Education:

  • Minimum 7+ years’ progressive experience in Inventory Planning, Demand Planning, or Supply Chain, with at least 3 years in a leadership or managerial role required.

  • Home decor or textile industry knowledge is preferred.

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, or a related field required; Master’s Degree or Supply Chain Certification (e.g., APICS) preferred (Elevated from Bachelor’s Degree preferred).

  • This is a fully remote role, though candidates residing on Long Island are preferred for occasional in-person team meetings or collaboration.

  • Salary Range: $85,000 - $95,000

das bringst du mit:

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift:Du drückst Dich klar, sicher und verständlich aus, sowohl mündlich als auch schriftlich.
  • Verlässlichkeit & Zielorientierung:Du bringst Dinge ins Ziel - strukturiert, zuverlässig und mit einem positiven Growth Mindset.

das bringen wir mit:

  • Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten: Durch kurze Entscheidungswege ermöglichen wir Dir, selbstständig zu arbeiten und Deine Ideen aktiv einzubringen – bei uns hast Du Raum, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.
  • Wachse mit uns: Entfalte Dein Potenzial mit zahlreichen Gestaltungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und einem jährlichen Entwicklungsbudget, um Deine fachlichen und persönlichen Ziele zu erreichen.
  • Gemeinsamer Spaß: Der Teamgeist kommt bei uns nicht zu kurz – wir bieten regelmäßig Events und Partys, bei denen der Spaß nicht zu kurz kommt.
  • Mobilität nach Wahl: Ob Bahnticket oder Parkplatz – wir unterstützen Dich bei der Wahl Deiner bevorzugten Mobilität.
  • Aktiv bleiben: Halte Dich fit mit einer vergünstigten Mitgliedschaft bei Fitness First oder Urban Sports Club oder nutze unseren Fitnessraum direkt im Haus, um nach der Arbeit aktiv zu bleiben und Deine Work-Life-Balance zu stärken.
  • Zukunft sichern: Denk auch an Deine Zukunft – wir bieten Dir Zuschüsse zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, damit Du mit uns langfristig planst.
  • Individuelle Angebote: Wir berücksichtigen Deine persönliche Lebenssituation – ob Du ein Elternteil bist oder gerne reist, wir bieten maßgeschneiderte Angebote, die zu Deinem Leben passen.

Für uns als Arbeitgeber sind Chancengleichheit und Diversität besonders wichtig. Daher freuen wir uns auf Bewerbungen von Müttern, Vätern, Menschen mit Behinderungen und Menschen aus der LGBTQIA+ Community. Bitte teile uns gerne mit, wenn wir z.B. ein geschlechtsneutrales Pronomen verwenden sollen, Du einen barrierefreien Zugang zu unserem Büro benötigst oder wir mehr Zeit für den Bewerbungsprozess einplanen sollen.

Offer Management & Onboarding

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Strategic thinker with a hands-on execution mindset.

  • Excellent organizational and multitasking abilities.
  • Comfortable managing multiple requisitions simultaneously.
  • Strong communicator with candidates, hiring managers, and leadership.
  • Ownership-driven and focused on delivering quality hiring outcomes.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Source candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter and job boards.
  • Review applications and conduct candidate screenings.
  • Coordinate interviews with hiring managers.
  • Update ATS records and recruitment pipelines.
  • Follow up with candidates throughout the hiring process.
  • Share market insights and hiring updates with stakeholders.
  • Track recruiting metrics and prioritize open requisitions.

In short: You build high-quality talent pipelines, guide candidates through an exceptional hiring experience, and help organizations make great hiring decisions efficiently.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Time-to-fill within target benchmarks
  • Candidate quality and interview-to-hire conversion rate

  • Candidate experience and communication quality
  • ATS accuracy and reporting consistency
  • Pipeline health and sourcing effectiveness

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Fully remote opportunity supporting U.S.-based hiring.

Interview Process

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the next step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient for you.

jobs.description:
About the role

Navteca LLC is hiring a Microsoft 365 GCC High Security Engineer to build and run secure Microsoft 365 environments for defense-sector clients that must meet NIST SP 800-171, DFARS 252.204-7012 and CMMC. You will configure a client's GCC High tenant from the ground up, migrate its devices, and then keep the environment secure, patched and audit-ready as the client's named administrator.

Navteca is an information technology and emerging-technology small business based in Chevy Chase, Maryland, serving federal and commercial clients.

Title

Microsoft 365 GCC High Security Engineer

Part-time employee

Hours

Core hours Monday to Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Eastern Time,

plus a share of an after-hours on-call rotation for critical security incidents

Remote, performed entirely from within the United States

$60 hourly

Start date

December 16, 2026

Eligibility. Because this role administers systems that give access to export-controlled information, the person hired must be a U.S. Person as defined in 22 CFR 120.62 (a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, or person granted refugee or asylee status) and must perform all work from within the United States.

Responsibilities

Build and migrate

  • Configure Microsoft Entra ID in GCC High: administrator accounts, role assignments through Privileged Identity Management, phishing-resistant MFA and Conditional Access.
  • Deploy Microsoft Intune and Defender for Endpoint: compliance and configuration policies, BitLocker, Windows LAPS, attack surface reduction rules, update rings and Windows Autopilot.
  • Implement application control (App Control for Business), from audit mode through enforcement.
  • Deploy and harden Windows App for access to client-furnished Azure Virtual Desktop environments.
  • Reset and re-enroll Windows 11 laptops into the GCC High tenant, coordinating directly with end users.
  • Write as-built configuration documentation and export evidence.
  • As clients grow: configure Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive and Teams in GCC High, Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels and data loss prevention for CUI, and Microsoft Sentinel in Azure Government.

Operate and secure

  • Monitor Defender and Intune alerts; review high and critical alerts the same business day.
  • Manage patches and vulnerabilities to fixed deadlines of 15, 30 and 90 days by severity, and review CISA and Microsoft advisories weekly.
  • Handle joiners, leavers and changes, removing access on the day of departure.
  • Follow formal change management: no change without the client's prior written approval, and every change logged.
  • Support incident response under the client's plan, including isolating devices, preserving evidence and notifying the client within 1 hour.
  • Provide remote user support using approved tools only.

Report and support compliance

  • Produce a monthly report covering device compliance, alerts and incidents, updates and vulnerabilities, changes and privileged activity.
  • Run quarterly reviews of accounts and privileged roles.
  • Assemble the annual evidence package for the client's NIST SP 800-171 self-assessment and take part in the annual incident response exercise.
  • Review client System Security Plans and procedures and recommend improvements.
  • Support clients through CMMC Level 2 assessments, with Navteca acting as an External Service Provider.

Qualifications

Required

  • 5 or more years administering Microsoft 365 security, including hands-on Intune, Defender for Endpoint and Entra ID Conditional Access.
  • Direct experience in Microsoft 365 GCC High or Azure Government, including knowledge of where its features differ from commercial Microsoft 365.
  • Working knowledge of NIST SP 800-171 and experience producing evidence against its controls.
  • Experience with Windows Autopilot, BitLocker, Windows LAPS and application control on Windows 11.
  • Clear written English: you will write reports, change requests and configuration documentation that clients and auditors read.
  • Comfort working independently and directly with a client's leadership and end users.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting a defense contractor under DFARS 252.204-7012 or through a CMMC Level 2 assessment.
  • Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Purview (sensitivity labels, DLP) and Azure Virtual Desktop experience.
  • Certifications such as Microsoft SC-300, SC-200, MD-102 or MS-102; CompTIA Security+; CMMC Certified Professional (CCP) or Registered Practitioner.
  • Managed service provider experience, including ticketing and service level commitments.
  • PowerShell and Microsoft Graph scripting.

Conditions of employment

  • Verification of identity and work eligibility, and of U.S. Person status.
  • Restricted party screening and verification of employment history or references.
  • Use of a Navteca-managed device and hardware security keys for all client administration.
  • Compliance with client security plans, U.S. export control regulations and Navteca's confidentiality requirements.
Salary: 60.00 hourly

jobs.excerpt: About CasesDaily We are a software-driven case-acquisition platform for plaintiff personal injury firms.
jobs.description:
About CasesDaily

We are a software-driven case-acquisition platform for plaintiff personal injury firms. We sell exclusive, AI-qualified car accident leads, priced per qualified lead, on top of an AI CRM and follow-up system most of the field does not have. The company was built by people who signed hundreds of PI cases and ran intake, so we sell to firm owners as peers. We work with more than a dozen firms today.

What makes the product different

  • Case quality, not volume. One case is worth $5,000 to a firm. Another is worth $100,000. We know the difference and we screen for it, so firms get cases worth signing.
  • AI qualifying and follow-up. Our software qualifies and warms every lead before a firm ever sees it, then keeps working it with automated follow-up.
  • Compliance built into the tech. Consent capture and compliance live inside the platform, not bolted on after, (including California SB37 compliance) which is what keeps the firms we sell to safe.

The opportunity

Selling qualified case leads is a small, quiet field. Fewer than a hundred companies do it seriously, and almost none bring real attorney and intake experience the way we do.

This is not a high-volume sales job. A single firm can order around $100,000 a month. A dozen strong relationships can add over $1.5 million a month in billing. You build and keep a short list of high-value firm relationships, with uncapped commission on every one. Two dozen good clients is a career.

Why an attorney

Firm owners buy from people they trust and who speak their language. Your license puts you in the room as a peer, not a vendor, and you understand the compliance that keeps those firms safe, which becomes one of your strongest selling points.

In today’s marketing, making equity partner at a firm turns on business development more than billable work, and the equity tier keeps shrinking. This role builds that exact skill right now, with full support from a team, and no waiting ten years for a committee to maybe review.

What you'd do

  • Run discovery calls with firm owners: cost per lead, close rate, cost per signed case, and the volume they can handle.
  • Turn that into a proof order and a path to locking up their market, then close it.
  • Manage the firms you sign so they keep buying and grow their orders.
  • Carry compliance as a value-add: TCPA and consent, DNC and reassigned numbers, California SB37, CAN-SPAM, A2P 10DLC, and Google Ads policy.

Who you are

  • A licensed attorney in good standing.
  • You build trust fast and can sign another attorney without it feeling like a pitch.
  • Personal injury experience and firm relationships are a plus.
  • Comfortable in an early company where some of what you need does not exist yet.

Compensation

  • An hourly rate for your legal and compliance work, so your expertise is paid from day one.
  • Uncapped commission on every firm you sign and manage.
  • A defined path to ownership for the person who proves the fit. That is a conversation, not a number in a job ad.

Logistics

Remote, hours you control. You work directly with the founders as the first attorney in the company.

How to apply

Skip the cover letter. Tell us about a deal or a case you closed and what it took to get it done. If you have personal injury relationships, tell us about those too.

Forecasting & Planning

Business Insights

About us

At Goodweek, we're building a next-generation AI tool designed to revolutionize business productivity. The goal is to make AI practical, controlled, and truly embedded in how modern organizations operate.

Goodweek is a partner-led AI Management Platform, built exclusively for our Partners: Distributors and MSPs (Managed Service Providers), who deploy it to their own clients. We give MSPs and Distributors a secure, governed, multi-model AI workspace with 40+ bidirectional integrations, SOC 2 certification, GDPR compliance, and 100% tenant isolation: the platform infrastructure they need to turn AI from a SKU they resell into a packaged, recurring service line they admin, bill, and support.

Our team spans across France, Spain, and the United States, and our vision is backed by 6 international investment funds.

The role

You will play a hands-on, critical role in driving partner sales and manage the Enablement, Activation, and Growth phases for our MSP partners. You will run the training meetings during Enablement, drive the partner through Activation (commercial plan, co-selling, use-case development), and help drive their growth, where they've become self-sufficient in their sales process.

This position requires a strong blend of hands-on execution, B2B Software sales acumen, culture-first leadership, and hands-on-engagement to build pipeline, drive software activation, and deliver mutual value across our partner ecosystem.

You'll manage several MSPs at the same time, follow the playbooks our team is developing, and share your insights and feedback from working directly with partners with the Goodweek team.

Responsibilities

We're hiring our second Account Executive to help build the next stage of our sales organization in the US market.

This is a true full-cycle role. You'll own prospecting, cold outreach, discovery, demos, follow-up, negotiation, and close.

  • Acquisition: identify, prospect, build meaningful pipeline through cold call, emails, referrals, trade shows events, paid marketing, social media.

  • Enablement: execute the full training sequence with your MSPs: Admin Training on Product (Spaces, Actions, Knowledge Bases, Admin Dashboard, integrations), MSP Staff Training on Product, MIP program and others. You'll have support from the Co-seller AE, but you'll own your pipeline and your number.

  • Activation: Build the commercial plan, co-sell into the partner's first end clients, and develop use cases for their book of business.

  • Growth: Bring partners to self-sufficiency and continue to manage the relationship going forward.

  • Adoption: Drive end-user adoption per MSP toward the annual goal.

  • Template execution: Use, adapt, and help create the central Goodweek template library.

  • Responsible for driving monthly incremental license sales with signed MSPs.

Day-to-day

  • Own and manage the full sales cycle, from lead stage to close with a strong bias for follow-up and follow-through.

  • Act as a trusted advisor to prospects and customers, learning their needs and demonstrating how our AI-management platform can meet their objectives.

  • Run Goodweek discovery and demos tailored to the end-customer’s actual workflows and priorities.

  • Be the Subject Matter Expert in AI tools and workflow development to lead Admin Training, MIP Workshops, and Sales/Marketing Hub training meetings.

  • Build the commercial plan with each partner and co-sell into the first End Clients during Activation.

  • Roll out starter packs, sign partners to growth packs, and arm them with collateral.

  • Track time-to-live, seats activated, and adoption rate for every MSP and end client in your book.

  • Bring field insight back: collaborate with Product and Leadership teams to provide market feedback and identify growth opportunities.

  • Analyze Partners Sales results and contribute to case studies and end-client success stories.

  • Consistently achieve and exceed quarterly revenue goals and key performance metrics.

  • Maintain accurate records of pipeline and account activity using CRM tools.

Requirements

  • A self-starter who can operate in fast-paced environment and knock down walls to get deals done.

  • Strong background in Partner Sales, Partner Management, Channel Sales, Enterprise Software Sales, or Strategy Consulting.

  • 5+ years of experience in prospecting and closing B2B leads, driving adoption of emerging technologies with a consultative, solutions-oriented sales approach.

  • Proven Track Record: Demonstrated success in meeting or exceeding indirect sales quotas, joint pipeline goals, and facilitating co-sell motions.

  • Collaborative Skills: good presentation, and negotiation skills, with a proven ability to build trust and rally cross-functional teams around a shared vision.

  • Hands-on configuration experience: you're comfortable inside an admin console.

  • Strong discovery and facilitation skills: you can walk a Head of HR or a CFO from 'AI is interesting' to a real use case in 45 minutes.

  • Operator mindset: you'll be running multiple onboardings in parallel.

  • AI in your daily work: you will use Goodweek and other AI tools every day in your own workflow for research, drafting, prep, follow-up, to optimize your output and efficiency. You treat continuous learning with AI as part of the job, not a side project. We expect you to live the practice you’re selling.

  • Comfort with multi-model AI: you don't need to be a prompt engineer; you do need to be confident building and tweaking Actions.

Nice-To-Have

  • Experience selling into global cloud commerce marketplace and technology distributor firms.

  • Ecosystem Understanding: practical B2B SaaS expertise in how SIs, MSPs, and Hyperscalers co-sell and deliver enterprise value.

  • Past life at an MSP, or a B2B SaaS company that sold through channel.

  • Experience helping build an early-stage sales motion.

  • Have participated in a customer onboarding or training program at scale.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex workstreams independently and deliver results.

  • Genuine curiosity about AI and how it is reshaping small and medium-sized organizations

Benefits

We offer a compensation package with $110,000-$165,000 in on-target earnings (OTE), consisting of a $100,000–$120,000 base salary and $10,000–$45,000 in commission, along with a stock options plan that gives you the opportunity to share in the company's long-term success.

In addition, we provide comprehensive health and dental coverage, as well as a 401(k) retirement plan. You'll also have opportunities to travel for industry trade shows, strategic MSP onboarding engagements, and company offsites.

The Data Integration Analyst will perform hands-on data profiling, source-to-target mapping, transformation rule definition, and reconciliation testing for an enterprise platform modernization effort.   • Migrate legacy data into ServiceNow. Configure ServiceNow Import Sets and Transform Maps, implementing data cleansing, validation, load sequencing, and exception-handling routines.
  • Align legacy and modern datasets for unified reporting. Partner with the data engineering and reporting teams to merge legacy and modernized operational records within the approved reporting architecture. Follow established data modeling standards to map consistent identifiers and apply shared entity, location, and date definitions.
  • Maintain reporting continuity and accuracy. Retain source-system identifiers, key crosswalks, and data lineage across system cutover. Account for partial records, adjustments, cancellations, status differences, and financial calculations to prevent duplicate counting across systems.
  • Validate migrations and reporting results. Execute trial migrations and automated reconciliation of record counts, relationships, quantities, and financial totals. Compare report outputs against source records and approved business rules, documenting discrepancies and acceptance evidence.
  • Support partner interfaces and Agile delivery. Coordinate external partner test data and scenarios for API and XML file exchanges, validate end-to-end outcomes, and resolve data defects. Participate in Agile ceremonies, maintain version-controlled mappings and test artifacts, and support cutover rehearsals and operational handover.

Expected Deliverables & Success Measures

  • Deliverables: Approved source-to-target mappings and business definitions; configured ServiceNow Transform Maps and scripts; key crosswalks and data lineage documentation; reconciliation and test results; and cutover support procedures.

Business owners can trace reported metrics back to source records, with all exceptions resolved against agreed acceptance criteria.

  • 3–5 years of experience in data analysis, data migration, system integration, or reporting across legacy and modernized enterprise platforms.
  • Hands-on ServiceNow experience with Import Sets, Transform Maps, field mapping, coalesce configuration, reference handling, and JavaScript transformation scripts.

  • Ability to map and validate parent-child data relationships, partial records, adjustments, and aggregation rules that prevent double counting.
  • Experience executing trial migrations, delta loads, cutover validation, and structured reconciliation testing.
  • Familiarity with API or file-based integrations (including XML) and supporting end-to-end testing with external partners.
  • Strong documentation and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in Agile teams and explain mapping logic and reconciliation findings to technical and business stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting large-scale federal or enterprise operational modernization programs.
  • Familiarity with business intelligence tools, dimensional modeling concepts, and historical reporting across legacy system retirements.
  • Knowledge of ServiceNow integration capabilities, secure data handling, access controls, and load performance tuning.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, data analytics, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

About the Role

We are seeking an exceptional graduate to join Stalis as a generalist across our technical and operational functions. You will work closely with teams across the business, developing a deep understanding of how healthcare data moves through our systems and identifying opportunities to apply programming, modern tooling, and AI to improve how we work. Over time, as Stalis’s data intelligence capability matures, you will have the opportunity to contribute directly to machine learning and analytics work that shapes our next generation of products.

The Reality of the Work

This is a broad role, and not every task will be glamorous. Much of the early value comes from genuinely understanding how work is done at Stalis today - which means doing the work, not just observing it. Some of your time will be spent on detailed, careful data tasks that are essential to our clients. The opportunity is to use that understanding as the foundation for automation, improvement, and new capability. The best ideas will come from the ground up, and we expect you to find them.

What you’ll actually do

  • Work alongside our data migration and engineering teams on live client projects, contributing to the day-to-day delivery of healthcare data work.
  • Identify inefficiencies, repetitive tasks, and fragile processes - and build the scripts, tools, and small systems that fix them.
  • Write and maintain code, primarily in Python & SQL, to automate workflows, process data, and support internal operations.
  • Apply and experiment with AI tooling - LLMs, embeddings, classifiers - to problems across the business where they add real value, and be honest about where they don’t.
  • Communicate your work clearly, in writing and in person, to colleagues who are not data scientists - so that your improvements get adopted rather than sidelined.
  • Over time, contribute to Stalis’s emerging data science and machine learning capability, including schema mapping, clinical data analytics, and data products.

Requirements

Who we’re looking for

You will need most, if not all, of the following:

  • Academic background. A strong degree from a top university in a quantitative or technical discipline - physics, engineering, computer science, mathematics, or similar.
  • Genuine technical aptitude. Comfortable writing code, and keen to write more of it. We are not looking for a particular stack or prior industry experience, but you should already be writing code for fun, coursework, or projects, and be able to pick up new tools quickly.
  • AI-savvy. Fluent with modern AI tools as a day-to-day part of how you work and think. You know what LLMs are good at, what they’re bad at, and how to use them without being credulous about their output.
  • Self-directed. You find problems, scope them yourself, and take them to a useful end state without being spoon-fed tasks. You are comfortable operating under ambiguity and choosing what to work on when it isn’t obvious.
  • Discerning and pragmatic. You can tell the difference between a problem worth solving properly and one worth a fifty-line script today. You don’t gold-plate.
  • Strong communicator, in writing especially. You can write a short memo or a handover document that brings people along. In a small, distributed business, this matters more than people think.
  • Emotionally intelligent. Improvements to how people work can feel like criticism, even when they aren’t. You can read a room, win people over, and work collaboratively with colleagues who know things you don’t.
  • Domain-humble. You are curious about how Stalis works today before you try to change it. You understand that experienced colleagues know things that aren’t written down, and you treat that knowledge as an asset.

Benefits

What you’ll get from us

  • Unusual breadth of exposure for a graduate role - you will see how a specialist healthcare data company actually runs, from the data up.
  • A path into machine learning and data science work as Stalis’s data intelligence capability develops, with real problems and real data to work on.
  • Direct access to senior colleagues, reporting to the Head of Data Science, and genuine influence over how the company evolves.
  • A role that will grow as quickly as you do.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Flosum is a bootstrapped, profitable B2B SaaS company building the leading Salesforce-native DevSecOps, Data Protection, and Security platform. Our solutions are trusted by Fortune 500 enterprises in the most heavily regulated industries on the planet — financial services, healthcare, government, and insurance.

We’re not a startup burning cash and chasing vanity metrics. We’re a proven, scaling business that reached profitability on our own terms. As a Salesforce Summit Partner and Innovation Award winner, we’ve earned our seat at the table alongside the biggest names in enterprise software.

Built 100% on the Salesforce platform. Serving enterprises that demand zero compromise on security, compliance, and reliability.

Why This Role Exists

We are entering an aggressive growth phase — expanding our product surface, deepening our platform capabilities, and accelerating our delivery velocity. We need senior-caliber Node.js developers who can own significant parts of our architecture and ship production code that enterprise customers depend on daily.

This is not a staff augmentation seat. You will work directly with engineering leadership, product managers, and the CEO. Your decisions will have real consequences, your opinions will be heard, and your craftsmanship will be visible to the customers who rely on our platform.

What You’ll Build

  • High-performance backend services and APIs powering enterprise-grade SaaS applications
  • Scalable, secure Node.js micro services and integrations within the Salesforce ecosystem
  • Modern front-end experiences using Vue.js and TypeScript that serve demanding enterprise users
  • CI/CD pipeline tooling, automation frameworks, and developer productivity infrastructure
  • Real-time data processing and event-driven architectures handling sensitive enterprise data at scale

Requirements

Read this section carefully. We are specific about what we need because we are serious about who we hire.

Non-Negotiable Technical Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional Node.js development in production environments — not tutorials, not side projects, not bootcamp exercises. Real production systems serving real users at scale.
  • Expert-level understanding of asynchronous programming, event loops, streams, and the Node.js runtime. You should be able to explain backpressure, the differences between setImmediate and process.nextTick, and why unhandled promise rejections are dangerous — without Googling it.
  • Deep experience with TypeScript in production codebases. We write typed code, and we expect you to understand why.
  • Strong command of RESTful API design, authentication patterns (OAuth 2.0, JWT), and API security best practices for enterprise environments.
  • Proven experience with SQL and NoSQL databases, query optimization, data modeling, and understanding the performance implications of schema decisions at scale.
  • Proficiency with Git workflows, code review practices, automated testing (unit, integration, and end-to-end), and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Solid understanding of containerization (Docker), cloud services (AWS/GCP/Azure), and infrastructure-as-code principles.

Highly Preferred (These Will Set You Apart)

  • Salesforce development experience: Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, or Salesforce API integrations. If you know both Node.js and Salesforce, you are a rare and extremely valuable candidate to us.
  • Experience building or contributing to Salesforce ISV (AppExchange) products.
  • Vue.js front-end development experience, particularly with Vue 3 Composition API and state management.
  • Experience working in B2B SaaS companies serving enterprise customers with strict compliance requirements (SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP, GDPR).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/DevSecOps toolchains and practices in the Salesforce ecosystem.

The Kind of Person We’re Looking For

Skills get you in the door. Mindset determines whether you thrive here:

Missionary, Not Mercenary

You care about what you’re building and why. You take ownership not because someone assigned it to you, but because that’s who you are. When something is broken at 2 AM, you don’t check whether it’s “your responsibility” — you fix it.

Builder, Not a Bystander

You don’t wait for perfect specifications. You dig in, ask hard questions, propose solutions, and ship. You would rather have a working prototype by Friday than a polished slide deck by next quarter.

Craftsperson Under Pressure

Enterprise customers depend on our uptime and data integrity. You write code that doesn’t just work — it survives. You understand that in regulated industries, your code is your reputation.

Direct Communicator

You say what you think, respectfully and clearly. If a technical decision is wrong, you speak up — regardless of who made it. We value candor over politeness-at-the-expense-of-quality.

This Is a Long-Term Commitment

Let us be direct: we are not looking for contractors who jump between projects every few months. We are building a world-class engineering team, and we invest heavily in the people who join us. In return, we expect commitment.

This role is designed as a long-term, full-time engagement. You will grow with us. You will own systems end-to-end. You will see the direct impact of your work in how Fortune 500 companies build, protect, and deploy on Salesforce.

If you’re looking for a short-term gig while you wait for something else, this isn’t the role. If you want to build something that matters and be part of a team that’s scaling from strong to dominant, keep reading.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Direct collaboration with the founding team and engineering leadership — your voice will carry weight from day one
  • A profitable, stable company with aggressive growth plans — no funding anxiety, no runway clock

jobs.description:
Overview

Build the Future

At McGraw Hill, we create best-in-class, next-generation solutions and services used by millions of students and educators worldwide every day. We design intuitive, effective tools and experiences that help institutions achieve their strategic goals, maximize educators’ time, and propel student success. We do it all in a supportive, collaborative environment, working alongside brilliant colleagues, making a difference in lives around the world, and continuing our own paths of lifelong learning.

Make an Impact

Looking for a marketing role where you can truly experience the impact of your work and flex your strategic, analytic, and creative skill set?

We’re looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager, Enterprise to lead go-to-market strategy, positioning, and messaging for our Enterprise solutions and services and help drive demand, adoption, and growth. As part of McGraw Hill’s Enterprise team, you’ll build meaningful relationships with educators, administrators, learners, and colleagues throughout the organization. With that comes the unique opportunity to touch lives across the world and to experience firsthand the difference your time and effort make.

How can you make an Impact?

Reporting to the Director of Enterprise Marketing, this Senior Product Marketing Manager, Enterprise will be responsible for go-to-market strategy and execution for McGraw Hill’s Higher Education Enterprise business to drive growth, retain customers, and exceed revenue goals. This position will require you to leverage a combination of your product and customer marketing experience and skills. You’ll play a critical role in shaping product positioning and messaging, delivering competitive insights, supporting and enabling our sales team, building relationships with customers and advocates, supporting high-impact events, and ensuring existing customers are satisfied and positioned to expand their use of our Enterprise solutions and services.

This is a remote position open to applicants authorized to work for any employer within the United States and requires up to 25% travel for the year.

What can you expect from the position?

  • Provide strategic product marketing direction across the Enterprise business while partnering with cross-functional teams in Product, Technology, Sales,Customer Success, and Marketing.
  • Lead go-to-market strategy and launches for new Enterprise solutions, services, and capabilities, ensuring cross-functional alignment, sales readiness, and successful market adoption.
  • Work with stakeholders to write and develop brand-consistent positioning and messaging in alignment with the sales and customer journey and ensure these are effectively communicated to target audiences via the Demand Generation team.
  • Serve as the voice of the market by gathering customer, prospect, and sales insights and translating them into actionable recommendations for product strategy, positioning, and go-to-market priorities.
  • Partner with Sales and Customer Success to develop strategies that strengthen customer adoption and satisfaction, support retention, and identify opportunities to expand the use of Enterprise solutions and services.
  • Create content to support campaigns, including sales tools, training materials, campaign playbooks, and lead follow-up resources that prepare Sales to effectively engage prospects.
  • Deliver executive-level presentations, lead strategic workshops, and facilitate informational sessions for internal and external stakeholders to effectively position and promote Enterprise solutions.
  • Partner on event and conference strategy and attend key events to effectively showcase Enterprise positioning, messaging, competitive differentiation, and solution value to generate interest and drive leads.
  • Develop and maintain competitive intelligence, including battlecards, positioning, key differentiators, and competitive talk tracks that strengthen sales effectiveness.
  • Analyze product and market trends and potential opportunities, providing insights and recommendations to guide research, planning, and development.
  • Develop a deep understanding of target audiences, buyer personas, institutional needs, and use cases to inform positioning, messaging, content, and go-to-market strategies.
  • Monitor the effectiveness of go-to-market efforts, messaging, sales enablement, and adoption initiatives to continuously optimize product marketing messaging and sales strategies.

We’re looking for someone with:

  • A Bachelor’s degree.
  • A minimum of 4 years of client-facing marketing and/or sales experience, preferably in the fields of education and/or technology. Product and enterprise marketing experience in EdTech SaaS is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of emerging marketing trends, technologies (especially Salesforce), and integration strategies.
  • Strong ability to identify, prioritize, and execute product marketing objectives to grow market share, strengthen customer retention and expansion, and drive revenue.
  • Ability to consistently meet deadlines and, on occasion, turn projects around in a short timeframe.
  • Success in managing and delivering virtual and/or live events and conducting compelling presentations—both internally and externally.
  • Ability to make data-informed decisions and track ROI.
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills.
  • Excellent communication skills (verbal and written).
  • A resourceful, proactive, and self-directed approach, with the ability to take ownership and move work forward.
  • Proficiency in the Microsoft Office suite.
  • Experience using Salesforce, Asana, Qualtrics or survey builders, and Teams.

Why Work with McGraw Hill?

The work you do at McGraw Hill will be work that matters. We are collectively designing solutions and services that will build the future of education. Play your part and experience a sense of fulfillment that will inspire you to even greater heights.

The pay range for this position is between $95,000 - $105,000 annually. However, base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and location. An annual bonus plan may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical and/or other benefits, depending on the position offered. The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren't beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

The role is part of the Security Function within the broader Mozilla Infrastructure team. The Security team supports Product, Enterprise and GRC functions across the organization aligned with the mission to build a safe & secure internet. This role is responsible for defining, developing and helping implement a Governance, Risk and Compliance framework for both Enterprise and Product verticals. The ideal candidate will be responsible to deliver an integrated framework that aligns security, privacy, regulatory, and risk management initiatives across the organization. This is an ideal role for someone early in their GRC or security career who is curious, organized, and eager to take on a wide range of work. You’ll get broad exposure across risk, audit, and a growing set of security programs.

What you'll do:

Risk Management

  • Perform risk assessments and process incoming risk questions and intake requests
  • Maintain the risk register, keeping entries accurate, current, and well documented
  • Track risk treatment plans and follow up with owners on progress
  • Manage the exceptions and issues tracking process, including intake, documentation, expiration follow-up, and reporting
  • Support third-party risk activities, such as vendor assessments, questionnaire review, and tracking remediation

Compliance and Audit

  • Coordinate evidence collection from control owners and chase outstanding requests
  • Help prepare control owners and stakeholders for audit interviews
  • Keep the SOC 2 system description, ISMS documentation, and Statement of Applicability (SoA) up to date
  • Track audit gaps and findings and drive remediation to closure with control owners

Security Program Support

  • Help GRC and partner teams run governance for the Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC), including tracking adoption, gathering evidence, and maintaining supporting standards

  • Track vulnerability management metrics and remediation status, and follow up with system owners on overdue items
  • Help coordinate penetration testing engagements, from scoping and scheduling through findings tracking and remediation follow-up

GRC Operations and Tooling

  • Serve as an administrator for our GRC platform, including users, workflows, integrations, and reporting
  • Identify opportunities to streamline processes and automate repetitive GRC work
  • Help maintain policies, standards, and supporting documentation

What you'll bring:

  • Experience in cybersecurity, GRC, IT audit, or a related field (typically 2-4 years)
  • Working knowledge of security and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or NIST
  • Familiarity with risk assessment concepts and the risk management lifecycle
  • Strong organization and follow-through, with the ability to juggle many workstreams and deadlines at once
  • Clear written and verbal communication, and comfort working with technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • A relevant certification or one in progress (e.g., Security+, CISA, CISM, CISSP)
What you'll get:

  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage.

  • Increase the regular use of our payment solution and sustainably grow monthly transaction volume.

  • Reduce onboarding drop-off and time to first transaction.

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Customer Success & Client Retention Specialist to strengthen client relationships, improve the customer experience, and reduce churn.

This role is focused on what happens after a client comes onboard — making sure customers see value, stay engaged, receive proactive support, and have compelling reasons to continue the relationship.

You’ll work closely with leadership, sales, and operations to improve the customer journey from onboarding through long-term retention.

If you have experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Client Retention, or Customer Experience and enjoy building lasting client relationships, this could be a strong fit.

Customer Success & Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with existing clients
  • Serve as a trusted point of contact throughout the customer lifecycle
  • Conduct proactive client check-ins and follow-ups
  • Understand client goals, concerns, and expectations
  • Identify potential issues before they become reasons for churn
  • Ensure clients consistently receive a responsive and professional experience

Client Retention & Churn Reduction

  • Develop and execute strategies to improve client retention
  • Identify customers who may be disengaged or at risk of leaving

    • Surveys
    • NPS
    • CSAT
    • Ongoing account interactions
  • Identify patterns and recurring client concerns
  • Translate feedback into clear, actionable recommendations
  • Share customer insights with leadership and relevant teams

Customer Success Metrics & Reporting

Monitor and report on metrics such as:

  • Client retention rate
  • Customer churn
  • NPS
  • CSAT
  • Customer engagement
  • Renewal performance

Use customer data and feedback to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with sales, operations, and leadership teams

  • Help improve handoffs between sales, onboarding, and ongoing customer support
  • Support initiatives designed to improve retention and customer lifetime value

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Are organized and capable of working independently

  • Strong understanding of:

  • Experience using CRM platforms such as:
    • HubSpot
    • Salesforce
    • or similar systems
  • Data-driven mindset with the ability to interpret customer feedback and performance metrics

  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Reliable internet connection and availability within the agreed part-time schedule

Nice to Have

    • SaaS
    • Service-based businesses
  • Familiarity with Customer Success platforms such as:
    • Gainsight
    • ChurnZero
    • Intercom
  • Experience managing:
    • Renewals
    • Upselling
    • Cross-selling
    • At-risk accounts
  • Familiarity with NPS, CSAT, churn, and retention reporting

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may include:

  • Reviewing client health and engagement
  • Reaching out proactively to existing customers
  • Following up with clients who may be at risk of churning
  • Supporting onboarding and early customer engagement
  • Gathering and analyzing client feedback
