jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
jobs.excerpt: your opportunity Veridian is building the infrastructure layer for digital identity.
jobs.description:
your opportunity

Veridian is building the infrastructure layer for digital identity. Born as a Cardano Foundation initiative and now an independent company, our technology already powers government identity programs and enterprise credential issuance across regulated industries.


We are hiring a Senior Full Stack Engineer. You will own features from database schema to screen: a cross platform identity wallet, web applications for credential issuance and verification, enterprise management interfaces and the backend services behind them.


Most of what you build is open source: Veridian Wallet and the KERI libraries it runs on, KERIA, Signify-TS and KERIpy.


You will wear multiple hats. Some weeks you design an issuance API and the workflow that consumes it. Other weeks you debug out of order key events during credential issuance, harden a key management path, tighten a CI pipeline or prototype something that did not exist last month.

you will

  • Own features of Veridian Wallet end to end, a cross-platform identity wallet for iOS and Android built with Ionic, Capacitor and TypeScript.

  • Work closely with the design team to transform their designs into a polished and responsive UI that feels intuitive.

  • Build the layer underneath the UI: the core of the wallet that manages the user's cryptographic keys and credentials, and talks to KERI infrastructure through edge signing libraries such as Signify-TS.

  • Treat security as a design constraint, not a review step. Key management, cryptographic operations and credential lifecycle correctness are yours to get right.

  • Build systems that hold up under real conditions: out-of-order events, eventual consistency, rotated keys, revoked credentials and connectivity failures.

  • Own the quality of what you ship: tests, observability, performance, deployment and the pipeline behind it.

  • Use AI coding assistants and agents effectively to accelerate development, debugging, testing, refactoring and exploration of unfamiliar codebases. You stay accountable for every line and every technical decision.

  • Work across the stack: contribute upstream to the KERI libraries when you hit gaps, or work on the cloud applications that integrate with Veridian Wallet.

our stack

TypeScript, React, Redux Toolkit, Ionic, Capacitor, Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Python, GitHub Actions, AWS (not need all of it from day 1).

what you bring

  • 5+ years building and running production software across the stack.

  • Strong React and TypeScript experience in production, with a good understanding of performance, rendering, state management and responsive user experiences.

  • Experience building or maintaining cross-platform mobile applications. Ionic, Capacitor or React Native experience is particularly relevant.

  • Experience integrating with backend services and client libraries where the client, not the server, is responsible for getting things right: retries, reconciliation, handling failure part-way through a flow.

  • Experience owning on-device data: designing local storage schemas, writing migrations users can't roll back from, and keeping data consistent across app updates and restarts.

  • Strong engineering judgement around performance, reliability, security and maintainability.

  • Clear async writing. The team is distributed across Europe.

nice to have

  • Experience working in a security-sensitive domain, such as cryptography, key management, authentication, WebAuthn or digital identity.

  • Familiarity with KERI, ACDC or decentralized identity protocols.

  • Experience with Python and/or the ability to move comfortably between different languages and ecosystems.

  • Contributions to open source projects or experience working in open source communities.

  • Startup experience or experience working in small teams where ownership, initiative and good judgement matter more than process.

  • Naturally curious and always exploring new frameworks, tools and approaches that could make the product, development workflow or engineering practices better.

why veridian

  • Small team, real ownership. You shape the architecture and set the patterns a growing engineering team will follow.

  • High stakes work. Identity infrastructure built for governments and regulated industries.

  • Open source by default.

  • Remote first, asynchronous, low process.

interview process

  • Step 1. Technical interview: background, system design across the stack and security sensitive engineering.

  • Step 2. Take home, capped at 3 hours: one API endpoint plus the interface that consumes it.

  • Step 3. Technical deep dive: we review your take home with you, then live problem solving and a code review exercise.

  • Step 4. Meet the team: how we work together day to day.

  • Triage enquiries, prioritising time-sensitive messages (e.g. race week queries, urgent logistics issues).
  • Maintain agreed response times and keep a clear record of enquiries and outcomes.
  • Escalate complex, sensitive or unusual cases to the team promptly, with a clear summary so the athlete does not have to repeat themselves.

Manage Instagram enquiries

  • Monitor and respond to direct messages and comments relating to events and enquiries.
  • Answer questions in a way that reflects the brand voice: approachable, encouraging and professional.
  • Direct people to the right resources (website, FAQs, athlete guides) and move more detailed or personal queries to email where appropriate.
  • Flag any negative feedback, complaints or reputational concerns to the team.

Handle withdrawals and transfers

  • Respond to requests to withdraw from, or transfer, an event entry, applying terms and conditions accurately and consistently.
  • Clearly explain the options, deadlines, fees and any eligibility criteria to the athlete.
  • Log requests and outcomes, and pass any approved changes to the relevant internal team member for processing.
  • Refer exceptions, disputes and special circumstances to the team for a decision rather than making commitments outside policy.

Answer event logistics questions

  • Respond to questions about event logistics, including (as applicable) registration and race collection, race-day schedule, start times, course information, travel and parking, accommodation, spectators and supporters, and race-day arrangements.
  • Keep up to date with event briefings and any changes, so information given to athletes is current and consistent.

Answer kit and equipment questions

  • Respond to questions about mandatory and recommended kit, equipment requirements, and event kit such as race packs, merchandise and finisher items.
  • Provide clear, accurate guidance in line with the event rules and the official kit list, and escalate technical or rules-related queries you are unsure of.

Communication quality and continuous improvement

  • Maintain a library of approved responses and templates for common queries, in agreement with the team.
  • Spot recurring questions and recommend updates to FAQs, athlete guides or website content to reduce repeat enquiries.
  • Provide a regular summary (e.g. weekly or post-event) of enquiry volumes, common themes, issues and athlete feedback.

Requirements

Essential

  • Excellent written communication skills, with a clear, warm and professional tone.
  • Proven experience in customer service, communications or community management, ideally in events, sport or a similar consumer-facing environment.
  • Confident handling of email inboxes and social media direct messages (Instagram in particular).
  • Ability to interpret and apply terms and conditions and policies accurately and fairly.
  • Strong organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to manage a high volume of enquiries and shifting priorities, particularly around event dates.
  • Good judgement on when to resolve an enquiry independently and when to escalate.
  • Reliable, self-directed and comfortable working remotely and to deadlines.

Desirable

  • Experience in endurance sport, triathlon, running or race event operations.
  • Familiarity with event registration or ticketing platforms and shared inbox or helpdesk tools.
  • Experience handling sensitive or emotional customer situations with empathy.
  • Understanding of data protection requirements when handling personal information.

Measures of success

  • Enquiries answered within agreed response times.
  • Accurate, consistent application of withdrawal and transfer terms.
  • Positive athlete feedback and a strong, consistent brand voice across email and Instagram.
  • Timely and well-documented escalations.
  • Fewer repeat queries over time through improved FAQs and templates.

jobs.description:
Jobbeschreibung

EINSTIEGSGEHALT: 45.000–60.000 € BRUTTO-JAHRESGEHALT (ABHÄNGIG VON BERUFSERFAHRUNG UND QUALIFIKATION)

Als Growth Key Account Manager bist du unser Aushängeschild beim Kunden und Experte für unsere Software-Lösungen sowie Online-Marketing. Dein Ziel ist es, das Kundenportfolio stetig wachsen zu lassen und Klienten optimal zu beraten. So finden sie dank deiner Hilfe auch für komplexe Herausforderungen schnell zielführende Lösungen. Bewirb dich jetzt bei Digistore24 ‒ einem der Top-IT-Unternehmen Deutschlands ‒ und gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Branche

Bitte beachte: Diese Position setzt fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse voraus.

👀 Du siehts die Stelle schon länger? Ja, das Team wächst stetig, wie unser Kundenstamm.

Über Digistore24?

Wir sind ein schnell wachsendes Technologieunternehmen und haben eine klare Vision: We shape the digital future.
UnsereMission? Menschen weltweit dabei zu unterstützen, ihr Wissen online zu teilen und sich damit ein eigenes, erfolgreiches Business aufzubauen. Mit unserer Platform ermöglichen wir Millionen von Menschen den Zugang zu wertvollem Wissen und geben ihnen die Werkzeuge an die Hand, ihre Ziele wirklich zu erreichen.

Was uns besonders macht:Wir sind rund 200 hochmotivierte Mitarbeitende, die nicht auf Anweisungen warten, sondern ihren Alltag aktiv gestalten und jeden Tag neu verbessern - genau wie unsere Kunden.
Unser Team ist so vielfältig wie unsere Ideen: Menschen aus über 40 verschiedenen Ländern arbeiten bei uns gemeinsam an einer Vision. Was uns verbindet, sind unsere Werte, unser Antrieb und unser Anspruch, wirklich etwas zu bewegen.

Wir sind keine großen Redner: wir sind Macher. We love to perform.
Mit unserem Wachstum bauen wir unsere Teams gezielt und nachhaltig aus und suchen Persönlichkeiten, die Verantwortung übernehmen, mitdenken und mit uns die Zukunft gestalten.

Dein neuer Traumjob

  • Du machst den Unterschied: Mit deiner Leistung trägst du direkt zur Umsatzsteigerung von Digistore24 und unseren VIP Kunden bei. Du befähigst Online-Unternehmer, ihre Infoprodukte mit unserer Software Millionen von Menschen zugänglich zu machen, und förderst so aktiv die Digitalisierung kleiner und mittlerer Unternehmen.
  • Langfristige Direkt-Kundenbetreuung: Du betreust einen festen Kundenstamm, baust langfristige Beziehungen auf und führst mit jedem deiner Kunden regelmäßig Business-Reviews sowie Calls zur Leistungssteigerung.
  • Expertenstatus: Nach einer gründlichen Einarbeitungsphase bist du Spezialist für Online-Marketing und Software-Anwendungen. Du beantwortest eigenverantwortlich Fragen rund um unsere Features und deren Anwendungsgebiete ‒ schriftlich und telefonisch.
  • Wachstumschancen erkennst du sofort und berätst deine Kunden proaktiv zu unseren Features, um ihre Verkäufe zu steigern. Auf Basis von Sales-Trend-, Funnel- und Performance-Analysen gibst du Empfehlungen zur Optimierung ihres Business.
  • Alles im Blick: Dank regelmäßigem Monitoring registrierst du mögliche Umsatzrückgänge sofort, analysierst Hintergründe und findest Maßnahmen zur Lösung. Die Betreuung von Bug-Reports und Feature-Requests gehören ebenfalls in deinen Verantwortungsbereich.
  • Repräsentiere Digistore24: Ob bei internationalen VIP-Kunden-Events, einem Business-Lunch oder auf Messen ‒ du verstehst es, Kundenbeziehungen auch face to face zu pflegen.

PS: Es handelt sich hierbei nicht um eine Vertriebsstelle

Unsere Werte

Bitte schau dir die WIRKLICH genau an. Bist du bereit diese zu leben?

Stellenanforderungen

Das sind deine Superkräfte

  • Starkes Auftreten: Du hast einen gefestigten Charakter, Spaß an Verantwortung und bist selbstsicher im Umgang mit Menschen aller Hierarchieebenen ‒ auch in Verhandlungssituationen.
  • Kommunikationsgeschick: Du kommunizierst präzise und empfängerfreundlich. Potenzielle Konflikte entschärfst du durch Feingefühl und Lösungsorientierung. Gegenüber Kunden und deinem Team triffst du ‒ auch unter Zeitdruck ‒ stets den richtigen Ton and you can seamlessly switch to English if necessary.
  • Account Management: Du besitzt mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung im Account Management und hast mindestens ein Jahr in einem technischen Umfeld gearbeitet. Komplexe Sachverhalte vermittelst du schriftlich wie mündlich versiert. Nice to have sind Grundkenntnisse in HTML, CSS sowie Erfahrung im Online-Marketing.
  • Organisationstalent: Du arbeitest strukturiert, verlässlich und kannst eigenverantwortlich Prioritäten setzen. Dank deiner ausgezeichneten Planung behältst du auch in Stresssituationen stets den Überblick und arbeitest im Homeoffice oder in Coworking-Spaces effektiv.
  • Hohe Motivation: Unsere Branche entwickelt sich ständig weiter. Um deine Kunden als Experte optimal zu beraten, verfolgst du daher laufend aktuelle Trends und hast Spaß daran, dich immer wieder eigenverantwortlich in neue Themen einzuarbeiten.

Dieser Job ist NICHT für dich geeignet, wenn du

  • … weniger als 2 Jahre Berufserfahrungim Account Management hast.
  • … dich schwertust mit der Planung und Priorisierung deiner Aufgaben.
  • … keinen Spaß daran hast, (technische) Probleme im Detail zu analysieren und zu lösen.
  • … lieber ausschließlich schriftlich mit Kunden kommunizierst statt (auch) telefonisch.
  • … lieber an kurzweiligen Kundenanfragen arbeitest, als Kundenlangfristig und mit Fokus auf Portfolio-Wachstum zu betreuen.
  • … nicht den Anspruch hast, dein Expertenwissen laufend auszubauen oder.
  • ... dich nicht mit unseren identifizierst
  • ...nicht fließend Deutsch (C2) und Englisch (mind. B2) in Wort und Schrift beherrschst (beide Sprachen sind Voraussetzung für diese Rolle).

Deine Benefits bei Digistore24

Bei Digistore24 sind wir überzeugt: Großartige Menschen leisten ihre beste Arbeit, wenn sie echte Autonomie, klare Ziele und ein unterstützendes Umfeld haben. Das erwartet dich bei uns:

  • 100 % Remote: Arbeite dauerhaft von zu Hause aus. Alles, was du brauchst, ist eine stabile Internetverbindung.
  • Du bist permanent außerhalb Deutschlands ansässig? Auch das ist in Festanstellung in vielen europäischen Ländern möglich.
  • Arbeite bis zu 170 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU-Ausland (weitere Länder nach Absprache ggf. möglich).
  • Nutze bis zu 3 Tage pro Woche die Coworking-Spaces unseres Partners.
  • 30 Urlaubstage auf Vollzeitbasis.
  • Klare Strukturen: Arbeiteim Gleitzeitmodell und in Absprache mit deinem Team.
  • Keine starren Entwicklungspläne: Deine Weiterentwicklung richtet sich individuell nach deinen Stärken. On the job setzt du dich mit modernen und relevanten Themen auseinander.
  • Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege: Die Stabilität eines extrem erfolgreichen deutschen Hightech-Unternehmens, das sich seinen Start-Up-Spirit über die Jahre bewahrt hat.
  • Unsere Founder sind Teil unseres Teams: wir agieren ohne externe Investoren aus eigener Kraft und reinvestieren alles, was wir erwirtschaften.
  • Selbstbestimmte, ergebnisorientierte Teams: Arbeite in einer Unternehmenskultur, die auf Eigenverantwortung, Autonomie und direktes Feedback setzt, statt auf Micromanagement.
  • Du erhältst von uns modernes Equipment für deine Arbeit.
  • Internationale, kollaborative Kultur: Arbeite mit einem internationalen Team aus engagierten, klugen Köpfen zusammen.
  • Team Lunches mit Lieferando-Guthaben.
  • Echte menschliche Verbindung: Erlebe spektakuläre Team-Events in ganz Europa und baue Beziehungen auf, die über Bildschirme hinausgehen.
  • Ownership vom ersten Tag an: Bei uns bist du kein Rädchen im System, sondern ein wichtiger Teil eines A-Player-Teams und wirst von der Teamleitung persönlich gefördert (und gechallenged!), unter anderem in monatlichen One-on-One-Gesprächen. .
  • Arbeite in deinem Team per du, ohne Dresscode und auf Augenhöhe.

So sieht dein typischer Tag aus

  • Struktur ist alles: Zum Start screenst du alle Nachrichten. Auf dieser Grundlage priorisierst und planst du deine heutigen Aufgaben.
  • High-Prio-Tasks zuerst: Einer deiner Kunden hat dich gebeten, seinen Funnel zu optimieren. Du analysierst alle Parts, von der Verkaufsseite bis zur Bestellbestätigungsseite. Dank deiner Kenntnisse aus Schulungen sowie der detaillierten Checkliste siehst du das Verbesserungspotenzial. Zur Sicherheit besprichst du dich kurz mit deinem Team, damit sie ihre Erfahrungen beitragen können. Anschließend stimmst du dich mit dem Kunden zu deinen Empfehlungen ab.
  • Nun sind deine Messenger dran. Technische Fragen zu APIs, Upsell-Flows und Split-Tests beantwortest du im Handumdrehen – solche Grundlagen hast du bereits im Onboarding gelernt.
  • Jetzt steht ein virtueller Kaffee-Call an: Die nächsten 15 Minuten sind für einen entspannten Austausch beim Kaffee mit einer Teamkollegin reserviert.
  • Dich schreibt spontan ein VIP-Kunde an und bittet dich um Unterstützung bei einem technischen Problem, das dir neu ist. Du überlegst dir Lösungsvorschläge und postest diese im Team-Chat. Deine Kollegin meldet sich prompt mit Feedback. Gut zu wissen, dass dein Team dir Rückendeckung gibt 🙂
  • In deiner Mittagspause triffst du Freunde bei deinem Lieblings-Italiener um die Ecke. Diese Freiheit kannst du dir nehmen, weil du remote arbeitest, und die Pause natürlich frei gestalten kannst.
  • Mit frischem Kopf zurück steht ein Business-Review-Call an. Du bist super vorbereitet, denn du hast am Vortag den Funnel des Kunden analysiert und dir dazu Notizen gemacht. Nun hörst du dem Kunden zu, um mehr über seine Business-Ziele zu erfahren und ihn entsprechend zu unterstützen.
  • Zeit für den Check-In Call mit einer Kundin: Dir ist aufgefallen, dass sie ein verkaufsförderndes Digistore24-Feature noch nicht nutzt. Du berätst sie zu ihrem Umsatzwachstum-Potenzial und hilfst ihr beim Set-up. Dafür folgt ihr dem Prozess in unserer Wissensdatenbank – easy!
  • Als nächstes rufst du einer VIP-Kundin an, eine Ärztin, die Health-Coachings anbietet, sie hat morgen einen großen Launch, doch für ihren Kurs von der Produktgenehmigung ein Änderungswunsch gemeldet. Obwohl die Coaching-Szene umstritten ist, kennst du deine Kunden persönlich und weißt, dass wir dank deiner Kolleginnen in der Produktprüfung ausschließlich seriöse Angebote auf unserer Plattform haben. Du prüfst den Freigabeprozess. Der Grund ist schnell klar: Die Preise auf der Produktseite und im Bestellformular stimmen nicht überein. Nach der Anpassung informierst du das Produktgenehmigungsteam. Das Produkt geht online, deine Kundin ist dankbar, und Tausende von Menschen kommen ihren Gesundheitszielen näher.
  • It's time to grow: Demnächst steht ein internationales Kunden-Event an, bei dem du aus deiner Komfortzone gelockt wirst. Du wirst unsere VIP-Kunden live begleiten. Herzklopfen? Keine Sorge! Du wirst glänzen, denn du nimmst du dir eh täglich 10 Minuten Zeit, um die Historie deiner Kunden zu kennen und ihre aktuellen Projekte auf Social Media zu verfolgen. Eine “echte Verbindung” zu deinen Kunden ist dir schließlich sehr wichtig.
  • Heute steht außerdem noch ein AI-Workshop an. Ein AI-Consultant erklärt die Nutzung eines Tools, das Kundengespräche aufzeichnet und Action-Items zusammengefasst. So bleibst du bei unson top der modernsten Technologie.
  • Mit einem guten Gefühl gehst du in den Feierabend: Heute hast du wieder Neues gelernt und konstruktives Feedback von Kunden und Kollegen bekommen. Es ist einfach super zu sehen, was du bewegen kannst.

jobs.title: IT Support Associate - Buenos Aires
jobs.excerpt: Interlaced is a cloud-focused IT services provider, providing outsourced IT services for innovative businesses across the globe.
jobs.description:
Interlaced is a cloud-focused IT services provider, providing outsourced IT services for innovative businesses across the globe. We specialize in designing, implementing, and supporting cutting edge technology infrastructure that helps our clients scale and achieve their missions.

How are we different from traditional IT companies?

  • We are cloud focused (but we will train you up if you don’t have all the necessary skills yet).
  • We have professional development pathways throughout the organization with accompanying training programs.
  • We work with cutting edge clients in forward thinking industries like tech startups, biotech and digital agencies.
  • We are poised for significant growth, and need you to help us do it!
  • We are a team of hungry, innovative, technology-lovers who are excited to build something amazing together.

Requirements

Interlaced is looking to hire a contracted IT Support Associate in the Buenos Aires, Argentina. This position requires knowledge of common business technologies and experience working in diverse technical environments as well as with various cloud infrastructure components.

The candidate we are looking for has a technical skill-set, and stays up to date with the latest technology trends. The ability to quickly incorporate new techniques and processes is a must. The candidate must be personable and have the ability to interact with each level of the client's business, from the front desk to the CEO. The ability to simplify complex technical solutions and convey them to end users is a requisite.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Acting as the central point between Interlaced's clients and staff you have a responsibility to clear and timely communication between both parties via phone, email, and chat.
  • Shadowing when taking proactive and reactive tickets for the first time. Will work on some issues independently (password re-sets, distribution groups, etc) but most often assigning tickets to IT Support Technician I or II.

jobs.description:
Position: Bookkeeper / Financial Administrator

Salary: $2000-$3000 NZD

Working Hours & Conditions: Full time, New Zealand business hours

Holidays: To follow

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

The Company is the world’s largest global franchise network for swimming pool and spa care, operating over 160 retail stores and 600+ mobile service vehicles across New Zealand, Australia, and the United States. Founded in 1992 by entrepreneur John O'Brien, the brand has spent more than 30 years establishing itself as ANZ's (Australia and New Zealand's) leading pool retail and maintenance network.

ROLE OVERVIEW:

The Company is New Zealand's trusted pool and spa service brand, with more than 30 years' experience. It provides pool cleaning and maintenance, equipment inspections, repairs and installation, commercial pool services and a retail range of chemicals, cleaners, filters and pumps.

The business needs a dedicated full-time bookkeeper and financial administrator who takes full ownership of the finance function. The role is focused on bookkeeping and financial administration. Operations, general admin and inbox management are not part of it and stay with the existing team. This person becomes the single owner of the books.

The business runs on three connected systems: Pooltracker for field service and invoicing, Lightspeed for retail point of sale and inventory, and Xero as the final accounting layer. Differences between the systems are common, so the role needs someone with an investigative mindset who enjoys finding where numbers have gone astray.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Financial Administration & Xero (Primary Focus)

  • Take full responsibility for day-to-day bookkeeping, bank reconciliations, accounts payable and accounts receivable
  • Reconcile supplier statements, and chase missing invoices, credits and payment allocations
  • Code transactions accurately, with the correct accounting treatment
  • Prepare GST and GST reconciliations, ready for Kelly's review and approval
  • Prepare information for year-end and work with the accountant on the year-end accounts

Financial Systems & Troubleshooting

  • Understand how Xero, Lightspeed and Pooltrackr work together, and how data moves between them
  • Investigate and resolve discrepancies between systems, finding where errors originate and fixing them at the source
  • Improve processes so the same errors don't recur, and document the fixes
  • Manage inventory accounting: stock valuations, cost of goods sold, product costs and margins
  • Handle retail cash transactions and register reconciliations, with the associated accounting

Cashflow & Reporting

  • Maintain a weekly cashflow forecast and supplier payment schedule
  • Monitor overdue debtors and follow up outstanding accounts
  • Identify upcoming payments, cashflow pressures and anything that needs attention
  • Produce monthly profit and loss and management reports
  • Give Kelly regular financial updates, highlighting issues and recommendations

Financial Processes & Improvements

  • Review the existing financial processes, and identify what needs improving
  • Identify financial tasks, checks and reporting that aren't being done but should be, and build them into the role
  • Establish better financial controls and procedures to improve accuracy and prevent recurring errors
  • Make sure processes are followed consistently and information is accurate and up to date
  • Recommend improvements proactively, instead of waiting for issues to arise

Requirements

Non-negotiable

  • Strong Xero experience and solid knowledge of New Zealand accounting and GST requirements
  • Experience with bank reconciliations, AP, AR, supplier statements and monthly management reporting
  • Experience with inventory accounting, stock valuations, cost of goods sold and margins
  • Experience with connected financial systems, and with retail cash and register reconciliations
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, confident investigating issues and recommending solutions, not just escalating them
  • Able to look at the whole finance function and identify areas for improvement
  • Proactive, organised and able to work independently
  • Availability to work New Zealand business hours
  • Clear written English for finance communication with suppliers, the accountant and the team

Strong Plus

  • Experience with Lightspeed (retail POS and inventory)
  • Experience with a field service or job management system (Pooltrackr is niche but learnable)
  • Experience building cashflow forecasts and financial controls
  • Experience in a franchise, trades, retail or service business

Soft Skills & Working Style

The manager needs someone who takes ownership of the numbers and tells her what she needs to know before she has to ask.

  • Takes ownership, working independently and coming with recommendations, not just problems
  • Proactive and independent, taking ownership of financial tasks end to end
  • Curious and persistent when numbers don't match across systems
  • Accurate, organised and reliable, especially around month-end
  • Communicates clearly, flagging problems early and summarising things simply
  • Discreet and trustworthy with the business's financial information

We're looking for a Collections Officer to recover overdue accounts for our U.S.-based customers. This is a phone-first role: you'll own a portfolio of delinquent accounts and work them until they're resolved, which means staying composed and persistent when customers delay, deflect, or push back.

We're hiring on how you handle the call, not how many years you've been doing it. If your collections experience is recent or limited, apply anyway.

★ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH ★

AI-First Growth Marketer

Location: Remote – Argentina

Work Arrangement: This is a fully remote (telecommute) position.

Employment Type: Full-Time

Industry: Financial Services / Private Lending / Real Estate Financing

Compensation: $2,500–$3,000 USD/month

Schedule: Monday–Friday | 8:45 AM–5:45 PM U.S. Eastern Time (ET)

English Proficiency: C1+ (written and spoken)

Start Date: Before December 31, 2026

About the Role

We are hiring an AI-First Growth Marketer for a U.S.-based private direct lender that funds business-purpose real estate loans nationwide, including fix-and-flip, bridge, ground-up construction and DSCR rental loans across a wide range of loan sizes. The company markets to two audiences: real estate investors who borrow and loan brokers who refer deals.

As the company's first dedicated marketing hire, you will own the function end to end. You write a short, data-backed plan, a company partner approves it, and you build and ship it yourself. Over time, you will run marketing entirely, reporting directly to a partner.

Above all, we are looking for an AI power user backed by real marketing experience. You use Claude and other AI tools every day to research, build, automate and produce work, and your experience tells you where to aim them. Where you lack depth, you learn fast with AI or direct and check a specialist; outside help is the exception.

Why This Opportunity?

  • Be the first marketing hire and build the function your way, with a clear path to running all of marketing

  • Spend your time building: CRM workflows, live dashboards, SEO content, community engagement and PR, not decks or long strategy documents

  • Freedom to test better tools and drop anything that isn't earning its cost

  • A direct line between your work and qualified leads, broker sign-ups and funded loans

What You'll Do

CRM, Email & SMS Automation (top priority)

  • Build GoHighLevel workflows, pipelines, lead routing, nurture sequences and a recurring newsletter for borrowers and brokers

  • Create segments such as borrowers by loan type, experience and state, and brokers by deal volume

  • Clean data safely, with backups and test runs before any bulk change

Tracking, Attribution & Live Reporting

  • Capture first- and last-touch source from WordPress (Gravity Forms) into the CRM without either being overwritten

  • Own UTMs, Google Tag Manager, GA4 and Microsoft Clarity

  • Build live dashboards on lead quality, AI mentions, traffic, form submissions, broker sign-ups, referral sources and funded loans; no manual reports

SEO, AEO, Website & PR

  • Run keyword research; write and optimize product, blog and state pages; manage internal linking and schema in WordPress

  • Earn citations in ChatGPT, Claude, Google AI, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot and emerging AI agents, and keep business listings consistent

  • Build lead magnets and A/B test landing pages, starting with the application and broker pages

  • Build backlinks at scale and source, pitch and write PR, feature and guest post placements

Social Media & Community

  • Share helpful, non-spammy content on LinkedIn, BiggerPockets, Reddit, Quora, investor forums and Facebook groups from a monthly calendar

  • Lightly manage the existing reviews setup

AI Content & Sales Enablement

  • Produce emails, landing pages, graphics, direct mail, one-pagers, term sheets, case studies and broker kits with AI

  • Maintain the brand guidelines and prompts the AI follows, and turn each funded deal into multiple content formats

  • Check all output for accuracy, loan terms and brand voice before it goes out

Data, Direct Mail, Automation & Paid Ads

  • Build targeted lists and enrich the CRM with data enrichment providers, and run hyper-personalized, measured direct mail campaigns

  • Replace manual work with automation and AI through Make.com, Zapier and GoHighLevel's AI tools

  • Later, once baselines exist, own paid ads (likely through GoHighLevel), including cost per lead and lead quality by channel

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • AI power user first: heavy daily use of Claude, ChatGPT or similar, with AI agents, automations or live dashboards you built yourself

  • 3+ years as the only or second marketer at a small company or startup, covering several channels long term

  • Hands-on CRM automation (GoHighLevel ideal; HubSpot or ActiveCampaign also count)

  • Make.com, Zapier or n8n, with enough understanding of APIs and webhooks to troubleshoot

  • GA4, Google Tag Manager, UTMs and attribution, including live dashboards used by leadership

  • SEO work with measurable results, plus working knowledge of AEO and WordPress

  • Proven growth of a brand on social media and in online communities

  • Ability to produce creatives and sales materials with AI tools and Canva

  • Track record of finding, testing and rolling out new marketing tools with results that justified them

  • Strong data sense to catch errors in AI output and data; self-directed without a playbook

  • C1+ English (written and spoken) and full, exclusive commitment during U.S. Eastern hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Lending, real estate, fintech or B2B lead generation experience, including the ability to explain fix-and-flip, bridge and DSCR loans

  • Paid ads on Google or Meta, including through GoHighLevel

  • Direct mail campaign experience

  • Gravity Forms and WordPress-to-CRM integrations

  • Lightweight internal tools built with Claude Code or Cursor

Candidate Evaluation Considerations

To ensure success in this role, the following factors will be carefully evaluated during the selection process:

  • Concrete examples of AI agents, automations or live dashboards you built

  • Measurable results in SEO, lead generation and community growth

  • Technical fluency with CRM automation, attribution and integrations

  • Accuracy and judgment when reviewing AI output and data

  • Autonomy, speed of learning and clear communication in English

How Success Is Measured

  • By Day 14: Productive in the tools, with the first quick wins shipped.

  • By Day 30: CRM, website and tracking audited; a 6-month plan approved; at least 3 quick wins live.

  • By Day 90: First- and last-touch source captured on every new lead; a live baseline dashboard running; borrower and broker nurture plus a monthly newsletter in place.

  • By Day 180: Targets set for qualified leads and broker sign-ups; SEO/AEO program running; weekly community posting with leads tracked; at least one direct mail campaign tested.

  • After Month 6: Success is judged by growth in qualified borrower and broker leads and funded loans from marketing.

Why Join Us

  • Fully remote, full-time role with a U.S.-based direct lender

  • Ownership of an entire marketing function, reporting directly to a company partner

  • Visible, measurable impact on company growth

Important Notes

  • This is a hands-on execution role: no decks, long strategy documents or waiting for direction

  • Advanced AI use is the core of this role, not a nice-to-have

  • Agency or freelance project work alone does not count toward the experience requirement

Controller (FP&A, Financial Reporting & Accounting Leadership) – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced and hands-on Controller to lead accounting operations, financial reporting, compliance, and financial close processes for a growing organization.

This is a leadership role for someone who combines deep technical accounting expertise with financial planning, team leadership, and operational excellence.

You’ll work closely with Executive Leadership, FP&A, Operations, Auditors, and Finance stakeholders to ensure the organization maintains accurate financial records, strong internal controls, audit-ready reporting, and scalable accounting processes.

If you enjoy balancing detailed accounting oversight with strategic financial leadership, this role is built for you.

What You’ll Own

Month-End & Year-End Close

  • Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close processes.
  • Maintain a five-business-day month-end close target.
  • Review and approve:
    • Journal entries
    • Account reconciliations
    • Accruals
    • Payroll allocations
    • Depreciation schedules
    • Intercompany transactions
  • Prepare complete financial reporting packages, including:
    • Profit & Loss Statements
    • Balance Sheets
    • Cash Flow Statements

Financial Reporting & Executive Insights

  • Prepare GAAP and IFRS-compliant financial statements.
  • Deliver executive reporting including:
    • Variance analysis
    • Financial commentary
    • Dashboards
    • Executive reporting packages
  • Support:
    • Board reporting
    • Investor reporting
    • Strategic planning
  • Translate financial data into actionable business recommendations.

Internal Controls & Compliance

  • Design, implement, and strengthen accounting controls.
  • Ensure compliance with:
    • GAAP
    • IFRS
    • Tax regulations
    • Audit requirements
    • Regulatory obligations
  • Coordinate external audits and manage PBC (Prepared by Client) requests.
  • Maintain organized, audit-ready financial documentation.

Budgeting, Forecasting & Cash Management

  • Partner with FP&A teams on:
    • Annual budgets
    • Forecasting
    • Scenario planning
    • Capital planning
  • Monitor:
    • Cash flow
    • Liquidity
    • Working capital
    • Debt compliance
  • Provide recommendations that improve financial performance and operational efficiency.

Accounting Team Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and develop the accounting team.
  • Review work for:
    • Accuracy
    • Completeness
    • Timeliness
  • Establish scalable accounting processes and quality standards.
  • Drive continuous improvement across accounting operations.

Process Improvement & Systems

  • Lead initiatives involving:
    • ERP implementations
    • Accounting automation
    • Workflow optimization
    • SOP development
  • Improve reporting systems and accounting infrastructure.
  • Reduce manual processes while increasing scalability and efficiency.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Strong balance of technical accounting expertise and business insight.
  • Highly organized and deadline-driven.
  • Comfortable presenting financial information to executive leadership.
  • Able to lead teams while remaining hands-on.
  • Proactive in identifying risks and process improvements.
  • Passionate about building scalable financial systems and controls.

Required Experience & Skills

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in:
    • Accounting
    • Finance
    • Related field

Experience

  • 7+ years of progressive accounting or finance experience.
  • 2+ years of leadership or supervisory experience.

Technical Skills

  • Strong knowledge of:
    • GAAP
    • IFRS
    • Internal controls
    • Financial reporting
    • Financial close management
  • Hands-on experience with ERP systems such as:
    • NetSuite
    • SAP
    • Oracle
    • QuickBooks Enterprise
    • Similar platforms
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and/or Google Sheets.
  • Strong financial analysis and reporting capabilities.

Nice-to-Have

  • CPA, ACCA, or MBA.
  • Previous experience as:
    • Controller
    • Finance Manager
    • Accounting Manager
  • ERP implementation or M&A integration experience.
  • Industry experience in:
    • SaaS
    • Professional Services
    • Real Estate
  • Experience using:
    • Power BI
    • Tableau
    • Looker
    • Financial dashboards

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Review reconciliations and approve journal entries.
  • Monitor month-end close progress and accounting deliverables.
  • Prepare financial reports and variance analyses.
  • Meet with leadership to discuss financial performance.
  • Coordinate audit and compliance activities.
  • Mentor accounting team members and review work quality.
  • Improve accounting processes and automation initiatives.
  • Analyze financial trends and recommend operational improvements.

In short: You’ll ensure financial operations remain accurate, compliant, scalable, and strategically valuable while supporting leadership with reliable financial insights.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Month-end close completed within five business days.
  • Zero material audit adjustments.
  • 100% on-time regulatory and tax filings.
  • Accurate and timely executive reporting.
  • Strong accounting team performance and development.
  • Improved efficiency through automation and process optimization.

Why Join Us?

  • High visibility with executive leadership.
  • Opportunity to influence financial strategy and business performance.
  • Blend of:
    • Accounting Leadership
    • FP&A
    • Financial Reporting
    • Internal Controls
    • Process Improvement
  • Meaningful ownership and impact across the organization.
  • Opportunity to help scale financial operations in a growing business.

Interview Process

  1. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  2. Practical Financial Review Task
  3. Client Interview
  4. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

AI/ML & Advanced Analytics

  • Support federal AI, cybersecurity, privacy, and governance compliance.

Collaboration & Innovation

Experience may be considered in lieu of degree as follows: HS (19+ years), AA/AS (17+ years), BA/BS (15+ years), MA/MS (13+ years), Doctorate Degree/Ph.D. (12+ years).

About OpenSesame

OpenSesame is the trusted partner for Workforce Reinvention in the age of AI. OpenSesame delivers integrated software, curated and customizable content, and expert services – embedded into existing learning, HR, and work systems – to help organizations expand their human+AI potential and thrive through change.

Learn more:

Internship Overview

OpenSesame seeks passionate, driven students and new graduates who already use AI to build and solve problems to join our paid summer internship program. You’ll gain hands-on experience at a fast-growing, remote-first B2B SaaS company developing AI-powered products that help organizations upskill their people and fuel long-term growth.

As an intern, you’ll collaborate with experienced teammates across the company to help shape the future of OpenSesame. You’ll work on meaningful projects that bring new ideas to life, strengthen the customer experience, and help customers achieve success.

AI is how we work here, not a side topic. You’ll have access to AI tools, including Claude, and we’ll encourage you to use them to research, prototype, analyze, and build. You’ll explore how AI and data can inform strategy, improve customer outcomes, and shape the future of learning technology, and see how human-centered design and AI innovation combine to create products with global impact.

Intern AI Hackathon

As part of your internship you will have the opportunity to participate in our first intern AI hackathon this summer. You’ll team up with interns from other departments to pitch, build with AI, and present a working product idea that improves how OpenSesame works or serves customers.

About the Partnerships Team

The Partnerships Team at OpenSesame is at the forefront of building powerful alliances with industry-leading LMSs, LXPs, HR platforms, and cutting-edge technology providers.

We’re the bridge that connects innovation with opportunity, collaborating closely with Sales and Marketing to amplify OpenSesame’s reach, drive meaningful impact, and shape the future of eLearning. Together, we create strategic relationships that unlock new possibilities and fuel our mission to transform workplace training!

Performance Objectives

By 2 Weeks

  • Complete onboarding to understand OpenSesame’s partnership strategy and tools.
  • Learn how to use internal systems, including Salesforce and Google Sheets.
  • Begin supporting partner programs through database updates and organizational tasks.

By 30 Days

  • Provide analytical assistance for ongoing partner initiatives, including creating reports and presentations.
  • Collaborate with the Partnerships Team to improve internal resources and documentation.
  • Support branding and lead generation initiatives alongside Marketing and Sales teams.

By 60 Days

  • Own a project aimed at enhancing the efficiency and effectiveness of partner programs.
  • Take ownership of small projects, such as streamlining partner-related workflows or creating partner-focused resources.

Application and Creative Project

Before you start, check out our Creative Project guide. It walks through what we're looking for below in more detail.

To apply, submit one application, which includes a link to your creative project. We want to see how you think and what you've built, so your creative project must be a video (5 minutes or less), shared as a YouTube link (unlisted is fine). Applications without a working YouTube link will not be reviewed.

We care more about your curiosity and how you think than a polished result, so don't let your experience level stop you from applying.

You can talk to the camera, or walk us through slides, a demo, or a screen recording. How you show it is up to you. In your video, please cover:

  • How do you see OpenSesame fitting into your career journey or long-term goals?
  • What strengths, skills, or perspectives do you bring to OpenSesame to make an impact and contribute to our mission?
  • Show us something you've built with AI. What problem did you solve, and what excites you about where AI is taking learning and work?
    • Haven't built anything with AI yet? Make something today! Try an AI tool, experiment with a new idea, and show us or walk us through how you did it.
    • Feel free to share something from your personal life, work, school, or anywhere else. Share whatever feels right to you.

We're drawn to curiosity, creativity, growth mindset and authentic expression. Keep it concise and focused.

Not selected for this role? You're still in the running. We'll review your application for alignment with our other open internships. If we see a potential fit, we'll reach out to you directly.

Additional Program Details

Application closes: Sunday, February 14th, 2027

Program dates: Anticipated start June 17, 2027 through August 28th, 2027. We can adjust up to two weeks earlier for students returning to school before the program concludes.

Commitment: Full-time (40 hours/week)

Eligibility and location: Must be a current student enrolled in a college/university program or have graduated within the past 12 months (undergraduate, postgraduate, or associate programs accepted). This position is fully remote and can be based anywhere in the U.S.

Compensation: $20 an hour

Equipment: Interns must have a personal computer with specs suitable for the work and access to consistent high-speed internet during working hours.

Opportunities and expectations: OpenSesame's internship program is immersive and growth-focused, pairing each intern with a dedicated mentor and offering meaningful, hands-on projects that make an impact. You'll also take part in professional development sessions, networking opportunities, the intern hackathon, and book club discussions, receive volunteer time off to give back to your community, and gain full access to our course catalog for your own learning and development.

Interview process: After the application review, selected candidates will be invited to a virtual OpenSesame webinar to learn more about our company, culture, and internship program. Following the event, selected candidates will move forward to interviews with the hiring manager and team for the department they're being considered for.

Equal Employment Opportunity: OpenSesame is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer that values and welcomes diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of various legally protected characteristics, including criminal history, and strive to provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. We prioritize safety and security and may use your information accordingly, and you can contact us for assistance or accommodations during the job application process.

CPRA (California candidates): When you submit your application, OpenSesame may collect and use your personal information in accordance with our privacy policy and the CPRA. This may include personal details and employment history, and will only be used for employment-related purposes. We may share this information with third-party service providers, but we will not sell it to third parties. If you have any questions or concerns, please contact us, and for more information on your rights under the CPRA, refer to our privacy policy or the California Attorney General's website.

jobs.description:
Who are we?

It all starts with the mission: NVISO is here to protect European society from potentially devastating cyber-attacks! This means we offer cyber security services to private and governmental organizations to help them be better prepared to prevent, detect, and respond to cyber security incidents.

All of this is built on four fundamental values that define who we are: We are Proud, We Break Barriers, We Care and No BS!

What will you do?

You will be joining NVISO’s Cloud Security team as a Cloud Security Senior Consultant. The ideal candidate has knowledge in Microsoft 365 cloud services, with a particular focus on security.

As part of a team of security consultants and engineers, you will collaborate closely with other colleagues and our customers to understand their business and security requirements, assess their current security posture, and develop tailored cloud security solutions for them.

Responsibilities

We are aware that cloud security features and products are abundant; the following list apply to the ones of interest to us. If you have experience or feel capable of conducting only some of them (not the full list), please reach out!

Strategy and Governance

  • Assess cloud security posture against frameworks (e.g., CIS, NIST, ISO 27001) and Microsoft benchmarks (Azure Security Benchmark, M365 baseline).

  • Define cloud security strategy, target operating model, and roadmap aligned to business and regulatory requirements.

  • Develop and maintain cloud security policies, standards, and guardrails for Azure and M365.

Identity and Access Management (IAM)

  • Design and implement Microsoft Entra tenant architecture, including identity lifecycle, conditional access, and MFA.

  • Implement and tune Conditional Access policies, risk-based access, and device compliance integrations with Intune/Endpoint Manager.

  • Deploy and operate Privileged Access Management (PAM), including PIM for Azure and M365 roles, just-in-time access, and break-glass accounts.

  • Integrate on-premises identities (hybrid) with secure synchronization and hardening of federation where used.

Platform Security and Hardening (Azure)

  • Build secure landing zones using Azure Policy, Blueprints/Bicep/Terraform, and management groups.

  • Enforce baseline controls for networking (NSGs, Azure Firewall, Private Link), compute (secure images, patching), and storage (encryption, private endpoints).

  • Configure Azure Key Vault for secrets, keys, and certificates management with RBAC and purge protection.

  • Implement workload isolation, tagging, and resource locks; manage identity-based access (managed identities).

Threat Protection and Monitoring

  • Deploy and tune Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Defender for Cloud Apps (MCAS), Defender for Endpoint, and Defender for Identity.

  • Configure Microsoft Sentinel: data connectors, analytics rules, UEBA, watchlists, workbooks, and SOAR playbooks (Logic Apps).

  • Develop detection use cases, threat hunting queries (KQL), and incident response runbooks specific to Azure and M365 threats.

  • Establish alert triage, escalation paths, and continuous tuning to reduce noise and improve mean time to detect/respond.

Microsoft 365 Security

  • Configure and manage Microsoft Purview (Compliance portal) for DLP, information protection labels, data lifecycle, and insider risk.

  • Implement Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Teams security baselines, safe links/attachments, and anti-phishing policies.

  • Enforce device compliance via Intune, app protection policies, and conditional access for BYOD and corporate devices.

  • Secure collaboration and external sharing with sensitivity labels, access reviews, and entitlement management.

Data Protection and Encryption

  • Design data classification and labelling strategies with Microsoft Purview; enforce DLP across endpoints, Exchange, SharePoint, and Teams.

  • Ensure encryption at rest and in transit, customer-managed keys (CMK), and double encryption where required.

  • Implement eDiscovery, legal hold, and audit configurations for regulatory needs.

Requirements

  • You hold citizenship of a NATO member country or Austria and are eligible for NATO security clearance.

  • At least 3 years of experience in information security specific to Azure or Microsoft 365 cloud environments.

  • Proven expertise with Microsoft’s cloud security services, including Entra ID, Microsoft Sentinel, and Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Cloud Apps, Defender for Identity, Intune, and/or Purview.

Quem somos/Who We Are

A Terra Mobility é um grupo líder global em mobilidade focado em viagens interurbanas terrestres, com a missão de transformar a forma como as pessoas se conectam em todo o mundo.

O grupo opera um mercado B2C focado na reserva de viagens interurbanas terrestres (ônibus, trem, caronas compartilhadas e muito mais), utilizado por mais de 100 milhões de viajantes em mais de 3 milhões de rotas em mais de 80 países.

A empresa também oferece software SaaS B2B vertical que impulsiona os negócios de centenas de operadores de viagens terrestres em todo o mundo.

Capacitamos os viajantes a descobrir novos destinos, construir conexões e experimentar o mundo, tudo isso enquanto fazem escolhas ambientalmente conscientes, promovendo um modo de transporte mais sustentável e acessível.

Terra Mobility is a leading global mobility group focused on intercity ground travel with a mission to transform the way people connect across the globe.

The group operates a B2C marketplace focused on booking intercity ground travel (bus, train, ridesharing & more) used by over 100 million travellers on over 3 million routes in 80+ countries.
The company also offers vertical B2B SaaS software that powers the business of hundreds of ground travel operators worldwide.

We empower travelers to discover new destinations, build connections, and experience the world — all while making environmentally conscious choices by fostering a more sustainable and accessible mode of transportation.

A função

Estamos em busca de um Customer Success Manager para desenvolver a operação, garantindo que os clientes alcancem sucesso contínuo com os produtos. Atuar de forma estratégica e orientada a dados para elevar satisfação, retenção e expansão, fortalecendo relacionamentos, impulsionando crescimento sustentável e assegurando alinhamento entre as necessidades dos clientes, a eficiência operacional e os objetivos organizacionais.

We are looking for a Customer Success Manager to develop the operation, ensuring that customers achieve ongoing success with our products. Act strategically and in a data-driven manner to increase satisfaction, retention, and expansion, strengthening relationships, driving sustainable growth, and ensuring alignment between customer needs, operational efficiency, and organizational goals.

O que irá fazer / What you'll be doing.

  • Conduzir pesquisas, conversas e entrevistas com clientes para entender necessidades, dores e percepção de valor;

  • Construir e manter dashboards, health score e relatórios de acompanhamento da carteira;
  • Conduzir reuniões periódicas de resultado (QBRs) com os clientes, apresentando indicadores e próximos passos.
  • Manage the customer portfolio end to end, acting as the point of reference for road passenger transportation companies in adopting and using the solutions;
  • Follow the implementation of new customers alongside the responsible teams, making sure milestones progress, risks are handled and the customer reaches stable operation;
  • Analyze customer usage, operational, sales and performance data to measure account health, identify patterns and support recommendations;
  • Identify, prioritize and address churn, low adoption and dissatisfaction risks, with action plans agreed with the customer;
  • Map improvements in customer operations and create expansion opportunities (upsell and cross-sell) together with the Sales team;
  • Run product demos and proofs of concept during the sales process, supporting the Sales team, and for existing customers, as well as tests of new features;
  • Conduct customer surveys, conversations and interviews to understand needs, pain points and perceived value;
  • Turn field learnings into structured input for Product and Engineering, supporting roadmap prioritization based on value for the Brazilian market;
  • Coordinate Sales, Engineering and Product to remove blockers and ensure that commitments made to customers are met;
  • Build and maintain dashboards, health scores and portfolio tracking reports;
  • Run periodic business reviews (QBRs) with customers, presenting indicators and next steps.

O que buscamos / Who you are

  • Forte capacidade analítica: leitura de dados, construção de indicadores e transformação de números em recomendações claras;
  • Domínio de ferramentas de análise de dados (Excel ou Google Sheets avançado, SQL e ferramentas de BI como Looker, Power BI ou Metabase);
  • Perfil resolutivo, com autonomia para diagnosticar problemas, propor soluções e conduzi-las até a conclusão;
  • Conhecimento do mercado de transporte rodoviário de passageiros: operação das empresas, canais de venda, bilhetagem, regulação da ANTT e BP-e;
  • Domínio de práticas e métricas de Customer Success (health score, NPS, adoção, retenção e expansão);
  • Organização e acompanhamento de projetos, com controle de prazos e comunicação com múltiplas partes;
  • Habilidade para conduzir pesquisas e entrevistas com clientes e sintetizar os achados;
  • Boa comunicação com públicos técnicos e de negócio, incluindo apresentações para gestores e diretoria do cliente;
  • Entendimento técnico de produtos SaaS, APIs e integrações, suficiente para conduzir demonstrações e testes e dialogar com Engenharia.
  • Graduação Completa

  • Command of data analysis tools (advanced Excel or Google Sheets, SQL and BI tools such as Looker, Power BI or Metabase);
  • Problem-solving profile, with the autonomy to diagnose issues, propose solutions and see them through;

Remuneração e Benefícios / What’s in it for you

jobs.excerpt: Who We Are Flosum is a bootstrapped, profitable B2B SaaS company building the leading Salesforce-native DevSecOps, Data Protection, and Security platform.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Flosum is a bootstrapped, profitable B2B SaaS company building the leading Salesforce-native DevSecOps, Data Protection, and Security platform. Our solutions are trusted by Fortune 500 enterprises in the most heavily regulated industries on the planet — financial services, healthcare, government, and insurance.

We’re not a startup burning cash and chasing vanity metrics. We’re a proven, scaling business that reached profitability on our own terms. As a Salesforce Summit Partner and Innovation Award winner, we’ve earned our seat at the table alongside the biggest names in enterprise software.

Built 100% on the Salesforce platform. Serving enterprises that demand zero compromise on security, compliance, and reliability.

Why This Role Exists

We are entering an aggressive growth phase — expanding our product surface, deepening our platform capabilities, and accelerating our delivery velocity. We need senior-caliber Node.js developers who can own significant parts of our architecture and ship production code that enterprise customers depend on daily.

This is not a staff augmentation seat. You will work directly with engineering leadership, product managers, and the CEO. Your decisions will have real consequences, your opinions will be heard, and your craftsmanship will be visible to the customers who rely on our platform.

What You’ll Build

  • High-performance backend services and APIs powering enterprise-grade SaaS applications
  • Scalable, secure Node.js micro services and integrations within the Salesforce ecosystem
  • Modern front-end experiences using Vue.js and TypeScript that serve demanding enterprise users
  • CI/CD pipeline tooling, automation frameworks, and developer productivity infrastructure
  • Real-time data processing and event-driven architectures handling sensitive enterprise data at scale

Requirements

Read this section carefully. We are specific about what we need because we are serious about who we hire.

Non-Negotiable Technical Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional Node.js development in production environments — not tutorials, not side projects, not bootcamp exercises. Real production systems serving real users at scale.
  • Expert-level understanding of asynchronous programming, event loops, streams, and the Node.js runtime. You should be able to explain backpressure, the differences between setImmediate and process.nextTick, and why unhandled promise rejections are dangerous — without Googling it.
  • Deep experience with TypeScript in production codebases. We write typed code, and we expect you to understand why.
  • Strong command of RESTful API design, authentication patterns (OAuth 2.0, JWT), and API security best practices for enterprise environments.
  • Proven experience with SQL and NoSQL databases, query optimization, data modeling, and understanding the performance implications of schema decisions at scale.
  • Proficiency with Git workflows, code review practices, automated testing (unit, integration, and end-to-end), and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Solid understanding of containerization (Docker), cloud services (AWS/GCP/Azure), and infrastructure-as-code principles.

Highly Preferred (These Will Set You Apart)

  • Salesforce development experience: Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, or Salesforce API integrations. If you know both Node.js and Salesforce, you are a rare and extremely valuable candidate to us.
  • Experience building or contributing to Salesforce ISV (AppExchange) products.
  • Vue.js front-end development experience, particularly with Vue 3 Composition API and state management.
  • Experience working in B2B SaaS companies serving enterprise customers with strict compliance requirements (SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP, GDPR).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/DevSecOps toolchains and practices in the Salesforce ecosystem.

The Kind of Person We’re Looking For

Skills get you in the door. Mindset determines whether you thrive here:

Missionary, Not Mercenary

You care about what you’re building and why. You take ownership not because someone assigned it to you, but because that’s who you are. When something is broken at 2 AM, you don’t check whether it’s “your responsibility” — you fix it.

Builder, Not a Bystander

You don’t wait for perfect specifications. You dig in, ask hard questions, propose solutions, and ship. You would rather have a working prototype by Friday than a polished slide deck by next quarter.

Craftsperson Under Pressure

Enterprise customers depend on our uptime and data integrity. You write code that doesn’t just work — it survives. You understand that in regulated industries, your code is your reputation.

Direct Communicator

You say what you think, respectfully and clearly. If a technical decision is wrong, you speak up — regardless of who made it. We value candor over politeness-at-the-expense-of-quality.

This Is a Long-Term Commitment

Let us be direct: we are not looking for contractors who jump between projects every few months. We are building a world-class engineering team, and we invest heavily in the people who join us. In return, we expect commitment.

This role is designed as a long-term, full-time engagement. You will grow with us. You will own systems end-to-end. You will see the direct impact of your work in how Fortune 500 companies build, protect, and deploy on Salesforce.

If you’re looking for a short-term gig while you wait for something else, this isn’t the role. If you want to build something that matters and be part of a team that’s scaling from strong to dominant, keep reading.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation commensurate with your experience and impact
  • Direct collaboration with the founding team and engineering leadership — your voice will carry weight from day one
  • A profitable, stable company with aggressive growth plans — no funding anxiety, no runway clock
  • The opportunity to work on enterprise-grade products used by some of the largest organizations in the world
  • Meaningful technical challenges: security, compliance, scale, and reliability at the intersection of Node.js and Salesforce
  • A culture that rewards ownership, speed, and craftsmanship over politics and hierarchy
  • Remote-first flexibility with a results-oriented work environment

About the Company

We're not telehealth and we're not a traditional doctor's office: we're the best parts of both. Our mission at Rezilient is simple: to make access to primary care convenient, timely and seamless.

In our hybrid model, clinics are staffed by paramedics with the provider joining the appointment virtually on-screen. The provider relies on the medic as their partner for a thorough physical assessment, with the aid of connected devices that live stream ENT, skin, and cardio respiratory exams. Not only does this allow the provider to see and hear high quality exams, but it allows the patient to participate in the experience themself through hearing their own heartbeat or seeing their own eardrum.

Our model is breaking through the old way of medicine and bringing transparency and high quality care through the use of technology. We are looking for team members that are ready to expand and break new grounds in the world of primary care.

About the Role

The Practice Administrator will support the day-to-day administrative provider operations of Rezilient Health’s provider practice, ensuring physicians, nurse practitioners, and physician assistants are operationally supported in providing safe, compliant, high-quality patient care. This role is responsible for provider schedules, licensure and credentialing, adherence to compliance and quality initiatives, continuing education coordination, and overall provider administrative management. The Practice Administrator works collaboratively with clinical and administrative teams to achieve organizational goals and deliver excellent patient experiences.

Key Responsibilities

Clinical Operations

  • Manage provider schedules in partnership with lead NPs and MDs, including on-call, weekend, and holiday coverage and time-off requests ensuring adequate coverage for volume demands.
  • Build business requirements to enhance and improve the administrative scheduling load within the Rezilient application to support workforce management.
  • Serve as the primary liaison between providers, staff, vendors, and leadership to ensure smooth communication and problem resolution.
  • Optimize provider administration through efficiency, productivity, and panel size without compromising patient care.
  • Evaluate and monitor KPI progress and identify and report provider coaching opportunities.
  • Coordinate with Clinical Operations Managers to align provider coverage with CloudClinic medic schedules and new market go-lives.
  • Deliver a weekly provider operations status report covering aging licenses, state-by-state status, CPA completion, onboarding pipeline, and licensing spend against budget.
  • Own assigned OKRs and keep the Clinical Operations priorities tracker current.

Licensure, Credentialing & Education

  • Ensure timely provider licensure, certification, and credentialing across all required entities and vendors.
  • Maintain provider licensures, continuing education hours, certifications, and credentialing.
  • Maintain current knowledge of industry regulations including CAQH and implement policy/procedure updates as required.
  • Coordinate continuing education, training, and certification renewals for providers.
  • Leads the scheduling coordination in partnership with the Director Clinical Education and Development for new provider onboarding and internal continuous learning sessions.
  • Determine the licensing pathway for each provider (individual state license, Interstate Medical Licensure Compact, and PA Licensure Compact once privileges are issued) and maintain a state coverage map tied to the market launch calendar.
  • Obtain and renew NPI and PDMP registrations where required, with zero lapses.
  • Own the full collaborative practice agreement (CPA) and supervision lifecycle for NPs and PAs, including collaborating physician matching, execution, renewals, prescriptive authority registrations, and state-required chart review cadence.
  • Manage credentialing and re-credentialing with partner health systems and other required entities, including CAQH profiles and attestations, primary source verification, and medical staff office coordination.
  • Conduct monthly OIG and SAM exclusion screening and track malpractice certificates of insurance for all providers.
  • Monitor state board actions, practice restrictions, and regulatory changes, escalating issues to the CMO and Head of Clinical Operations.
  • Partner with People Operations to sequence provider start dates based on licensure and credentialing readiness, and provision system access and clinical resources (EHR, Rezilient application, clinical references) with tracked renewals.
  • Lead end-to-end provider offboarding, including CPA termination, license and vendor deactivation, partner notification, and record archiving.

Quality & Project Management

  • Identify and report administrative trends benefiting from continuous quality improvement.
  • Conduct appointment and chart audits reporting findings to Head of Clinical Operations and MD.
  • Identify and send APRN and PA chart reviews to Collaborative Practice MD for compliance reviews.
  • Track collaborating physician chart review completion against each state's required cadence and escalate gaps.

Financial & Administrative Oversight

  • Partner with finance teams to monitor practice budgets, expenses, provider overtime, and revenue targets set by department heads.
  • Manage licensing and credentialing vendors and the provider compliance tracking system, including SLAs, volume forecasts, and contract performance.
  • Track licensing and credentialing spend against budget.
  • Prepare business cases and vendor comparisons to support leadership decisions.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Nursing, Business Administration, or related field required; Master’s preferred.
  • Minimum 3–5 years of experience in healthcare administration, preferably in a multi-provider and virtual practice setting.
  • Strong knowledge of healthcare regulations, credentialing, and multi-state licensing practices.
  • Minimum 2 years of hands-on multi-state licensing and credentialing experience for MDs/DOs, NPs, and PAs.
  • Working knowledge of state NP and PA scope-of-practice, collaboration, and supervision requirements, and of compact licensure pathways.
  • Proven ability to manage provider schedules and operations.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and leadership skills.
  • Proficiency with electronic health records (EHR) and practice management software.
  • Experience with credentialing or license-tracking platforms; Epic experience a plus.
  • Strong written communication, including status reports, business cases, and vendor comparisons.
  • Demonstrated experience in one or more of the following clinical settings: virtual primary care, virtual urgent care, ambulatory care.
  • Proficiency in working independently and collaboratively with clinical and non-clinical staff.
  • Excellent remote and in-person communication skills, enabling seamless interaction with colleagues.
  • A proactive problem-solving attitude, coupled with a passion for revolutionizing healthcare.
  • A hands-on, can-do personality, driven to contribute to innovative solutions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • CMPE (MGMA), CPCS, or CPMSM certification.
  • Experience in a multi-state telehealth or employer-sponsored primary care organization.
  • Experience implementing a provider compliance or credentialing system.

Success Measures (First 12 Months)

  • Zero lapsed licenses, registrations, or CPAs.
  • 100% CPA and chart review compliance by state.
  • Days from offer to ready-to-practice tracked for every new provider and improving.
  • On-time renewals and re-credentialing at or above 98%.
  • Provider coverage meeting scheduled demand.

Benefits

At Rezilient Health, we're on a mission to make humane healthcare truly abundant, and we invest in the people who make that possible. This is a high-impact role where your ideas directly shape how care is delivered, within a supportive, collaborative, and diverse team that believes healthcare is fundamentally a human experience. We back that commitment with a robust total rewards package:

  • Meaningful ownership through stock options, allowing you to share directly in the value you help create as we grow
  • Competitive base compensation
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage options, with Rezilient contributing toward your premiums
  • Complimentary access to Rezilient's clinical programs for you and your household members, the same connected care we deliver to our patients
  • 401(k) retirement plan to support your long-term financial well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off, so you can recharge without counting days
  • Dedicated Paid Sick Leave, separate from your FTO, for when health needs come first
  • 11 paid company holidays each year
  • Paid family leave to support you through life's biggest moments
  • Optional ancillary benefits, including life insurance, disability coverage, and a Health Savings Account (HSA)

Rezilient Health is an equal opportunity employer. As such, we welcome and celebrate people of all backgrounds and are committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination and harassment.

All employment decisions at Rezilient are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, genetic information, age, veteran, disability, family or parental status, and any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

We encourage you to come as you are, resting assured that we strive to provide an equitable and inclusive experience for every candidate.
