jobs.description:
Role Overview

Are you an experienced Business Development Manager with a strong understanding of agriculture and a track record of growing markets through distributors and commercial partnerships?

We’re looking for a Distributor Business Development Manager to join our high performing team to help drive the next phase of growth for ABS across key European and international markets. This is a high-impact commercial role where you’ll take ownership of strategic territories, strengthen existing distributor partnerships and identify new routes to market that unlock sustainable, profitable growth.

With responsibility for market strategy, commercial performance and P&L, you’ll work closely with our distributor network to build capability, increase market penetration and bring ABS genetics, technical expertise and value propositions to more customers.

If you enjoy developing markets, building long-term partnerships and turning commercial strategy into measurable results, this is an opportunity to make a genuine international impact.

You will need to be highly motivated to build a market almost from scratch and with little guidance

This is a remote role where the preferred location is Germany, you'll need to be comfortable with 50% travel

The salary for this role is expected to be between €90,000 and €110,000

You Will

  • Working with the ABS Product Line Management & Commercial team and relevant sources to obtain market data & evaluate opportunity linked to ABS value propositions. Developing an understanding of relevant markets and how they are likely to respond
  • Responsible for finding, growing, managing the network of distributors in targeted markets for long-term agreements. Identify and engage with prospects, convert prospects into new route to markets (RTM). Ensure the distributor experience exceeds expectations
  • Negotiate and deliver commercial agreements including financial and legal due diligence
  • Responsible for growing a market by managing the network of distributors in targeted markets for long-term agreements
  • Prepare and agree operational and strategic action plans with the distributor
  • Prioritise resources and build capability in Distributors around value propositions
  • Develop the route to market; primarily by education on genetics, sales methodology and technical services to distributor employees, but also making changes in the route where appropriate
  • Deliver a strategy to grow operating profit through business plans focused on value propositions
  • Listen to local customer needs and identify solutions. Utilise ABS customer database (CRM) where appropriate and build segmentation knowledge
  • Develop a keen understanding of competitors in markets, anticipating their actions, and crafting proactive strategies to respond effectively. Communicate any relevant market trends and competitor activities through both informal channels and formal monthly reports
  • Work with the Genus Finance Partner to provide monthly, quarterly and annual financial forecasts and advise changes. Take accountability for bad debt and cash collection
  • Interpret internal or external business issues and recommend best practices

Requirements

  • Degree in Business Management and/or Agriculture
  • International business development preferred; extensive commercial retail or wholesale route to market management experiences with demonstrable impact
  • Willingness to travel up to 50% of your time
  • English language capability to a professional standard
  • Multi-lingual capability an advantage

Business Overview

ABS - is the world-leading provider of bovine genetics, reproductive services, technologies and udder care products. Marketed in more than 70 countries, ABS has been at the forefront of animal genetics and technology since its founding in 1941.  We are uniquely positioned as a global player with a dedicated R&D function and an international distribution network.

We breed and distribute the genes of the world’s best bulls, scientifically selecting livestock to increase the profitability of our customers who are some of the world’s biggest farmers and food producers.

IntelliGen Technologies is the technology within ABS that develops sexed bovine genetics that helps customers maximize their profitability and reach their end goals in a fast and efficient manner.

We were born to challenge standards. Since the beginning, innovation has been part of our DNA. From co-development of the first semen tank, to the recent ground-breaking launch of our innovative Sexcel® sexed genetics product, we have made our mark in the bovine genetics industry.

Genus is an agricultural biotechnology pioneer. We are a global FTSE 250 company, headquartered in the UK, and listed on the London Stock Exchange. Genus PLC has a presence in over 70 countries and a global workforce of over 3,000 employees and growing. We are a worldwide leader in porcine and bovine animal genetics, partnering with farmers to transform how we nourish the world – a mission that is important to a sustainable future.

Our vision is clear: Pioneering animal genetic improvement to sustainably nourish the world.

Our Values

  • Collaborate as One Team
  • Create Value for Customers
  • Innovate with Purpose
  • Never stop improving

DEI

Genus is a place where you can be yourself and be part of a growing global team. We have a culture of respect, openness and fairness for all. Whatever your background, your role or your area of work, you will have the chance to thrive in an environment that inspires, challenges and supports you to succeed.

Tackling climate change:

  • Monitor and identify goals for the reduction of our GHG emissions from our own operations.
  • Drive porcine and bovine genetic improvements which support productivity gains and improve feed efficiency, enabling a reduction in the production of greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions per unit of milk or meat produced
  • Identify facility and other opportunities for reductions in GHG emissions, consistent with our goals
  • Partner and advocate for policies that advance positive climate goals and identified United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

Benefits Overview

jobs.title: Social Content Manager
jobs.excerpt: 🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.
jobs.description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not only about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo.

Due to high interest, we’ll close applications once we have enough candidates to move to the next stage. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible so you don’t miss out.

📍UK Remote | 💰£68,000 - £85,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits ✨

The Role 🚀

We’re hiring a Social Content Manager to join the team at Monzo. We’re looking for a brilliant social strategist and storyteller to help us scale our next chapter: showing up less like a standard brand account and more like an authoritative, high-craft Media Publisher.

Through witty, relatable, and deeply educational content, we’ve already proven that we can challenge what a bank looks like online. But as we expand, our goal is to drive deep trust and authority around the culture of money. We want to take complex financial concepts and turn them into highly engaging, platform-native formats that position Monzo as THE banking partner of choice.

This role is to build always-on, high-performing organic ecosystems that drive real brand love and broaden our product association across our portfolio.

We’ve built a great foundation, but we want to go further. As our Social Content Manager, you’ll be the creative engine behind our feeds. You won't just follow internet culture; you’ll help us create it, turning complex financial concepts into scroll-stopping, uniquely Monzo content.

The Team 💫

You’ll join a tight-knit, collaborative social team. You’ll report directly to our Head of Social and Influencer, working alongside another Social Content Manager (who focuses on campaign strategy) and a dedicated Social Creative Producer.

Monzo is growing up, and we’re ready for our next stage of growth. We’re moving away from the old playbook to build a high-quality, always-on social ecosystem with partners at the top of their game, and we need someone to lead the charge. This role is a massive piece of the puzzle. You’ll have the creative autonomy to experiment, tear up the rulebook, and directly define how Monzo shows up across the internet.

You’ll play a key role by...

  • Champion platform-native creativity: Bring a deep, nuanced understanding of social platforms, including TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, Facebook and Threads. You know what makes audiences click, share, and engage, and you’ll use this expertise to make sure our content always feels native, timely, and culturally relevant.
  • Co-create with agency partners and creators: Act as a key creative bridge, collaborating hand-in-hand with external agency partners and creators. You'll help brief, guide, and refine their output to design and execute repeatable, episodic content formats that build long-term audience loyalty.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Work seamlessly across internal teams, partnering with Brand Designers, Copywriters, and the broader marketing org, to align social-first concepts with our overarching brand strategies and business goals.
  • Translate platform insights into action: Keep a pulse on performance metrics and platform trends. You’ll translate data and audience behavior into actionable creative insights, continuously refining your concepts to keep our brand at the cutting edge. You won’t be afraid to experiment and learn from the data.

We’d love to hear from you if…

  • You balance strategic partnerships with hands-on hustle. You’re completely comfortable collaborating with agency partners to bring big ideas to life, but you’re equally excited to roll up your sleeves and get stuck into the day-to-day execution.
  • You have a deep understanding of social platforms. You know how to hook an audience in the first two seconds, you understand algorithm behavior, and you have a portfolio of social-first content you’re incredibly proud of that shows your ability to translate concepts across channels.
  • You’re driven by commercial performance. You don’t just create for the sake of views or vanity metrics; you have a strong commercial instinct and a genuine interest in how creative storytelling drives real business growth.
  • You thrive in a lean, agile environment. You’re excited to be a key player in a tight-knit, in-house team where your impact is felt daily and collaboration is second nature. You’ll be an expert at understanding how our always on strategy can support other key brand moments, collaborating seamlessly with our campaign team to bring this to life seamlessly.
  • You have high empathy and good judgment. Money can be a sensitive topic. You know how to be funny and provocative without punching down or taking unnecessary risks with our brand reputation.
  • You have impeccable planning skills. You’ll have your finger on the pulse of money and wider culture to look at how we integrate trending conversations in to our brand world, tastefully and with meaningful value for our audience.

This role may not be for you if...

  • You want to slot into a fully fleshed-out system. We are still actively building, experimenting, and scaling our social playbook. If you need rigid, pre-established processes to succeed rather than the chance to help craft and design our systems from inception, this won’t be the right fit.
  • You shy away from high-production social. While we love quick, reactive, and native content, we also play in the big leagues. You will be an expert at knowing which muscle to flex and when. We dream up and execute highly polished, ambitious campaigns and episodic series alongside agency partners. If you're only comfortable making low-fi, phone-shot videos, you'll miss out on the scale of what we're trying to build.

Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!

🙌 What’s in it for you

💰 £68,000 - £85,000 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.

📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London)

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.

📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps

  1. Intro call with the recruiter
  2. Video call with Hiring Manager
  3. Take home Task
  4. Full loop Behavioural and Role Specific interviews

We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

Due to high interest, we’ll close applications once we have enough candidates to move to the next stage. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible so you don’t miss out.

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage.

This is a remote position.

Power BI Adoption Lead

Most Power BI roles ask you to build what someone else has already specified. This one asks you to decide how an entire enterprise uses Power BI — and then to make it happen.

A leading UK financial services organisation is standing up a modern cloud data platform, with Power BI as the strategic reporting layer on top of it. The governed semantic layer, certified datasets, enterprise design standards and community of practice are still being shaped — and the organisation is serious enough about data capability to have already invested in it. You will decide what good looks like, and own it end to end.

This is deliberately not a pure Power BI developer role, and equally not a change-management role. It is the rarer combination: someone who can build a performant enterprise semantic model, credibly challenge a developer's DAX, then stand in front of the business and teach it.

What you'll do

  • Own the enterprise Power BI adoption roadmap, with measurable adoption and value targets.
  • Build engagement from the ground up: stakeholder buy-in, a champions network, forums, clinics and a genuine community of practice.
  • Design and personally deliver structured training — workshops, learning materials and guidance, pitched from Excel-refugee to seasoned analyst.
  • Shape the governed semantic layer alongside data engineering: consistent KPI definitions, certification processes, naming conventions and refresh strategy.
  • Author the enterprise reporting Design Guide — standards, templates, palettes, UX conventions — and hold the organisation to it.
  • Establish workspace governance: deployment pipelines, Dev/QA/Prod design, RLS/CLS, sensitivity labelling and auditability.
  • Build and optimise flagship dashboards yourself, and troubleshoot performance where others are stuck.
  • Reduce duplicated, ungoverned reporting — and prove you have.

Requirements

Essential experience

  • Power BI technical depth — you have personally delivered enterprise-scale Power BI. Advanced DAX, Power Query/M, semantic model design and optimisation, large and complex datasets, workspace strategy and administration, RLS, certified datasets. You can coach on all of it and push back on poor implementation.
  • Adoption & change leadership — you have created an enterprise adoption roadmap, run champion networks, driven cultural change around data-driven decision making, and measured adoption and business value. This is the most critical dimension of the role.
  • Training & enablement — you have designed and personally delivered structured training programmes and built the materials yourself. Occasional knowledge-sharing is not what we mean.
  • Governance & operating model — reporting standards, dashboard design principles, workspace management, certified dataset processes and self-service controls. You know how to scale Power BI without creating a governance problem.

Desirable

Format and style are entirely your own.

jobs.excerpt: THE COMPANY At Cardiovascular Associates of America (CVAUSA), we believe that the total cost of cardiovascular care is too high and the optimal way to identify and remove the avoidable costs in cardiovascular care delivery is by equipping and empowering cardiovascular physicians with new care models and new financial incentives via risk-based contracts.
jobs.description:
THE COMPANY
At Cardiovascular Associates of America (CVAUSA), we believe that the total cost of cardiovascular care is too high and the optimal way to identify and remove the avoidable costs in cardiovascular care delivery is by equipping and empowering cardiovascular physicians with new care models and new financial incentives via risk-based contracts.

Novocardia, the value-based care division of CVAUSA, is responsible for supporting our partner practices to transform care models in ways which improve care quality and help achieve the triple aim and implement risk-based contracting. We are deeply passionate about improving care quality, and about providing more Americans with access to great, evidence-based chronic disease care. We are also committed to building more sustainable and durable payment models for this care – models which reward clinicians for delivering the right care, in the right place at the right time.

OPPORTUNITY
The Director of Actuarial Services is responsible for leading the analysis, monitoring, and evaluation of financial, clinical, operational, and utilization performance across Novocardia's value-based care arrangements. This role serves as a strategic partner to Operations, Clinical, Finance, Contracting, and Executive Leadership teams by identifying performance drivers, quantifying opportunities, and developing actionable recommendations that improve outcomes and financial performance.
The Director of Actuarial Services will develop and execute a robust performance management framework that evaluates performance at the contract, market, and population levels. This individual will monitor results against financial targets, underwriting assumptions, benchmarks, and shared savings expectations to identify performance gaps, evaluate opportunities, assess interventions, and measure financial impact.
This role will apply actuarial methodologies to forecasting, settlement reconciliations, valuation modeling, opportunity analyses, and financial performance assessments. The position plays a critical role in translating complex healthcare data into meaningful insights that support strategic decision-making and value-based care success.

The ideal candidate possesses strong healthcare analytics, medical economics, and actuarial problem-solving skills, with the ability to connect operational performance and clinical outcomes to financial results. Successful candidates will have experience identifying savings opportunities, performing financial impact analyses, reconciling payer-reported performance, and developing models that support growth and profitability.
The Director of Actuarial Services will serve as a key leader responsible for advancing the organization's actuarial strategy, analytical rigor, and financial performance across value-based care programs.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES
Actuarial Services & Performance Management
  • Lead the development and execution of a comprehensive performance management framework across value-based care arrangements.
  • Monitor contract performance relative to budgets, forecasts, benchmarks, underwriting assumptions, and shared savings targets.
  • Identify performance gaps, emerging risks, and opportunities through analysis of medical costs, utilization, quality, and operational metrics.
  • Develop methodologies that measure performance at the contract, market, and population levels.
  • Establish recurring processes that support performance monitoring, financial accountability, and operational optimization.
Trend Analysis & Opportunity Identification
  • Analyze medical cost, utilization, quality, risk adjustment, and provider performance trends to identify key drivers of results.
  • Quantify opportunities that impact total cost of care, quality outcomes, risk adjustment revenue, and value-based care performance.
  • Investigate favorable and unfavorable performance drivers and communicate findings to leadership.
  • Translate analytical findings into actionable operational, clinical, and contractual strategies.
  • Support the development and prioritization of initiatives designed to improve performance and financial outcomes.
Actuarial Analysis & Financial Modeling
  • Apply actuarial and medical economics principles in the analysis of healthcare claims, eligibility, utilization, and financial data.
  • Develop, maintain, and enhance forecasting, projection, and valuation models used to assess contract performance and opportunity areas.
  • Quantify the expected and realized financial impact of operational, clinical, and strategic initiatives.
  • Support budgeting, forecasting, target-setting, and long-range financial planning activities.
  • Develop and document actuarial methodologies, assumptions, and procedures for internal use.
Contract Performance & Reconciliation
  • Lead reconciliation and validation of payer-reported financial results, settlements, shared savings calculations, and quality performance outcomes.
  • Investigate variances between internal analyses and external payer reporting.
  • Maintain methodologies and processes supporting settlement validation and performance measurement.
  • Coordinate with external actuarial partners and consultants on financial analyses, forecasts, and performance evaluations.
  • Support contract renewals, strategic planning, and financial assessments of new opportunities.
Collaboration & Strategic Leadership
  • Partner closely with Clinical Operations, Finance, Contracting, Analytics, and Executive Leadership teams to develop and measure performance improvement initiatives.
  • Connect operational and clinical performance metrics to financial outcomes and value creation.
  • Present analytical findings, recommendations, and opportunity assessments to senior leadership and external stakeholders.
  • Translate complex analytical concepts into clear business recommendations and action plans.
  • Foster a culture of analytical rigor, accountability, and data-driven decision-making.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor's degree in Actuarial Science, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Finance, Healthcare Administration, Data Science, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in healthcare analytics, Actuarial Services, actuarial services, healthcare finance, or value-based care analytics.
  • Experience applying actuarial or financial modeling methodologies within healthcare environments.
  • Experience developing forecasting, valuation, projection, or opportunity assessment models.
  • Experience reconciling payer-reported results, settlements, shared savings calculations, or risk-based contract performance.
  • Advanced SQL experience analyzing large healthcare claims, eligibility, provider, and quality datasets.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare economics, medical cost trend analysis, utilization analytics, forecasting, benchmarking, and performance measurement.
  • Experience supporting Medicare Advantage, value-based care, capitation, shared savings, bundled payments, or other risk-bearing arrangements.
  • Proven ability to quantify financial opportunities, assess return on investment, and evaluate performance improvement initiatives.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence both technical and non-technical audiences.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Fellow of the Society of Actuaries (FSA) or Associate of the Society of Actuaries (ASA).
  • Experience with CMS alternative payment models (e.g., MSSP, ACO).
  • Experience with HCC risk adjustment, STAR Ratings, HEDIS, and healthcare quality measurement programs.
  • Experience with Snowflake, Databricks, or similar cloud-based analytics platforms.
  • Experience with Python, R, or advanced statistical modeling techniques.
BENEFITS
  • 401(k)
  • Health insurance
  • Dental insurance
  • Vision insurance
  • Disability insurance
  • Life insurance
  • Paid time off

This is a remote work-from-home position.

Candidates must be available to work Eastern Time (ET) business hours, generally between 8:00 AM and 5:00 PM.

jobs.description:
Global Remote Sensing Manager

Remote (from home) with 30% travel in your working week

Starting salary for this position is £48,264

MAG (Mines Advisory Group) is an international humanitarian organisation based in Manchester, UK, and working in 32 countries. We remove landmines and unexploded ordnance to release safe and productive land for communities, and work to reduce the threat of armed violence by supporting governments to safely manage weapons and ammunition. In 1997, MAG was a co-recipient of the Nobel Peace Prize for our work campaigning for the Anti-Personnel Mine Ban Convention.

About the role:

Joining our growing Programme Information Management unit, you will develop practical, innovative methodologies and tools to enhance MAG’s operational efficiency, decision making, and situational awareness across our global portfolio of programmes. You will lead research and development processes to advance the use of Earth Observation (EO) data and drone-based solutions in Humanitarian Mine Action (HMA) and Weapon and Ammunition Management (WAM) operational contexts. You will play a key role in partnership development, particularly focused on enriching our theoretical and empirical practices. You will integrate environmental considerations and uphold MAG’s core values to promote our mission and extend our impact where it matters most.

Requirements

Proficiency with remote sensing systems and GIS software for data processing, analysis, including machine learning, and visualisation is essential. You should have proven experience leading on remote sensing projects, including developing operational use cases and standard operating procedures. You should hold a degree in a relevant field, with strong skills in project management and report writing. You will be a strong communicator, able to translate complex data into actionable insights and build meaningful partnerships to enhance MAG’s practice. You should be adaptable and proactive, with the willingness and flexibility to travel internationally, including in challenging environments. Formal training or certification in drone operations, and knowledge of international standards and best practices for humanitarian mine action and weapons and ammunition management would be advantageous.

  • Substantial senior experience in remote sensing and geospatial analysis, ideally in humanitarian, defence, development or environmental contexts
  • Expert knowledge of satellite and aerial sensors (optical, multispectral, SAR, thermal and LiDAR) and their suitability for different uses
  • Strong skills in GIS and remote sensing software (e.g. ArcGIS Pro, QGIS, ENVI, Google Earth Engine) and Python scripting
  • Sound understanding of machine learning and AI for geospatial analysis, including validation and reporting of error and confidence
  • Working knowledge of imagery procurement and licensing, drone operations and regulation, and secure handling of sensitive operational data
  • Proven record of leading donor funded geospatial projects to agreed objectives, budgets and deadlines
  • Experience developing SOPs, standards or governance frameworks for satellite imagery or drone operations
  • Experience line managing and developing technical staff
  • Experience building partnerships with donors, research institutions, technology providers and government authorities
  • Ability to set direction for a new capability and turn it into a practical, funded workplan
  • Ability to influence senior stakeholders and explain complex technical issues clearly to non-specialists, with excellent writing and presentation skills
  • Sound judgement on evidence, uncertainty and operational risk
  • Able to work independently in a remote team spread across several countries
  • Fluent written and spoken English

Benefits

  • Salary: £48,264 per annum and this increases with service.
  • Pension: MAG has a salary sacrifice group personal pension plan in place, and matches employee’s contributions up to 5%. This is only available to individuals based in the UK.
  • Leave: We recognise our staff work hard and need the appropriate time out to stay motivated. Annual Leave starts at five weeks each year and increases with service to six weeks. We also offer paid sick leave, and the amount of the entitlement increases with service. Once you’ve been with MAG for two years, you’re entitled to 13 weeks. MAG also has policies on compassionate leave, flexible working and family leave, including maternity, paternity, adoption and surrogacy leave.
  • Insurance: MAG provides personal accident insurance and life assurance to all staff, as well as medical and repatriation insurance for any period spent overseas whilst working for MAG.
  • Professional Subscriptions: MAG will pay for the cost of your annual subscription/membership fee for one professional body in certain circumstances.
  • Employee Assistance Programme: MAG offers free access to Health Assured, a service providing 24/7 confidential support and expert advice on a wide range of issues.

This role is based remote from home, with expected travel around 30% of working time. MAG will consider applications from candidates who are based in any country, however the final decision on whether employment in a specific country location can be supported will be based on a compliance and budget check and be reviewed by MAG’s senior management.

HOW TO APPLY

Please submit your application before the closing date of 12pm Monday 7 December 2026 (UK)

Please note that as part of MAG's commitment to safeguarding, this post is subject to background checks before an offer of employment is confirmed. For more information on MAG’s approach to safeguarding and background checks please visit our website .

MAG is committed to the principles of diversity, equality and inclusion. If you think you would be suited to one of our roles we would welcome your application regardless of your background. We strive to provide an inclusive and supportive working environment where all employees feel respected and supported in fulfilling their potential.

jobs.description:
Navarro Research and Engineering is recruiting a DOE Nuclear Fire Protection Subject Matter Expert (4046). This is remote consulting work.

Navarro Research & Engineering is an award-winning federal contractor dedicated to partnering with clients to advance clean energy and deliver effective solutions for complex challenges in the nuclear and environmental fields. Joining Navarro means being a part of an exceptional team committed to quality and safety while also looking for innovative strategies to create value for the client’s success. Headquartered in Oak Ridge, Tennessee, Navarro has active programs in place across the nation for DOE/NNSA, NASA, and the Department of Defense.

Position Summary

Navarro is seeking an independent consultant Fire Protection Subject Matter Expert (SME) to support the development and review of a Fire Protection Safety Management Program (SMP) description associated with an upcoming U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) Documented Safety Analysis (DSA). This remote consultant will supplement the project team by providing fire protection expertise and producing defensible, DOE-quality documentation supporting the DSA and associated Technical Safety Requirements (TSRs).

Responsibilities

  • Develop, revise, and review the Fire Protection SMP description supporting a DOE DSA and associated TSRs.
  • Apply applicable fire protection requirements, including DOE O 420.1C, 10 CFR 830, DOE-STD-3009, National Fire Protection Association standards, and approved facility practices.
  • Evaluate fire hazards analyses, combustible loading controls, impairment procedures, fire protection system documentation, inspection and testing records, and implementing procedures for completeness and consistency.
  • Assess the integration of fire prevention, detection, suppression, emergency response, and combustible control programs with the facility safety basis.
  • Identify technical gaps, inconsistencies, and compliance concerns and recommend practical, defensible resolutions.
  • Coordinate with safety basis personnel, fire protection engineers, system engineers, facility representatives, and program owners to ensure the SMP description accurately reflects implementation.
  • Produce clear, traceable, and technically defensible documentation suitable for DOE and contractor review.
  • Support comment resolution, document revisions, technical reviews, and related DSA deliverables.

Requirements

  • Demonstrated DOE or NNSA nuclear facility experience in fire protection engineering, fire hazards analysis, or fire protection program implementation.
  • Experience developing, implementing, assessing, or reviewing a Fire Protection SMP supporting DSAs and TSRs.
  • Working knowledge of 10 CFR 830, DOE O 420.1C, DOE-STD-3009, applicable NFPA standards, and DOE fire protection program expectations.
  • Prior experience preparing, reviewing, or supporting fire protection sections of DSA, SMP, safety basis, or related nuclear facility documentation.
  • Ability to independently review complex technical material and produce clear, accurate, and defensible DOE-quality documentation.
  • Strong written communication, technical judgment, and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to perform work remotely as an independent 1099 consultant.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional Engineer licensure or recognized senior-level fire protection engineering credentials.
  • Previous experience supporting DOE Idaho programs, facilities, management and operating contractors, or DOE-ID oversight activities.
  • Experience participating in DOE readiness reviews, assessments, audits, fire protection program reviews, or regulatory compliance evaluations.
  • Background as a retired or recently separated DOE, NNSA, national laboratory, or management and operating contractor fire protection professional.
  • Availability to support intermittent assignments as project needs develop over the next several months.

Education and Experience

  • A bachelor’s degree in fire protection engineering or a closely related engineering discipline is preferred. Candidates must possess sufficient technical education, training, and directly relevant DOE nuclear facility fire protection experience to serve as a credible subject matter expert and independently perform the required document development and review work.

Due to the nature of the government contract requirements and/or clearances requirements, US citizenship is required.

Navarro is an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, religion, color, national origin, age, disability, veteran’s status, or any classification protected by applicable state or local law.

jobs.title: Customer Success Account Manager, Mid-Market - German
jobs.excerpt: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

You help customers adopt the platform, realise measurable value, and renew and expand with confidence. You pick up where Implementation leaves off, learn each customer's fleet and challenges, and advise on tailoring Samsara to them. You manage 100+ named accounts, using AI tooling to extend your reach and focus your time where it counts. Your understanding of the value customers get earns you the right to lead the ROI conversation, negotiate terms and close renewals that work for both sides, minimising financial attrition. You work with Sales, Support, Deal Desk, Operations and Product.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. This team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper-growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together, and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Deeply understand the Samsara platform's capabilities and explain them to businesses of all types, from field services and utilities to long-haul transportation and school buses.
  • Manage a portfolio of 100+ named accounts, using AI tooling to accelerate your engagement, prioritize proactively, and drive efficiency and outcomes across your book of business.
  • Lead the ROI and value conversation into the renewal, negotiate favorable terms, and close renewals that are a win for both the customer and Samsara while minimizing financial attrition.
  • Demonstrate a willingness to understand and explain technical issues to a non-technical audience and to engage the right cross-functional partners to drive resolution.
  • Conduct workshops with customers to understand their current operations and recommend workflow changes to maximize the value of their Samsara products.
  • Work cross-functionally with Sales, Support, Deal Desk, Operations and Product to strategically solve problems and optimize customer experience and business outcomes.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Business fluency in German (spoken and written).
  • 2+ years in a customer-facing, quota-carrying role (renewals, customer success, account management or sales), ideally in SaaS, technology or logistics.
  • A record of consistent quota over-achievement.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication and presentation skills, and the ability to build trust with executives, users and internal teams.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Gainsight, Gong or similar GTM tools.
  • Comfort in a fast-changing, high-growth environment.
  • A bachelor's degree from a 4-year institution, or equivalent practical experience.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • A strong bias towards action, big-picture thinking and high standards.
  • An AI-first approach: you use AI tooling to drive efficiency and outcomes.
  • Technical depth across a suite of products, with a bonus for hardware-software integration.
  • Industry Knowledge: Experience with routing, navigation, commercial trucking fleets, and logistics

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

We are a growing, values-led community of employees in the US, UK and Australia who share a vision to unify school communities, improve the quality of education, and enhance learning.

Veracross is five product brands in one global tech company

We're standing up a new Platform Architecture Group to take the Veracross Platform, and everything built on top of it, into the agentic AI era. This is a rare opportunity to lead product for a brand-new initaitive from day one: partnering daily with our CTO to build the platform that makes AI-native, workflow-driven school software possible.

This isn't a single feature area — it's the connective tissue that determines how fast every other Veracross product team can ship, and the foundation for our future: a modern monolithic unified platform that allows for quick innovation, autonomous agents that complete school workflows end-to-end, a FinTech suite that competes with purpose-built tools, and a partner ecosystem built on a modern, monetizable API.

In addition to running the Platform Architecture team, you’ll have 2 PMs reporting to you who own Platform Automations, AI including Veracross’s first AI tool, VC Studio.

Responsibilities:

  • Together with the CTO, define and own the product strategy and roadmap for the Platform Architecture Group across Axiom's core architecture, AI infrastructure, APIs, and Automations.
  • Partner daily with our CTO to turn platform investment into a sequenced, shippable roadmap for a 10-person engineering team.
  • Build the business case and success metrics for platform investment, translating technical modernization into measurable revenue impact: FinTech acceleration, agentic workflows, API monetization, and a growing partner ecosystem.
  • Champion a small set of foundational capabilities, such as a shared data layer, a central user identity service, and an agentic execution platform, that unlock revenue opportunities across the wider product organization.

  • Experience translating deep technical and architectural investment into a business case that executives will fund.
  • Comfort operating at both the strategic level (a multi-year platform bet) and the detailed level (backlog, sequencing, and trade-offs with a 10-person engineering team).

Preferred

jobs.excerpt: KI verändert gerade, wie Unternehmen arbeiten.  Viele Geschäftsführer:innen wissen, dass sie handeln müssen, aber nicht, wo sie anfangen sollen.
jobs.description:
KI verändert gerade, wie Unternehmen arbeiten. Viele Geschäftsführer:innen wissen, dass sie handeln müssen, aber nicht, wo sie anfangen sollen.

Das Institut für Zukunftsbildung (IZB) hat die Antwort: Mit unserem AZAV-zertifizierten Programm „KI Leader“ machen wir aus Mitarbeitenden Gestalter:innen der Zukunft. Für kleine und mittlere Unternehmen wird die Weiterbildung bis zu 100 % über das Qualifizierungschancengesetz gefördert. Arbeitsuchende können über einen Bildungsgutschein der Agentur für Arbeit oder des Jobcenters teilnehmen.

Als KI-Transformation Consultant führst du Beratungsgespräche mit Interessent:innen, für die unser Team bereits Beratungstermine vereinbart hat. Du sprichst mit Geschäftsführer:innen und mit Arbeitsuchenden, verstehst, wo sie beim Thema KI stehen, und begleitest sie bis zur Entscheidung. Dafür suchen wir keine Einzelkämpfer:innen auf der schnellen Jagd nach Provision, sondern einen Partner, der langfristig mit uns wachsen will.

Wir starten mit ca. 10 Stunden pro Woche. Wenn die Zusammenarbeit passt, wollen wir im weiteren Verlauf auf 20 Stunden pro Woche erhöhen.

Aufgaben

  • Beratungsgespräche führen: Du sprichst per Video oder Telefon mit Geschäftsführer:innen aus kleinen und mittleren Unternehmen und mit Arbeitsuchenden, die sich für die Weiterbildung interessieren. Die Beratungstermine sind vorqualifiziert, du startest also nie kalt.

  • Bedarf verstehen: Du findest heraus, wo das Unternehmen oder die Person beim Thema KI steht, welche Mitarbeitenden profitieren und welches Ziel dahintersteht.

  • Förderung erklären: Du zeigst verständlich, wie die Weiterbildung gefördert wird: für Unternehmen bis zu 100 % über das Qualifizierungschancengesetz, für Arbeitsuchende über den Bildungsgutschein.

  • Ehrlich abschließen: Du führst zur Entscheidung, ohne Druck und ohne Versprechen, die wir nicht halten können. Ein ehrliches Nein ist uns lieber als eine überredete Entscheidung, die später platzt.

  • Sauber übergeben: Nach der Zusage übergibst du an unser Fördermanagement, das den Förderantrag übernimmt. So konzentrierst du dich voll auf deine Gespräche.

  • Sauber dokumentieren: Du hältst Gespräche, nächste Schritte und Einwände in unserem CRM Close fest.

  • Mitdenken: Du gibst dem Team, das die Beratungstermine vereinbart, Feedback zur Terminqualität und teilst, was in Beratungsgesprächen funktioniert und was nicht.

Qualifikation

  • KI aus der eigenen Praxis: Du nutzt KI-Tools regelmäßig im Beruf, verstehst die Einrichtung von MCP- oder API-Schnittstellen, baust Workflows für deinen eigenen Alltag und kannst schnell relevante Praxisprojekte für dein Gegenüber ableiten.

  • Abschlusserfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb: Du hast schon Beratungs- oder Verkaufsgespräche mit Entscheider:innen geführt und selbst abgeschlossen, idealerweise bei erklärungsbedürftigen Produkten oder Dienstleistungen.

  • Beratung statt Druck: Du stellst gute Fragen, hörst zu und führst trotzdem klar zur Entscheidung.

  • Sicher mit Einwänden: „Keine Zeit“, „Zu kompliziert“ oder „Haben wir schon“ bringen dich nicht aus dem Konzept.

  • Verständnis für Förderprozesse: Erfahrung mit geförderten Weiterbildungen, Bildungsgutscheinen oder dem Qualifizierungschancengesetz ist ein Plus. Den Rest bringen wir dir bei.

  • Integrität: Du bist ehrlich zu Interessent:innen und zu uns. Was du zusagst, das hältst du.

  • Ownership: Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Ergebnisse und wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jemand sagt, was zu tun ist.

  • Langfristig gedacht: Du suchst kein kurzes Projekt, sondern eine Zusammenarbeit, die trägt.

  • Rahmen: Verfügbarkeit von ca. 10 Stunden pro Woche, mit der Bereitschaft, später auf 20 Stunden aufzustocken. Dazu Deutsch auf C1-Niveau, ein ruhiger Arbeitsplatz, ein gutes Headset, eine Webcam und stabiles Internet.

Benefits

  • Faire und starke Vergütung: 200 € für jede Zusage aus deinen Beratungsgesprächen, als Honorar auf Rechnung zzgl. USt. Bei ca. 10 Stunden pro Woche sind realistisch 2.500 bis 3.000 € im Monat drin. Wenn wir auf 20 Stunden erhöhen, liegst du rechnerisch bei 5.000 bis 6.000 € im Monat, mit Luft nach oben.

  • Beratungstermine statt Kaltakquise: Unser Team vereinbart vorqualifizierte Beratungstermine mit Interessent:innen für dich. Du konzentrierst dich auf das Beratungsgespräch und die Zusage.

  • Ein Produkt mit Sinn: Du bietest eine bis zu 100 % geförderte Weiterbildung an, die Unternehmen und Arbeitsuchende wirklich weiterbringt. Gestaltet wird sie von mehreren Gastdozent:innen aus Recht, Technologie und Strategie, und die Nachfrage ist aktuell sehr hoch.

  • Zugang zum KI-Leader-Programm: Du bekommst vollen Zugriff auf alle Inhalte, Aufzeichnungen und Materialien. Wir wünschen uns, dass du dir die Inhalte im Selbststudium aneignest und sie dadurch authentisch vermitteln kannst.

  • Rückenwind im Gespräch: 49 Fünf-Sterne-Bewertungen bei Google zeigen, wie zufrieden unsere Teilnehmenden sind. Ein starkes Argument in jedem Gespräch.

About Sadie Restaurant

Sadie is building voice AI for restaurants. Sadie answers restaurant phones 24/7, takes reservations and takeout orders, and answers guest questions, working directly with the restaurant's reservation system and POS.

You'll decide which operators are worth a salesperson's time. AI should be part of how you work. Use it to research accounts, draft outreach, and analyse what's converting. You're responsible for the quality of the result.

What we value

  • Sound judgement about which prospects deserve the next call.
  • Taking responsibility for your numbers and finishing work without being chased.
  • Understanding how a restaurant makes money and what a missed call costs it.
  • Curiosity and a willingness to change an approach that isn't working.
  • The honesty to log what actually happened on a call, including when it went badly.
  • Respect for an operator's time, especially during service.

What you'll do

  • Outbound prospecting. Initiate contact with potential clients through Sadie's existing go-to-market channels, focusing on businesses integrated with Sadie's AI-powered voice technology products.
  • Lead qualification. Assess and qualify leads to make sure they align with our product offerings, then pass them to the appropriate sales teams.
  • CRM management. Keep accurate records of interactions and lead statuses in the CRM, so all data stays up to date for efficient pipeline management.
  • Performance metrics. Meet and exceed targets for lead generation, qualification rates, and Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) contribution from sales qualified leads (SQLs).
  • Collaboration. Work closely with the marketing and sales teams to refine outreach strategies, messaging, and processes that maximise lead generation.
  • Market insights and trend monitoring. Stay informed about technological advancements and operational trends in the hospitality industry.
    • Regularly analyse market dynamics, customer behaviours, and competitor activities to identify new opportunities and adjust outreach strategies accordingly.
    • Share relevant insights with internal teams to inform product development and marketing efforts.

What you'll bring

  • Experience in outbound sales, business development, or another role with outreach and conversion targets.
  • Experience prospecting by phone and email, including cold calls.
  • You can qualify a lead in conversation: who decides, what the problem costs them, and whether the product fits.
  • You keep CRM records accurate without reminders.
  • You can explain a technical product in plain terms to a busy owner.
  • You're comfortable being measured on lead volume, qualification rate, and ARR contribution, and you track your own numbers.
  • You use AI to research accounts and draft outreach, and you check the output before it reaches a prospect.
  • You plan your own week around targets and work without close supervision.
  • You follow up until you have an answer, yes or no.

Useful experience

  • Selling to restaurants, cafes, pubs, or hotel food and beverage teams
  • Front-of-house or venue management in hospitality
  • SaaS sales to small and mid-sized businesses
  • Familiarity with reservation and POS systems used by Australian restaurants
  • Selling AI or voice products
  • Sales engagement and sequencing tools
  • Building campaigns with a marketing team
  • Knowledge of hospitality markets across Australian cities

Who will enjoy this role

When an owner tells you the staff handle the phones fine, you ask what happened to the calls during Friday dinner service. You want to know how their night actually runs before you decide whether Sadie belongs in it.

In a single week you'll work through a call list, rewrite an email sequence with marketing, hand a qualified operator to sales with a clean set of notes, and write up what you keep hearing about a competitor.

Most outreach gets no reply or a no. Restaurant operators are busy, often sceptical of new technology, and easiest to reach at awkward hours. Part of your target is ARR from deals someone else closes, so your number depends partly on how well you qualified.

jobs.excerpt: Company Description Guardant Health is a leading precision oncology company focused on guarding wellness and giving every person more time free from cancer.
jobs.description:
Company Description

Guardant Health is a leading precision oncology company focused on guarding wellness and giving every person more time free from cancer. Founded in 2012, Guardant® is transforming patient care and accelerating new cancer therapies by providing critical insights into what drives disease through its advanced blood and tissue tests, real-world data and AI analytics. Guardant tests help improve outcomes across all stages of care, including screening to find cancer early, monitoring for recurrence in early-stage cancer, and treatment selection for patients with advanced cancer. For more information, visit guardanthealth.com and follow the company on LinkedIn, X (Twitter) and Facebook.

The Senior Global Medical Affairs Director, Breast Oncology provides strategic medical leadership for Guardant’s oncology portfolio across the full product lifecycle, from early product concept and development through launch, adoption, and post-commercial evidence generation. This role is accountable for shaping the global medical strategy within the assigned oncology disease area(s), ensuring that clinical insights, evidence generation, education, and external engagement strategies advance Guardant’s broader portfolio and business objectives.


The Senior Director serves as a senior medical leader and cross-functional partner across Research & Development, Clinical Development, Product and Technology, Laboratory Medicine, Regulatory, Reimbursement/Market Access, Commercial, Data Science, Scientific Communications, and Biopharma Partnerships. The role brings deep clinical and scientific expertise to strategic portfolio and product decisions, helping define what Guardant builds, where evidence investments should be prioritized, and how emerging clinical, therapeutic, and diagnostic trends should inform future strategy.


This leader is responsible for translating evolving standards of care and advances in precision oncology into actionable medical strategies that support product differentiation, clinical adoption, guideline inclusion, payer coverage, and ultimately improved patient care. The Senior Director also represents Guardant externally with key opinion leaders, investigators, professional societies, guideline bodies, biopharma partners, and other stakeholders and provides leadership and mentorship across the broader Medical Affairs organization.


Responsibilities:


Global Medical Strategy and Portfolio Leadership

  • Lead the development and execution of the global medical and education strategy for assigned oncology disease areas, ensuring alignment with portfolio, product, regulatory, evidence generation, market access, and commercial objectives.
  • Serve as a senior medical advisor to Product and Technology Development, bringing clinical perspective into early portfolio and product decisions, including clinically meaningful use cases, intended patient populations, unmet medical needs, clinical feasibility, workflow integration, specimen requirements, and interpretability.
  • Provide strategic medical recommendations at concept reviews, development milestones, launch readiness reviews, and portfolio planning discussions, influencing investment priorities and product development decisions.
  • Translate changes in standards of care, therapeutic development, biomarker science, competitive dynamics, and clinical practice into implications and recommendations for Guardant’s oncology portfolio.
  • Partner with Regulatory, Clinical Development, Product, and other functions to define evidence requirements necessary to support product claims, regulatory strategies, clinical adoption, and future product expansion.
  • Identify emerging opportunities and risks across the oncology landscape and recommend strategic actions to senior leadership.

Evidence Generation and Scientific Strategy

  • Own the integrated clinical evidence strategyfor assigned oncology disease areas, identifying evidence gaps across analytical validity, clinical validity, clinical utility, health economics, and real-world clinical practice.
  • Lead integrated evidence planning across prospective studies, registries, investigator-initiated studies, collaborative research programs, and real-world evidence initiatives, ensuring investments address the highest-priority medical and business questions.
  • Provide senior clinical leadership in the development and evaluation of research concepts and protocols, including patient populations, endpoints, biomarker strategies, specimen timing, clinical feasibility, and implications for practice through the Protocol Review Committee and other governance mechanisms.
  • Evaluate the fitness, bias, representativeness, and clinical applicability of real-world clinical and molecular datasets used to support evidence generation.
  • Partner with Reimbursement/Market Access and Health Economics Outcomes Research to ensure evidence strategies address payer requirements, value demonstration, and coverage objectives.
  • Shape publication and scientific communication strategy in partnership with Scientific Communications, including prioritization and review of abstracts, manuscripts, congress presentations, and other scientific communications.
  • Interpret complex clinical, molecular, and real-world evidence and translate findings into strategic recommendations for executive, scientific, commercial, and external audiences.
  • Establish measures of medical impact and use evidence, stakeholder insights, and clinical adoption trends to refine medical strategy and investment priorities.

Education, Launch, and Commercialization

  • Provide strategic medical leadership for global launch readiness and lifecycle management within assigned oncology disease areas.
  • Establish disease-specific educational strategies addressing precision oncology, appropriate diagnostic utilization, evolving standards of care, and the strengths and limitations of available clinical evidence.
  • Guide medical readiness across scientific platforms, training, medical information, congress strategy, educational programs, and external scientific communications.
  • Provide senior medical leadership for strategic institutional engagements, complex RFP responses, testing pathways, and other high-value clinical opportunities.
  • Establish the medical strategy and priorities for Field Medical/MSL engagement and ensure field insights are systematically synthesized and incorporated into product, evidence, and commercial planning.
  • Serve as a senior medical partner to Commercial leadership while maintaining appropriate scientific independence and ensuring externally facing materials and activities meet standards for medical accuracy, scientific integrity, and compliance.
  • Mentor and enable Medical Affairs, Field Medical, and cross-functional colleagues to communicate complex oncology and diagnostic concepts effectively.

Laboratory and Diagnostic Strategy

  • Serve as a senior clinical advisor to Laboratory and Medical Director teams regarding current and emerging diagnostic needs within assigned oncology disease areas.
  • Anticipate changes in the therapeutic, biomarker, and diagnostic landscape that could create new requirements or opportunities for molecular testing, companion diagnostics, assay modalities, and testing algorithms.
  • Partner with Laboratory Medicine, Product, Biopharma, Regulatory, and other stakeholders to translate evolving clinical measurement needs into implications for diagnostic strategy.
  • Provide clinical guidance regarding interpretation, specimen selection, testing sequence, and appropriate diagnostic utilization while clearly differentiating clinical needs from assay capabilities and technical limitations.
  • Influence longer-range diagnostic strategy by identifying emerging clinical trends and technology needs that may impact Guardant’s future oncology portfolio.

External Engagement, Research Partnerships, and Biopharma

  • Represent Guardant as a senior medical and scientific leader with national and global KOLs, investigators, academic institutions, professional societies, guideline bodies, biopharma partners, and other external stakeholders.
  • Provide strategic medical leadership for biopharma partnerships, including clinical trial collaborations, companion diagnostic programs, biomarker strategies, and translational research initiatives.
  • Lead disease-specific working groups and other scientific forums, bringing together internal leaders, KOLs, and partner investigators around shared research priorities.
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with influential national and global oncology experts and leverage external insights to inform evidence, product, and portfolio strategies.
  • Partner with regional Medical Affairs leaders to develop global and regional external engagement strategies, including advisory boards, expert consultations, and scientific exchange.
  • Serve as a scientific ambassador for Guardant at major oncology congresses, professional meetings, investigator forums, and other external scientific venues.
  • Identify opportunities for novel academic, research, and industry collaborations that advance the evidence base and strategic objectives for Guardant’s oncology portfolio.

Organizational Leadership and Operations

  • Provide leadership, mentorship, and strategic direction across Medical Affairs, influencing teams and initiatives beyond the direct scope of the role.
  • Lead complex, highly matrixed cross-functional initiatives requiring alignment across Medical Affairs, Product, Clinical Development, Regulatory, Laboratory Medicine, Market Access, Commercial, Data Science, and Biopharma.
  • Serve as a trusted medical advisor to senior and executive leadership on oncology strategy, evidence priorities, emerging clinical trends, and portfolio opportunities and risks.
  • Maintain deep subspecialty expertise and ensure that significant scientific, therapeutic, regulatory, and competitive developments are translated rapidly into organizational recommendations and priorities.
  • Lead or oversee indication research, scientific landscape assessments, and competitive analyses to inform portfolio and investment decisions.
  • Provide strategic consultation and training to internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, investigators and study-site personnel regarding disease area, technology, evidence, and clinical protocols.
  • Promote scientific rigor and ensure adherence to established processes governing medical engagement, research approvals, data access, confidentiality, conflicts of interest, and compliance.
  • Contribute to the evolution of Medical Affairs operating models, governance processes, SOPs, policies, and standards of excellence as the organization and portfolio scale.
  • Develop medical talent and organizational capability through coaching, mentorship, knowledge sharing, and leadership of cross-functional teams and initiatives.

Required Qualifications:


  • MD, DO, or equivalent medical degree; completion of medical oncology fellowship and board certification in Medical Oncology, or recognized equivalent, required.
  • Significant clinical experience and demonstrated expertise within breast oncology.
  • 8+ years of relevant experience in Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, diagnostics, biotechnology, pharmaceutical development, or a related field, with demonstrated progression in scope and leadership responsibility.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and leading medical strategy at the disease, product, or portfolio level, including influencing senior cross-functional stakeholders and investment priorities.
  • Deep understanding of precision oncology, molecular diagnostics, biomarker-driven treatment strategies, and their application across the cancer care continuum.
  • Demonstrated ability to critically evaluate clinical trials, molecular evidence, and real-world data and translate complex evidence into strategic implications for clinical practice, product development, and commercialization.
  • Experience supporting products through multiple stages of the lifecycle, including development, launch, adoption, and lifecycle management; diagnostic launch experience strongly preferred.
  • Strong working knowledge of evidence requirements supporting regulatory review, payer coverage, clinical adoption, and guideline inclusion.
  • Demonstrated success leading complex cross-functional initiatives within a matrixed environment and influencing stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Experience engaging senior external stakeholders, including KOLs, investigators, academic institutions, professional societies, guideline organizations, or biopharma partners.
  • Executive-level written, verbal, and scientific communication skills, with demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with scientific, clinical, commercial, and senior leadership audiences.
  • Demonstrated sound medical judgment, strategic thinking, and the ability to make recommendations in complex or ambiguous situations.
  • Proven ability to mentor and develop medical/scientific talent and provide leadership across teams, whether through direct people management or matrix leadership.
  • Ability to travel up to 40%.

Preferred Qualifications:


  • Strong research and publication record within the relevant oncology disease area, including experience developing study concepts and contributing to clinical trial design.
  • Experience leading global medical strategy or integrated evidence planning for oncology products, diagnostics, or portfolios.
  • Experience working with biopharma partners on clinical development, companion diagnostic, translational research, or biomarker programs.
  • Clinical Development or Clinical Affairs experience, with strong knowledge of GCP/ICH principles and clinical study design.
  • Experience establishing or leading investigator collaborations, research consortia, advisory boards, or disease-specific working groups.
  • Experience using real-world clinical and molecular datasets to inform research, evidence generation, product strategy, or clinical practice.
  • Experience with diagnostic development, companion diagnostics, molecular testing, and research governance.
  • Experience directly managing, developing, or providing functional leadership to physicians, scientists, or Medical Affairs professionals.
  • Experience presenting medical strategy, evidence, or portfolio recommendations to senior or executive leadership.
  • Current clinical practice or ongoing academic affiliation preferred.

AI & Digital Fluency

  • Demonstrate curiosity, sound judgment, and the ability to critically evaluate and responsibly leverage AI-enabled tools in accordance with company policies, ethical standards, and regulatory requirements to improve the efficiency, effectiveness, and quality of work.

Hybrid Work Model:This section is applicable to onsite employees who are eligible for hybrid work location as specified by management and related policies. Guardant has defined days for in-person/onsite collaboration and work-from-home days for individual-focused time. All U.S. employees who live within 50 miles of a Guardant facility will be required to be onsite on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays. We have found aligning our scheduled in-office days allows our teams to do the best work and creates the focused thinking time our innovative work requires. At Guardant, our work model has created flexibility for better work-life balance while keeping teams connected to advance our science for our patients.

Hiring Entity: FlexEnergi, a Subsidiary of Accurant

Job Title: Senior Software Engineer – Device & Protocol Integration (IoT / Energy Systems)

We are hiring a Senior .NET Software Engineer to build the connectors that let FlexEnergi’s DERMS platform see and control real devices: vehicles, EV chargers, thermostats, batteries, and commercial buildings. Each connector is reused across every utility program we run, so quality and consistency matter as much as speed.

This role is ideal for engineers who have worked with real third-party device APIs and hardware and enjoy turning protocol specs into reliable production code.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain device connectors against OEM cloud APIs, aggregator platforms, and direct protocols on top of our connector framework
  • Build the connector for our own building gateway, which brings the gateway and the building equipment behind it into the platform: telemetry, commands, and health
  • Implement standards-based integrations (OpenADR, IEEE 2030.5, OCPP), either from the spec or by integrating third-party protocol stacks
  • Extend our dispatch processors to new device types so they can be controlled reliably in real time
  • Handle real-world device behavior: rate limits, token refresh, offline devices, delayed telemetry, and vendor API changes
  • Write the tests, telemetry, and runbooks that keep connectors healthy in production, and troubleshoot when a device or vendor misbehaves
  • Work directly with OEM and partner technical contacts
  • Contribute to engineering standards, code quality, and system design discussions

Requirements

  • 4+ years of software engineering experience (backend-focused)
  • Experience integrating with external hardware or third-party device APIs (IoT, EV charging, smart home, metering, building automation, or similar)
  • Strong experience with .NET (C#), or strong Java, Go, or Python and willing to work in .NET
  • Experience with REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth2, message queues, and asynchronous, event-driven design
  • Comfortable reading a protocol spec or vendor API reference and turning it into maintainable code
  • Writes tests by default and cares about observability

Preferred:

  • Experience at product companies, building and running your own product over time
  • Hands-on experience with OpenADR, IEEE 2030.5, OCPP, BACnet, or Modbus
  • Experience with EV, charger, thermostat, solar/inverter, or battery OEM APIs
  • Experience with Azure Service Bus, Event Hub, RabbitMQ, MQTT, or Kafka

  • Support negotiations with delivery insight. Help establish achievable schedules, clear scope boundaries, acceptance criteria, payment milestones, change mechanisms, warranties and appropriate risk positions.
  • Preserve continuity after award. Ensure a structured handover of commitments, assumptions, risks and customer expectations. Where assigned, lead execution as Project Director or remain involved as executive sponsor through critical phases.
  • Strengthen ABB’s pursuit and delivery capability. Collaborate across Sales, Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Legal and Finance; coach teams; and feed execution outcomes into future estimates, reference cases and delivery practices.

Your background

  • A degree in instrumentation, control, electrical, chemical engineering or an equivalent discipline; an executive or business master’s degree is an advantage.
  • At least 12 years of industrial automation project delivery experience, including substantial responsibility as Project Manager or Project Director on large, complex projects in oil and gas, chemicals, refining or energy.
  • Full-lifecycle leadership of at least one extra-large or highly complex automation project, together with direct experience recovering a challenged project.
  • Demonstrated contribution to winning major pursuits, such as MAC selections, FEED-to-EPC conversions or frame agreements.
  • Deep understanding of EPC delivery, contracting models, interface management and the dynamics between owners, EPCs and technology vendors.
  • Working knowledge of DCS, SIS, PLC/SCADA, advanced process control and OT/IT convergence, enabling you to connect execution choices with customers’ operational outcomes.
  • A recognized project management certification, such as PMP, IPMA Level A/B, or an equivalent ABB certification.
  • Fluent English and willingness to travel extensively

What will help you succeed

You build trust through first-hand delivery experience, candid advice and confidence with customer executives and EPC leaders. You connect execution decisions with commercial value and unite Sales and delivery teams around realistic, shared commitments.


The impact you will make

Engage customers earlier, strengthen ABB’s execution credibility and help win strategic projects - supported by smooth handovers, protected margins and lessons that improve future pursuits.

*This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive.

The final offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards.
