jobs.description:
At Fresh Tracks Canada, we craft tailor-made Canadian vacations for people from all over the world. Since 1996, our team of Canadian Insiders have helped our customers plan their vacations and enjoy life-changing travel experiences.

We believe in keeping our customers front and center in everything we do; in fact, focus on serving our customers is one of our core values. Everyone acts and operates as an owner, treating this business as their own. We raise the bar constantly, embracing that nothing is perfect but continuous improvement is key. Our team is made up of passionate, positive experts who drive healthy collaboration by winning or losing as one, and we bring out the best in each other as a family committed to grow.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Reporting into the Vice President of Sales and part of the Travel Trade team, the Business Development Manager (BDM) is responsible for driving B2B sales growth for Fresh Tracks Canada and expanding market share by developing strategic relationships with travel agents.

The BDM must navigate a dynamic and competitive travel landscape, identifying opportunities for growth and resolving challenges that arise within agency relationships. This includes adapting strategies to meet partner needs, analyzing performance data to inform decision-making, and responding to market shifts with agility. The role requires a proactive approach to overcoming obstacles and leveraging insights to optimize sales outcomes.

This role involves attending trade shows across North America, executing marketing plans, delivering training to Travel Trade partners, and promoting brand initiatives through in-person and virtual engagement. At it’s core, this person has the full responsibility of driving education and awareness on the Fresh Tracks Canada value proposition to the Travel Trade. The Business Development Manager (BDM) will work closely with the Marketing team, Sales leadership team and Travel Trade team to ensure alignment with corporate objectives and maximize agency performance.

The ideal candidate will have strong sales acumen, excellent communication and presentation skills, and experience in travel industry account management or business development.

Salary Range: $80,000-$90,000 USD annually, based on experience and qualifications with a total on target earnings of $130,000 USD with base and variable pay.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Build strong, long-term Travel Agent relationships by understanding partner needs and positioning the right Fresh Tracks Canada solutions to maximize product visibility, conversion, and revenue.
  • Act as a strategic consultant to partners by educating them on Fresh Tracks Canada’s product capabilities, distribution ecosystem, marketing opportunities, and customer reach.
  • Drive the acquisition of new partners across the the U.S., Canada and Australia, while managing and growing an existing portfolio of strategic supplier accounts. Identify high-potential partners and unlock incremental revenue opportunities.
  • Partner closely with suppliers to drive campaign participation, promotional coverage, and merchandising opportunities across key sales moments and seasonal initiatives.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with teams across sales, product, finance and marketing functions within a highly collaborative environment.
  • Navigate ambiguity and solve operational or commercial challenges proactively, helping build scalable solutions in a rapidly evolving business.
  • Maintain frequent contact with our Partners and collaborate with the Travel Trade and Sales teams to manage shared accounts.
  • Conduct training sessions and webinars to educate travel agents on Fresh Tracks Canada offerings, promotions, and booking processes. Develop and deliver engaging training materials, including presentations, videos, and interactive content.
  • Facilitate and run certain FAMs for our partners
  • Maintain accurate and detailed agency database through Salesforce CRM, track budgets and be results driven

REQUIREMENTS

  • 7+ years of experience in business development, account management, or revenue growth within tourism, or e-commerce. Previous experience at an Online Travel Agency (OTA) or travel marketplace is a strong plus, with familiarity with attractions, tours, or destination experiences highly valued.
  • A proven track record of building scalable sales programs that drive revenue growth
  • Comfortable with approximately 50% travel and cross-time-zone collaboration, with the flexibility to support partners and internal teams in a global, fast-paced environment.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and CRM/account management tools.
  • Entrepreneurial, proactive, and execution-focused, with a strong sense of ownership. Proven ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, cross-cultural environment with the ability to create structure from complexity.
Salary: $80,000-$90,000 USD base salary

jobs.description:
Part-Time HR Generalist, Client Services (Bilingual)
RCR Consulting Group | Fully Remote | 25-30 hours per week, Monday-Friday | $32.00-$40.00 per hour

The Opportunity

RCR Consulting Group is looking for a hands-on, bilingual (English/Spanish) HR generalist who likes doing the work, not just advising on it.

You will support a portfolio of small and mid-size client organizations across a wide range of industries, and no two days look the same. One morning you are drafting an offer letter and running a background check. That afternoon you are putting together an FMLA designation notice, then jumping on a call to walk a client's payroll administrator through a deduction correction in Rippling. Next week you might be explaining a benefits change, in Spanish, to a group of union-represented employees.

Many of the employees you will support are Spanish-speaking and covered by collective bargaining agreements, and their HR and payroll run on Rippling. Fluent Spanish, experience in a union environment, and hands-on Rippling skills are all required for this role.

If that variety sounds energizing rather than scattered, keep reading. If your instinct is that this work should be handed to someone else, this is not the right fit, and we would rather both of us know that now.
This is a permanent part-time, fully remote position. We are looking for someone who wants RCR to be their work, not a side engagement alongside other employment or their own consulting practice.

The Schedule

Core hours are 9:30 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. Eastern, when we need you reachable for clients. The remaining hours each week are yours to place — early mornings, evenings, whatever fits your life. We hold this schedule seriously; it is the reason the role exists as part-time rather than full-time.

We do ask for flexibility to pick up additional hours occasionally when client needs spike — open enrollment, an implementation go-live, an urgent employee relations matter.

A Note on Career Breaks

We welcome applicants returning to the workforce after time away. A gap on your resume is not a mark against you here — we care that you have the experience and that you are ready to use it. If you stepped back from a career in HR and want back in, we would like to hear from you.

What You Will Actually Do

We made this section specific on purpose, because we want you to know exactly what you are signing up for.

Day-to-day HR execution: you do the work, not delegate it

  • Draft and send offer letters, and manage onboarding paperwork, I-9s, and background checks end to end
  • Prepare FMLA, ADA, and state leave notices and correspondence, and track leave cases from first request through return to work
  • Process and audit payroll in Rippling: entering changes, chasing down discrepancies, reconciling deductions (including union dues), resolving the check that came out $46 short
  • Maintain accurate employee data in Rippling and other HRIS platforms. You are the one in the system, not the one reviewing a report about the system
  • Build and update handbooks, policies, job descriptions, offer templates, and employee communications, in both English and Spanish
  • Run open enrollment logistics: employee meetings (some conducted in Spanish), election tracking, carrier file follow-up, post-enrollment audits

Client service that earns the "wow"

  • Serve as the primary day-to-day HR contact for your clients, the person they call when something goes sideways
  • Communicate directly with Spanish-speaking employees, verbally and in writing, on everything from a routine PTO question to a sensitive employee relations matter
  • Respond fast, follow through completely, and close the loop without being asked twice
  • Handle a client's employee question with the same care whether it is a routine PTO balance or a resignation letter that just landed
  • Anticipate what is coming: the I-9 that expires next month, the notice that is due, the manager who will need coaching before that conversation

Projects and systems implementations

  • Work implementations start to finish, including Rippling configurations and migrations: data gathering and cleanup, configuration testing, parallel payroll runs, employee communications, go-live support
  • Manage several client projects at once and keep every one of them moving
  • Document processes so the next person can run them

Employee relations, labor relations, and manager support

  • Investigate and resolve employee relations matters (complaints, performance concerns, policy violations) with discretion and clean documentation
  • Apply collective bargaining agreement provisions day to day, including seniority, scheduling, progressive discipline, and grievance timelines, and support clients through grievance meetings and union communications
  • Coach frontline and mid-level managers through performance conversations, write-ups, and terminations, including in unionized workplaces
  • Keep clients compliant with federal and state employment law, including FMLA, ADA, FLSA, ACA, and NLRA, plus the multi-state patchwork that comes with our client base

Who Thrives Here

  • You would rather have twelve things on your plate than three, and you have a system for keeping all of them straight
  • You get bored when work gets repetitive, and you look for the next problem to solve
  • You take real pride in being the person a client can count on — responsiveness is part of your professional identity, not a requirement someone imposed on you
  • You are comfortable being the one who does the task, files the form, fixes the record, and sends the email
  • You are steady when three clients need you at once and one of them is upset
  • You are detail-obsessed. A wrong date on a leave notice or a typo in an offer letter bothers you

Who This Is Not For

We say this plainly because false starts are expensive for everyone:
  • You are looking for advisory-only or strategy-only work. Roughly 70% of this job is execution. If you want to build the framework and hand it off, this will frustrate you.
  • You want to lead a team. There is no team to lead. You are an individual contributor, and you will stay one.
  • You are building or maintaining your own consulting practice. We are hiring an employee, not contracting a firm. This needs to be your primary professional commitment.
  • You want this as a second job. We are not a fit alongside other employment.
  • Administrative work feels beneath your level. Some days it is data entry and chasing signatures. If that reads as a step down, we are not the right place.
  • You need a lot of structure and ramp time. You will be supporting live clients within your first few weeks.

What You Bring

  • Fluent, professional-level proficiency in both English and Spanish, spoken and written. You can explain a benefits election or deliver a difficult message to an employee in Spanish as clearly as in English. Spanish proficiency will be assessed during the interview process.
  • Hands-on HR experience in a unionized environment, including working within a collective bargaining agreement and supporting grievance, discipline, or labor relations processes
  • Hands-on Rippling experience: processing payroll, maintaining employee records, and managing onboarding and benefits workflows in the platform
  • 7-10 years of hands-on HR generalist experience — and you are still doing the work yourself today, not overseeing others who do it
  • Real depth across the full HR lifecycle: recruiting and onboarding, payroll, benefits administration, leave administration, employee relations, and policy work
  • Payroll fluency. You have processed it, audited it, and fixed it — not just approved it.
  • Leave administration experience. You can produce a compliant FMLA notice without a template hunt.
  • HRIS proficiency and real experience with at least one implementation or platform migration
  • Strong writing. You can produce a polished handbook, a clear policy, and a professional employee email without heavy editing.
  • Working knowledge of federal and multi-state employment law, including labor law basics under the NLRA, and good instincts about when to escalate
  • Proven remote work experience — you are self-directed, communicative, and reliably reachable during core hours
  • BA/BS in Human Resources or a related field

Preferred

  • Prior HR consulting, PEO, HRO, or multi-client experience
  • Experience supporting multiple entities or client organizations at once
  • Experience translating HR documents (handbooks, policies, notices) into Spanish
  • PHR, SPHR, SHRM-CP, or SHRM-SCP certification
  • Proficiency across the Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel

Compensation and Benefits

  • $32.00 - $40.00 per hour, depending on experience
  • Paid time off and paid holidays — uncommon in part-time HR work, and intentional on our part
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Professional development assistance, including certification support
  • Fully remote, with a consistent Monday-Friday schedule
We are hiring an employee, not contracting a firm. The benefits package reflects that.

We are committed to being an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

Senior Full Stack Software Engineer (Product & Infrastructure)

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Client Business Hours

About the Role

We’re hiring a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to build, scale, and maintain modern web applications and cloud infrastructure across high-impact product environments.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who can own features end-to-end — from front-end user experience to back-end architecture, APIs, databases, deployments, and infrastructure reliability.

You’ll work closely with product, design, and engineering teams to ship scalable applications that are performant, secure, and built for long-term growth.

This role goes beyond simply writing code. You’ll contribute to technical architecture, improve engineering processes, mentor junior developers, and help shape the reliability and scalability of the platform as the company grows.

If you enjoy building production-grade systems, solving infrastructure challenges, and shipping features quickly without compromising quality, this role is for you.

What You’ll Own

Full Stack Product Development

  • Build and maintain scalable web applications using React, Next.js, Angular, or Vue
    • Develop secure and performant back-end services using Node.js, Python (FastAPI, Django, Flask), or similar frameworks
    • Design and build RESTful and GraphQL APIs
    • Translate Figma or product requirements into responsive, production-ready interfaces
    • Optimize front-end performance, accessibility, and user experience across devices

Database & System Architecture

  • Design scalable database schemas using PostgreSQL, MySQL, or MongoDB
    • Write efficient queries and optimize application performance
    • Build systems that support scalability, maintainability, and reliability
    • Contribute to architecture decisions and long-term technical planning

Infrastructure, DevOps & Cloud Deployment

  • Deploy and manage applications on AWS, GCP, or Azure
    • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, CircleCI, or similar tools
    • Containerize applications using Docker and manage deployments through Kubernetes or serverless infrastructure
    • Monitor uptime, logs, and system health across environments

Testing, Reliability & Security

  • Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests using Jest, Cypress, PyTest, or similar tools
    • Maintain strong testing standards and high code quality
    • Implement secure authentication, authorization, and API best practices
    • Follow modern security standards including OWASP best practices and secure infrastructure design
    • Troubleshoot outages, performance bottlenecks, and production issues proactively

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

  • Participate in architecture reviews and technical planning discussions
    • Review pull requests and mentor junior engineers through code feedback and collaboration
    • Work closely with product managers and designers to refine requirements and technical feasibility
    • Help improve engineering workflows, standards, and development processes

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • You can independently ship features from concept to deployment
    • You understand both application development and infrastructure reliability
    • You balance speed, scalability, and code quality effectively
    • You enjoy solving complex technical problems in production environments
    • You communicate clearly and collaborate well across teams
    • You take ownership of outcomes, not just tickets

Required Experience & Skills

  • 5+ years of professional full stack software engineering experience
    • Strong proficiency with JavaScript/TypeScript, React, and Node.js
    • Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB)
    • Experience deploying and managing applications in AWS, GCP, or Azure
    • Strong understanding of APIs, authentication, and scalable application architecture
    • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and Git workflows
    • Strong debugging, optimization, and problem-solving skills
    • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

Preferred Experience

  • Experience leading architecture discussions or technical design reviews
    • Infrastructure-as-Code experience (Terraform, Pulumi, CloudFormation)
    • Background working on SaaS products or high-traffic web applications
    • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or serverless architectures
    • Familiarity with microservices and event-driven systems
    • Experience monitoring production systems using Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, or similar tools
    • Exposure to performance optimization and cloud cost management

What a Typical Day Looks Like

A Senior Full Stack Engineer’s day revolves around building features, improving infrastructure, and maintaining system reliability. You will:
• Participate in standups and technical planning discussions
• Build front-end interfaces and back-end APIs for new product features
• Review and merge pull requests while mentoring junior developers
• Debug production issues and optimize application performance
• Deploy updates through CI/CD pipelines and monitor infrastructure health
• Collaborate with product and design teams to refine workflows and user experience
• Improve testing, scalability, and long-term maintainability of the platform

In short: you are responsible for building reliable, scalable, and production-ready software systems that directly support business growth.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • On-time delivery of features and technical initiatives
    • Application uptime and infrastructure reliability (99.9%+)
    • Code quality, testing coverage, and reduction of technical debt
    • Performance optimization and scalability improvements
    • Successful mentoring and collaboration across engineering teams
    • Stability and reliability of production deployments

Interview Process

  • Initial Phone Screen

• Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter

  • Technical Assessment (Full Stack Exercise or Architecture Scenario)
    • Client Interview(s) with Engineering Team

• Offer & Background Verification

jobs.description:
About U.S. Nature Initiative

U.S. Nature Initiative advances durable, bipartisan conservation outcomes by strategically aligning philanthropic investment with policy, campaign, and communications expertise. As a pooled funder, regranting partner, and strategic campaign architect, we resource high-impact efforts across public lands, private lands and water- strengthening the field and building lasting wins.

U.S. Nature Initiative is a fiscally sponsored project of Resources Legacy Fund (RLF). RLF delivers transformative outcomes for our planet and its people through trusted partnerships and creative campaigns. Rooted in California and expanding across Western North America and beyond, we have a 25-year track record of supporting initiatives at every scale. We host fiscally sponsored projects that reach across the globe, reinforcing the efforts of change makers worldwide. To learn more about Resources Legacy Fund, visit .

Position Summary

The U.S. Nature Initiative (USNI) is seeking a Campaign Director with a proven track record of successful advocacy campaign execution in the water, private lands, and/or public lands sectors. The Campaign Director will support USNI's conservation advocacy campaigns across various stages of development and implementation. They build strong working relationships with partners across the political spectrum. The Campaign Director works closely with the Vice President of Campaigns and USNI’s communications team.

This position is full-time, exempt, and reports to USNI’s Vice President of Communications. It is fully remote within the U.S., with occasional travel (estimated 25%.)

Key Responsibilities:

Grantee Partnership Management (50%)

  • Collaborating closely with selected grantees to ensure the successful development and delivery of high-quality campaign deliverables.
  • Providing grantees with strategic guidance, technical assistance, and ensuring alignment with USNI's objectives while engaging the USNI team as appropriate.
  • USNI anticipates having 10-15 active advocacy campaigns at any given time spanning fresh water, private land, and public lands issues.

Campaign Planning and Strategy (20%)

  • Assisting leadership in the development of robust, measurable, and impactful campaign plans–primarily focusing on developing subsequent phases of campaigns following the success of existing advocacy campaign investments.

Grantee Identification and Vetting (20%)

  • Assisting leadership in researching, evaluating, and recommending potential grantees capable of executing campaign goals.

Ad Hoc Campaign Support (10%)

  • Executing various other campaign-related tasks as determined by USNI leadership.

Requirements

Qualifications:

Note: These qualifications are guidelines, not hard and fast rules, so if you have 75% of the qualifications listed, we encourage you to apply. Experience can include paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work that helped you to build the competencies, knowledge, and skills needed for this position. Applying gives you the opportunity to be considered.

  • 8+ experience in conservation advocacy campaign execution, including implementing long-term, multi-phase advocacy campaigns that create momentum for bold policy outcomes.
  • Demonstrated experience in one or more of the following areas: water resource conservation, private and working lands management/conservation, or public lands and wildlife protection/advocacy.
  • A robust understanding of strategic communications tactics and how to effectively deploy these tactics in service of conservation advocacy campaigns.
  • Strong project management skills, particularly in managing multi-stakeholder initiatives.
  • Proven ability to work effectively with non-profit organizations, grassroots groups, and other field partners.
  • Experience working with organizations from across the ideological spectrum, ensuring alignment behind long-term goals and objectives.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and time management ability; a self-starter who takes initiative.

Preferred Qualifications

The ideal candidate will:

  • Have a deep working knowledge and experience with public land and wildlife policy, particularly in the Intermountain West.
  • Possess a working knowledge of various accountability tools and tactics that can be deployed to build and wield influence for a policy goal, including familiarity with 501(c)(3) and 501(c)(4) advocacy rules
  • Have experience working in partnership and interfacing with philanthropy

Commitment to Nondiscrimination

We are committed to providing a work environment free from discrimination, where all team members feel valued, respected, and included. We know that our work is enriched by the varied voices and perspectives of every staff and board member, so we are committed to making an earnest effort to recruit, welcome, train, develop, and retain talented individuals from all backgrounds. We believe that a welcoming culture expands our creative capacity to do our work and achieve greater outcomes for people and the natural world.

RLF participates in E-Verify, potential candidates can review the information here and here.

Benefits

The starting salary range for the Campaigns Director is $120,000-135,000 annually, salary commensurate with experience. We offer a comprehensive benefit package including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401k plan with a 5% match, and generous paid time off. RLF also offers a technology allowance, student loan repayment assistance, the Calm app, mental health benefits and approximately 16 paid holidays per year.

jobs.description:
Position: Sales Executive

Salary: ~£900–£1,200/month base + incentives

Working Hours & Conditions: UK hours: 9:00am – 5:30pm (1-hour lunch); full-time (remote)

Holidays: UK Holidays

ROLE OVERVIEW:

As a Sales Executive, you will be responsible for driving new customer acquisition for the company.

This is a front-end sales role where you will take ownership of the entire sales process, from identifying potential clients and making the first approach through to arranging sales meetings, presenting our services, handling objections, closing deals and managing the initial onboarding process.

You'll be targeting contractors and construction-related businesses across the UK, identifying those who could benefit from having a dedicated outsourced business development team working on their behalf.

You'll need to be comfortable picking up the telephone, sending targeted emails, networking through LinkedIn and proactively approaching business owners and directors.

Your objective is straightforward: identify businesses that need help winning more work, demonstrate how our services can help them and convert those opportunities into paying clients.

This isn't a passive sales role. We want someone who is hungry for new business, enjoys speaking to decision-makers, follows up consistently and takes pride in closing deals.

You'll be supported by the wider company team, but you'll be responsible for managing your own sales pipeline and driving your own results.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

1. Prospecting & Identifying New Clients

  • Research and identify potential new clients within the UK construction industry.
  • Build targeted prospect lists of contractors, subcontractors, specialist trades and construction-related businesses.
  • Identify business owners, directors and senior decision-makers.
  • Use LinkedIn, company websites, construction directories and other research tools to identify suitable prospects.
  • Understand each prospect's business, services, market position and potential need for outsourced business development.
  • Proactively build and maintain a pipeline of potential clients.

2. Outbound Sales & Lead Generation

  • Make consistent outbound telephone calls to prospective clients.
  • Send targeted cold emails introducing the company and explaining the benefits of our service.
  • Use LinkedIn to connect with business owners, directors and other relevant decision-makers.
  • Build relationships with prospective clients through consistent communication and follow-up.
  • Generate interest in the company's outsourced business development service.
  • Identify businesses experiencing challenges with winning new work, developing relationships or maintaining a consistent sales pipeline.
  • Convert initial interest into qualified sales conversations.

3. Booking & Conducting Sales Meetings

  • Arrange telephone and online meetings with prospective clients.
  • Understand their current business development arrangements, commercial objectives and growth ambitions.
  • Explain how the company operates and how our team would work as an extension of their business.
  • Present the benefits of having dedicated outsourced business development support.
  • Explain our approach to prospecting, relationship building, introductions and generating new work opportunities.
  • Demonstrate the value of our services through relevant examples and case studies.
  • Handle questions, concerns and objections confidently.

4. Closing New Business

  • Follow up on proposals and sales conversations.
  • Maintain consistent communication with prospective clients throughout the sales process.
  • Handle commercial discussions and explain pricing and contractual arrangements.
  • Overcome objections and help prospects understand the value of investing in business development.
  • Secure signed agreements and confirm new client commitments.
  • Follow opportunities through to successful payment and onboarding.
  • Maintain ownership of your sales pipeline until the client has successfully joined the company.

5. Client Onboarding & Handover

  • Coordinate the initial onboarding process for new clients.
  • Collect relevant company information, service details, capabilities and target market requirements.
  • Ensure agreements and initial payments are completed.
  • Arrange introductions and handovers to the Business Development Account Management team.
  • Ensure the client has a clear understanding of what happens next and how their service will operate.
  • Maintain a professional relationship with newly signed clients throughout the transition.

6. Sales Reporting & Performance

  • Maintain accurate records of prospecting, calls, emails, LinkedIn activity and sales conversations.
  • Manage your pipeline using our internal CRM and tracking systems.
  • Monitor conversion rates from initial contact through to signed agreements.
  • Provide regular sales activity and performance updates.
  • Work towards agreed targets for prospecting, appointments, proposals and new client acquisitions.
  • Take responsibility for developing your own pipeline and achieving your sales objectives.

Requirements

QUALIFICATIONS:

We're looking for someone who is naturally confident, commercially minded and motivated by bringing new business into a growing company.

You should enjoy speaking to people, be comfortable approaching businesses you have never spoken to before and have the persistence to follow opportunities through to a successful sale.

You don't necessarily need construction industry experience, as training will be provided. However, previous experience in B2B sales, telesales or business development would be beneficial.

Essential Skills & Attributes

  • Confident in making outbound cold calls.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Comfortable speaking with business owners, directors and senior decision-makers.
  • Confident presenting and selling a professional business service.
  • Strong objection-handling and negotiation skills.
  • Persistent and proactive when following up sales opportunities.
  • Organised and able to manage multiple prospects and sales conversations.
  • Target-driven with a genuine desire to achieve and exceed sales targets.
  • Comfortable using LinkedIn, email, telephone and CRM systems.
  • Able to work independently and take ownership of sales performance.
  • Professional, personable and confident representing the company.

Desirable Experience

● Previous B2B sales experience.

  • Experience in telesales, outbound sales or appointment setting.
  • Experience selling professional services or business-to-business solutions.
  • Experience dealing with company directors and business owners.
  • Knowledge of the UK construction industry.

Social Media Manager – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Social Media Manager to lead and grow their brand presence across multiple social media platforms.

This is a hands-on role for someone who understands how to combine creative storytelling, content strategy, community engagement, and performance marketing to drive meaningful business results. You’ll own the social media strategy from planning through execution, creating content that grows audiences, increases engagement, and supports broader marketing objectives.

You’ll collaborate closely with marketing, design, and leadership teams to build a consistent, high-performing presence across LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, X (Twitter), YouTube, and other relevant platforms.

If you’re passionate about creating engaging content, growing online communities, and using data to optimize performance, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

Social Media Strategy & Planning

  • Develop and execute social media strategies aligned with brand awareness, engagement, and growth objectives.
  • Create and maintain content calendars across multiple social platforms.
  • Identify content opportunities, industry trends, and audience insights to strengthen brand positioning.
  • Ensure consistent messaging and brand voice across all channels.

Content Creation & Publishing

  • Write engaging captions, hooks, and platform-specific content.
  • Collaborate with designers, video editors, and marketing teams to produce high-performing visual content.
  • Schedule and publish content using tools such as Hootsuite, Buffer, Sprout Social, HubSpot, or similar platforms.
  • Support the creation and distribution of short-form video content for Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and other emerging formats.

Community Management

  • Monitor comments, direct messages, mentions, and community interactions daily.
  • Engage with audiences by responding promptly and professionally.
  • Participate in relevant conversations and industry trends to increase visibility and engagement.
  • Foster meaningful relationships that strengthen community growth and brand loyalty.

Campaign Management & Performance

  • Support both organic and paid social campaigns for promotions, events, and brand initiatives.
  • Analyze campaign performance using platform analytics and reporting tools.
  • Track KPIs including:
    • Engagement
    • Reach
    • Follower growth
    • Website traffic
    • Click-through rates
    • Conversions
  • Continuously optimize content strategy based on performance insights and audience behavior.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with marketing, content, and leadership teams to align social media initiatives with broader business goals.
  • Coordinate campaign launches, promotional activities, and content execution.
  • Stay informed on platform updates, social trends, and emerging opportunities to keep the brand competitive.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • You’re creative, organized, and highly proactive.
  • You understand how different social platforms require different content strategies.
  • You combine creativity with data-driven decision-making.
  • You enjoy building communities and creating content that resonates with audiences.
  • You’re comfortable managing multiple platforms and priorities simultaneously.
  • You stay ahead of industry trends and continuously experiment with new ideas.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in social media management, content marketing, or digital marketing.
  • Experience managing business or brand accounts across multiple social media platforms.
  • Excellent copywriting, storytelling, and content creation skills.
  • Experience using scheduling and analytics platforms such as:
    • Hootsuite
    • Buffer
    • Sprout Social
    • HubSpot
    • or similar tools
  • Strong understanding of best practices for:
    • LinkedIn
    • Instagram
    • TikTok
    • Facebook
    • X (Twitter)
    • YouTube
  • Experience using Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar creative tools.
  • Strong understanding of audience engagement, content strategy, and organic social media growth.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and optimize performance.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience managing social media for SaaS, e-commerce, agency, or professional services businesses.
  • Experience with influencer partnerships or UGC campaigns.
  • Familiarity with paid social advertising and campaign boosting.
  • Experience creating or coordinating short-form video content.
  • Previous experience working in startup or high-growth environments.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent growth in audience engagement across all platforms.
  • Steady increase in followers, reach, and brand visibility.
  • Increased website traffic and lead generation from social media.
  • Reliable, high-quality content published on schedule.
  • Strong community engagement and responsive communication.
  • Continuous improvement in campaign performance through testing and optimization.

Interview Process

  • Initial Phone Screen
  • Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  • Practical Assessment (Social Media Strategy & Content Exercise)
  • Client Interview
  • Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the final step that completes your application.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This allows hiring managers to evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful while reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed. Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re a creative, data-driven social media professional who enjoys building brands, growing communities, and creating content that drives measurable results, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and share examples of the social media accounts, campaigns, or content you’ve managed.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

jobs.excerpt: Mylan Inc. Viatris is a global healthcare company uniquely positioned to bridge the traditional divide between generics and brands, combining the best of both to more holistically address healthcare needs globally.
jobs.description:
Mylan Inc.

Viatris is a global healthcare company uniquely positioned to bridge the traditional divide between generics and brands, combining the best of both to more holistically address healthcare needs globally. With a mission to empower people worldwide to live healthier at every stage of life, we provide access at scale, currently supplying high-quality medicines to approximately 1 billion patients around the world annually and touching all of life's moments, from birth to the end of life, acute conditions to chronic diseases.

We have been included on number of award lists that demonstrate the impact we are making.

Every day, we rise to the challenge to make a difference and here’s how the role will make an impact:


The Director, Identity and Access Management (IAM) provides strategic leadership and enterprise oversight for the global IAM function and is a member of the Global Security leadership team, reporting to the Chief Security Officer. The Director establishes and leads the organization responsible for designing, building, operating, and continuously improving enterprise identity and access capabilities. The role directs identity governance, authentication, authorization, privileged access, identity lifecycle management, and secure integration of business applications and services. The Director partners with business and technology leaders to reduce identity-related risk, support regulatory obligations, improve user experience, and enable secure business operations.

Key responsibilities for this role include:

  • Develop and execute the enterprise IAM strategy, operating model, roadmap, and standards aligned with business priorities and security objectives.
  • Build, lead, and develop a global IAM organization accountable for architecture, engineering, delivery, operations, and service improvement.
  • Direct enterprise identity lifecycle processes, including onboarding, changes, offboarding, provisioning, and deprovisioning across workforce and non-workforce identities.
  • Oversee authentication, authorization, federation, single sign-on, and modern access controls to provide secure and usable access to enterprise resources.
  • Lead privileged access management and identity governance capabilities, including entitlement management, access approvals, certifications, and segregation of duties.
  • Ensure IAM architectures, technology selection, and integrations meet enterprise security requirements and support scalable, reliable service delivery.
  • Establish IAM service performance, risk, and control measures; report progress, issues, and priorities to the Chief Security Officer and senior leadership.
  • Direct IAM investment planning, budgets, resources, and delivery priorities while improving automation, operational efficiency, and service resilience.
  • Partner with Human Resources, IT, application owners, and business leaders to integrate identity lifecycle and access decisions into business processes.
  • Collaborate with security architecture, operations, privacy, compliance, and audit teams to embed IAM controls and address identity-related risks and findings.
  • Support enterprise transformation, application onboarding, and organizational change by defining secure identity integration and access requirements.
  • Promote adoption of IAM policies, secure authentication practices, and role-based training through stakeholder engagement and communications.
  • Coordinate with technology and business continuity teams to maintain the availability and recovery readiness of critical identity services.

The minimum qualifications for this role are:

  • Minimum of a Bachelor’s degree with a focus in MIS ,IT or Engineering or equivalent is required. Masters degree in MIS, IT, Engineering or related is preferred. Related experience and/or education may be considered.
  • Minimum of ten years of IT or Cybersecurity experience is required. IAM – CISSP, CISM, CIAM, CIMP, or equivalent identity and access management certification preferred.
  • Knowledge of enterprise IAM principles, identity lifecycle governance, access control models, and cybersecurity and privacy requirements.
  • Knowledge of authentication and authorization methods, federation, single sign-on, and privileged access security concepts.
  • Knowledge of security architecture, integration patterns, and evolving technologies supporting enterprise identity services.
  • Knowledge of risk management, security controls, and governance requirements for access to sensitive business systems and information.
  • Knowledge of IAM service delivery, operational resilience, and the business impacts of identity control failures.
  • Knowledge of applicable cybersecurity, privacy, and regulatory obligations in a global, highly regulated enterprise.
  • Ability to advise and influence senior company management on IAM strategy, identity-related risks, and investment priorities to support informed business decisions.
  • Proven ability to partner with business management to deliver efficient, effective IAM solutions that meet operational needs and align with company objectives.
  • Ability to lead global teams, manage organizational change, and establish accountability for service performance and continuous improvement.
  • Skill in developing enterprise IAM strategies, roadmaps, and pragmatic solutions to complex access management challenges.
  • Skill in evaluating identity-related risks, control effectiveness, and remediation priorities across enterprise systems.
  • Skill in assessing IAM architectures, integrations, and technical control designs against business and security requirements.

Exact compensation may vary based on items such as skills, experience and location. The salary range for this position is: $112,000 - $236,000.

At Viatris, we offer competitive salaries, benefits and an inclusive environment where you can use your experiences, perspectives and skills to help make an impact on the lives of others.

Viatris is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, religion, age, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, disability, or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations.

jobs.excerpt: Description The Fresche Solutions professional services team is seeking a highly motivated and versatile product manager to join our team and set the long-term vision and product strategy for customer IBM i modernization experiences.
jobs.description:
Description

The Fresche Solutions professional services team is seeking a highly motivated and versatile product manager to join our team and set the long-term vision and product strategy for customer IBM i modernization experiences. You will lead the packaging, launch, and growth of our productized services portfolio. You will turn custom or repeatable service capabilities into standardized, scalable, and repeatable offerings with clear scope, pricing, and delivery guidance. As Senior Product Manager for IBM i Modernization, you will own what our Modernization practice sells. You package the work we already deliver well, price it simply, and take it to market. You are comfortable with ambiguity, ask hard questions, push back when needed, and bring people along. Working across delivery, sales, marketing, operations, and engineering teams, you will balance customer value, margin, and operational efficiency across the portfolio. You will join a team of builders, product leaders, and end-to-end operators who set high standards, care deeply about customers, and invest in each other’s growth.

Key Job Responsibilities

Package and Price:

  • Find the work we deliver again and again, document repeatable patterns, and turn it into reusable assets
  • Work cross-functionally to ensure product decisions align with legal/regulatory obligations, customer needs requirements, and business growth & margin goals.
  • Design each offering as a module that combines with others into a more comprehensive end-to-end solution.

Take Offerings to Market:

  • Map the customer journey and the strategic use cases we pursue based on differentiation.
  • Align Sales, Legal, Marketing, and delivery teams on one go-to-market plan for each offering.
  • Train sellers to lead and close deals with offerings. Join customer discovery and advisory calls to hear problems first-hand.

Own the Portfolio:

  • Build your practice’s portfolio of productized services with supporting data. Find gaps worth filling.
  • Track each offering’s in-market performance. Improve weak offerings, and retire the ones that don’t earn their place.
  • Own the positioning, prioritization, and roadmap for your offerings, today and 2 to 3 years out.

What Happens on a Tuesday

Here's a typical day into the role:

  • In the morning. An account executive emails about a new customer use case. They want an offering for it in the solutions catalog by Friday. You check whether the need repeats, and plan a first version.
  • During late morning. You review a modernization partner’s discovery questionnaire. Two answers came back vague, so you chase them until they are clear.
  • After lunch. You lead a portfolio review with the practice. You cover how published offerings perform, plus risks and customer signals on offerings in progress.
  • In the afternoon. You assess the pricing strategy in a new cross-practice managed services offering and set its conditions. You also structure offering data so Fresche’s AI tools can use it.
  • At the end of the day. The executive team asks how much growth to forecast from the Modernization portfolio. You answer with data.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, analytics, mathematics, statistics, IT or equivalent
  • 5+ years in product management, or equivalent experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition in technical program management or operations roles.
  • Experience packaging a service, solution, or product, and taking it to market: value-based scope, price, positioning, ROI, and launch.
  • Experience defining product requirements, writing business needs documentation, and setting outcome-based success criteria that align development execution with measurable results.
  • Experience engaging with senior technical stakeholders and business leaders
  • Uses AI tools in daily work for research, analysis, and writing.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in engineering, statistics, computer science, operations research, business analytics, information systems or equivalent.
  • Experience with IBM i (aka AS/400 or iSeries), or with modernizing legacy business applications.
  • Experience in IT services or consulting, where you sold people’s time and expertise.
  • Experience packaging managed services or ongoing application support.
  • Experience building solutions with partners.
  • Experience in at least one enterprise vertical: e.g. financial services, healthcare/life sciences, manufacturing, telecommunications, retail, energy sector.

WHY JOIN FRESCHE? Fresche Solutions helps companies that run their business on IBM i modernize their applications, run them in the cloud, and get more from their data. We believe in leading our industry, we believe in innovation, we believe in delighting our customers, guaranteeing their success, and ensuring that 100% of our customers are referenceable.

At Fresche Solutions, we offer great work-life balance with flexible hours. You can work anywhere in North America… either from your home or in one of our offices… the decision is up to you. Our distinct company culture makes us a top employer, as well a premiere choice for our customers for the last eleven (11) consecutive years. We work hard to ensure that our values permeate the company and are reflected in everything we do. Whether it be in setting priorities, defining ideas, or carrying out processes, we are committed to ensuring that our values are manifested at all levels of our organization.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.title: Quantum Information Science Postdoctoral Research Associate
jobs.excerpt: Brookhaven Lab’s Computing and Data Sciences directorate (CDS) is accelerating computing and domain science by providing a complete ecosystem that safely and seamlessly provides the expertise, compute and data resources, and research environment to drive discovery.
jobs.description:
Brookhaven Lab’s Computing and Data Sciences directorate (CDS) is accelerating computing and domain science by providing a complete ecosystem that safely and seamlessly provides the expertise, compute and data resources, and research environment to drive discovery.

CDS employs a multidisciplinary, collaborative approach to its applied math, artificial intelligence, and computing research and uses broad capabilities to target scientific challenges, working with fellow researchers at the Lab and many global partners.

The focus of this position is mainly on designing new topological quantum error correcting codes and analyzing their properties. We are also interested in quantum algorithm / quantum code co-design, as well as code design for specific hardware architectures.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

We are looking for a postdoctoral research associate who can collaborate closely with the PI on projects related to topological quantum error correcting codes. The work is theoretical, mainly consisting of devising and using mathematical tools for analysis and varying degrees of coding for testing ideas.

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Ph.D. in Theoretical Physics, Mathematics or Computer Science within the last 5 years.

  • Research experience in quantum information science, particularly quantum error correcting codes.

  • Candidates must have excellent written and oral communication skills, be self-motivated and able to work both independently and as a part of a team.

  • Ability to interact effectively and work closely with the PI and collaborators.

  • Proven ability to disseminate research results by writing manuscripts and giving academic presentations.

  • Candidates must be interested in quantum error correcting codes, and algorithm / code codesign.

  • Aptitude for analytical work and ability to code efficiently.

Preferred Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Familiarity with topological codes

  • Expertise in tensor networks

  • Expertise in training Artificial Intelligence (AI) models, in particular graph neural networks.

  • Familiarity with high-performance computing.

Environmental, Health & Safety Requirements:

  • Demonstrated commitment to working safely, acting ethically, and taking personal accountability for operational excellence.

Other Information:

  • This is a fully remote position with the option to be onsite

  • This position has an initial 1-year term, with the possibility of renewal contingent on performance and funding availability.

  • BNL policy requires that after obtaining a PhD, eligible candidates for research associate appointments may not exceed a combined total of 5 years of relevant work experience as a post-doc and/or in an R&D position, excluding time associated with family planning, military service, illness or other life-changing events.

  • Candidates must have received a Ph.D. by the commencement of employment.

Brookhaven Laboratory is committed to providing fair, equitable and competitive compensation. The full salary range for this position is $ $74,050 - $122,550/ year. You will be placed at the level and salary commensurate with your experience. Salary offers will be commensurate with the final candidate’s qualification, education and experience and considered with the internal peer group.


Brookhaven National Laboratory is committed to employee success and we believe that a comprehensive employee benefits program is an important and meaningful part of the compensation employees receive. Review more information at BNL | Benefits Program


Brookhaven National Laboratory requires all non-badged personnel including visitors to produce a REAL-ID or REAL-ID compliant documentation to access Brookhaven National Laboratory – view more information at . This is due to nationwide identification requirements for federal site access as required by the federal REAL ID Act. Those not in possession of a REAL ID-compliant document will not be permitted to access the site which includes access to the Laboratory for interviews.


As a U.S. Department of Energy laboratory, Brookhaven National Laboratory requires employees to obtain and maintain a DOE Uncleared Personal Identity Verification (UPIV) credential in accordance with Homeland Security Presidential Directive 12 (HSPD-12) requirements. The credentialing process is completed as part of onboarding and enables access to DOE facilities and information systems. As a condition of employment, the selected candidate must be able to obtain and maintain a UPIV credential. These requirements are established under DOE Order 206.2 Chg. 2, Identity, Credential, and Access Management (ICAM- Identity, Credential, and Access Management (ICAM)), and DOE Order 473.1A- Physical Protection Program- Physical Protection Program.


About Us

Brookhaven National Laboratory (www.bnl.gov) delivers discovery science and transformative technology to power and secure the nation’s future. Brookhaven Lab is a multidisciplinary laboratory with seven Nobel Prize-winning discoveries, 37 R&D 100 Awards, and more than 70 years of pioneering research. The Lab is primarily supported by the U.S. Department of Energy’s (DOE) Office of Science. Brookhaven Science Associates (BSA) operates and manages the Laboratory for DOE. BSA is a partnership between Battelle and The Research Foundation for the State University of New York on behalf of Stony Brook University. BSA salutes our veterans and active military members with careers that leverage the skills and unique experience they gained while serving our country, learn more at BNL | Opportunities for Veterans at Brookhaven National Laboratory.


Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer

Guided by our core values of integrity, responsibility, innovation, respect, and teamwork, Brookhaven Science Associates is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer-Vets/Disabled. We are committed to fostering a respectful and collaborative environment that fuels scientific discovery. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to any characteristic protected by law. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. ABOUT PLACER.AI:

Placer.ai is transforming how organizations understand the physical world. Our location analytics platform provides unprecedented visibility into locations, markets, and consumer behavior. Placer empowers thousands of customers—from Fortune 500 companies, to local governments and nonprofits— to make smarter, data-driven decisions.

What sets us apart? We've built the most advanced location intelligence platform in the market while maintaining an uncompromising commitment to privacy, proving that powerful analytics and responsible data practices can coexist.

We're creating a $100B+ market opportunity, and we're just getting started.

Named one of Forbes America's Best Startup Employers and a Deloitte Technology Fast 500 company, we're building a culture where innovation thrives, collaboration is the norm, and every team member contributes to reshaping how the world understands location.

SUMMARY:

Placer.ai is looking for a seasoned, hunter-minded Account Executive to win net-new logos in our Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) vertical! This is a new business role: rather than inheriting an existing book, you will build your own pipeline from the ground up, prospecting into and working between 20-30 new accounts per month across CPG manufacturers and brands, spanning food and beverage, personal care, household goods, confectionery, toys and other consumer categories. You’ll partner with sales, category management, insights and trade marketing leaders to show how Placer’s foot traffic and audience insights help them make smarter decisions about distribution, store segmentation, demand forecasting and new product launches. Placer gives CPG teams the visit signal that complements the point-of-sale and panel data they already rely on: who is showing up at their retail partners’ stores, and how that is changing. When fully-ramped, you’ll be expected to handle 30+ meetings per week while maintaining a clean pipeline and actively keeping an accurate forecast.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Prospect, open and close net-new CPG manufacturers and brands, owning the full sales cycle from first outreach to signed contract and working complex deals that require multiple touch points and meetings with key stakeholders across sales, category management, consumer insights, trade marketing and executive leadership.
  • Build and manage your own pipeline (4x monthly sales target) through self-sourced outbound prospecting, moving a large number of transactions through the sales pipeline.
  • Deliver tailored demos of Placer’s platform built around CPG use cases such as category management, store segmentation, demand forecasting, retail partner performance and new product launches, while interfacing with pre/post sales teams.
  • Complete 20+ new demos of Placer’s platform per month.
  • Position Placer alongside the syndicated point-of-sale and consumer panel data CPG teams already use (such as Circana, NielsenIQ and Numerator), showing how visit and audience insights add a view of their retail partners they can’t get elsewhere.
  • Show CPG prospects how Placer insights can strengthen their retailer conversations, joint business plans and trade spend decisions.
  • Share CPG market feedback with Placer’s product and marketing teams to sharpen our positioning and roadmap for the vertical.
  • Achieve and consistently exceed monthly sales goals.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • BA/BS or similar college-level education.
  • 5+ years selling in the B2B Software space, including direct experience selling data, analytics or SaaS solutions to CPG manufacturers or brands.
  • A proven track record of self-sourcing pipeline and winning net-new logos through outbound prospecting, with consistent quota attainment.
  • Working knowledge of how CPG companies go to market, including category management, retailer relationships, trade spend and class of trade (grocery, mass, club, drug and convenience).
  • Familiarity with the CPG data landscape, including syndicated point-of-sale data, consumer panels and retailer-shared data.
  • Mastery of Command of the Message, MEDDPICC and/or other strategic sales methodologies and processes.
  • Experience working with G-Suite: Gmail, Google Slides, Sheets, etc.
  • Advanced understanding of working with SFDC or relevant CRM.
  • Excellent, clear verbal and non-verbal communication skills.
  • A positive attitude and a selfless approach to teamwork.
  • An established network across CPG sales, category management, insights or trade marketing teams is a plus.
  • Prior experience at a CPG manufacturer, retailer, broker or syndicated data provider is a plus.
  • A proven ‘problem solver’ with the ability to work in a fast-paced, ever-growing startup organization.
  • Travel is required up to 25% of the time for prospect meetings and conferences, including key CPG and retail industry events.

NICE TO HAVES:

  • Demonstrated use of AI tools to work more efficiently—whether professionally or personally—and a curiosity for finding new ways to apply them.
  • Comfort integrating generative AI into day-to-day workflows to boost productivity, quality, and output.

WHY JOIN PLACER.AI?

  • Join a rocketship!
  • Take a central and critical role at Placer.ai
  • Work with, and learn from, top-notch talent
  • Competitive salary
  • Excellent benefits
  • Fully remote

Base pay offered within the stated range may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including job-related skills, professional experience, education and licenses (if applicable), work location and compensation market data.

Base pay is just a part of our total rewards program. Placer provides medical, dental and vision coverage as well as flexible time off, 401K and equity awards for certain roles.

Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

The Senior NPI Engineer owns that transition. jobs.title: Account Executive, Public Safety - Cloudrunner
jobs.excerpt: About Genetec: Genetec is a global technology company that develops open-platform software, hardware and cloud-based services for physical security, public safety and operations.
jobs.description:
About Genetec:

Genetec is a global technology company that develops open-platform software, hardware and cloud-based services for physical security, public safety and operations. Its portfolio includes Security Center for unified video, access control and automatic license plate recognition (ALPR), AutoVu ALPR, Genetec Clearance digital evidence management, and Genetec Cloudrunner. Headquartered in Montreal, Canada, Genetec serves enterprise and government organizations through a network of certified integrators, resellers and consultants around the world.

Genetec Cloudrunner is a cloud-based vehicle-centric investigation system. It combines purpose-built, solar-powered ALPR cameras with an intuitive cloud platform to capture license plates and vehicle characteristics such as color, type, make and model, day or night and in any weather. Investigators can search for vehicles of interest, receive real-time hotlist alerts, collaborate securely with partner agencies, and share evidence through Genetec Clearance. Cloudrunner is sold as an all-inclusive subscription that covers hardware, software, configuration, and support.

Job overview:

The Account Executive, Cloudrunner is a quota-carrying sales professional who grows Genetec's vehicle-centric investigation business across public safety agencies, colleges and universities, and K-12 lower education customers. Cloudrunner and Genetec's other ALPR technologies are the core of the role, in addition the successful candidate will also speak credibly to the wider Genetec portfolio and bring in the right specialists when a customer's needs extend to video, access control, evidence management or unified operations.

This is not a feature-and-price role. The Account Executive leads outcome-based conversations with chiefs, sheriffs, investigators, campus police and public safety directors, superintendents, CIOs and elected officials. They understand the narrative of each market: how agencies close cases and protect communities with fewer resources, how campuses keep students, staff and visitors safe across open environments, and how school districts balance safety, privacy and community trust. They turn that understanding into a clear business case, and they guide customers through public sector budgeting, grants and procurement to a signed agreement.

Your day at a glance:

Position Cloudrunner and Genetec ALPR:

  • Own the full sales cycle for Cloudrunner and Genetec ALPR in your assigned territory, from prospecting and discovery through demonstration, proposal, procurement and close.
  • Build and manage a healthy pipeline of new and expansion opportunities, and forecast accurately in CRM.
  • Run discovery around the customer's mission and desired outcomes, such as faster case closure, stronger investigative leads, safer campuses and better collaboration between agencies.
  • Deliver compelling demonstrations and pilots that show how vehicle-centric investigations turns witness descriptions and partial plates into actionable leads.
  • Grow existing customers by expanding camera deployments, adding sites and partner agencies, and securing on-time subscription renewals.

Lead outcome-based conversations with decision makers:

  • Engage executive and operational stakeholders, including police chiefs, sheriffs, investigators, crime analysts, campus police chiefs, public safety and emergency management directors, superintendents, CIOs, city managers and elected officials.
  • Build business cases that tie Cloudrunner to measurable outcomes, such as investigative efficiency, case clearance, officer time saved and community safety, rather than product features alone.
  • Address privacy, data governance and policy questions with confidence, explaining how Cloudrunner supports responsible use, controlled data sharing and auditability.
  • Help customers build support across their organizations, including city councils, school boards, campus leadership and community stakeholders.

Understand and tell the market story:

  • Know the public safety narrative: real-time crime centers, investigative workflows, regional collaboration between agencies, staffing pressures and the growing role of technology in solving crime.
  • Know the higher education and K-12 narrative: real-time safety centers, open campuses, perimeter and parking lot safety, collaboration with local law enforcement, emergency preparedness, and the expectations of students, parents and the community.
  • Stay current on competitive offerings in the ALPR and vehicle-centric investigation market, and position Genetec's differentiators clearly and credibly.
  • Share market feedback with Product Management and Marketing to shape Cloudrunner's roadmap and messaging.

Position the wider Genetec portfolio:

  • Speak to how Cloudrunner fits within the broader Genetec ecosystem, including Security Center, AutoVu, Genetec Clearance and other Genetec solutions.
  • Recognize opportunities beyond ALPR and bring in Genetec vertical sales directors, account executives and solution engineers to pursue them as a team.
  • Support opportunities in other public sector verticals, such as transportation, municipal government and critical infrastructure, when assigned.

Navigate public sector buying:

  • Guide customers through budget cycles, grant funding, cooperative purchasing contracts, RFPs and sole-source justifications.
  • Work with the Genetec Grants and Contracts Office, Legal, and Deal Desk to structure compliant proposals and agreements.
  • Partner with authorized resellers and integrators where needed to support installation, delivery and procurement requirements.

Collaborate across Genetec:

  • Work closely with the Public Safety Manager, the Public Safety and Education sales teams, sales engineers, customer success managers and support to deliver a seamless customer experience.
  • Represent Genetec at trade shows, association conferences and customer events, such as IACP and state chiefs' and sheriffs' associations, and campus safety and education technology events.

What makes you a great fit:

  • Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • At least 5 years of business-to-government or public sector technology sales experience, with a consistent record of meeting or exceeding quota.
  • Experience selling into law enforcement or public safety agencies, higher education or K-12; experience in more than one of these markets is a strong plus.
  • A proven ability to lead consultative, outcome-based sales conversations with senior and elected decision-makers.
  • A working understanding of public sector procurement, including budget cycles, grants, cooperative contracts and RFPs.
  • Familiarity with ALPR, video management, real-time crime center or other public safety technologies.
  • Comfort selling subscription and cloud-based (SaaS) solutions, including renewals and expansion.
  • Excellent presentation, written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technology in plain business terms.
  • Self-motivated, organized and comfortable working remotely and managing a large territory.
  • Proficiency with CRM tools and disciplined pipeline management.
  • Able to travel up to 50% to customer sites

An asset if you have:

  • Prior experience in law enforcement, campus public safety, school safety or emergency management.
  • Experience selling ALPR or vehicle-centric investigation solutions.
  • Knowledge of Genetec Security Center, AutoVu or Genetec Clearance.
  • Familiarity with CJIS, data privacy and ALPR policy requirements at the state level.
  • Existing relationships within public safety associations, campus safety organizations or school district networks.
  • Experience with grant programs that fund public safety and school safety technology.

How success is measured:

  • Revenue: Annual Cloudrunner and ALPR revenue against objective
  • Pipeline: A qualified pipeline of several times quota, with accurate forecasting
  • New logos: New agencies, campuses and school districts brought onto Cloudrunner
  • Expansion: Growth in cameras, sites and partner agencies within existing customers
  • Renewals: Subscription renewals completed on time with strong retention
  • Portfolio pull-through: Qualified opportunities for other Genetec solutions handed to the right teams

Let’s talk perks!

  • Attractive compensation package with 401K match
  • Training Tuition Reimbursement Program
  • Work-life balance with a flexible working schedule

We know that diverse backgrounds and experiences bring great value to our teams. Even if you don't think you tick all the boxes, we still encourage you to apply - your profile may surprise us!

Thank you for your application, but please note that only selected candidates will be contacted. Head-hunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumés/CVs through this Web site or directly to managers.
