Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is: Our client is an Australian-founded consumer technology & DTC business operating in the sleep and lifestyle space, specialising in innovative products designed to improve everyday comfort and sleep experiences. With a strong emphasis on innovation, customer experience and accessible technology, the company serves a growing consumer market through direct-to-consumer channels, while also developing partnerships across retail and other commercial channels.

Role Overview: We are a founder-led group of three DTC brands in sleep and end consumer products, with some B2B sales. We are looking for a top-tier AI marketing strategist to own everything under the marketing umbrella, with a co-founder's mindset.

We need someone who is close to an AI architect of marketing: you design the systems, automations and feedback loops that run our marketing, rather than only doing the tasks by hand.

Our long-term goal is for you, with AI, to replace the external agency we use today.

Key Responsibilities:

What You'll Own

  • Strategy: personas, angles, messaging and channels across all three brands.
  • Paid media: all Meta and Google ads.
  • Organic social: strategy, calendars, scheduling and posting.
  • Email and SMS: Klaviyo flows, campaigns and segmentation.
  • Content production: edit all statics, reels and video from physical product shoots. Raw footage to a finished 30–45 second reel in 30 minutes or less, using AI.
  • AI test-and-learn loops: publish variants, read performance, re-edit and retest. Winners are promoted into paid campaigns.
  • Influencers, affiliates and brand partners: vet, brief, manage and track. Define what each posts based on what our audience converts on.
  • Sales calendars and alignment: build and maintain a sales calendar for each market (AU, EU). Plan campaigns and promotions, and align them across brands, channels (paid, email/SMS, organic, influencers) and each country's holidays and sale periods, so offers, creative and ad budgets are ready ahead of time.
  • Agency: work with our onshore AU agency while building toward replacing it.
  • Profit-based performance: run everything on profit, not just clicks and sales: MER, CAC, margin and ROAS targets.
  • Website conversion: Shopify, landing pages, A/B testing and checkout drop-off, so good ads land on pages that convert.
  • Search and AI search: SEO and AEO (being cited by ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and similar), plus Google Business Profile.
  • Reviews and social proof: collect reviews and UGC (Judge.me, Trustpilot) and turn them into ad and social content.
  • Creative briefing: brief filmed shoots and UGC creators, not just edit the footage.
  • Retail and marketplace support: promo assets and content for B2B partners and bricks and mortar channels.
  • Brand positioning: keep core brand claims consistent across all brands
  • Ownership and handover: we own all ad accounts, pixels, Klaviyo and assets. Document everything in SOPs so nothing lives only in your head.
  • Reporting: clear, regular reporting to the co-founders.
  • Retention and customer value: LTV, repeat purchase, win-back and/or referral programs.

Requirements

What You'll Need

  • 5+ years as a senior strategist or marketing director.
  • Proven results marketing to Western audiences.
  • Top-tier AI fluency (Claude, ChatGPT, Grok), including plugging AI into CapCut, Instagram Edits, Premiere and DaVinci, and deep analysis of instagram.

jobs.excerpt: About CG Oncology, Inc.  Are you ready to make a difference in the world and become part of our patient-centered team that is focused on Attacking Bladder Cancer for a Better Tomorrow?
jobs.description:
About CG Oncology, Inc.

Are you ready to make a difference in the world and become part of our patient-centered team that is focused on Attacking Bladder Cancer for a Better Tomorrow? At CG Oncology, we believe that by having exceptionally talented individuals on our team who share our passion and enjoy working together, we can truly achieve our Vision and Mission to benefit patients around the world.

Every day we are making significant advancements across our multiple pipelines and are growing rapidly to meet the needs of our patients who cannot afford to wait to benefit from our novel immunotherapies. Please review this job posting and our Values and if they resonate with you and are what you expect from your organization and team, then we would like to hear from you.

About the role

Integrated Value & Evidence Strategy (IVES) brings together clinical, comparative, economic, real-world, and patient-centered evidence to inform CG Oncology's clinical development, launch readiness, market access, and lifecycle strategies. Working across functions, IVES ensures that evidence generation is aligned with key scientific, clinical, and business decisions.

The Director, Value & Evidence Programs will serve as a senior scientific and program execution leader within IVES. Reporting to the Senior Director, IVES, this individual will lead the design, integration, and delivery of assigned evidence programs within the enterprise IVES roadmap, ensuring that evidence investments translate into scientifically credible, decision-relevant outputs supporting clinical development, launch readiness, market access, commercialization, and lifecycle strategy.

The role requires deep expertise in value and evidence generation, together with multidisciplinary breadth across health economics and outcomes research (HEOR), comparative effectiveness, evidence synthesis, real-world evidence (RWE), patient-centered evidence, and payer/HTA evidence. The successful candidate will combine scientific and methodological judgment with business acumen and strong program leadership to connect evidence generation with the clinical, provider, payer, and business decisions it is intended to support.

Working across Clinical Development, Medical Affairs, Clinical Science, Biostatistics, Market Access, Commercial, Regulatory, and other partners, this individual will independently lead assigned evidence programs from concept through execution, interpretation, dissemination, and application. The Director will provide scientific leadership to external research partners and collaborators while helping IVES scale an expanding pre-launch and lifecycle evidence portfolio.

Essential Functions

Evidence Program Leadership:Independently lead assigned complex value and evidence programs from research question formulation and study design through execution, interpretation, dissemination, and stakeholder application, translating established IVES priorities into actionable research plans, technical specifications, timelines, and deliverables.

Scientific and Methodological Oversight:Lead and provide scientific oversight across health economic modeling, comparative effectiveness and indirect treatment comparisons, systematic literature reviews/evidence synthesis, burden-of-illness and healthcare resource utilization research, and other outcomes research. Integrate RWE/epidemiology and patient-centered evidence as appropriate, critically evaluating study designs, data sources, assumptions, methods, and results.

Cross-Functional Evidence Integration:Partner with Clinical Development, Clinical Science, Biostatistics, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Commercial, Regulatory, and other stakeholders to ensure evidence programs address clinically meaningful questions and support development, launch readiness, reimbursement, and lifecycle decisions.

Value and Evidence Translation:Connect research findings across clinical, comparative, economic, real-world, and patient-centered evidence to the broader IVES value narrative, translating complex results into actionable insights supporting clinical differentiation, provider decision-making, payer/HTA assessments, and other stakeholder needs.

External Research and Scientific Collaboration:Provide day-to-day scientific and technical leadership to external research organizations, data partners, methodologists, and assigned clinical/KOL collaborators, critically challenging research approaches, ensuring scientific quality, and managing partner performance and deliverables.

Scientific Dissemination and Evidence Planning:Drive peer-reviewed publications, congress presentations, and other scientific dissemination activities in collaboration with relevant functions. Monitor emerging evidence, competitive developments, and stakeholder needs to identify evidence gaps and recommend future research opportunities to IVES leadership.

Integrated Program Execution and Resource Management:Drive coordinated execution across multiple evidence workstreams, managing project plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, vendor commitments, budgets, forecasts, and resources. Proactively resolve execution challenges and escalate material scientific, strategic, or investment decisions to IVES leadership.

Functional Representation and Capability Building:Represent IVES in designated cross-functional workstreams and governance forums, contribute to the development of scalable evidence-generation methods, operating standards, and infrastructure, and support mentoring and team development as the function expands.

Qualifications

  • Advanced degree (PhD, PharmD, MD, MPH, MS or equivalent) in health economics, outcomes research, epidemiology, public health, health services research, pharmacy, medicine, or a related scientific discipline.
  • Approximately 8+ years of relevant experience in biopharmaceutical evidence generation and/or healthcare/life-sciences consulting, with demonstrated progression in scientific and program leadership.
  • Demonstrated experience independently leading complex, multidisciplinary evidence programs or consulting engagements from problem definition and research strategy through execution, interpretation, scientific dissemination, and stakeholder application.
  • Demonstrated scientific and methodological depth in at least two core value and evidence-generation disciplines, with strong multidisciplinary breadth across several of the following: health economic modeling, comparative effectiveness and indirect treatment comparisons, systematic literature reviews/evidence synthesis, real-world evidence (RWE)/observational research, healthcare resource utilization, burden-of-illness research, patient-centered clinical outcomes assessment (PRO/COA), payer evidence, and/or health technology assessment (HTA). Ability to critically evaluate, integrate, and independently lead research programs spanning multiple evidence domains.
  • Ability to critically evaluate comparative clinical evidence, comparator selection, endpoint definitions, heterogeneity, study design, statistical methods, model assumptions, data sources, bias/confounding, uncertainty, and interpretation without needing to personally perform every analysis.
  • Demonstrated ability to connect technical evidence to stakeholder and business questions and to translate complex analyses into clear implications and recommendations.
  • Demonstrated success leading cross-functional work with partners such as Clinical Development, Medical Affairs, Biostatistics, Market Access, Commercial, or equivalent client stakeholders.
  • Experience leading external research organizations, technical vendors, data partners, multidisciplinary consulting teams, and/or scientific collaborators.
  • Track record of scientific dissemination through peer-reviewed manuscripts, congress presentations, reimbursement/HTA evidence, or other scientific communications.
  • Ability to lead multiple concurrent programs with a high degree of independence in a fast-paced, resource-efficient biotechnology or consulting environment.

Work Authorization for US Applicants:Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

Please note that CG Oncology does not accept unsolicited information and/or resumes from search firms or agencies for our job postings. Any resumes or client information submitted to our careers page or any employee of CG Oncology by any search firm or agency without an applicable contract in place will become the property of CG Oncology and no fee(s) will be paid.

Total Rewards

CG Oncology offers very competitive and comprehensive Total Rewards, helping to support and reward our global team of high-performing employees focused on developing bladder-saving therapeutics for patients afflicted with bladder cancer.

HIGHLY COMPETITIVE SALARIES

ANNUAL PERFORMANCE/MERIT REVIEWS

ANNUAL PERFORMANCE BONUSES

EQUITYSPECIAL RECOGNITION

Well-Being Benefits

In addition to our Total Rewards, CG Oncology offers a variety of Well-Being Benefits to meet the majority of the needs of our unique and growing workforce. These benefits are designed to support our team to achieve a healthy balance between work and their personal lives to remain refreshed, engaged, and creating an environment where each person can find a deeper meaning and purpose in their work.

Well-Being Benefits eligibility begins the 1st of the month after hire. While a majority of these benefits are for our US-based workforce, we continue to assess comparable levels of benefits for our international team members that are aligned with country-specific regulations and their national programs offered.

REST AND RECHARGE BENEFITS - Unlimited Flexible Time Off

HOLIDAYS - In 2026 we will observe 14 holidays

ADDITIONAL EXCLUSIVE BENEFITS - Voluntary Legal, Pet, Plus More

All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. Help shape how people discover, understand and connect with careers at Advocate Health.


Advocate Health hires across an extraordinary range of professions, specialties, locations and communities. That creates an equally important marketing challenge: how do we make the right opportunity meaningful to the right person?


As a Senior Specialist, Talent Marketing, your work will directly shape how candidates experience our employer brand, from the advertisement that first catches their attention to the content that keeps them engaged and ultimately helps them imagine a career here.


This is a role for a strong writer and creative marketer who knows how to turn an employment opportunity into a compelling story, adapt that story for different audiences and use performance insights to continuously make the work better.


What you'll do


  • Create recruitment marketing that connects. Develop compelling, candidate-focused content for a wide variety of audiences, professions and markets. You'll create messaging that brings career opportunities to life through CRM talent community and lead-nurture campaigns, paid media, digital and print collateral, flyers, booklets and other recruitment marketing materials.
  • Transform job postings into job advertisements. Help lead an organization-wide evolution of our job content, moving beyond traditional job descriptions to create engaging, candidate-friendly advertisements that clearly communicate the opportunity, experience and reasons to consider a career with Advocate Health.
  • Strengthen our presence where candidates are searching. Manage and optimize employer profiles for Advocate Health and our care delivery brands, helping ensure candidates encounter an accurate, engaging and consistent representation of our employer brand throughout their job search.
  • Turn strategy into practical recruitment marketing. Serve as a trusted partner to Talent Acquisition teammates, helping identify the right audiences, messaging, channels and tactics to support hiring needs. You'll help make recruitment marketing easier to understand, access and activate across a large, complex organization.
  • Use performance insights to make the work better. Audit and evaluate performance across recruitment marketing channels and translate data into actionable recommendations.
  • Keep us looking ahead. Monitor recruitment marketing trends, competitive activity, emerging channels and candidate behavior. Bring forward ideas that help Advocate Health continue to evolve how we attract and engage talent.

What you'll bring


You are equal parts writer, marketer, collaborator and problem-solver.


You can take a complicated opportunity or hiring need and find the message that will make it meaningful to the audience. You understand that marketing to a nurse in Charlotte may require a very different approach than engaging a physician in Milwaukee or experienced leader in Chicago, and you're energized by figuring out what will resonate with each.


You are comfortable moving between creative work and performance data. You care about the words, the audience and the candidate experience, but you also want to know whether the work is actually producing results.


And because great employer branding rarely happens in isolation, you know how to collaborate. You can listen to what recruiters and stakeholders need, bring a marketing perspective to the conversation and turn that partnership into thoughtful, effective work.


We’re looking for someone who brings experience with:


  • Recruitment marketing, employer branding, content marketing or a related marketing discipline
  • Copywriting and translating complex information into concise, engaging candidate-facing content
  • Audience segmentation, persona-based messaging and lifecycle or nurture marketing
  • CRM and email marketing campaigns
  • Paid digital media and campaign development
  • Employer profiles and job advertising platforms such as Indeed and ZipRecruiter
  • Developing digital and print marketing collateral
  • Reviewing channel and campaign performance and turning insights into recommendations
  • Partnering effectively with recruiters, HR, marketing, communications, creative teams or other stakeholders
  • Managing multiple projects and audiences while maintaining a consistent brand

Minimum job requirements:


  • Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Communications or related field
  • Requires 5 years of experience in marketing, branding, advertising or other communications function, with strong background in copywriting.
  • Certification / License: None required

Physical requirements and working conditions


  • This position requires travel, therefore, will be exposed to weather and road conditions.
  • Operates all equipment necessary to perform the job.
  • Exposed to a normal office environment.

Our Commitment to You:

Advocate Health offers a comprehensive suite of Total Rewards: benefits and well-being programs, competitive compensation, generous retirement offerings, programs that invest in your career development and so much more – so you can live fully at and away from work, including:

Compensation

  • Base compensation listed within the listed pay range based on factors such as qualifications, skills, relevant experience, and/or training

  • Premium pay such as shift, on call, and more based on a teammate's job

  • Incentive pay for select positions

  • Opportunity for annual increases based on performance

Benefits and more

  • Paid Time Off programs

  • Health and welfare benefits such as medical, dental, vision, life, and Short- and Long-Term Disability

  • Flexible Spending Accounts for eligible health care and dependent care expenses

  • Family benefits such as adoption assistance and paid parental leave

  • Defined contribution retirement plans with employer match and other financial wellness programs

  • Educational Assistance Program

Note: Eligibility for programs listed above may depend on your FTE or status (e.g., full-time, part-time, per diem, temporary, etc.); please ask a Recruiter for more information during an interview.

About Advocate Health

Advocate Health is the third-largest nonprofit, integrated health system in the United States, created from the combination of Advocate Aurora Health and Atrium Health. Providing care under the names Advocate Health Care in Illinois; Atrium Health in the Carolinas, Georgia and Alabama; and Aurora Health Care in Wisconsin, Advocate Health is a national leader in clinical innovation, health outcomes, consumer experience and value-based care. Headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, Advocate Health services nearly 6 million patients and is engaged in hundreds of clinical trials and research studies, with Wake Forest University School of Medicine serving as the academic core of the enterprise. It is nationally recognized for its expertise in cardiology, neurosciences, oncology, pediatrics and rehabilitation, as well as organ transplants, burn treatments and specialized musculoskeletal programs. Advocate Health employs 155,000 teammates across 69 hospitals and over 1,000 care locations, and offers one of the nation’s largest graduate medical education programs with over 2,000 residents and fellows across more than 200 programs. Committed to providing equitable care for all, Advocate Health provides more than $6 billion in annual community benefits.

jobs.excerpt: As a Senior SCADA Electrical Engineer on our Industrial Commercial Energy team, you’ll lead the detailed SCADA and communications design for utility substation projects through each submittal phase.
jobs.description:
As a Senior SCADA Electrical Engineer on our Industrial Commercial Energy team, you’ll lead the detailed SCADA and communications design for utility substation projects through each submittal phase. You’ll define and manage station-side interfaces, coordinate in-station fiber and telecommunications design, and resolve complex connections among SCADA, Protection and Control, and communications systems. From anywhere in the continental United States, you’ll guide multidisciplinary teams, mentor developing professionals, and help deliver reliable power infrastructure while sharing in the firm you help build.

About Wade Trim

    Wade Trim has been developing solutions to complex engineering and planning challenges for a century to deliver water and sewer services to residents and businesses, keep traffic flowing smoothly and safely, treat wastewater and stormwater to protect our waterways, distribute reliable power to customers, and provide community spaces to enjoy.

    We’re 100% employee-owned, so our 850+ employee-owners share in the firm’s success and help set its direction. Our teams are organized by practice, so you’ll collaborate with experts and leaders across offices and markets. We also invest in new ideas through our Office of Applied Technology and Innovation Hub.

What You’ll Do

  • Serve as technical lead for SCADA and communications detailed design, developing and reviewing RTU/SCADA point lists, interface documentation, POI telemetry requirements, IED and relay interfaces, and communications and logic diagrams

  • Design and coordinate teleprotection channels, in-station telecommunications equipment and terminations, and station-side fiber, Ethernet, and serial communications interfaces

  • Resolve P&C, SCADA, and communications interfaces with the P&C lead and direct designers and AutoCAD Electrical resources preparing related drawings

  • Provide technical review and QC of SCADA, communications, and related P&C deliverables through each submittal phase, resolve client comments, and maintain SCADA, RTU, and HMI standards, templates, and typical designs

  • Support procurement, construction, submittal reviews, RFIs, field inspections, testing, startup, factory acceptance testing, and commissioning

  • Prepare cost estimates, proposals, and presentations; assist project managers; mentor junior engineers and technicians; maintain excellent client relations; and maintain a safe working environment

What You’ll Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering

  • 7+ years of utility substation SCADA, automation, or communications design experience

  • Experience with distribution- and transmission-voltage substations and switchyards

  • Demonstrated experience with RTU/SCADA point development, POI telemetry, IED or relay interfaces, communications and logic diagrams, and teleprotection channels

  • Experience with in-station telecommunications equipment, terminations, and station-side fiber, Ethernet, and serial communications interfaces

  • Experience directing detailed SCADA development and resolving P&C, SCADA, and communications interfaces through phased project submittals

  • Strong coordination skills with multidisciplinary teams, contractors, and utility stakeholders, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical users

  • Willingness to travel up to 10%

Nice to Have

  • Professional Engineering license; candidates progressing toward licensure may be considered

  • Working knowledge of DNP3

  • Working knowledge of IEC 61850

  • Working knowledge of IEEE C37.94

  • Knowledge of applicable IEEE, NEC, and NESC standards

  • Experience with Microsoft Office and Bluebeam Revu PDF Editor

  • Experience with Bentley ProjectWise or SharePoint

  • Experience with RTU or automation configuration tools

Work Arrangement

    This is a full-time remote opportunity for candidates located in the Eastern or Central time zones within the continental United States. A hybrid work arrangement is preferred for candidates who live within reasonable driving distance of a Wade Trim office.

What We Offer

    As an employee-owner, you’ll share in the firm’s success through profit sharing, an employee stock purchase plan, and a 401(k) with a company match. You’ll have every opportunity to grow through mentoring, the Wade Trim Leadership Academy, and tuition reimbursement.

    And because life outside of work matters, we offer paid parental leave, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, and a stewardship day, along with medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance and an employee assistance program.

jobs.title: Manager, Client Experience - Health & Wellness
jobs.excerpt: A LITTLE BIT ABOUT Boldr • Boldr is the first global B-Corp dedicated to delivering world-class Client experiences while creating access to dignified, meaningful work in communities around the world.
jobs.description:
A LITTLE BIT ABOUT Boldr

  • Boldr is the first global B-Corp dedicated to delivering world-class Client experiences while creating access to dignified, meaningful work in communities around the world.
  • We are a global team, united by our desire to connect diverse people with common values for boldr impact.

LET’S START WITH OUR VALUES

  • Excellent. Being excellent at what we do sets us apart. It happens when we care about our work and how it lands, set clear standards, and hold each other accountable. We don't stop at meeting the standard; we keep raising the bar.
  • Authentic. Real connection happens when we show up as our best, truest selves, help others do the same, and stand by each other through the harder times.
  • Curious. Curiosity keeps us innovative. Better understanding comes from asking helpful questions, seeking to understand before we act, and building on each other's thinking.
  • Dynamic. Growth is central to our purpose, and it only happens in dynamic environments where we stay flexible, adaptable and open.
  • Empathetic. Great partnerships happen when we take the time to understand the people we work with, our teams, our clients and our communities, for better outcomes for each.

WHAT IS YOUR ROLE

We’re looking for a Client Experience Manager with a career built in healthcare, health-tech or wellness to lead delivery for Boldr’s Health & Wellness clients. Our clients span preventive and functional health, digital health, diagnostics and lab testing, practitioner platforms and wellness brands. Their customers are patients and members, not just shoppers, so privacy, clinical sensitivity and getting it right first time matter on every contact.

You will own delivery for a portfolio of Health & Wellness accounts and lead the Team Captains who run them. You will act as a business owner, accountable for SLA performance, quality and compliance, and you will be the operations voice in the room with client leaders, including founders, medical directors and clinical operations teams.

You will help foster a healthy working environment for our team members, represent Boldr to our clients, and act as our internal client across departments. You will need to be laser-focused on operational performance and comfortable leading global teams day to day.

You will be responsible for client communication, performance reporting, training and escalation management, including clinical and privacy escalations. Having an eye for detail will be important, as you will keep our client success tools and procedures accurate and up to date.

WHY DO WE WANT YOU

Health & Wellness is one of Boldr’s core verticals, and our clients trust us with their patients’ and members’ experience. We need someone who already speaks their language: someone who understands care journeys, health data privacy and clinical escalation, and who can turn that knowledge into tight, measurable operations. If you are impact-driven, bring your best to everything you do and champion our values, we would love to hear from you.

WHAT WILL YOU DO

Processes

  • Develop and maintain an authentic relationship with all the Client and internal stakeholders.
  • Build a deep understanding of each health and wellness client’s business model (e.g., preventive and functional health, digital health, practitioner platforms, wellness products), their regulatory context, and the outcomes that matter most to them (e.g., member retention, care journey completion, appointment and test adherence).
  • Work confidently with clinical and medical stakeholders (e.g., medical directors, clinical operations teams) and ensure care-related issues follow clear escalation paths.
  • Own the clinical and safety escalation path for your accounts: make sure agents know what they can and cannot answer, and that urgent or care-related issues reach the right clinical team fast.
  • Run daily and weekly performance reviews with client stakeholders and Boldr leadership, tracking health-specific measures alongside SLAs (e.g., care journey completion, appointment and test adherence, member retention, escalation turnaround).
  • Ability to work seamlessly with different departments namely: Implementation, Client Solutions, Finance, IT, People Experience and Office Operations.
  • Communicating and resolving basic to complex inquiries and concerns in an accurate, valid, complete, and timely manner.
  • Create and manage Client contracts such as MSAs and SLAs.
  • Manage a team of Team Captains and monitor compliance against SLAs and achievement of Client KPIs.
  • Root cause analysis, planning and execution to ensure KPIs are met
  • Ensure your teams meet health data privacy and security requirements (e.g., HIPAA, GDPR), including access controls, handling of protected health information (PHI), audit readiness and privacy incident response.
  • Partner with Team Captains to ensure documentation is constantly updated and identification of process improvements are sourced with the TC and their team.
  • Lead the operations story in Client Business Reviews (MBRs and QBRs) in partnership with your SBU Head: what the numbers mean for the client’s patients or members, and what we will do next.
  • Develop relationships within each Health & Wellness client to spot growth opportunities, such as new lines of business, sister brands or additional services, and bring them to the commercial team.
  • Use AI and automation in your own work and your teams’ workflows (e.g., reporting, QA, knowledge management, planning) in ways that keep protected health information safe.
  • Update Hubspot deal cards and ensure all necessary items are appropriately invoiced.
  • Follow up with clients on invoicing, pricing discrepancies, and other billing-related issues.

People Management

  • Supervise and develop Team Captains through guidance, observation, and performance management activities.
  • Coach Team Captains and their teams to handle sensitive patient and member conversations with empathy, accuracy and the right escalation.
  • As needed, joins the Team Captain on calls with the Client, team huddles or coaching sessions to stay up to date with all Client and team developments.
    • This also provides an opportunity to observe the Team Captain’s presentation, Client communication and coaching skills.
  • Taking steps to ensure learning and growth through development plans and, when necessary, progressive counseling.
  • Promote and foster a culture of continuous improvement by providing positive and constructive feedback to team members.
  • Establish, promote, and maintain the Boldr culture within the organization.
  • Understand employee career growth aspirations to enable matching Boldr’s needs with employee abilities.
  • Act as the escalation point for the Team Captains and Senior Team Captains.
  • Responsible for upholding our organization’s values throughout the workplace
  • Monitor achievement of internal and external KPI’s and ensure Operational Excellence
  • Identify performance issues, conduct root cause analysis, and work with operations to improve performance on KPIs through motivating, guiding, and holding local operations managers accountable for following SLA.

Tools, Administration, and Reporting

  • Familiarity with Google Suite of Services is a must for this role
    • Gmail, Drive, Sheets, Slides, and Docs are used heavily in Boldr
  • Experience with Hubspot is a plus.
  • Experience with health and wellness CX and care tools such as Zendesk, Intercom, Salesforce Health Cloud, EHR/EMR or practice-management platforms, telehealth or lab-ordering systems is a plus.
  • Confident using AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to work faster and smarter.
  • Maintain Client schedule (Weekly Updates, MBRs, QBRs, Implementations) and collect feedback and drive necessary actions to completion

Training

  • Coordinate necessary training and best practices related to Tools and Processes
  • Onboard new hires so they are ready to succeed, including privacy and PHI training before they handle client data.
  • Build health and wellness knowledge (e.g., care journeys, privacy requirements, clinical escalation protocols) into team training and QA.
  • Lean six sigma knowledge and/or certification is a plus

Ongoing support and knowledge sharing

  • Obtain feedback from Clients and team members on processes and tools to ensure continuous improvement
  • Provides input and communication to drive Client Success improvement, for all Clients, enterprise-wide.

Requirements

WHAT WE’LL LIKE ABOUT YOU

YOU ARE…

  • Rooted in health and wellness: you understand how patients and members experience care, and you care about getting it right for them
  • Curious and authentic, just like us! #beboldr
  • An analytical and critical thinker, with an eye for even the most minute of details
  • Proactive and passionate about the client, patient and member experience
  • Strongly interested in learning new ideas, processes, and unique requirements. On top of that, you’re willing to share your skills and talents with the team.
  • Calm and credible with senior client leaders and clinical stakeholders, with the executive presence to hold the room

YOU HAVE…

  • 3+ years in a client-facing operations management role
  • 5+ years of customer experience or operations experience in healthcare, health-tech or wellness (e.g., digital health, telehealth, diagnostics or lab testing, preventive or functional health, health insurance, wellness or supplement brands), with clear career progression within the sector. BPO, staffing or other business services experience is a plus.
  • 3+ years of people management experience, ideally including team leads or supervisors across locations
  • Hands-on experience with health and wellness support workflows: patient or member onboarding, scheduling, lab and test journeys, billing and insurance queries, and clinical escalation.
  • Experience working directly with clinical or medical stakeholders, such as medical directors, nurses or clinical operations teams.
  • Working knowledge of health data privacy and compliance (e.g., HIPAA, GDPR) and how it shapes support workflows, QA and escalation.
  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills for the reporting you will own
  • A track record of presenting performance and insight to senior client leaders and turning data into clear recommendations.
  • Create dashboards and provide visibility to stakeholders

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

As a Senior Sales Engineer at Samsara, you’d be part of a diverse group of both technically and business minded folks working together to bring our unique connected operations technology to customers. Our daily customer engagements include conversations around logistics/supply chain management, fleet management and maintenance strategies, global asset management, system integrations, and regulatory compliance. This means a successful Sales Engineer at Samsara will develop a thorough understanding of IoT hardware and sensors, hands-on installation/deployment scenarios, carrier networks, cloud infrastructure, and third-party system integrations (via our open API) to ensure the proper technical solution is presented to our customers.

This is a unique opportunity to support and grow a key market for Samsara in close collaboration with other areas of the business: Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Technical Support, and Customer Success.

This role can be office-based (London) or fully remote in the UK. This role requires travel up to 50% of the time.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

In this role, you will:

  • Become an expert on Samsara products: where the rubber of cutting-edge tech (IoT, AI, computer vision) meets the road of driving digital transformation for physical operations.
  • Articulate to prospects how businesses like theirs use Samsara today to solve problems common to their industry.

  • Act as a liaison between Samsara’s product and sales teams, translating technical feedback and enrolling the right customers in our beta programs.
  • Partner with sales executives to plan, prepare, and execute transactions in rapid sales cycles.
  • Work in multiple levels of the technology stack.
  • Support sales executives ad-hoc queries and emails.
  • Build relationships with third-party partners, such as software providers, systems integrators, and installation partners.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.
  • 4+ years experience working with customers in a pre-sales, customer success, or customer/product support capacity.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders based on your technical sales acumen and a solid understanding of business processes and change management.
  • Knowledge of MEDDIC/BANT/CoM and/or Value Selling sales concepts.
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Previous experience managing hardware and/or software product evaluations.
  • Basic understanding of electronics and electrical systems.
  • Experience with the following concepts: technical consulting, cloud software, cloud-connected hardware, computer networking, business systems integration, automation, and control systems.
  • Great time management and organizational skills to work on multiple accounts and projects at different stages.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.
  • Work experience in task automation scripting and transferring data between systems using Bash, Python, JavaScript, or equivalent language.
  • Work experience building solutions leveraging open APIs.

  • Hobbyist interest in working with things driven by electronic systems (car audio installation/classic car restoration, home automation, building things with Raspberry Pi, Arduino, etc.).

  • Experience working with product teams internally and feature request processes.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Building Rapport - The assistant must be approachable, reliable, and supportive, creating a safe environment where veterans feel valued and understood.

Conducting Coaching Sessions for C&P Exams - The assistant will help veterans to understand the exam process and prepare them for questions they might face.

Other Menial Office Tasks - Keeping accurate records of all communications and documents, ensuring that your Swingline stapler is maintained, and all equipment is ready to assist with helping Veterans.

Requirements

What we offer you

  • A clear path to grow; we promote from within and invest in the people who invest in the mission.

Our Core Values
Our values are the heart of this company. The right person for any role here recognizes themselves in each of them.
Empathy, Without Exception. Every veteran is a person who served, not a case number. We lead with understanding and we hold that standard on the hardest days, in the longest calls, with the most frustrated client. Empathy is the one thing we will never trade away.
Remarkable Character. We do right by veterans when no one is watching. We tell each other hard truths with care, accept them with humility, and keep our words and our actions pointed at the same goal.
Relentless Advocacy. We fight for every benefit a veteran earned, and we do not quit when the system pushes back. It is us against the issue, never us against the veteran, and never each other.
Competitive Greatness. We hold ourselves to an elite standard because the people who served deserve elite representation. We compound small improvements into outsized results, and we build each other into leaders along the way.
How to apply
If this is the mission you've been looking for, apply now. Tell us why this work matters to you, we read every one.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Credit
jobs.excerpt: Jeeves is the stablecoin-native banking platform for global enterprises.
jobs.description:
Jeeves is the stablecoin-native banking platform for global enterprises. Thousands of companies across 35 countries run their corporate cards, payments, treasury and spend on one platform, with more than $5B in annualized volume, payouts to 190 countries, and one of the fastest-growing stablecoin payment networks in the world. BMW, H&M, Lululemon, Burger King, Kavak and XP are among them, and more than 80% of customers use multiple Jeeves products.

We chose hard problems on purpose.

We hire for one thing: relentlessness. A strong motor that keeps going when the problem has no playbook. You'll know in your first week if Jeeves is right for you. For the right people, it's the steepest learning curve of your career.

Jeeves has raised more than $400 million in equity funding from Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, CRV, Coinbase Ventures, GIC, AllianceBernstein, CoinFund and others.

If you want to rebuild how money moves across borders, come build it with us.

We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to be the single owner of our credit business: its growth, its economics, and how it runs day to day. You'll set the metrics that matter, design the product from application through collections, and work with compliance, treasury, and capital markets so the business can scale. Why this role now: we are growing credit usage in the markets where we already operate, and we are launching credit in the US and Spain. You will own those launches and make sure they are compliant from day one.
Location: This role is remote based out of the United States.

What you'll own — Economics and growth

  • Credit economics: pricing, fees, rewards cost, utilization, losses, and portfolio profitability.
  • Growth: credit adoption, activation, and usage, and how credit drives use of the rest of Jeeves.

What you'll own — The credit lifecycle, from application to collections

  • Application and lines: the application and approval experience, line assignment, limit increases and decreases, sub-limits, and multiple lines per company.
  • Draw controls: when customers can use their line, when we stop them, and how we tell them why.
  • Statements and billing: cycles, interest, fees, rewards, disclosures, and country-specific tax and invoicing.
  • Repayment: collection across local rails and auto-debit, and applying each payment correctly across statements and lines.
  • Collections and recovery: delinquency states, freezes, retries, digital collection, recovery, and charge-off.

What you'll own — Compliance, capital, and risk data

  • Compliance and capital: turning regulatory, legal, and lender requirements into product, working with compliance, treasury, and capital markets.
  • Risk data: the data and pipelines our credit team uses to approve and monitor customers.

In your first year

  • Set credit metrics and targets, and report on them to leadership.
  • Grow credit usage across existing markets.
  • Fully automate payment application, including for customers with multiple lines.
  • Launch auto-debit repayment, with clear rules for failed debits.
  • Consolidate draw controls into one decision point with clear reasons.
  • Launch credit products in the US and Spain, compliant from day one.

What we're looking for — Must-haves

  • 5+ years in product management, including 2+ years owning a lending or card-credit product.
  • Fluency in credit metrics: approval rates, line assignment, utilization, vintage curves, delinquency, charge-offs, interchange, and rewards cost.
  • A track record of growing a credit product, with results you can measure.
  • Experience designing payment application or reconciliation logic, including edge cases.
  • Sound judgment in regulated products, and the ability to turn legal and lender requirements into clear specs.
  • A habit of experimenting and deciding with data. Strong SQL.
  • You use AI tools in your day-to-day work (research, writing specs, analysis) and can identify where AI belongs in the credit product itself.
  • Clear communication of tradeoffs to executives and partners.
  • Professional fluency in written and spoken English. You'll work daily with teams and partners across the US, Europe, and Latin America.

What we're looking for — Nice to have

  • Experience building or owning credit products in Latin America, the US, or Spain.
  • Working proficiency in Spanish and/or Portuguese.

jobs.title: Java Integration Engineer (APIs & Fintech) - Mexico Only (2 pm a 11 pm GMT)
jobs.excerpt: Descripción ¡Trabaja en DaCodes!  Somos una firma de expertos en software y transformación digital de alto impacto.
jobs.description:
Descripción

¡Trabaja en DaCodes!

Somos una firma de expertos en software y transformación digital de alto impacto.
Durante 10 años hemos creado soluciones enfocadas en la tecnología e innovación gracias a nuestro equipo de casi 300 talentosos #DaCoders, incluyendo desarrolladores, arquitectos, diseñadores UX/UI, PMs, QA testers y más. Nuestro equipo colabora en proyectos con clientes en LATAM y Estados Unidos, logrando resultados sobresalientes.
En DaCodes, tendrás la oportunidad de impulsar tu desarrollo profesional, trabajar en diversos proyectos dentro de distintas industrias, y contribuir al diseño, implementación y optimización de infraestructuras en la nube.
Nuestros DaCoders tienen un gran impacto en el éxito de nuestro negocio y el de nuestros clientes. Serás el experto que participará en nuestros proyectos y tendrás acceso a startups disruptivas y marcas globales.
¿Te interesa?

Estamos buscando un Especialista de Integración Tecnológica con experiencia profesional en programación Java, sólidos fundamentos técnicos y capacidad para investigar, diagnosticar y resolver problemas relacionados con la comunicación e integración entre sistemas.

Formarás parte de un proyecto de modernización tecnológica dentro del sector financiero, participando en la evolución de servicios web existentes hacia APIs y nuevos mecanismos de integración para plataformas de pagos electrónicos.

Tendrás contacto directo con equipos de ingeniería de empresas nacionales e internacionales, desde grandes organizaciones con infraestructuras tecnológicas complejas hasta empresas con equipos técnicos más pequeños que requieren mayor acompañamiento durante sus procesos de integración.

Tu responsabilidad será comprender las necesidades técnicas de estos clientes, asesorarlos en la configuración y consumo de servicios, identificar el origen de incidentes y facilitar su resolución en colaboración con equipos especializados.

Esta posición no está enfocada en el desarrollo de software full-time ni requiere un nivel Senior de programación Java. Sin embargo, es indispensable contar con experiencia laboral real programando, así como con la madurez profesional, iniciativa y criterio técnico necesarios para investigar problemas, formular hipótesis, proponer soluciones y dar seguimiento a los incidentes.

Buscamos a una persona que vaya más allá de ejecutar instrucciones o escalar tickets, que disfrute entender cómo funcionan los sistemas y tenga interés en ampliar sus conocimientos en integraciones empresariales, seguridad, infraestructura y tecnología financiera.

Ubicación: México.

Modalidad: 100% remota.

Seniority: Intermedio, con experiencia profesional en Java.

Idioma: Inglés intermedio conversacional requerido para comunicación y soporte a clientes.

Requerimientos
Principales responsabilidades

  • Brindar soporte y asesoría técnica a equipos de ingeniería de clientes nacionales e internacionales durante la configuración, implementación y operación de integraciones tecnológicas.
  • Participar en la modernización de servicios web hacia APIs, acompañando a los clientes durante la transición y adopción de los nuevos mecanismos de integración.
  • Investigar incidentes técnicos mediante el análisis de logs, trazas, código Java, peticiones y mensajes de error.
  • Identificar si el origen de una falla corresponde a la aplicación, configuración del cliente, conectividad, cifrado o infraestructura.
  • Orientar a los equipos técnicos de los clientes en el consumo de servicios, configuración de conexiones y resolución de problemas de integración.
  • Aplicar conocimientos de programación Java para comprender el comportamiento de los servicios, identificar defectos y facilitar su resolución.
  • Realizar pruebas técnicas que permitan validar hipótesis, reproducir errores y comprobar el funcionamiento de las integraciones.
  • Coordinar la atención de problemas con equipos internos de desarrollo, arquitectura, infraestructura, seguridad y cumplimiento regulatorio.
  • Organizar sesiones técnicas con las áreas involucradas cuando la resolución de un incidente requiera conocimientos especializados.
  • Dar seguimiento a los problemas asignados hasta su resolución, manteniendo una comunicación clara y oportuna con los clientes.
  • Documentar hallazgos, causas de incidentes, soluciones y procedimientos técnicos.
  • Identificar oportunidades de mejora y automatización de procesos.


¿Qué tipo de retos técnicos encontrarás?
Durante tu participación en el proyecto, podrás enfrentarte a situaciones como:

  • Problemas de comunicación entre aplicaciones: investigar por qué un cliente no logra establecer comunicación con un servicio, diferenciando problemas de conectividad, configuración y errores de aplicación.
  • Errores en peticiones HTTP/HTTPS: identificar las diferencias entre un timeout, un error 404 u otros códigos de respuesta, determinando las posibles causas y acciones necesarias.
  • Problemas de cifrado y descifrado: analizar situaciones en las que los sistemas no logran procesar correctamente información cifrada, aplicando fundamentos de criptografía simétrica y asimétrica.
  • Análisis de logs y código Java: investigar el comportamiento de los servicios para determinar dónde se origina una falla y orientar su resolución.
  • Configuraciones de integración: asesorar a clientes cuyos equipos técnicos presentan dificultades para consumir APIs, configurar servicios web o establecer conexiones.
  • Incidentes de infraestructura y conectividad: identificar cuándo un problema está relacionado con VPN, redes, arquitectura o servicios en la nube y coordinar su atención con las áreas correspondientes.
  • Integraciones financieras: acompañar a clientes que requieren orientación técnica relacionada con sistemas de pagos y canalizar consultas regulatorias hacia los equipos especializados.


No tendrás que resolver todos los problemas por tu cuenta, pero sí deberás contar con el criterio técnico necesario para investigarlos, identificar su posible origen y movilizar a las áreas correspondientes hasta encontrar una solución.

Requirements

Experiencia y conocimientos indispensables

  • Experiencia laboral real en programación Java, preferentemente de 2 a 3 años o experiencia equivalente que demuestre los conocimientos requeridos.
  • Haber participado directamente en el desarrollo, mantenimiento o corrección de componentes de software utilizando Java.
  • Capacidad para leer, interpretar y analizar código Java.
  • Experiencia investigando errores, resolviendo defectos de software o diagnosticando problemas técnicos.
  • Fundamentos del funcionamiento y consumo de APIs y WebServices.
  • Comprensión del funcionamiento de peticiones HTTP y HTTPS.
  • Conocimiento de códigos de respuesta HTTP y capacidad para diferenciar errores de aplicación, problemas de conexión y timeouts.
  • Fundamentos de cifrado simétrico y asimétrico, incluyendo la comprensión de los procesos de cifrado y descifrado.
  • Capacidad para interpretar logs, trazas y mensajes de error.
  • Habilidad para realizar troubleshooting de manera estructurada, formular hipótesis y validar posibles causas de un problema.
  • Inglés intermedio conversacional, con capacidad para participar en llamadas y comunicarse con equipos técnicos de clientes internacionales.


Conocimientos y experiencia deseables

  • Experiencia en soporte de aplicaciones, soporte técnico especializado o soporte de segundo nivel (L2).
  • Experiencia en integraciones Host-to-Host (H2H).
  • Conocimientos de APIs REST y WebServices SOAP.
  • Manejo de herramientas para pruebas y diagnóstico de APIs, como Postman o similares.
  • Conocimientos de SFTP y mecanismos de intercambio de información entre sistemas.
  • Fundamentos de bases de datos y SQL.
  • Conocimientos básicos de redes, VPN y conectividad.
  • Nociones de arquitectura de software e infraestructura en la nube.
  • Experiencia con herramientas de gestión de tickets e incidentes.
  • Experiencia brindando asesoría técnica a clientes empresariales.
  • Conocimiento del sector financiero, plataformas de pagos electrónicos o SPEI.
  • Conocimientos de automatización de procesos.
  • Interés o experiencia en desarrollo de agentes de inteligencia artificial.


No es indispensable contar con experiencia previa en integraciones H2H, sistemas de pagos o desarrollo de agentes de IA. Valoramos especialmente tu experiencia práctica en Java, tus fundamentos técnicos y tu capacidad para aprender y resolver problemas.

Habilidades y competencias

  • Pensamiento analítico y razonamiento técnico.
  • Autonomía para investigar problemas sin depender exclusivamente de procedimientos preestablecidos.
  • Capacidad para formular hipótesis, realizar pruebas e interpretar resultados.
  • Proactividad e iniciativa para buscar soluciones.
  • Madurez profesional y sentido de responsabilidad sobre los incidentes asignados.
  • Comunicación efectiva con clientes y equipos de ingeniería.
  • Capacidad para explicar conceptos técnicos de manera clara y estructurada.
  • Liderazgo transversal y capacidad para coordinar actividades con diferentes áreas, sin necesidad de tener personal a cargo.
  • Criterio para reconocer cuándo un problema requiere la intervención de un especialista.
  • Orientación al servicio y empatía con el cliente.
  • Curiosidad tecnológica y disposición para adquirir nuevos conocimientos.


¿Qué podrás aprender y desarrollar en esta posición?

  • Integraciones tecnológicas empresariales y mecanismos de comunicación Host-to-Host (H2H).
  • Modernización de servicios web hacia arquitecturas de integración basadas en APIs.
  • Diagnóstico de incidentes en plataformas financieras y sistemas de pagos electrónicos.
  • Aplicación de mecanismos de cifrado y seguridad en integraciones empresariales.
  • Funcionamiento de sistemas de pagos y aspectos técnicos relacionados con SPEI.
  • Fundamentos de arquitectura, infraestructura, conectividad y servicios en la nube mediante la colaboración con equipos especializados.
  • Gestión de incidentes técnicos en entornos empresariales.
  • Asesoría técnica y comunicación con equipos de ingeniería de organizaciones nacionales e internacionales.
  • Identificación de oportunidades de automatización y posibles aplicaciones de inteligencia artificial agéntica en procesos tecnológicos.


Esta posición representa una oportunidad para profesionales con experiencia en Java que quieran ampliar su trayectoria hacia la integración de sistemas, el troubleshooting especializado, la consultoría técnica y la tecnología financiera.

Disponibilidad

Disponibilidad para trabajar en un horario establecido, de acuerdo con la posición asignada.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer - Skribble team
jobs.excerpt: We are currently looking for a Senior Product Designer with strong skills and proven experience who is ready to dive into the Skribble team, for a full-time engagement, to join our team of passionate IT professionals.
jobs.description:
We are currently looking for a Senior Product Designer with strong skills and proven experience who is ready to dive into the Skribble team, for a full-time engagement, to join our team of passionate IT professionals.

Skribble is an e-signature platform with a global reach. We’re simplifying life by making digital signatures intuitive and seamless. We help organizations trust more, waste less, and protect our planet’s resources.

In three years, Skribble evolved from a Swiss startup to a European scaleup without losing their spark. They're a motivated, fun-loving, non-commissioned team driven by energy and purpose. They're making the world better - one signature at a time.

In 2027, their Product organisation will split into two teams, Growth and Core. We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to support one of the teams. The decision about which is still outstanding. The right candidate will work with a product specialist, engineers, and AI, and will be involved in the entire solution discovery process.

Your contribution:

  • Own problems end-to-end. Take a product problem from framing through shipping and iteration, with little steering.
  • Bring a product mindset. Start from what is valuable for the user and design the whole flow from start to finish. A flow that works matters more to us than the most beautiful screen.
  • Shape the solution in Discovery. Work with AI, PM, and engineers on problem framing and the solution.
  • Explain design in the abstract. Describe flows and concepts before any screen exists, and explain your design and UX decisions, so engineers and business colleagues understand how the solution works and why.
  • Work with engineers all the way. We don’t do handoffs. You build prototypes with AI and use them to talk through design, constraints, and trade-offs with engineers from the first idea through to ship.
  • Design with AI. Use AI tools for prototyping, research synthesis, and faster iteration, and help design Skribble’s AI features. Experience with Claude is a big plus.
  • Push the craft with your fellow designer. Work with our other Senior Product Designer on new ways of designing with AI, contribute to our design system in Figma, and bring a clear eye for hierarchy and detail.
  • Design for growth or features. Depending on your team, improve onboarding, activation, conversion, and upgrade flows, or build out workflow-heavy features.
  • Stay with the product. Improve one product over years rather than jumping between fresh concepts.

Your profile:

  • Experience: Usually 5+ years as a Product Designer or UX Designer, but what you have shipped counts more than how long you have been doing it.
  • PLG SaaS: You’ve shipped a product-led growth product where users sign up, try, and buy without talking to sales. Workflow-heavy products are a plus.
  • Methodical problem solver: You’re structured and fast-paced, and you frame the problem before designing screens.
  • Technical: You’re comfortable with engineers, constraints, and trade-offs.
  • AI-native or AI-hungry: You already use AI tools in your design workflow, or you’re clearly experimenting with them.
  • Figma: You’re fluent, including components and design systems.
  • Taste: You have a strong eye for hierarchy, detail, and craft.
  • Portfolio: One case is enough if it shows the problem, your process, and the outcome, and you owned it end to end.

jobs.excerpt: GenePlanet | Delo iz Slovenije (na daljavo) | Polni delovni čas | Redna zaposlitev Govoriš tekoče italijansko, rad/-a delaš z ljudmi in te veseli prodaja?
jobs.description:
GenePlanet | Delo iz Slovenije (na daljavo) | Polni delovni čas | Redna zaposlitev

Govoriš tekoče italijansko, rad/-a delaš z ljudmi in te veseli prodaja? Potem je to služba zate. GenePlanet je slovensko biotehnološko podjetje s področja preventivnih genetskih testov, prisotno v več kot 50 državah in z ekipo 260 zaposlenih. Iščemo sodelavca/-ko, ki bo z nami razvijal/-a italijanski trg, delo pa opravljal/-a kar iz Slovenije.

Eden naših glavnih produktov je NIPT (neinvazivni prenatalni test), sodobna in varna presejalna tehnologija, ki bodočim staršem že zgodaj v nosečnosti, iz enega odvzema krvi, ponudi vpogled v zdravje nosečnosti. To pomeni, da boš večino dneva govoril/-a z nosečnicami in bodočimi mamicami, pogosto v čustvenem in pomembnem trenutku njihovega življenja. Pomemben del tega dela je, da jih znaš pospremiti s toplino in potrpežljivostjo, zato je vloga odlična za nekoga, ki uživa v delu z ljudmi in v pomoči ženskam na tej poti.

Delamo z več kot 5.000 medicinskimi centri, zdravniki in klinikami ter ljudem pomagamo prevzeti nadzor nad svojim zdravjem. Ti boš glas, ki ga italijanske stranke slišijo: spletno zanimanje spreminjaš v opravljene teste, bodoče mamice z empatijo vodiš skozi občutljivo odločitev in nam pomagaš graditi trg od temeljev.

V svojem bistvu je to prodajna vloga, a človeška in ustvarjalna. Ne boš samo prodajal/-a in nudil/-a podpore, ampak boš tesno sodeloval/-a tudi z našo marketinško ekipo pri gradnji kampanj, ki poganjajo rast italijanskega trga. Če te motivirajo cilji, ti je telefon domač, ti je mar za ljudi na drugi strani linije in rad/-a prispevaš ideje, beri naprej.

Kaj boš počel/-a

  • Pretvarjal/-a boš povpraševanja v prodajo. Klical/-a in kvalificiral/-a spletne kontakte ter jih spreminjal/-a v opravljene GenePlanet teste. To je srce te vloge.
  • Vodil/-a boš pot stranke. Organiziral/-a termine za odvzem krvi in poskrbel/-a, da je celotna izkušnja za bodoče mamice tekoča, jasna in pomirjujoča.
  • Nudil/-a boš podporo z empatijo. Odgovarjal/-a na vprašanja in reševal/-a zadeve potrpežljivo, pogosto za nosečnice, ki so v skrbeh ali neodločene.
  • Dosegal/-a in presegal/-a cilje. Skrbel/-a za svoje rezultate in jih iz meseca v mesec povečeval/-a.
  • Gradil/-a kampanje z marketingom. Z roko v roki z marketinško ekipo sooblikoval/-a in izboljševal/-a kampanje za italijanski trg. Ker si vsak dan v stiku s strankami, tvoje povratne informacije neposredno oblikujejo sporočila, ponudbe in vsebino.
  • Prinašal/-a ideje, ne le povratne informacije. Delil/-a, kaj pri strankah deluje, in pomagal/-a pri novih idejah, akcijah in vsebinah. Če imaš občutek za marketing, ga boš tukaj lahko uporabil/-a in razvijal/-a.

Koga iščemo

  • Pristen prodajni čut. Rad/-a sklepaš posle in dosegaš cilje.
  • Tekoče ali materno znanje italijanščine ter slovenščine. Angleščina je prednost za delo z ekipo.
  • Idealno 1–2+ leti izkušenj v prodaji, podpori strankam ali klicnem centru. Komercialni čut nam pomeni več kot popoln življenjepis.
  • Jasna in topla komunikacija ter sposobnost hitre vzpostavitve zaupanja po telefonu.
  • Sproščenost in skrbnost pri pogovoru z nosečnicami o občutljivi in čustveni temi.
  • Organiziranost, samostojnost in zmožnost dela na daljavo.
  • Prednost (ni pa pogoj): izkušnje z marketingom ali vsebinami, občutek za kampanje, ali poznavanje zdravstva.

Kaj nudimo

Vloga je zasnovana tako, da več kot prodaš, več zaslužiš. Tvojemu uspehu ni zgornje meje.

  • Zaposlitev pri slovenskem podjetju.
  • Konkurenčna osnovna plača, ki je vredna tvojega časa že pred kakršnimkoli bonusom.
  • Bonus za vsak prodan test. Neposredna nagrada, izplačana po rezultatih, brez zgornje meje.
  • Bonusi ob doseženih mejnikih. Bolj ko trg raste, bolj rasteš ti.
  • Resničen vpliv na trg, ki ga pomagaš graditi, in ne mesto v ogromnem klicnem centru.
  • Mednarodno, podporno okolje in priložnosti za rast, ko se italijanski trg širi.

Resni smo glede rasti italijanskega posla in želimo nekoga, ki ga želi graditi z nami in biti za to dobro plačan.

Se prepoznaš?

Prijavi se z življenjepisom in kratko predstavitvijo, zakaj te zanimata prav prodaja in ta vloga. Za pravo osebo se premaknemo hitro.

Prijave so dobrodošle v slovenščini ali italijanščini. Znanje italijanščine bomo preverili v sklopu izbirnega postopka.

💻 BI Analyst / BI Developer – Power BI, SQL & DAX (Remote, India)

Gusti Leder is a German brand for natural leather goods, with retail stores in Germany and Austria, an online shop, and teams across Europe and India. We want every team—from the CEO to store managers—to make decisions from fast, clear, and trustworthy dashboards.

We are looking for our first dedicated BI specialist: someone who understands what colleagues really need from their data, helps us choose the right BI platform, builds a solid data model, and delivers dashboards people actually use.

🚀 What Matters Most to Us

  • Numbers You Can Trust: Totals that reconcile with our source systems, clear KPI definitions, and checks that catch problems before management does.

  • Understanding the Goal Behind a Request: You look beyond the written requirement, understand how colleagues want to work with the data, and suggest better ways to answer their question.

  • Business Sense: You think about cost, speed, and how a dashboard looks to a busy CEO—not only about the technology.

  • Ownership: You take a report from requirement to rollout and keep it running.

🌟 Why Join Us?

  • Direct Strategic Impact: Become our first dedicated BI specialist, helping select our BI platform and building the reporting foundation for retail stores in Germany and Austria, our online shop, and leadership.

  • Stable, Overlapping Schedule: Remote work from India with consistent weekday hours (12:30–21:30 IST) that give you at least 7 hours of live overlap with our technical lead in Germany.

  • Modern Data Stack & Growth: Work directly with a MySQL-based data warehouse aggregating POS, ERP, e-commerce, and marketing data, supported by a dedicated learning budget (e.g., for Microsoft PL-300).

  • Clean, Documented BI Function: Build a lasting data dictionary, clear KPI definitions, and self-help guides in our Outline knowledge base.

💼 Key Responsibilities

  1. BI Platform Evaluation

  • What You Will Do: Run a proof of concept on our real reports, compare options on licence and hosting cost, maintenance effort, performance with wide tables (50+ columns), and visual quality, and present a clear recommendation with a business case. Then set up the chosen tool.

  1. Requirements & Business Partnering

  • What You Will Do: Work with management, marketing, finance, and stores to understand the goal behind each request (e.g., "how does ad spend on channel X change user behaviour Y?"), translate it into KPIs and data needs, and propose solutions—not just build what is written down.

  1. Data Connections & Pipelines

  • What You Will Do: Connect our sources—our base is a MySQL-based data warehouse, with data aggregated from POS, ERP/warehouse systems, the online shop, Google Sheets, and finance files, with new sources added regularly—with scheduled refreshes and monitoring. Specify the structured data you need; our development team helps bring new sources into the warehouse.

  1. Data Modelling & DAX

  • What You Will Do: Build star-schema models and DAX measures (contribution margin, sales, returns, stock, marketing performance) whose totals are correct at every level. Prepare the model so a move to Power BI is straightforward.

  1. Data Validation & Quality

  • What You Will Do: Check the data you work with for duplicates, inconsistent values, returns, and gaps; reconcile figures with the source systems; set up data-quality checks and flag issues to the data team.

  1. Dashboards & Reports

  • What You Will Do: Design fast, readable dashboards for management and stores: wide tables with frozen columns, filters by date, country, SKU, and channel, drill-down, and Excel export.

  1. Maintenance & Support

  • What You Will Do: Keep refreshes, connections, and access rights running; tune performance; manage versions and changes.

  1. Documentation & Training

  • What You Will Do: Keep a data dictionary, KPI definitions, and how-to guides in our Outline knowledge base; train business users.

  1. Presenting Insights

  • What You Will Do: Present findings and recommendations in simple English to colleagues in Germany.

📌 Key Requirements

  • Hands-On BI Experience: 2–3 years of hands-on experience in BI or data analysis, building dashboards used in production, backed by a degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, or similar (or equivalent experience).

  • Power BI & Data Modelling: Strong proficiency in DAX (CALCULATE, SUMX, time intelligence, context), Power Query, and star-schema data modelling.

The Secondary Packaging Development Coordinator (SPDC) for Label Design and Secondary Packaging is responsible for the layout of label designs, design & ordering of secondary packaging materials and labels to ensure all production materials are produced to meet the timelines following SOPs, applicable ICH-GxP* and other applicable industry & regulatory guidelines to meet or exceed client expectations.

The SPDC is the link between Regulatory and Clinical Logistics and the main contact for label print vendors and packaging material manufactures.

About the Role

We are seeking a Secondary Packaging Development Coordinator to join our team in India in a Remote capacity. As a Secondary Packaging Development Coordinator, you will support clinical research activities that advance new treatments for patients by ensuring that clinical trial labels and packaging are designed, produced, and delivered accurately and on time. This position plays a key role in study execution, regulatory compliance, and the quality of clinical trial materials. You will collaborate with Regulatory, Quality, Procurement, depot teams, and external vendors, follow SOPs and industry-standard processes, and coordinate study requirements from beginning to end.

Responsibilities include project managing label design and production for allocated projects, designing final label artwork, and serving as the main contact for label printing vendors and packaging material manufacturers, with opportunities to deepen your expertise and influence study outcomes.

You will serve as the link between Regulatory and Clinical Trial Supplies and Logistics (CTSL), helping to ensure production materials meet agreed timelines, follow SOPs and International Council for Harmonisation (ICH) Good Practice (GxP) and other applicable regulatory guidelines, and meet or exceed client expectations. You will join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through label design, secondary packaging, and vendor partnerships. Clinical trial labels and packaging are essential to getting investigational medicines to patients safely and on schedule, and your work will be central to that. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Secondary Packaging Development Coordinator can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research.


Key Responsibilities

  • Project manage label design and production processes for allocated projects, coordinating study requirements from beginning to end.
  • Serve as the main contact for label print vendors and packaging material manufacturers, providing input into vendor selection and monitoring vendor performance.
  • Design final label artwork for simple to high-complexity studies, including blinded labels, variable data, and non-Western fonts, and perform quality control on print proofs and packaging solutions provided by vendors.
  • Advise internal and external customers on package and label designs, propose package designs as required, and coordinate requirements with external groups, including sponsors.
  • Request quotes, obtain offers, explain cost estimates to study teams, communicate standard timelines, and order products using Oracle iProcurement.
  • Ensure assigned labels are designed, produced, and available at packaging facilities to meet agreed timelines, and manage label inventories across the depot network.
  • Coordinate purchasing, manufacturing, distribution, return, recall, and destruction of clinical trial medication as applicable, including label destruction planning for customers.
  • Create medication kit lists, define material specifications, and prepare supporting documents and quality documentation, including Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) relevant documentation.
  • Comply with SOPs and GxP standards, handle complaints following GxP guidelines, and contribute to the development of SOPs, worksheets, and process improvements.
  • Perform day-to-day communication with the logistics team and vendors, and provide on-the-job training for Clinical Supply Specialists and Senior Clinical Supply Specialists.

You'll thrive in this role if you bring:

  • Strengths in result orientation, self-motivation, analytical thinking, creative problem solving, and decision making.
  • Experience working in clinical logistics, packaging, labeling, or another regulated environment.
  • The ability to collaborate across teams and communicate clearly with clients, colleagues, and external vendors.
  • A client-focused, positive, and result-driven mindset with a sense of urgency and strong attention to detail.

Preferred Qualifications
