jobs.description:
About the role

This is a hands-on senior role. You will write the core code, set the engineering standard for how we build agents, and work directly with clients to turn their workflows into acceptance criteria an agent can be tested against.

If you have shipped a LangGraph system to production and can walk us through what broke and how you fixed it, we want to talk to you.

What you'll build

The runtime

  • Design and build reusable agent runtimes in Python on LangGraph and LangChain, with clean interfaces for models, tools, memory, and integrations.

  • Build stateful workflows with conditional routing, parallel branches, subgraphs, and human approval steps. Add multiple agents only when evaluation results justify the complexity.

Reliability

  • Implement durable checkpointing, pause and resume, timeouts, and cancellation.

  • Make retries safe with idempotency keys, deduplication, and reconciliation when the outcome of an external action is unknown.

Tools, context, and memory

  • Build tool integrations with validated schemas, scoped permissions, authentication, and structured error handling across enterprise APIs and data systems.

  • Engineer context and memory: retrieval, summarization, context selection, token budgets, retention, and tenant isolation.

Evaluation and observability

  • Build evaluation datasets and automated checks for business outcomes, tool-use correctness, policy compliance, and recovery, allowing for valid alternative execution paths.

  • Gate every model, prompt, tool, and graph change on regression results.

  • Instrument agents with LangSmith or equivalent tracing, then use traces to improve task success, latency, and cost per completed workflow.

Security

  • Implement prompt-injection defenses, authorization checks, secrets handling, audit trails, and approval controls for sensitive actions. Sandbox code execution where required.

Delivery and leadership

  • Own production delivery with backend and platform teams: APIs, streaming, containers, CI/CD, monitoring, incident response, and runbooks.

  • Review code, mentor engineers, and translate client workflows into testable acceptance criteria.

What you bring

  • 8+ years of software engineering, including owning production systems from design through operation and hands-on AI/ML application work.

  • 2+ years building LLM applications with LangChain, and at least one LangGraph system you shipped and ran in production. You can explain its architecture, how it failed, how you evaluated it, and what improved.

  • Deep LangGraph knowledge: state schemas, reducers, nodes and edges, conditional routing, subgraphs, checkpointers, interrupts, and persistence. Fluent in current LangChain APIs for tool calling, structured outputs, retrieval, and middleware.

  • Agent harness experience: extending Deep Agents or a comparable harness, including middleware, planning, subagents, filesystem access, and sandboxed execution.

  • Model Context Protocol (MCP): building and securing MCP tool servers, integrated with enterprise identity and access controls.

  • Retrieval engineering: permission-aware RAG, hybrid search, reranking, and retrieval evaluation.

  • Strong Python: async, typing, testing, API design, and maintainable service architecture.

  • Backend and distributed-systems fundamentals: PostgreSQL, queues, concurrency, retries, idempotency, and failure handling.

  • Real experience with LLM failure modes: unreliable tool calls, context limits, nondeterminism, rate limits, and regressions after model or prompt changes. You have used evals and traces to find and fix them.

  • Observability: OpenTelemetry instrumentation alongside LangSmith or equivalent agent tracing.

  • Cloud delivery: Docker, automated testing, and CI/CD on AWS, GCP, or Azure.

  • AI-native development: you work in an AI-enabled software development lifecycle, using coding agents for design, implementation, testing, and review, with the judgment to verify their output and the habits to make a team faster with them.

  • Clear communication: you can explain tradeoffs to engineers and clients and own delivery without close supervision.

Customer Service Representative – Plumbing Services, Inbound Calls & Appointment Scheduling | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Location: Latin America or Philippines Preferred (Open to Other Regions)
Working Hours: U.S. Eastern Time (ET) – Evenings & Weekends
Compensation: USD $1,000–$1,500/month
Industry: Plumbing / Home Services / Customer Support

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a reliable, proactive, and customer-focused Customer Service Representative (CSR) to support a growing U.S.-based plumbing services company.

This role focuses on inbound call handling, lead management, appointment scheduling, and customer support during evenings and weekends. You’ll be responsible for responding quickly to customer inquiries, identifying urgent plumbing service requests, and converting incoming leads into booked appointments.

The ideal candidate has experience in customer service, call handling, or home services dispatch, communicates confidently in English, and can manage time-sensitive requests while maintaining accurate records in Housecall Pro.

Weekend availability is mandatory, as the primary objective is to ensure no customer inquiry or potential business opportunity is missed outside regular office hours.

Key Responsibilities

Inbound Calls & Customer Service

  • Answer incoming customer calls promptly and professionally.
  • Assist customers with plumbing service inquiries, including urgent requests.
  • Ask relevant questions to understand plumbing issues and customer needs.
  • Provide basic service information without attempting technical diagnosis.
  • Deliver a positive customer experience while handling high-priority inquiries calmly.

Lead Management & CRM

  • Capture and accurately enter all incoming leads into Housecall Pro.
  • Record customer contact information, service requests, and relevant details.
  • Track lead sources, including Google, Yelp, Angi, Facebook, and other marketing channels.
  • Maintain accurate lead attribution to support marketing performance reporting.
  • Follow up with potential customers to maximize booking opportunities.

Appointment Scheduling & Dispatch Support

  • Assess the urgency of customer requests and prioritize appointments accordingly.
  • Schedule plumbing technicians based on customer needs and availability.
  • Coordinate urgent service requests following established company procedures.
  • Maintain accurate appointment details and customer records.
  • Ensure all inquiries and leads are properly documented before the end of each shift.

Required Qualifications

  • Previous experience in customer service, inbound call handling, appointment scheduling, or dispatch.
  • Excellent spoken and written English with clear, professional communication.
  • Ability to handle urgent customer inquiries calmly and efficiently.
  • Basic understanding of common plumbing issues and service requests.
  • Strong attention to detail and accurate CRM data entry skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple inquiries, follow-ups, and scheduling priorities.
  • Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Reliable internet connection and a quiet workspace suitable for customer calls.
  • Mandatory availability to work both Saturdays and Sundays.
  • Ability to work evening shifts aligned with U.S. Eastern Time (ET).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting a U.S.-based plumbing, HVAC, electrical, or home services company.
  • Familiarity with Housecall Pro (training can be provided).
  • Experience scheduling field technicians or coordinating service appointments.
  • Experience managing leads from multiple marketing channels.
  • Proven ability to convert inbound customer inquiries into booked appointments.
  • Previous experience handling urgent or time-sensitive service requests.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You’re comfortable speaking with U.S. customers and handling inbound calls professionally.
  • You understand that plumbing emergencies require quick responses and clear communication.
  • You take ownership of customer inquiries and ensure no lead is overlooked.
  • You’re organized, detail-oriented, and consistent with CRM documentation.
  • You can confidently convert customer inquiries into scheduled service appointments.
  • You’re dependable and comfortable working evenings and weekends.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your shift begins by reviewing pending inquiries, scheduled appointments, and any customer follow-ups requiring attention.

Throughout the shift, you’ll answer incoming calls, understand customers’ plumbing service needs, assess urgency, and schedule available technicians. You’ll document customer details in Housecall Pro, track marketing lead sources, and follow up on inquiries when necessary.

Before ending your shift, you’ll ensure all customer requests, appointments, and lead information are accurately recorded.

In short: You’ll provide reliable evening and weekend customer support while helping convert incoming plumbing service inquiries into booked appointments.

Working Schedule

All hours are in U.S. Eastern Time (ET).

  • Weekdays: Approximately 5:00 PM – 10:00 PM
  • Saturday: Approximately 9:00 AM – 7:00 PM or 8:00 PM
  • Sunday: Approximately 9:00 AM – 7:00 PM or 8:00 PM
  • Days Off: One or two weekdays, depending on the final schedule
  • Weekly Hours: Approximately 40 hours, subject to the agreed schedule

Important: Working both Saturday and Sunday is essential. The position is specifically designed to provide customer service coverage outside regular business hours.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Success in this role will be measured through:

  • Call Responsiveness: Promptly answering incoming customer calls.
  • Lead Conversion: Converting customer inquiries into booked service appointments.
  • CRM Accuracy: Maintaining complete and accurate records in Housecall Pro.
  • Lead Attribution: Correctly documenting marketing sources for incoming leads.
  • Scheduling Efficiency: Prioritizing urgent requests and coordinating appointments effectively.
  • Customer Experience: Providing professional, helpful, and reliable service.
  • Coverage Reliability: Ensuring consistent customer support during evenings and weekends.

Compensation

Monthly Salary: USD $1,000–$1,500

Compensation will depend on relevant experience, English communication skills, and the final agreed working schedule.

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Recruiter Screening
  4. Client Interview
  5. Final Selection & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re an experienced Customer Service Representative, Inbound Call Agent, Appointment Scheduler, or Home Services Dispatcher with excellent English communication skills and a customer-first mindset, we’d love to hear from you.

This is an opportunity to support a growing U.S. plumbing services business, manage customer inquiries, and contribute directly to appointment bookings and customer satisfaction.

Candidates with home services experience, Housecall Pro knowledge, and availability to work both weekend days are strongly encouraged to apply.

jobs.excerpt: As a Senior Product Owner, you will manage the execution of NMI's strategy and roadmap, while facilitating backlog grooming, prioritisation, triage and other development ceremonies.
jobs.description:
As a Senior Product Owner, you will manage the execution of NMI's strategy and roadmap, while facilitating backlog grooming, prioritisation, triage and other development ceremonies. Our Product Owners also take an active role in product launches, ensuring internal stakeholders are trained on the latest product capabilities.

You will need a unique blend of business and technical savvy, a big-picture vision and attention to detail, and the drive to make that vision a reality. You must enjoy spending time learning the product and understanding its users in order to make the best design decisions for our clients.

About NMI

NMI, a global leader in payment technologies, allows software and sales professionals to deliver payment innovations to their clients without having to build payment expertise in house. NMI enables our partners with choice, and challenges the one-size-fits-all approach to payments. You've probably used NMI in the last 24 hours without even realizing it. We're the platform that powers success for innovative tech created by SMBs, entrepreneurs and fintech startups. We're creative problem solvers who help visionaries smash through boundaries and think beyond what's possible so they can think about what's next. But we're not just built for the tech savvy. We democratize the latest payments technology so that everyone can realize the benefits of easy payments across the full spectrum of commerce. Our mission is to use our expertise to enable more payments, in more ways and more places. We provide ISOs, Fintech Innovators and Technologists the freedom to focus on what they do best, liberating them from restricted payment solutions and giving them access to the latest payment technology now and in the future.

How We Work - Our Core Values

  • Be a Good Person, It's Simple. We treat everyone fairly and with respect. We lead with kindness, humility and integrity. We take the time to understand each other and our customers. And we serve with care, because customers are never a transaction, and always our focus
  • Align, Trust & Go. We debate openly, listen carefully and challenge thoughtfully. Once we decide, we move forward together - holding ourselves accountable to our commitments, and focusing on what matters most to our customers. That alignment creates momentum.
  • Raise the Bar. Good enough isn't enough. We stay curious, measure everything, stay honest about progress and keep pushing ourselves to think creatively. We drive change, again and again. And leave things better than we found them. When we raise the bar, our customers feel it too.

What will I be doing?

  • Prioritise the product backlog and coordinate with stakeholders including the Product Manager, customer facing teams, executives and your development team to deliver maximum value and quality to the market.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert in the relevant product domains.
  • Develop an understanding of the target market and user base, and use this to guide product decisions.
  • Develop epics and user stories for all new functionality, present user stories to product teams and ensure new functionality meets the acceptance criteria.
  • Partner with stakeholders to help define a Minimum Viable Product (MVP) that delivers incremental value and aligns with the product vision and NMI's strategic goals.
  • Work with the development team, Product Manager and other Product Owners on release planning.
  • Write detailed release notes and provide product training to internal teams.
  • Conduct User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure new products and functionality work as expected.
  • Work with other Product Owners to ensure dependencies are prioritised appropriately across teams.
  • Communicate work in progress and upcoming work to key stakeholders.
  • Ensure the conceptual and functional integrity of new features or components.
  • Help establish timelines and product benchmarks.
  • Develop the voice of the customer through customer interviews.

Do I have what it takes?

The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity and approaches problem solving, teamwork and innovation with a positive attitude. This person has a very strong understanding of our customers, including the driving forces in payments technology and product evolution, and has the coaching skills to motivate teams and individuals around a common vision of product development excellence.

  • At least 3–5 years of product owner experience, or similar/equivalent.
  • Experience in ecommerce, retail and/or payments technology; payments technology experience is preferred.
  • Ability to take business requirements and translate them into detailed product specifications.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with customers, business and technical team members across the organisation.
  • Knowledge of technology and comfort reading technical specifications and working with APIs and SDKs.
  • Ability to communicate and work effectively in a distributed environment, with colleagues in different geographical regions and across various levels of the organisation.
  • Passion for solving puzzles and understanding how different solutions work together in a retail, ecommerce or payments environment.

Do you feel like you have a slightly out of the ordinary career path or history? We are open to all walks of life and very willing to hear your story. Please don't feel like this should be a barrier to securing a great career at NMI! We appreciate success can come in all shapes and sizes. Fill in the 'Additional Info' box on our application to tell us more about your path.

As well as being a part of something exciting everyday, you will also receive the following benefits:

  • Annual bonus scheme dependent on individual and company performance
  • Annual salary of £50,000 - £70,000
  • 25 days holiday each year (+ bank holidays + 1 day after each year of service with up to a max. of 30 days)
  • Workplace pension scheme
  • Private medical insurance (upon 30 days of employment)
  • 7 hours per day, 35 hours per week
  • A remote first culture
  • Great work-life balance with our Flexi-time policy
  • Family Friendly policies (Enhanced Maternity and Paternity Pay and Shared Parental Leave).
  • A chance to develop with an allocated company training budget
  • Bike2Work Scheme
  • Lifeworks, an Employee Assistance Programme which offers wellbeing, family and financial support services, such as assessments, resources and even 1:1 counselling sessions. It also offers interesting perks such as discounts on gyms, restaurants, high street retailers and cinema tickets
  • A strong commitment to employee wellbeing including mental health first aiders
  • Employee referral scheme with generous financial reward
  • Bonusly colleague reward scheme

We believe that having a diverse group of employees strengthens both our work and our workplace. We're focused on making NMI more diverse and welcoming with initiatives like having a dedicated Diversity, Equity & Inclusion action group, diversity goals for hiring, anonymized resume screening, affinity groups such as our Women's network and LGBTQ+ Network, open forums for discussions on diversity and social justice, and measuring inclusion and belonging as part of our regular employee engagement surveys.

Equal Opportunity

jobs.excerpt: About OpenSesame OpenSesame is the trusted partner for Workforce Reinvention in the age of AI.
jobs.description:
About OpenSesame

OpenSesame is the trusted partner for Workforce Reinvention in the age of AI. OpenSesame delivers integrated software, curated and customizable content, and expert services – embedded into existing learning, HR, and work systems – to help organizations expand their human+AI potential and thrive through change.

Learn more:

Internship Overview

OpenSesame seeks passionate, driven students and new graduates who already use AI to build and solve problems to join our paid summer internship program. You’ll gain hands-on experience at a fast-growing, remote-first B2B SaaS company developing AI-powered products that help organizations upskill their people and fuel long-term growth.

As an intern, you’ll collaborate with experienced teammates across the company to help shape the future of OpenSesame. You’ll work on meaningful projects that bring new ideas to life, strengthen the customer experience, and help customers achieve success.

AI is how we work here, not a side topic. You’ll have access to AI tools, including Claude, and we’ll encourage you to use them to research, prototype, analyze, and build. You’ll explore how AI and data can inform strategy, improve customer outcomes, and shape the future of learning technology, and see how human-centered design and AI innovation combine to create products with global impact.

Intern AI Hackathon

As part of your internship you will have the opportunity to participate in our first intern AI hackathon this summer. You’ll team up with interns from other departments to pitch, build with AI, and present a working product idea that improves how OpenSesame works or serves customers.

About the Team

At OpenSesame, our Engineering Team is the creative force behind the cutting-edge solutions that bring our mission to life. Guided by Extreme Programming (XP) principles, we thrive on collaboration, pair programming, and iterative development to deliver reliable, scalable, and impactful technologies.

Our engineers—spanning software development, DevOps, and data operations—partner across teams to tackle real-world challenges, designing and building tools that adapt to the ever-changing needs of our customers. We’re an AI-forward team, integrating artificial intelligence and automation into our products and internal systems to improve efficiency, insight, and scalability.

Whether developing new product features, enhancing our infrastructure, or leveraging AI to optimize workflows, we’re fueled by a passion for innovation and a culture of continuous learning. Together, we’re redefining what’s possible in eLearning technology!

Performance Objectives

By 2 Weeks

  • Pair program with team members to gain hands-on experience and learn our engineering, DevOps, and deployment practices.
  • Participate in team discussions about tools, technologies, and AI-driven innovations while contributing to brainstorming sessions.
  • Begin learning the technologies we use—such as TypeScript, React, Terraform, AWS, and CI/CD systems—through direct collaboration with engineers across software and DevOps.

By 30 Days

  • Work on individual and team projects, contributing to production-ready code, infrastructure, or automation tools that may include AI-powered solutions.
  • Actively participate in all team meetings and events to understand how different engineering disciplines collaborate to deliver intelligent, data-driven solutions.
  • Suggest improvements to processes, workflows, or AI-enabled tools based on your early observations and experiences.

By 60 Days

  • Take ownership of individual tasks and contribute independently to ongoing engineering, DevOps, or AI-related projects.
  • Support efforts to enhance system reliability, scalability, and automation through the integration of AI and modern engineering practices.
  • Share insights and knowledge about emerging technologies—especially in AI, automation, and infrastructure—helping foster team learning and continuous improvement.

Application and Creative Project

Before you start, check out our Creative Project guide. It walks through what we're looking for below in more detail.

To apply, submit one application, which includes a link to your creative project. We want to see how you think and what you've built, so your creative project must be a video (5 minutes or less), shared as a YouTube link (unlisted is fine). Applications without a working YouTube link will not be reviewed.

We care more about your curiosity and how you think than a polished result, so don't let your experience level stop you from applying.

You can talk to the camera, or walk us through slides, a demo, or a screen recording. How you show it is up to you. In your video, please cover:

  • How do you see OpenSesame fitting into your career journey or long-term goals?
  • What strengths, skills, or perspectives do you bring to OpenSesame to make an impact and contribute to our mission?
  • Show us something you've built with AI. What problem did you solve, and what excites you about where AI is taking learning and work?
    • Haven't built anything with AI yet? Make something today! Try an AI tool, experiment with a new idea, and show us or walk us through how you did it.
    • Feel free to share something from your personal life, work, school, or anywhere else. Share whatever feels right to you.

We're drawn to curiosity, creativity, growth mindset and authentic expression. Keep it concise and focused.

Not selected for this role? You're still in the running. We'll review your application for alignment with our other open internships. If we see a potential fit, we'll reach out to you directly.

Additional Program Details

Application closes: Sunday, February 14th, 2027

Program dates: Anticipated start June 17, 2027 through August 28th, 2027. We can adjust up to two weeks earlier for students returning to school before the program concludes.

Commitment: Full-time (40 hours/week)

Eligibility and location: Must be a current student enrolled in a college/university program or have graduated within the past 12 months (undergraduate, postgraduate, or associate programs accepted). This position is fully remote and can be based anywhere in the U.S.

Compensation: $25 an hour

Equipment: Interns must have a personal computer with specs suitable for the work and access to consistent high-speed internet during working hours.

Opportunities and expectations: OpenSesame’s internship program is immersive and growth-focused, pairing each intern with a dedicated mentor and offering meaningful, hands-on projects that make an impact. You’ll also take part in professional development sessions, networking opportunities, the intern hackathon, and book club discussions, receive volunteer time off to give back to your community, and gain full access to our course catalog for your own learning and development.

Interview process: After the application review, selected candidates will be invited to a virtual OpenSesame webinar to learn more about our company, culture, and internship program. Following the event, selected candidates will move forward to interviews with the hiring manager and team for the department they’re being considered for.

Equal Employment Opportunity: OpenSesame is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer that values and welcomes diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of various legally protected characteristics, including criminal history, and strive to provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. We prioritize safety and security and may use your information accordingly, and you can contact us for assistance or accommodations during the job application process. For more information on our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion initiatives, click here.

CPRA (California candidates): When you submit your application, OpenSesame may collect and use your personal information in accordance with our privacy policy and the CPRA. This may include personal details and employment history, and will only be used for employment-related purposes. We may share this information with third-party service providers, but we will not sell it to third parties. If you have any questions or concerns, please contact us, and for more information on your rights under the CPRA, refer to our privacy policy or the California Attorney General’s website.

jobs.excerpt: JOB SUMMARY The Operations Manager for the Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) team leads the administrative and technical operations supporting physician and pharmacist reviews, including prior authorizations, appeals, and other pharmacy utilization management services.
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY

The Operations Manager for the Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) team leads the administrative and technical operations supporting physician and pharmacist reviews, including prior authorizations, appeals, and other pharmacy utilization management services. This role oversees operational staffing, workflow performance, operational quality assurance, reviewer coordination, financial accuracy, and final delivery across PBM client accounts. Working closely with the clinical leadership, the Operations Manager ensures efficient workflows, compliance with client requirements, appropriate management of contracted reviewer fees, and timely service delivery while maintaining clear separation between operational responsibilities and clinical decision-making.

Mission, Culture & Values

At Dane Street, we believe exceptional employee experiences create exceptional client experiences. Our culture is built on collaboration, continuous improvement, accountability, and care.

We care for our customers, we care for our employees, and we care for one another. Every team member plays an important role in creating an environment where people feel respected, supported, empowered to grow, and inspired to do meaningful work.

What You’ll Do

Strategic Growth

  • Drive revenue growth and operational efficiency by ensuring operational execution consistently meets or exceeds client turnaround time (TAT) expectations and output targets.
  • Partner with Sales and Account Management on prospective client presentations and site visits to demonstrate operational capacity, system capabilities, and workflow reliability.
  • Continuously evaluate operational workflows and capacity models to support scalable service delivery as referral volumes grow.
  • Support the implementation of new PBM services, client workflows, and operational enhancements, including physician and pharmacist review pathways and pharmacy technician-supported workflows.

Management and Leadership

  • Oversee daily PBM operations, managing performance, capacity, and productivity metrics for Operations Supervisors, Operations/CPhT Leads, Pharmacy Coordinators (CPhTs), and administrative support personnel.
  • Translate organizational goals into measurable productivity, quality, and service-level expectations for the Operations team.
  • Recruit, onboard, train, evaluate, and mentor operations personnel, fostering a high-accountability culture and managing performance improvements or disciplinary actions as needed.
  • Ensure appropriate staffing, training, and performance expectations for Pharmacy Coordinators and operational staff.

Operational Tasks

  • Plan, organize, and monitor daily activities across PBM case workflows, reviewer coordination, operational quality assurance, and final delivery to prevent inefficiencies.
  • Manage PBM physician and reviewer panel cost structures by enforcing client and reviewer-contracted fee schedules, proper specialty selection, and geography-based assignment rules.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key PBM physician reviewers to support reviewer retention and fee compliance.
  • Ensure accurate verification of contracted reviewer payment amounts and client billing based on the type of review performed, applicable fee schedules, and client agreements.
  • Monitor operational productivity, turnaround times, reviewer utilization, and staffing capacity to identify performance gaps and address potential service delays.
  • Oversee operational QA processes to ensure administrative and technical accuracy, case completeness, adherence to client requirements, and appropriate resolution of identified deficiencies.
  • Ensure operational QA activities remain within staff qualifications and authorized responsibilities, with substantive clinical questions and reviewer clarifications referred to qualified clinical personnel.

Collaboration

  • Partner closely with clinical leadership to align operational workflows, staffing capacity, and case preparation with clinical review requirements and turnaround time priorities.
  • Coordinate with internal support departments, including Human Resources, Finance, IT, and Business Analytics, to maintain smooth technology platforms and accurate labor planning.
  • Respond promptly to client inquiries and collaborate with Account Management to address service-level questions or customized client operational needs.
  • Coordinate with clinical leadership on quality findings, escalations, and corrective actions affecting both operational and clinical workflows, while clinical determinations and clinical QA remain under clinical oversight.

Compliance

  • Ensure all daily PBM operations and administrative and technical workflows comply with applicable state and federal regulations, client requirements, company policies, and established operational procedures.
  • Maintain precise operational data tracking and audit readiness across case records, tracking systems, client portals, operational reporting, and final delivery documentation.
  • Implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) for operations personnel to uphold data integrity, privacy, and regulatory guidelines.
  • Ensure delegated pharmacy technician functions remain within authorized scope of practice, established protocols, and applicable regulatory requirements, with appropriate clinical oversight and escalation procedures.
  • Support operational compliance with applicable accreditation requirements, including URAC and NCQA standards, as relevant to assigned PBM services.

Other duties

Perform other duties as assigned.

What Makes This Role Successful:

  • Success in this role means maintaining an efficient, highly reliable operational team that delivers timely, accurate, compliant, and financially responsible PBM services. High performance looks like:
  • Operational Efficiency & Speed: Consistently meeting or exceeding client TAT standards through real-time queue management and proactive capacity planning.
  • Margin & Cost Control: Optimizing reviewer selection and fee schedule adherence to protect operational profitability while maintaining service quality and ensuring accurate contracted reviewer payments and client billing.
  • Data-Driven Performance Management: Utilizing key metrics to keep operational team performance aligned with established productivity and quality expectations and identifying capacity needs before bottlenecks occur.

jobs.description:
Operations Coordinator

Company: Busybee Teachers
Location: Remote, U.S.-based only
Employment Type: Part-Time and/or Full-Time
Compensation: $18 per hour
Schedule: Eastern Time hours, exact schedule TBD

About Busybee Teachers
Busybee Teachers connects dependable educators with schools that need classroom support. We are a growing, high-trust team that values initiative, sound judgment, accountability, and follow-through.

The Role
This is a hands-on operations role supporting our educators and the broader business. You will help keep day-to-day operations moving by coordinating schedules and communications, responding to calls and messages, maintaining records and internal materials, supporting onboarding and training, and assisting with administrative and operational projects.

The work is varied, and the right person should be comfortable wearing multiple hats. Some responsibilities will be routine, while others will require you to troubleshoot problems, communicate with external partners, research solutions, and figure out an approach where one does not already exist.

Who We're Looking For
Before applying, we want to be clear about the working style this role requires. Professionals often lean toward one of two operating styles:

  • The Task Executor: Does their best work when responsibilities, procedures, and next steps are clearly defined.
  • The Outcome Owner: Give them the destination, and they figure out the route. They use available resources, work through roadblocks, make reasonable judgment calls, and take responsibility for reaching the result.

Both styles have value. This particular role requires an Outcome Owner mindset. You will receive clear goals, resources, and support, but you will not receive a detailed daily checklist for every situation. We are looking for someone who can think through problems, roll up their sleeves, and keep work moving without needing constant direction.

Being an Outcome Owner does not mean having all the answers or never making a mistake. We are comfortable with reasoned decisions that may occasionally need to be adjusted. We are not comfortable with careless decisions, avoidable inaction, or problems being left unresolved simply because no one provided step-by-step instructions.

Paid experience in operations or administration is helpful, but it is not required. We care more about how you treat people, how you think, how you communicate, and whether you follow through. We are less concerned with where you developed these skills than whether you can demonstrate them.

You will thrive here if:

  • You are warm, approachable, and respectful: Especially when dealing with people who report to you, rely on you, or need your help. We are not looking for someone who becomes short, dismissive, condescending, or difficult simply because they have a little authority.
  • You can take ownership without waiting for every step: You can take a loosely defined assignment, figure out what needs to happen, and move it forward without waiting for every step to be explained.
  • You are comfortable making reasoned mistakes, not lazy mistakes: We would rather you make a thoughtful decision that needs to be adjusted than make a careless decision because you did not take the time to think, check, or use the information available to you.
  • You keep your commitments: If you have a pattern of last-minute call-outs, frequently changing plans, or committing to things you cannot consistently follow through on, this is not the role for you.
  • You write polished communications: You use correct grammar, spelling, punctuation, and formatting.
    What we want to see: Good afternoon, Ms. Johnson. I received your message and I am reviewing the schedule now. I will follow up shortly with an update.
    What we will pass on: hey ms johnson . i seen your message im checking the schedule now i will let you know once i figure it out
  • You pick up the phone: You are comfortable speaking professionally and handling routine issues without avoiding the conversation.
  • You manage multiple moving pieces: You keep track of details, notice missing information and loose ends, and follow up until each one is actually complete.
  • You are resourceful and willing to challenge what is not working: When you do not know the answer, you research it and come back with a practical solution. You are comfortable researching and recommending new tools, suggesting better methods, and speaking up when a current process is not working as well as it should.
  • You learn systems quickly: You can learn unfamiliar software and systems without needing extensive hand-holding.

How to Apply
Skip the standard cover letter. Email your resume to with the subject line Operations Coordinator and include your response to the scenario question below.

Application Scenario
Imagine you are one week into a new role as Operations Coordinator for Community Bridge, a fictional nonprofit that provides groceries and household essentials to families in the community. Volunteers help prepare orders, organize donations, and assist with distribution.

During your first week, you notice that eight recently added volunteers seem unsure about what they are supposed to be doing. Some are asking other volunteers for direction, some are waiting around for instructions, and the experience appears inconsistent depending on who happens to be working that day. Twelve more volunteers are scheduled to start Monday.

During a conversation, your manager mentions how frustrating it has been that new volunteers often do not know what to do when they arrive. They tell you, Please figure out a solution. I already have too much on my plate to manage this.

Keeping in mind that Community Bridge is a nonprofit with limited resources, from start to finish, how do you solve this problem?

Unfortunately, applications that do not include the requested written response will not be considered.

Wir suchen neue Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) für unser Performance-Marketing-Team, die uns dabei unterstützen, die Meta-Kampagnen unserer zahlreichen Kunden (Engel & Völkers, RE/MAX, Quarterback Immobilien AG) zu betreuen. Du übernimmst bereits früh Verantwortung und steuerst selbstständig die Werbekampagnen deiner zugeteilten Makler, Bauträger und Vertriebsgesellschaften. Du verwaltest Werbebudgets in fünfstelliger Höhe, generierst werthaltige Kundenanfragen und sorgst für messbare Kundenergebnisse. Vorher wirst du umfassend von uns auf deine Rolle vorbereitet.

Unternehmensbeschreibung

Mit über 800+ Partnern zählt Immo-Marketer zu den etabliertesten Marketing- und Vertriebsagenturen der Immobilienbranche. Unser Expertenteam hilft Immobilienmaklern, Bauträgern & Immobilienvertrieben bei der Gewinnung neuer Kunden, indem wir professionelle Social-Media-Kampagnen erstellen und beim Aufbau digitaler Vertriebsprozesse begleiten.

Mit einem 25-Köpfigen Team unterstützen wir Partner in der gesamten DACH-Region und sind durchgehend auf der Suche nach neuen Kolleginnen & Kollegen, die in einem stabilen Umfeld ihre Stärken einbringen wollen. Wenn Du bereit bist, mit Struktur und klaren Prozessen zum weiteren Wachstum des Unternehmens beizutragen, dann werde jetzt Teil unseres Teams und starte Deine Karriere bei Immo-Marketer.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Tägliche Kampagnen-Analysen, um sicherzustellen, dass vorgegebene Kennzahlen erreicht werden.

  • Umsetzung von bewährten Optimierungs-Maßnahmen, um das Maximum aus dem verfügbaren Werbebudget herauszuholen.

  • Enge Abstimmung mit dem Projektteam, wo deine Erkenntnisse ein wichtiger Hebel sind.

  • Du entscheidest selbstständig über die profitable Verwendung von Werbebudgets i.H.v. 50.000€+ pro Monat.

Wenn du weitere Informationen zu unserem Unternehmen und deiner Karriere bei Immo-Marketer haben möchtest, findest du diese aufwww.immo-marketer.de/karriere.

Gehalt: 3.000 - 3.500 Euro pro Monat (brutto)Die Einarbeitungsphase dauert in der Regel 1–3 Monate (bereits voll bezahlt).

Auch nach über 12 Monaten Betriebszugehörigkeit kannst Du weiterhin mit regelmäßigen Gehaltserhöhungen rechnen.

Was wir Dir bieten:

  • Sicherer Arbeitsplatz: Jede Person, die wir einstellen, soll langfristig mit uns wachsen. Das Ziel jeder Einstellung ist eine unbefristete Übernahme. Die Übernahmequote liegt aktuell bei über 95%.

  • Professionelle Arbeitsatmosphäre: Der Umgang untereinander ist sehr kollegial und auf Augenhöhe. Wir ziehen alle am gleichen Strang und motivieren uns gegenseitig zu Bestleistungen, um unsere Zielvorgaben zu erreichen.

  • Attraktive Vergütung & Karrierechancen:Unsere Mitarbeiter erhalten eine sehr gute Vergütung mit garantierten Gehaltserhöhungen. Über die nächsten Jahre werden wir weiter wachsen und expandieren. Daher benötigen wir weitere Experten und/oder Führungskräfte.

  • Arbeitsort flexibel:Modernes 350qm Büro in Bochum (Nähe Bermuda3Eck) mit moderner Büroausstattung und kostenlosen Parkplätzen auf dem Firmengelände - oder komplett remote aus dem Home-Office

  • Strukturierte Einarbeitung: Um bei uns erfolgreich zu sein, benötigst du keine Vorerfahrung im Vertrieb. Durch unser eigenes Schulungssystem + deinen eigenen Mentor wirst du strukturiert für deine Rolle im Performance-Marketing ausgebildet.

  • Eigene Inhouse-Design-Abteilung: Schnelle Bereitstellung von Creatives und Grafiken, damit du dich auf die Optimierung und Steuerung der Kampagnen fokussieren kannst.

Requirements

Das bist Du:

  • Du denkst analytisch, liebst Zahlen und bist in der Lage schnell Muster zu erkennen.

  • Erreichte Kennzahlen sind die höchste Form der Anerkennung für dich!

  • Du hast den Anspruch an dich selbst, ein echter A-Player zu sein und bist gern umgeben von hochmotivierten Menschen.

  • Du bist in der Lage, analytisch zu arbeiten und faktenbasiert Entscheidungen zu treffen

  • Du bist am effektivsten, wenn du klare Prozessvorgaben hast und diese befolgen kannst.

  • Vorkenntnisse im Media-Buying (Werbebudget von mindestens 10k€+) sind vorteilhaft - aber nicht erforderlich.

  • Du sprichst sehr gut Deutsch und kannst dich gut selbst organisieren.

jobs.title: Go-To-Market Lead (DACH)
jobs.excerpt: About us Hey there!  We're Lleverage, and we're making the Autonomous Back Office actually achievable for businesses.
jobs.description:
About us

Hey there! We're Lleverage, and we're making the Autonomous Back Office actually achievable for businesses. We enable European companies to integrate AI agents into their business, because AI is only useful when it actually fits into daily operations.

We help the most strategic European industries – manufacturing, logistics, and wholesale – automate the messy, manual processes that most tools can’t handle.

We’re a fast-growing, VC-backed scale-up based in Amsterdam, with big ambitions for 2027 and beyond. This is your chance to join early, have real impact, and grow alongside the company. If that sounds something you want to help build, we'd love to have you on board!

About the role

We're looking for a Go-To-Market Lead to open and lead the DACH market (Germany, Austria and Switzerland) for Lleverage. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role: you set the strategy for DACH, build the first pipeline yourself, close our first DACH customers and own the DACH number. You'll work directly with our founding team, including our CCO, and you'll be the face of Lleverage in DACH.

As the market grows, you'll lead a small DACH pod. A Go-To-Market Associate will join you to run revops and German-language outreach and calling, and a Forward Deployed Engineer will join once the first deals are signed, to deliver for those customers.

Responsibilities

  • Open and lead the DACH market: build pipeline from scratch and close our first DACH customers, focused on mid-size and larger manufacturing, logistics and wholesale companies

  • Own the DACH number: set targets with the founding team and be accountable for pipeline and revenue in DACH

  • Own the full sales cycle: from first contact to signed contract, including C-level conversations and complex, multi-stakeholder deals

  • Build the DACH playbook: ICP, German-language messaging, channels and partners

  • Lead the pod: coach the Go-To-Market Associate on pipeline and work with the Forward Deployed Engineer on first deliveries

  • Represent Lleverage: with DACH customers, partners and at industry events

  • Work directly with the founding team: on strategy, targets, approach and customer feedback

  • Bring insights: from DACH customers back into product development

Requirements

What we’re looking for

  • Around 10 years of B2B sales experience, with a strong track record of closing complex deals and hitting targets

  • You have opened a market or built a sales territory from scratch before, and you have taken ownership of a number

  • A senior seller who still loves running deals yourself and is ready to lead a small team as it grows, not a sales executive who manages from a distance

  • You're an excellent relationship builder. You win trust fast, communicate with confidence at all levels, and genuinely enjoy the process of turning a cold conversation into a long-term partnership.

  • You're commercially sharp and consultative. You understand that the best outcomes come from genuinely understanding someone's pain, not pitching a product. You listen well and use data to shape your priorities.

  • You're energised by ambiguity. A new market with no playbook excites you rather than stops you.

  • Native-level German and fluent English

  • Based in Germany, Austria or Switzerland, or in the Netherlands

Nice to haves

A network in the DACH Mittelstand. Experience in B2B sales, partnerships, or business development. Background in SaaS, AI, or Consultancy. Networks in manufacturing, wholesale, distribution or the PE industry. Previous entrepreneurial experience is a big plus, built something, ran something, grew something. 50% of our team are former founders, that tells you something.

Why Lleverage?

Change the world, literally. Traditional industries are sitting on a massive AI opportunity and most of them haven't been reached yet. You'll be the one opening those doors.

Work, learn, have fun. We're building one of the strongest commercial teams in Europe. You'll work directly with the founding team, surrounded by exceptional talent, and genuinely enjoy the people around you.

Build a unique network. Lleverage is a global top AI brand. You'll connect with industry leaders and some of the most important operators in tech and traditional industry.

Get autonomy and ownership. You design the approach, build the relationships, own the results, and grow with the company.

Compensation. Competitive salary depending on experience, strong bonus structure (fi we win you win), and an excellent share package that makes this genuinely worth betting on.

jobs.title: Instructional Designer
jobs.excerpt: GuidePoint Security provides trusted cybersecurity expertise, solutions and services that help organizations make better decisions and minimize risk.
jobs.description:
GuidePoint Security provides trusted cybersecurity expertise, solutions and services that help organizations make better decisions and minimize risk. By taking a three-tiered, holistic approach for evaluating security posture and ecosystems, GuidePoint enables some of the nation’s top organizations, such as Fortune 500 companies and U.S. government agencies, to identify threats, optimize resources and integrate best-fit solutions that mitigate risk.

Overview

Instructional Designers at GuidePoint Security are creative, organized and collaborative people who design and deliver engaging learning for a fast-growing cybersecurity company. As part of the GuidePoint Learning team, they build and maintain training across our Learning Management System (LMS). They work with subject matter experts and leaders across the business to turn complex technical and business topics into clear, effective courses. This role reports to the Manager, Training Enablement. As GuidePoint Security grows, team members can keep building their skills in instructional design, learning technology and cybersecurity.

RolesandResponsibilities:

  • Design and develop eLearning courses, learning plans and career paths for audiences ranging from technical to non-technical.
  • Convert instructor-led training into self-paced eLearning in the LMS.
  • Work with subject matter experts to build courseware, including syllabi, slide decks, assessments, videos and job aids.
  • Create engaging supporting materials in several formats, such as audio, video, simulations and interactive activities.
  • Work with regional and practice leadership to design role-based and specialty career tracks.
  • Build, update and maintain courses and learning plans in the LMS (Docebo) with the Learning team.
  • Review course materials regularly and update the curriculum so content stays accurate and meets business objectives.
  • Gather and act on learner and stakeholder feedback to improve current courseware.
  • Communicate project status to stakeholders regularly and on time.
  • Look for ways to make content development faster and more scalable, including with AI-enabled tools.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Required Experience and Education:

  • BA/BS in Instructional Design, Education, Communications or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • 1-2 years of experience in instructional design or corporate training development.
  • Experience with content authoring tools such as Articulate 360.
  • Experience with a corporate LMS; Docebo preferred.
  • Basic knowledge of information security or cyber operations desired.
  • Willing to learn and use AI-enabled tools.
  • Strong Microsoft 365 skills for course development (PowerPoint, Word, Excel).
  • Ability to understand technical subject matter and explain it clearly to many different audiences.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Self-motivated and able to manage several projects, adapt to shifting priorities and stay productive in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong attention to detail.

Travel Requirements:

  • Up to 15% travel required.

Physical Requirements:

  • Sedentary work.
  • Substantial movement of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers for a minimum of 8 hours a day.
  • Required to have close visual acuity to view computer terminal and/or extensive reading for a minimum of 8 hours a day.

We use Greenhouse Software as our applicant tracking system and Zoom Scheduler for HR screen request scheduling. At times, your email may block our communication with you. Please be sure to check your SPAM folder so that you don't miss updates on your application.

Why GuidePoint?

GuidePoint Security is a rapidly growing, profitable, privately-held value added reseller that focuses exclusively on Information Security. Since its inception in 2011, GuidePoint has grown to over 1,300 employees, established strategic partnerships with leading security vendors, and serves as a trusted advisor to more than 6,200 customers.

Firmly-defined core values drive all aspects of the business, which have been paramount to the company’s success and establishment of an enjoyable workplace atmosphere. At GuidePoint, your colleagues are knowledgeable, skilled, and experienced and will seek to collaborate and provide mentorship and guidance at every opportunity.

This is a unique and rare opportunity to grow your career along with one of the fastest growing companies in the nation.

Some added perks….

  • Remote workforce primarily (U.S. based only, some travel may be required for certain positions, working on-site may be required for Federal positions)
  • Group Medical Insurance options: Zero Deductible PPO Plan (GuidePoint pays 90% of the premium for employees and 70% for family plans (spouse/children/family) or High Deductible Health Plan with HSA (GuidePoint pays 100% of the employees premiums and 75% for family plans (spouse/children/family). If you choose the High Deductible / HSA plan, GPS will contribute in 4 equal quarterly installments: ($850 per EE annually / $1750 per family annually (includes spouse/children/family options)
  • Group Dental Insurance: GuidePoint pays 100% of the premium for employees and 75% of family plans
  • 12 corporate holidays and a Flexible Time Off (FTO) program
  • Healthy mobile phone and home internet allowance
  • Eligibility for retirement plan after 2 months at open enrollment
  • Pet Benefit Option

jobs.title: Head of Brand & Product Marketing
jobs.excerpt: ABOUT US HyperionDev is one of the largest providers of accelerated tech education in EMEA and one of the oldest providers of ‘coding bootcamps’ in the world.
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

HyperionDev is one of the largest providers of accelerated tech education in EMEA and one of the oldest providers of ‘coding bootcamps’ in the world. We work with top universities such as Imperial College London, The London School of Economics, The University of Edinburgh, and Stellenbosch University to deliver structured technical courses and bootcamps that accelerate people into fulfilling tech careers. We’ve been recognised as one of the top education technology scaleups in the world and gained the financial backing of Meta (previously Facebook), which recognised us as the most socially impactful startup operating in Africa, where we initially started our work.

We’re also home to Longdue, an independent narrative game studio incubated within HyperionDev. Longdue crafts psychologically rich, story-driven RPGs that challenge players to navigate complex moral worlds and deeply human stories. Inspired by games like Disco Elysium, Longdue is in the early stages of developing a bold new RPG IP, with a focus on world-building, narrative depth, and artistic innovation. While HyperionDev focuses on transforming education and careers through technology, Longdue carries the same mission-driven DNA into the world of games, storytelling with purpose and resonance.

Together, HyperionDev and Longdue share infrastructure, support functions, and a deep commitment to pushing boundaries in their respective industries.

At HyperionDev, we are dedicated to closing the global tech skills gap and expanding the possibilities of digital creativity. Our model — combining human mentorship, scalable tech infrastructure, and access-driven partnerships — has helped us reach millions of learners a year from over 60 countries. We’ve partnered with government bodies such as the UK’s Department for Education, who provide scholarships for students to study on our bootcamps and gain employment at companies such as AstraZeneca and the United Kingdom’s National Health Service (NHS).

HyperionDev is backed by nearly 2000 investors, having raised the largest crowdfunding round of funding for an edtech company in history. As a primarily bootstrapped, profitable, and scale-up tech business, join us as we play our part in making the world a more stable, safer, and fair place through both education and interactive storytelling.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Brand & Digital Marketing Lead to bring together brand strategy, product marketing and creative delivery at HyperionDev.

You’ll lead our designers, copywriters and product marketers to create clear course propositions, compelling campaigns and effective digital experiences. From how we tell our story to how prospective students explore courses and apply, you’ll ensure our marketing is consistent, persuasive and grounded in customer needs.

A key part of the role will be improving our marketing website and landing pages. You’ll guide messaging, design and user journeys, working with creative and development teams to make it easier for prospective students to understand their options and progress towards enrolment.

You’ll work closely with our growth team, which leads paid media, SEO and CRM, to align campaigns and website experiences with acquisition activity. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who combines strong brand and creative judgement with project management skills and a focus on commercial results.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Brand Strategy & Positioning
Develop clear positioning and consistent messaging for HyperionDev, its courses and university partner offerings.

Product Marketing & Launches
Lead customer propositions and go-to-market planning for course launches and updates, aligning audiences, messaging and delivery across teams.

Creative Direction
Set clear creative briefs and provide constructive direction to designers and copywriters across campaigns, website content and marketing materials.

Website Experience & Conversion
Guide improvements to course pages, landing pages and user journeys, using research and performance insights to increase enquiries and applications.

Campaign Planning & Delivery
Lead integrated marketing projects from concept to launch, coordinating creative assets, timelines, stakeholders and approvals.

Customer & Market Research
Use audience research, admissions feedback and competitor intelligence to strengthen positioning, messaging and the prospective student experience.

Growth & Admissions Collaboration
Partner with paid media, SEO, CRM and admissions teams to connect acquisition activity with relevant messaging and effective enrolment journeys.

Brand Quality & Partner Alignment
Maintain accurate, consistent marketing materials that meet HyperionDev’s standards and university partner requirements.

Team & Resource Management
Lead and develop designers, copywriters and product marketers, managing priorities, capacity and external suppliers to deliver high-quality work.

Performance & Improvement
Evaluate campaign and website results, prioritise testing and improvements, and communicate their contribution to marketing and enrolment goals.

Requirements

Minimum

  • At least 5 years’ experience in brand, product or digital marketing, including at least 2 years leading a marketing or creative team.
  • Experience developing brand positioning, product propositions and customer-focused messaging.
  • Demonstrated success delivering integrated consumer marketing campaigns across digital channels.
  • Experience leading website or landing page improvements, with evidence of improving customer experience or conversion.
  • Strong creative judgement and experience briefing and guiding designers and copywriters.
  • Practical understanding of UX/UI principles and the ability to evaluate user journeys, page layouts and prototypes.
  • Strong project management skills, including managing timelines, dependencies, stakeholders and approvals across concurrent projects.
  • Experience using customer research and marketing performance data to inform decisions.
  • Excellent written communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred

  • Experience in education, edtech or another business with a considered purchase and longer customer decision cycle.
  • Experience marketing across multiple brands, international markets or university partnerships.
  • Experience with conversion optimisation, usability testing and A/B testing.
  • Familiarity with website analytics and user behaviour tools, such as Google Analytics.
  • Experience collaborating with developers to deliver website improvements.
  • Experience managing agencies, freelancers and external suppliers.
  • Familiarity with project management tools such as Basecamp, Asana or Trello.
  • Experience supporting PR, brand communications, events or activations.
  • A qualification in Marketing, Communications, Business or a related discipline.

Benefits

BENEFITS

Flexible & remote working: We are a remote-friendly organisation and offer flexible work options.

Generous annual leave and medical benefits: We provide up to 19 annual leave days as part of our leave policy, as well as health insurance or medical aid benefits for our staff.

Join the heart of tech in Africa, the US, and Europe: You'll work with the best of the best and rub shoulders with the world leaders in edtech, developer education, and developer assessments. Join one of the most ambitious and highest-performing tech companies in the space, with a founding team that draws their former experience from companies such as Google, Amazon, GetSmarter/2U, & Yoco.

Life-changing work: Solve real problems that make education and tech careers accessible to those who need it most: you're allowed to brag about it.

OUR VALUES

We're a people-forward company with a purpose that underlines everything we do. We're obsessed with the potential in people and challenge them to do their best work. We embrace a culture of growth and learning to deliver on our vision, and ours is a relentless quest for improvement.

jobs.excerpt: Talent Acquisition Specialist Position Type: Full-Time, Remote Working Hours: EST Business Hours About the Role Pavago is seeking a passionate and proactive Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our growing recruitment team.
jobs.description:
Talent Acquisition Specialist

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote

Working Hours: EST Business Hours

About the Role

Pavago is seeking a passionate and proactive Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our growing recruitment team. This role plays a critical part in identifying, attracting, and hiring exceptional talent for a diverse range of client positions across multiple industries.

This is more than just sourcing resumes—you will own the recruitment lifecycle from job posting through candidate presentation while delivering an outstanding experience for both candidates and clients. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy connecting great talent with exciting opportunities, and take pride in building strong hiring pipelines, we'd love to hear from you.

Responsibilities

Candidate Sourcing & Recruitment

  • Create and publish engaging job postings across multiple hiring platforms.
  • Source high-quality candidates through LinkedIn, job boards, networking, referrals, and other recruitment channels.
  • Review applications and conduct initial candidate screenings.
  • Build and maintain strong talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs.
  • Identify passive candidates through proactive sourcing strategies.

Candidate Assessment & Interviewing

  • Conduct structured interviews to evaluate candidates' technical skills, communication abilities, and cultural fit.
  • Assess candidate suitability based on client requirements.
  • Prepare comprehensive interview evaluations and hiring recommendations.
  • Present shortlisted candidates to clients with detailed profiles highlighting their strengths and qualifications.

Interview Coordination

  • Coordinate interviews between candidates and hiring managers.
  • Manage interview scheduling and ensure a smooth recruitment experience.
  • Maintain regular communication with candidates throughout every stage of the hiring process.
  • Provide timely updates and feedback whenever possible.

Client Collaboration

  • Develop a strong understanding of each client's hiring requirements, business goals, and company culture.
  • Work closely with internal stakeholders to refine candidate profiles and hiring strategies.
  • Deliver exceptional client service by presenting highly qualified candidates efficiently.

Recruitment Operations

  • Maintain accurate candidate records within the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
  • Keep recruitment pipelines organized and up to date.
  • Support onboarding activities to ensure a seamless transition for successful candidates.
  • Continuously improve recruitment workflows and sourcing strategies.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You genuinely enjoy connecting talented people with great career opportunities.
  • You are highly organized and can manage multiple hiring processes simultaneously.
  • You communicate confidently with candidates, clients, and internal stakeholders.
  • You proactively solve recruitment challenges instead of waiting for direction.
  • You take ownership of your roles and consistently deliver results.
  • You thrive in a remote, fast-paced, and collaborative environment.

Required Experience & Skills

Must-Have

  • Previous experience in Talent Acquisition, Recruitment, or a similar hiring role.
  • Strong experience sourcing candidates through LinkedIn, job boards, referrals, and networking.
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
  • Experience conducting structured candidate interviews.
  • Ability to evaluate candidate qualifications and cultural fit.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Experience coordinating multiple recruitment processes simultaneously.
  • Familiarity with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and recruitment platforms.
  • Proficiency with video conferencing tools for remote interviews.
  • Ability to work independently while managing competing priorities.

Nice-to-Have

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Human Resources, or a related field.
  • Experience recruiting for remote or international positions.
  • Experience working in a recruitment agency or staffing environment.
  • Knowledge of Boolean search and advanced sourcing techniques.
  • Experience recruiting across multiple industries and functional roles.

What Does a Typical Day Look Like?

Your day begins by reviewing active hiring priorities, responding to new applications, and sourcing candidates across multiple platforms. Throughout the day, you conduct candidate interviews, coordinate client interviews, communicate with hiring managers, and present qualified candidates for open positions.

You'll maintain ATS records, manage recruitment pipelines, support onboarding activities, and continuously build relationships with talented professionals for future opportunities.

Success in this role comes from consistently identifying high-quality talent, delivering an excellent candidate experience, and helping clients hire exceptional people.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Time-to-Fill
  • Quality of Candidates Submitted
  • Interview-to-Offer Ratio
  • Candidate Response Rate
  • Client Satisfaction
  • ATS Data Accuracy
  • Candidate Experience
  • Offer Acceptance Rate

You Are the Right Person If...

  • You enjoy building relationships with people.
  • You are naturally curious and know how to uncover great talent.
  • You can confidently assess candidates through structured interviews.
  • You stay organized even while managing multiple open roles.
  • You are proactive, resourceful, and accountable.
  • You enjoy working in a fast-moving recruitment environment.

Interview Process

  1. Initial Recruiter Screening
  2. Video Interview
  3. Final Team Interview
  4. Background & Reference Checks
  5. Offer Stage

jobs.description:
AI-Augmented QA Engineer

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

We are looking for an AI-Augmented QA Engineer to own and expand automated testing for an early-stage, fast-moving security platform.

You’ll work closely with frontend and backend engineers to build reliable test coverage, strengthen the existing Playwright test suite, and ensure critical product workflows remain stable as the platform evolves.

This is a hands-on engineering role where you’ll have significant ownership. You’ll receive clear goals around test coverage and reliability rather than step-by-step instructions, making it ideal for someone who enjoys working independently and improving systems proactively.

What You’ll Own

Test Automation & Coverage

  • Write and maintain automated end-to-end tests using Playwright
  • Expand coverage across critical product workflows
  • Build regression tests that run automatically on every pull request
  • Test workflows including dashboards, detection workflows, device management, user permissions, and settings
  • Keep the test architecture clean, maintainable, and scalable as the product grows

Test Infrastructure & Reliability

  • Own the reliability of the automated test suite and CI pipeline
  • Diagnose and reduce flaky tests
  • Manage test data and seed data requirements
  • Monitor and improve staging environment stability
  • Maintain reliable test execution as the product and test suite expand

AI-Assisted Exploratory Testing

  • Use AI-assisted browser automation to explore edge cases and uncover bugs
  • Work with Claude and LLM-based tools as part of daily testing workflows
  • Experiment with AI-driven testing approaches beyond scripted test cases
  • Identify issues that traditional automated regression tests may not catch
  • Continuously explore ways to improve QA efficiency through AI tooling

Engineering Collaboration

  • Work directly with frontend and backend engineers throughout the development cycle
  • Collaborate on testing requirements and critical product flows
  • Communicate test failures, bugs, and reliability issues clearly
  • Contribute to a culture where engineers trust and act on automated test results
  • Take ownership of QA improvements without relying on layers of project management

Requirements

  • 3–5 years of QA, software testing, or test automation experience preferred
  • Candidates with less experience will also be considered if they demonstrate strong automation skills and relevant hands-on experience
  • Strong TypeScript skills and the ability to write clean, maintainable test code
  • Hands-on experience with Playwright, Cypress, or a similar E2E testing framework
  • Strong understanding of web application testing
  • Understanding of DOM interaction, network requests, and asynchronous behavior
  • Ability to diagnose and troubleshoot flaky automated tests
  • Experience creating or maintaining automated regression tests
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of testing goals
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
  • Willingness to learn and use AI tools as part of the testing workflow
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to test reliability

Nice to Have

  • Experience building E2E testing infrastructure from scratch
  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI pipelines
  • Experience with test data management, parallelization, and test reporting
  • Hands-on experience with Playwright specifically
  • Experience testing complex B2B web applications
  • Experience with multi-tenant applications and role-based access
  • Experience testing multi-step workflows
  • Familiarity with Claude or other AI/LLM-based development and testing tools
  • Experience working with React applications
  • Familiarity with Sentry, GCP Stackdriver, or similar observability tools

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

  • Prefer building automated testing systems over relying primarily on manual QA
  • Enjoy improving test coverage and reliability proactively
  • Can work independently from high-level goals
  • Are comfortable diagnosing problems rather than waiting for detailed instructions
  • Have strong curiosity about AI-assisted testing and emerging tools
  • Enjoy working directly with engineers in a small, fast-moving team
  • Care about building test suites that engineers genuinely trust
  • Think beyond individual test cases and consider the reliability of the overall QA system

Tech Stack

  • TypeScript — Test code
  • Playwright — E2E testing framework
  • Claude & AI tooling — AI-assisted exploratory testing
  • React — Frontend application
  • Sentry — Error monitoring
  • GCP Stackdriver — Logging and observability

Interview Process

  1. Recruiter Screening
  2. Client Interview
  3. Final Selection & Onboarding

Location: Remote – LATAM

Type: Contractor

Salary: $1,500 – $2,000 per month, depending on experience

About Us

eJam is a bootstrapped consumer products company that has built, scaled, and exited multiple brands — all without ever taking a dollar of outside capital. Our portfolio includes category leaders ranked at the top of Amazon, carried in major retailers nationwide, and sold across DTC, marketplaces, and every channel in between.

We’re not a startup hoping something works. We’re a team that has done it repeatedly — taken products from idea to category leader, landed them on retail shelves nationwide, and built real brands that consumers love. We operate like a holding company with the speed of a startup: small team, no bureaucracy, massive ownership.

This is the place where you’ll see the entire machine — sourcing, product development, packaging, manufacturing, compliance, marketing, marketplace strategy, retail — all under one roof. If you want to learn how consumer products actually get built and shipped at scale, there is no faster education than this.

The Role

We're looking for an Email Retention Analyst to join our Retention team and build the email campaigns and flows that keep our customers coming back. You'll turn briefs into live Klaviyo campaigns and flows for two consumer brands, QA everything before it sends, and keep our owned-channel reporting sharp. This is a hands-on, junior role for someone who loves building, works from data and uses AI tools every day. You'll report to our Retention, Subscription & Lifecycle Manager and work alongside our Email Retention Designer and CRO team.

What You'll Do

  • Campaign builds: set up and schedule email campaigns from briefs for two brands.
  • Flows and segments: build, QA and maintain lifecycle and subscription flows in Klaviyo, and segment customers by purchase behavior, subscription status and engagement.
  • QA: make sure every send is error-free: links, rendering, segments, UTMs and send times.
  • Design to build: take approved designs from Figma and build them into Klaviyo.
  • Reporting: keep weekly owned-channel KPIs up to date (open rate, CTR, CVR, revenue per recipient) and flag what's moving and why.
  • Documentation: audit and document active flows and segments.
  • CRO support: help implement tests when assigned.

Requirements

  • 1–3 years of hands-on experience in email marketing, CRM or e-commerce retention.
  • Klaviyo: you have built campaigns, flows and segments in Klaviyo yourself. Experience in Omnisend, Braze or Mailchimp can also work.
  • Data-driven: you track email KPIs and use them to decide what to change. Everything is a report.
  • AI every day: you use AI tools daily to work faster on builds, QA, reporting and copy variants.
  • Spreadsheets: comfortable building weekly reports, pivots and formulas on your own.
  • Detail-oriented: you QA before you ship.
  • English and schedule: working-level English and daily overlap with US Pacific Time mornings.

Nice to Have

  • Subscription experience: you have worked with a DTC subscription brand or a loyalty program, using a platform such as Recharge, Checkout Champ or similar.
  • Shopify experience.
  • Familiarity with Figma or other design tools.
  • Deliverability knowledge.
  • A/B testing experience.

Compensation

  • $1,500–$2,000 USD per month, depending on experience.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • 100% remote: work from anywhere within LATAM, with daily overlap with US Pacific Time (PT) mornings
  • Long-term engagement with a profitable, growing company
  • Direct access to leadership and real ownership of your work
  • Exposure to the full consumer products machine across multiple brands
  • Learning & development opportunities

Why eJam

  • We build and scale category-leading eCommerce brands
  • We operate with speed, ownership, and accountability
  • Ideas move quickly from concept to execution
  • Every team member has direct impact on company growth
  • We value operators who think strategically and execute decisively

Equal Employment Opportunity

eJam is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where all team members feel valued and respected. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

We believe diversity drives innovation and strengthens our ability to serve our customers. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.
