Standard Job Description

Responsible for designing and delivering repeatable digital-analytics and automated business-process solutions that improve financial planning and decision-making. The Data Analyst combines finance-domain knowledge with data science and analytics architecture to integrate data, map processes, build reusable data products, develop analytical models, and establish reliable controls. This role supports digital analytics and process improvement across F-35 Finance and Business Operations. Depending on business need, the analyst may be deployed to Financial Planning and Analysis, Business Management, Program Finance, Estimating and Pricing, or Contracts Administration teams. Work may include Long-Range Planning for Orders, Sales, Earnings, and Cash forecasts, program performance, earned value, estimates at completion, cost and pricing analysis, proposal support, contract data elements, and contract administration. The primary deliverables are process maps, automated workflows, data models and pipelines, analytical models, reusable code or workflow components, control procedures, validation records, and other repeatable work products that increase automation while enhancing decision support.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in data science, computer science, engineering, mathematics, statistics, finance, accounting, economics, business, or a related field, or eight years of related experience in lieu of a bachelors degree.
  • 3 or more years of experience in data analytics, data science, analytics engineering, business intelligence, financial analytics, data architecture, process automation, or a related discipline.
  • Experience analyzing complex, multi-source data and translating results into business recommendations or management actions.
  • Experience developing a reusable data product, data model, pipeline, automated workflow, analytical dataset, semantic layer, or comparable maintainable analytics solution.
  • Experience using SQL or a comparable query capability and Python, R, scripting, or another programming or automation language.
  • Experience with process mapping, requirements definition, data integration, APIs, data validation, forecasting, statistical analysis, or analytical modeling.
  • Experience applying data governance and information protection practices, document methods and assumptions, test work products, and communicate technical findings to nontechnical audiences.
  • Experience evaluating AI-assisted outputs critically, retain human accountability, and protect sensitive company or government information.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain any U.S. government security clearance required for the supported program, if applicable.

Desired Skills

  • FP&A, financial modeling, rolling forecasts, monthly outlooks, business case analysis Long Range Planning, Orders, Sales, EBIT, Cash, working capital, or related financial measures.
  • Program Finance, Program Management, Earned Value Management Systems, EIA-748 concepts, CPI/SPI, variance analysis, Estimate at Completion, Estimate to Complete, cost and schedule integration, or program controls.
  • Estimating and Pricing, Basis of Estimate development, cost-volume analysis, direct and indirect rates, labor and material pricing, proposal support, price analysis, or historical cost analysis.
  • Contracts Administration, contract data, contract modifications, contract status, funding, invoicing, billing, compliance, audit support, FAR, DFARS, or other government-contracting concepts.
  • Data architecture concepts including dimensional modeling, lakehouse or warehouse patterns, semantic models, data contracts, lineage, metadata, and API-based integration.
  • Time-series forecasting, regression, anomaly detection, scenario analysis, simulation, optimization, or other applied statistical and machine-learning methods.
  • Process mapping, workflow redesign, automation, control design, standard work, runbooks, continuous improvement, or business process management.
  • SAP or SAP S/4HANA, Oracle EPM, Hyperion/Essbase, Deltek Cobra, Costpoint, ProPricer, or other ERP, EVMS, planning, estimating, pricing, and contract data structures.
  • Git or equivalent version control, automated testing, code review, model monitoring, reproducibility, and controlled deployment or handoff.
  • Generative AI or AI-assisted development tools, human-in-the-loop review, source traceability, and responsible AI practices.
  • Strong communication, creative problem-solving, customer focus, continuous learning, and cross-functional collaboration.
  • SQL, Python, Power Query, Alteryx, Power Automate, Databricks, Azure, SQL Server, SAP HANA, Power BI, Tableau, or comparable tools and platforms

This role is responsible for end-to-end listing coordination, marketing execution, transaction
support, and administrative systems management, ensuring that listings launch on time,
transactions stay on track, and clients experience a seamless, professional process from start to
finish. The position requires strong project-management skills, attention to detail, and the ability
to proactively manage multiple workflows while coordinating with local on-the-ground support in the U.S.
This is not a task-only VA role. The ideal candidate thinks in systems, anticipates next steps,
and owns outcomes—not just to-do lists.

Core Responsibilities

1. Administrative & Business Operations

● Own inbox triage and calendar management
● Schedule all appointments, inspections, photography, and meetings
● Maintain CRM accuracy: data entry, tagging, segmentation, notes
● Build and manage checklists for listings, escrows, and repeat processes
● Track deadlines, contingencies, and escrow milestones
● Manage DocuSign, disclosures, and compliance files
● Perform transaction coordination for buyer and seller transactions
● Track expenses, invoices, and receipts
● Create and maintain SOPs and internal documentation
● Prepare weekly status reports and priority summaries for the agent

● Gather and organize seller disclosures
● Enter and update MLS listings accurately
● Draft MLS descriptions and marketing copy for agent approval
● Build property websites and upload all media
● Proof all marketing materials before release
● Manage showing instructions and feedback
● Prepare neighborhood stats, disclosures packets, and pricing docs
● Track listing timelines and ensure deadlines are hit

● Create, schedule and publish social media posts across all channels
● Write marketing captions and copy
● Create graphics and marketing assets using tools like AI, Canva, and Adobe

● Draft follow-up emails after client meetings

Junior Full Stack AI Engineer

About Orion Digital

Orion Digital Corp (NASDAQ/TSX: ORIO) is a publicly listed Canadian fintech operating a multi-engine financial platform spanning lending (Mogo), payments (Carta), and wealth (Intelligent Investing).

We have moved past the traditional fintech model. Capital allocation, decisioning, and risk management sit at the core of how the business creates value, and AI runs as an enabling layer across the platform rather than as a standalone product narrative. That layer is real and in use, and the work now is making it faster, safer, and harder to break.

Lending or Wealth

This role is open to both of our product engineering teams. Depending on your background and where the business needs you, you will join one of them. Let us know which interests you more when you apply.

  • Lending (Mogo): consumer credit products, including onboarding, credit decisioning, repayments and customer support, using AI to improve decisions and personalization over time.
  • Wealth (Intelligent Investing): a self-directed and managed investing platform built on value-investing principles, with AI-native flows that help investors act on discipline rather than impulse.

Both teams work to the same engineering standard and the same expectations for ownership of what ships.

The Role: Junior Full Stack AI Engineer

We’re looking for a product-minded engineer early in their career who can:

  • Learn fast and ship real product to production early
  • Build and maintain TypeScript and Node.js services with guidance from senior engineers
  • Work with AI coding tools, write clear specs, and critically review AI-generated code
  • Own what you ship, including the tests and the monitoring

You will work directly with senior engineers and grow quickly into owning features end to end.

What You’ll Build

  • Backend Services
    TypeScript and Node.js services built as event-driven microservices on RabbitMQ and AWS (SQS, SNS, Lambda), with MySQL, Postgres and Redis, deployed to Kubernetes through ArgoCD and monitored in Datadog.
  • Product Features, Web and Mobile
    Full-stack features across our lending and investing products, including React and Next.js on the web and React Native in the Wealth mobile app.
  • AI-Native Workflows
    Work with senior engineers to build AI-assisted flows, with human oversight, that help the team make decisions faster and help customers make better long-term choices.
  • Production Quality
    Write tests in Jest, ship through CI/CD, and own what you ship in production. Handle customer data and PII carefully, and learn the on-call and incident process alongside senior engineers.
  • The Craft That Earns Trust
    Keeping money moving correctly, from order and repayment lifecycles to reconciliation against partner and custodian files and statements. This is where you learn how real financial systems stay correct, and it is the fastest route to becoming a senior engineer.

What You’ll Need

  • 0-3 years of professional experience (or projects that show you’re ready)
  • TypeScript/Node.js and API development
  • React, Next.js or React Native is a plus, and Ruby/Rails exposure is a plus for Lending
  • Comfortable working with AI coding tools, writing clear specs, and critically reviewing AI-generated code
  • Curiosity about AI, credit and risk, investing, and how good product decisions are made
  • Bonus: Python, event-driven systems (RabbitMQ or SQS), or serverless AWS

Who Thrives Here

  • You use AI every day to learn and build faster, and you can say where it helped and where it did not
  • You write code with intention, not just speed
  • You care about long-term outcomes over short-term engagement
  • You say what you do not know and close gaps by asking
  • You have strong design instincts, humility, hunger, and a high standard for your work
  • You move quickly in small, safe steps and measure the outcome of every change

How We Hire

  1. Intro screen: a conversation about your background and what you want to work on.
  2. Technical interview: a practical exercise in the stack above.
  3. Team conversation: meet the engineers you would work with.

Let’s Build the Future Together

AI is real and in use at Orion, and the work now is making it faster, safer, and harder to break. If you want to do that on a small team that owns what it ships, apply now.

Working at Abbott 

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You'll also have access to:

The Opportunity 

We’re advancing cancer care through innovative screening and diagnostic tests that help patients and healthcare providers make informed decisions before, during and after a cancer diagnosis. Our growing portfolio includes Cologuard®, Oncotype DX®, Cancerguard® and Oncodetect®, along with advanced genetic testing, supporting patients from cancer prevention and early detection through personalized treatment decisions and recurrence monitoring. WM Partners is seeking a Director of Legal Affairs to serve as a senior legal partner to the firm and its portfolio companies. Reporting to the General Counsel, the Director will handle a broad range of legal matters across the firm and its portfolio.

This is a hands-on role for an experienced attorney who is comfortable dealing directly with executive leadership and handling many diverse matters. The Director will work independently on most matters, and will bring in the General Counsel and outside counsel where the complexity or risk calls for it. The right person combines strong legal skills with sound business judgment and a practical, solutions-oriented approach and has practical experience with FDA, FTC, SEC legal matters and is well-versed in general corporate, contracts and transactional matters.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities

• Serve as the primary legal advisor to portfolio companies and their leadership on a wide range of legal matters, with a particular focus on FDA and FTC regulatory work and related contractual matters

• Assist the firm’s legal team on a variety of transactional and investment matters, including acquisitions and dispositions, diligence and debt and equity finance

• Partner with fund compliance and business leaders to support adherence to applicable laws, regulations and firm policies, including fund investment matters, disclosures, direct investor communications and ongoing compliance

• Review, draft and negotiate a wide variety of complex agreements (including NDAs, vendor, consulting, engagement and technology contracts), with a proven ability to explain key risks and practical alternatives in clear business terms

• Build and maintain contract templates, guidelines and a contract management process that improve consistency and turnaround

• Manage multiple requests at once, setting priorities and keeping stakeholders informed of status and timelines

• Offer practical guidance and training to colleagues on recurring legal topics and approval requirements

• Keep the General Counsel informed of key matters, risks and priorities, and escalate material issues promptly

Requirements

Education and Experience

  • Juris Doctor from an accredited law school and active membership in good standing in at least one U.S. state bar; ability to satisfy any applicable in-house counsel registration requirements.
  • At least five years of relevant legal experience, with substantial responsibility for independently reviewing, drafting, and negotiating commercial contracts.
  • Experience in a law firm preferred, but in-house legal department will also be considered.
  • Familiarity with the private equity investment lifecycle and related confidentiality, advisory, and diligence arrangements preferred; exposure to health and wellness businesses is a plus.
  • Experience with cross-border work preferred.

Required Skills and Competencies

  • Strong commercial judgment and the ability to balance legal risk with business priorities.
  • Excellent drafting, negotiation, and communication skills, including the ability to make complex issues understandable to nonlegal stakeholders.
  • Initiative and accountability: takes ownership of requests, follows through on commitments, and drives timely resolution.
  • Focus and organization: prioritizes competing requests across firm operations and investment activities while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Collaboration and discretion: builds productive relationships, handles sensitive information carefully, and knows when to seek specialized guidance.

jobs.title: Lead Platform Engineer - Meridian
jobs.excerpt: Company Overview hermeneutic research is a best-in-class proprietary trading firm.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

hermeneutic research is a best-in-class proprietary trading firm. It deploys research-driven discretionary and systematic strategies as well as makes strategic long-term investments. The partners' decade-long history of success in trading and business building and a firm-wide cultural emphasis on alpha generation, open debate, relentless iteration, and teamwork are key to the firm's continued expansion in a challenging market environment that has hamstrung competitors. A hard-wired emphasis on risk management and opportunistic market participation ensures that hermeneutic research will continue its growth trajectory in the coming decades.

Job Overview

You will take a research platform that already works and make it production infrastructure while the team keeps shipping, then build the engineering function around it.

hermeneutic Research Labs is the firm’s applied research and engineering unit. Its first project, Meridian, is a research intelligence platform for digital-asset markets, built with our researchers and traders and used by them every day. The platform turns market, on-chain, macro and news data into event-driven research that trading decisions rely on. The platform is held to the standard we apply to our own trading: rigorous, falsifiable and measured on outcomes.

The Labs is making a multi-year investment to turn the platform into production infrastructure that a growing set of internal users can depend on. As part of that investment, it is hiring a founding Lead Platform Engineer for Meridian.

You will own how software is built, shipped, run and secured here, for years, not for a quarter: environments, delivery, reliability, data operations, security posture, cost, and the developer experience of everyone who touches the platform. You will do it without stopping a team that ships daily. You will remove as much as you add. The current stack is a starting point, not a constraint: the technology choices from here are yours to make and to defend with evidence.

You start by writing and shipping code every week. As the function grows, you will hire, onboard and lead its engineers. The role is built to grow into Head of Platform Engineering.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design the architecture and the path to production: the target topology for a multi-service backend, a web frontend and a data layer of several stores, defended by cost and blast radius rather than fashion, with staging and production environments and a migration plan that never stops the team.
  • Own delivery: a deploy path that builds once, promotes immutable artifacts and rolls back by re-promoting, CI that finishes in minutes, and gates proportional to the risk of a change.
  • Own reliability: service levels for market hours and the instrumentation to measure them, a runbook behind every page, post-mortems that fix classes of failure, and capacity work under real load.
  • Run data operations with data engineering: storage policy for very large time-series tables, point-in-time recovery, restore drills you run yourself, and the managed-versus-self-hosted decision as the estate grows.
  • Own security at the infrastructure layer, working with the security function: secrets management and rotation, the network edge, least-privilege roles, supply-chain gates on dependencies and base images, and audit trails.
  • Control cost and efficiency: attribution per service, per tenant and per workload, idle capacity made visible, and the economics of self-hosted versus managed infrastructure and of compute for model serving.
  • Set engineering standards: architecture review, coding standards, test strategy, review culture, and how AI coding agents are directed and reviewed at volume.
  • Build the team: join the interview panels for the engineers who follow, hire and onboard them, and grow a platform team as the function grows.

Requirements

Must-Haves

  • 10+ years building and operating production backend systems, including 5+ years owning a deploy path, an on-call rotation and a production database end to end, and 3+ years leading other engineers while still shipping code every week.
  • A track record of widening scope: one system you took from fragile to depended-upon, and one function you built from nothing.
  • A simplifier’s record: process or infrastructure you removed, the measurement that justified it, and a system that got safer.
  • Deep backend engineering, with Python among your languages: asynchronous services, typed interfaces, and profiling and fixing under load. You can still write the hardest parts yourself, and you do.
  • Relational database operations at scale (Postgres today), including heavy time-series workloads: partitioning, compression, retention and recovery. You have restored a production database from backup under pressure.
  • Infrastructure at more than one scale: single-host container deployments and orchestrated platforms (Kubernetes, managed or self-run) in production, a migration between them, and the numbers to argue which fits a given stage.
  • Delivery and observability built from scratch, more than once: CI/CD you designed, an observability stack you stood up, and service levels people were paged on.
  • Security as part of engineering, not a hand-off: secrets, edge, least privilege and supply chain. You have closed a real exposure and fixed the class.

Technologies named here are what we run today, not a filter. We hire for depth and judgment.

Desired Attributes

  • Sound judgment with AI coding agents: you direct and review AI-generated code daily, know what you refuse to merge, and keep your own judgment sharp.
  • Initiative: you take the hard problem first, and bring the plan and the first implementation, not a request for direction.
  • Hiring: you have hired and grown engineers, and can name a hire you regretted and what you missed.
  • Bonus: a major cloud at the account and network level, managed Kubernetes in production, GitLab-class CI, Next.js build and deployment.
  • Bonus: systems with market-hours change windows or other hard change controls.
  • Bonus: a security engineering or SRE specialty.

Interview Process

  1. CV Screening – We will review your application based on the qualifications and experience outlined above.
  2. Hiring Manager Screen – A conversation about the largest production system you have owned end to end.
  3. Hands-On Round – A live exercise on a shared screen.
  4. Architecture Deep-Dive – A whiteboard session on designing a path to production.
  5. Operations and Incident Scenarios – A scenario discussion with peers from engineering and security.
  6. Leadership and AI-Assisted Work – A conversation on how you lead engineers and review AI-generated code.
  7. Co-Founder Interview – A concluding discussion to assess your capabilities, strategic thinking, and cultural fit.

Company Values

Throughout the process, you'll be assessed for cultural fit through our company values:

  • Drive – We believe the best team members are deeply passionate about what they do. That passion fuels their growth, drives them to seek out the best teams, and leads them to hold high expectations of themselves in pursuit of excellence.
  • Ownership – We aim to extend ownership as broadly as possible across the firm. In return, we value people who take initiative, step up when needed, and treat the company’s goals as their own.
  • Judgment – We value those who see the big picture and focus on what truly drives impact and results. They use time wisely, adapt across domains, and always prioritize outcomes over comfort zones.
  • Openness – We foster a culture of open communication, mutual challenge, and shared growth. We believe constructive debate and proactive knowledge sharing lead us closer to the truth—and better decisions.
  • Competence – We work with people who bring exceptional intellectual strength. What sets them apart isn’t just what they know—it’s how they use what they know to navigate change, adapt quickly, and contribute meaningfully in fast-changing environments.
  • Resilience – We perform under pressure. Markets move fast, and so do we—but we stay grounded, focused, and calm. We embrace uncertainty, learn from setbacks, and adapt quickly without losing sight of long-term goals.

Role Purpose

The Project Controls Engineer supports the design, configuration, commissioning, and documentation of plant control systems for utility-scale solar, storage, and hybrid renewable energy projects. This engineer executes project work with guidance from senior engineers, applies working knowledge of grid functionality and Utility/ISO standards, and contributes to the continuous improvement of product standards. Approximately 90% of this role is project execution, while up to 10% is continuous improvement and product development.

Responsibilities

Project Execution & Technical Delivery (~90%)

  • Execute controls design for utility-scale solar, BESS, and hybrid projects under the guidance of senior engineers, including review of the project scope to identify project-specific requirements and deviations from the standard Terabase controls product offering.
  • Program and commission SEL controllers using AcSELerator; develop control logic in Codesys using IEC 61131-3 structured text and continuous function charts
  • Follow the controls development process for any project-specific development work, including documentation of requirements, logic development, testing in a simulated/lab environment and documentation of test results.
  • Implement and validate closed-loop Active Power and Reactive Power, AVR and PFR Algorithms
  • Maintain version control for all code artifacts according to established version control procedure (Bitbucket)
  • Troubleshoot SCADA and controls issues using Wireshark, breakpoints, cross-reference, and watch list tools, escalating complex issues to senior engineers as needed
  • Produce project deliverables: System Architecture Diagrams, Control Narratives, Logic Diagrams, commissioning documents, and operator manuals

Product & Process Improvement (~10%)

  • Contribute to new feature development and bug fixes in collaboration with the Product Engineering team
  • Prepare technical and non-technical documentation for review by senior controls engineers
  • Participate in the Continuous Improvement and Lessons Learned program, sharing field insights to inform product standards and templates
  • Prepare for FATs and customer-facing presentations with coaching from senior engineers

Stakeholder Communication & Collaboration

  • Support senior engineers as a controls technical contact for EPCs, asset owners, and grid operators through project execution, FAT, and commissioning
  • Support FATs and lead assigned portions as formal presentations; communicate to non-technical audiences with supporting materials prepared in advance
  • Flag technical risks and schedule pressures to project management team with context and proposed solutions
  • Maintain Jira tickets daily with thorough detail, following Jira best practices

Expectations & Success Indicators

  • Deliver high-quality work across multiple concurrent projects with ownership and urgency, seeking guidance when needed
  • Leverage standardized platforms and tools to work efficiently
  • Maintain 100% adherence to Terabase quality processes
  • Actively develop technical skills through code reviews, feedback, and FAT participation alongside senior engineers
  • Project deliverables completed on time, within scope, and meeting Utility/ISO regulatory standards
  • Jira, version control, and documentation consistently maintained without follow-up from management
  • Build growing expertise in Terabase SCADA and Utility-Scale grid controls, progressing toward independent project ownership
  • Travel up to 10% for on-site commissioning, FAT, and customer engagements

Requirements

Requirements

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Engineering, Control Systems, Computer Science, or related field
  • 3+ years of IEC 61131-3/PLC programming experience, preferably in Codesys or AcSELerator environment
  • 2+ year of utility-scale renewable power plant controls experience (solar, BESS, or hybrid) preferred, including exposure to project-specific development work, Factory Acceptance Test (FAT), commissioning and Site Acceptance Test (SAT)

Technical Skills

  • Proficient IEC 61131-3 programming; primary IDE is AcSELerator (SEL controllers) and Codesys, familiarity with Diagram Builder; proficiency with using traces, cross-references, breakpoints, and watch lists
  • Working knowledge of industrial protocols: Modbus-TCP, DNP3, OPC-UA, C37.118, etc.
  • Solid understanding of grid functionality: Primary Frequency Response (PFR), Automatic Voltage Regulation (AVR), Active/Reactive power closed loop control, and capacitor bank functionality – including the underlying principles
  • Familiarity with Utility/ISO testing and interconnection requirements (ERCOT, PJM, BPA, IEEE 2800, NERC, etc.)
  • Exposure to Power Plant Controller (PPC) design, configuration, and commissioning
  • Familiarity with PSCAD, PSSE, and/or TSAT modeling processes for utility-scale sites is a plus
  • Exposure to hardware in the loop (HIL) hardware, such as RTDS, OPAL-RT, Speedgoat, Typhoon, etc., is a plus

Benefits

Compensation And Benefits

This role offers a base salary of $110,000 – $125,000 (DOE)

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within each posted range, individual pay is determined (and may be greater or higher), dependent on work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Terabase offers competitive compensation along with a comprehensive benefits package, including:

• Generous time off and holiday policy

• Remote flexibility

• Flexible time off

• Comprehensive benefits package

jobs.description:
About CG Oncology, Inc.

Are you ready to make a difference in the world and become part of our patient-centered team that is focused on Attacking Bladder Cancer for a Better Tomorrow? At CG Oncology, we believe that by having exceptionally talented individuals on our team who share our passion and enjoy working together, we can truly achieve our Vision and Mission to benefit patients around the world.

Every day we are making significant advancements across our multiple pipelines and are growing rapidly to meet the needs of our patients who cannot afford to wait to benefit from our novel immunotherapies. Please review this job posting and our Values and if they resonate with you and are what you expect from your organization and team, then we would like to hear from you.

About the role

The Associate Director, Market Access Marketing operationalizes CG Oncology's market access strategy into compliant, field-ready communications for the company's first commercial launch in oncology. The role owns the market access marketing content roadmap and its execution: payer, health system, and practice value communications, reimbursement and access tools, field enablement, agency and vendor management, and end-to-end ownership of the medical, legal, and regulatory (MLR) review process for market access materials, so assets are approved and deployed on the timeline the launch requires. This is a strategy-fluent role that sits where strategy bridges into execution.

This role suits a builder. It is a greenfield opportunity to shape the market access marketing capability from the ground up, helping refine the broader access strategy and translating it into launch execution.

The role works in close partnership with Brand Marketing across the full interface: integrating access messaging into the core brand materials, maintaining brand identity and visual consistency across access materials, and coordinating with omnichannel planning on placements and sequencing.

Essential Functions

Market Access Marketing Strategy & Content Roadmap

  • Refine and operationalize the market access marketing strategy and own the content roadmap and resource inventory sequenced to launch milestones.
  • Translate the access strategy into a clear message architecture and audience-tailored messaging across payer, health system, practice, channel, reimbursement, and patient-support audiences.
  • Maintain a live launch resource tracker covering every asset, owner, review status, approval date, and deployment milestone.

Brand Marketing Partnership

  • Partner closely with Brand Marketing to co-develop an integrated HCP message architecture, aligning access and brand messaging, campaign timing, and shared assets across the customer experience.
  • Serve as Market Access's primary interface into brand planning, so access considerations shape the HCP experience from the start; brand strategy ownership remains with Brand Marketing.
  • Maintain brand identity and visual consistency across all access materials, and coordinate with omnichannel planning on the placement, sequencing, and channel mix of access content.

MLR & Promotional Review Process Ownership

  • Serve as primary point of contact and process owner for market access materials in MLR review, owing to the end-to-end workflow: submission scheduling and routing, claims substantiation, comment consolidation and resolution, version control, and approval-timeline management.
  • Maintain a tracking system for real-time visibility into review status and approval dates; set submission standards and cadence, and coach agency and internal partners on MLR requirements before submission.

Payer, Health System & Practice Value Communications

  • Lead payer and organized-customer value communications, including the payer value story, objection handlers, coverage and formulary resources, and dossier pull-through materials, in partnership with HEOR and Medical Affairs, tailored for national and regional payers, PBMs, GPOs, IDNs, health systems, and pathway stakeholders.
  • Develop health systems and practice value communications that support access conversations at the site of care.
  • Equip the national and strategic account team with current, approved value resources and account-discussion guides.

Access, Reimbursement & Billing Education

  • Develop health system and practice-facing access materials: reimbursement guides, J-code and HCPCS coding and billing education, buy-and-bill economics, site-of-care considerations, and quick-start and office-staff resources.
  • Build patient-services and hub overview materials covering enrollment, benefit verification, affordability, and case management for HCPs and office staff.

Field Enablement & Training

  • Develop access-specific training, FAQs, and role-based pull-through tools for account directors, field reimbursement teams, and sales, in partnership with the field training function, so field teams can explain access, use approved resources correctly, answer objections compliantly, and escalate operational issues appropriately.

Agency, Vendor & Sponsorship Management

  • Manage the agency of record (AOR) and additional agency and vendor relationships as needs emerge: project briefs, timelines, SOWs, budgets, feedback consolidation, and deliverable quality.
  • Scope new work, evaluate and onboard new agencies and vendors, and manage budget tracking, SOWs, and vendor performance across the portfolio of partners.
  • Plan and manage access-relevant sponsorships and paid placements, including association and congress sponsorships and trade and access-channel placements, within the market access marketing budget, coordinating with Brand Marketing where placements intersect the broader HCP media plan.

Launch Readiness, Optimization & Cross-functional Alignment

  • Act as the access-message and enablement control point through launch and hypercare, and run the post-launch feedback loop from field, payer, and reimbursement insights into resource updates, training refreshes, and lifecycle and indication-expansion content.
  • Coordinate across Market Access, Payer Accounts, Patient Services, HEOR, Medical, Legal, Regulatory, Compliance, Brand Marketing, Field Training, Trade Operations, and Commercial Operations, ensuring all activities comply with Company policies, promotional-review standards, and approved product messaging.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree in marketing, business, or life sciences is preferred
  • 7+ years of professional experience, or equivalent, including experience in a pharmaceutical, biotech, or life sciences commercial role.
  • Commercial marketing experience required, including direct development of customer-facing materials; market access marketing or payer marketing experience strongly preferred.
  • Product launch experience strongly preferred, particularly development of payer, health system, and practice access materials.
  • Experience taking materials through MLR or promotional review; experience as the review process owner and with agency-of-record management strongly preferred.
  • Oncology or specialty/rare disease experience strongly preferred; urology or bladder cancer experience a plus.
  • Approximately 15 to 20% travel required.

Interview Process

Finalists will receive a sample monthly KPI report before the final interview. During the interview, you’ll discuss your priorities, recommendations, growth opportunities, and strategic decisions based on the data provided.

About Us

LifeMD is a leading provider of virtual primary care, telehealth, and specialized treatment programs serving hundreds of thousands of patients nationwide. Our vertically integrated platform combines 50-state licensed providers, in-house pharmacy and lab integrations, and proprietary technology that enables safe, high-quality, and affordable care.

At the heart of this transformation is our team of developers, engineers, and tech innovators building state-of-the-art systems that make healthcare smarter, faster, and more accessible. From architecting scalable backend systems to crafting intuitive user experiences, we are pushing boundaries every day.

Recognized as one of the fastest-growing healthcare tech companies (#166 on Deloitte Fast 500 in 2023), LifeMD is not just a healthcare company — it's a tech company revolutionizing healthcare.

About the Role

The VP, Operations & Patient Experience leads the teams that deliver care and support to every LifeMD patient. The role oversees about 150 people across clinical support operations (medical assistants, scheduling and clinical program management), the patient care center (customer service, care navigation, sales and quality assurance), and the operations function that keeps the business running (program management, procurement and inventory).

The VP serves as the central hub connecting every part of the business to the patient. Delivering high-quality care depends on ongoing collaboration with marketing, technology, finance, pharmacy and LifeMD's affiliated medical group: aligning patient support capacity with marketing's acquisition and retention plans, shaping the product and technology roadmap around what patients and care teams need, partnering with finance on budgets, KPIs and unit economics, and working with pharmacy and providers so every patient's care, from visit to medication, is seamless.

This is a hands-on operating role for a leader who has run clinical operations at scale. In the coming year, the priorities are using AI and automation to raise productivity across patient support, optimizing every patient touchpoint from onboarding through ongoing care, and lowering the cost of serving each patient.

Responsibilities

Cross-functional Partnership

  • Act as the operational hub between patient-facing teams and the rest of the business, so decisions across every function account for their impact on patient care.
  • Partner with marketing on demand forecasts, launches and retention programs, so staffing and support are ready for every patient.
  • Partner with technology and product to prioritize platform, workflow and AI improvements based on what patients and care teams need.
  • Partner with finance on budgets, operational KPIs and unit economics.
  • Partner with LifeMD's pharmacy on fulfillment, shipping and refills, so patients receive their medications reliably and on time.
  • Partner with LifeMD's affiliated medical group (PC) on clinical workflows, quality and handoffs between providers and care teams, so care delivery and patient support work as one.

Clinical Operations

  • Lead clinical support operations, including medical assistants, scheduling and clinical program management.
  • Partner with medical group leadership on provider capacity, utilization and coverage across sync and async care.
  • Manage clinical vendor relationships, contracts and transitions.

AI and Automation

  • Lead the adoption of AI and automation across patient support and clinical workflows, including AI agents in the patient care center.
  • Measure the impact of each deployment on productivity, quality and cost.

Cost and Unit Economics

  • Own the operations budget and deliver against annual cost targets.
  • Drive down the cost of serving each patient through workforce planning, productivity standards and vendor rationalization.
  • Set and report operational KPIs in partnership with finance.

Patient Care Center and Experience

  • Set the strategy and direction for the patient care center (customer service, care navigation, sales and quality assurance), working through its senior director and director, who lead the teams day to day.
  • Own patient experience metrics such as resolution, response times and satisfaction, and partner with the business GMs on the on-therapy patient experience.

Operations and Program Management

  • Run the program management office for cross-functional initiatives, keeping work on schedule and surfacing bottlenecks early.
  • Oversee procurement and inventory.

Leadership

  • Lead and develop a team of directors and senior managers, building a strong leadership bench.
  • Represent operations and patient experience with the executive team and with external vendors and partners.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of operations experience, including 5+ years leading multi-layer operations teams (leaders of managers) with large hourly or clinical support workforces.
  • Senior leadership experience in healthcare clinical operations, ideally in virtual care, telehealth or a multi-state provider group.
  • Hands-on experience deploying AI or automation in operations, with measurable results.
  • Proven cost discipline: has owned a large operating budget and reduced costs without sacrificing quality or patient experience.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including with executive and board audiences.

Preferred

  • A clinical background, such as RN, NP or PA, or a clinical operations leadership track.
  • Experience leading a contact center at scale.
  • Familiarity with multi-state licensing and the regulatory environment for virtual care.

  • Retirement Plan (401k, Roth 401k)

jobs.excerpt: Career Category Supply ChainJob Description Defying Imagination at Amgen At Amgen, every team member contributes to a mission that extends beyond individual roles: serving patients worldwide.
jobs.description:
Career Category

Supply Chain

Job Description

Defying Imagination at Amgen

At Amgen, every team member contributes to a mission that extends beyond individual roles: serving patients worldwide. This shared commitment drives our pursuit of excellence and innovation and supports Amgen’s position as a global biotechnology leader. Our collaborative culture enables us to research, manufacture, and deliver products that reach more than 10 million patients around the world. If you are seeking a career with purpose, Amgen offers an opportunity to make a meaningful difference.

Live

What you will do

Amgen is one of the world’s leading independent biotechnology companies. For over 4 decades, Amgen has pioneered biotechnology breakthroughs, to bring state-of-the-art medicines from laboratory to the patient. Amgen has not only discovered and developed innovative human therapeutics, but has invested in cutting edge manufacturing capability and support services to deliver these exciting therapies to medical teams around the world. Japan and Asia Pacific (JAPAC) is the fastest growing region in Amgen. Now we are hiring a Senior Manager, Illicit Trade, Theft, Risk & Supplier Assurance – JAPAC based out of Singapore or Malaysia or Thailand.

Live

What you will do

Accountabilities:

Reporting to the Senior Director, Product Security, within Global Security (GS), the Senior Manager, Illicit Trade, Theft, Risk & Supplier Assurance – JAPAC will execute on regional efforts to protect patients and Amgen products from external threats across the regulated supply chain and illicit markets.

The role covers supply chain security, illicit trade, and brand protection, with a focus on threats such as diversion, theft, counterfeiting, and unauthorized marketing of Amgen products. The Senior Manager will direct regional incident response, investigations, and remediation for the region, while coordinating with global Product Security colleagues and partners across Amgen.

The role will develop and implement regional strategies, policies, procedures, and standards in partnership with key stakeholders. It will also work with industry groups, government agencies, law enforcement, health authorities, suppliers, and other external partners to strengthen product security and patient safety across APAC.

Responsibilities:

  • Support Product Security efforts across APAC to protect Amgen’s product portfolio from external threats, including counterfeiting, diversion, theft, illicit generics, and unauthorized marketing.
  • Provide support for regional supply chain security initiatives in partnership with Supply Chain Security and Operations.
  • Support and facilitate cross-functional governance with representatives from Global Security, Legal, Operations, Supply Chain, Legal, Corporate Audit, and other relevant functions.
  • Define and implement regional strategies for threat monitoring, incident reporting and response, counterfeit deterrence and authentication, enforcement, and remediation.
  • Collaborate with the Product Security Intelligence team to monitor physical and online markets for suspicious activity involving Amgen products.
  • Investigate suspected or confirmed illicit activity affecting Amgen products, working with internal stakeholders and, as appropriate, law enforcement, health authorities, and industry partners.
  • Assess threats and vulnerabilities affecting active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), materials, finished products, returns, sites, and the regulated supply chain; develop and implement mitigation plans.
  • Support the development and use of tools, systems, and security technologies to monitor threats and strengthen protection across the supply chain.
  • Provide Amgen leaders with metrics, key performance indicators, and reports on emerging and ongoing threats in the region.
  • Develop and deliver education and awareness initiatives for internal and external audiences.
  • Represent Amgen in relevant industry and government working groups, task forces, and committees, and advocate for the company’s interests.
  • Coordinate the regional supply chain security audit framework and program in partnership with internal stakeholders.
  • Facilitate proactive, for-cause, and pre-contract security audits of vendors, suppliers, and business partners.
  • Build and maintain relationships with law enforcement, emergency services, health authorities, and other relevant agencies to support effective communication and response.
  • Coordinate with regional and functional directorates across Global Security and with global Product Security colleagues to align efforts.
  • Select, train, and manage contract workers and consultants, as needed. This may include drafting requests for proposals, making recommendations, negotiating contracts, providing direction, and reviewing deliverables and invoices.
  • Conduct and manage internal and external investigations as needed, maintaining appropriate chain of custody and evidence management.

Win

What we expect of you

Qualifications and Expectations

  • Extensive knowledge of illicit supply chains, supply chain security, and effective investigation and remediation practices.
  • Demonstrated experience conducting or managing investigations involving organized criminal activity.
  • Expertise in chain of custody and evidence management.
  • Strong working knowledge of GxP environments, including GMP and GDP.
  • Experience with supply chain security standards and programs, such as TAPA and CTPAT.
  • Experience conducting or supporting supply chain security audits and assessments, identifying control gaps, and recommending corrective actions.
  • Proficiency with security systems and the ability to assess their effectiveness, recognize limitations, and recommend improvements.
  • Sound judgment and the ability to act swiftly in a dynamic threat environment.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills, including the ability to gather and evaluate information and prepare clear, concise reports.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple tasks, work well under pressure, and communicate effectively with leadership and executive stakeholders.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including consensus-building, presentation, and professional writing abilities.
  • Ability to influence, engage, and inspire teams, and to build effective relationships across all levels of the organization.
  • Experience working with key partners as part of an Incident Management Team.
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently while collaborating across a complex organization.
  • Commitment to the highest standards of integrity, compliance, and confidentiality.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree and seven to nine years of experience in private-sector global or corporate supply chain security, enforcement, investigations, or related program management; biopharmaceutical industry experience preferred.
  • Experience working across APAC markets and with regional law enforcement, health authorities, industry groups, or other relevant partners.
  • Supervisory law enforcement and/or military experience desirable but not required.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
  • Willingness to travel approximately 20% of the time, including overnight and weekend travel.
  • Professional security or investigative certifications, such as Certified Protection Professional (CPP), Physical Security Professional (PSP), or Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE), preferred but not required.

Thrive

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, so we work to care for our teammates’ professional

and personal growth and well-being.

· Vast opportunities to learn and move up and across our global organization

· Diverse and inclusive community of belonging, where teammates are empowered to bring ideas to the table and act

· Generous Total Rewards Plan comprising health, finance and wealth, work/life balance, and career benefits

Ready to be a Titan?
As a CSM Team Customer Success Manager, you play a crucial role in ensuring our customers’ success and satisfaction. You’ll be responsible for building strong relationships with our customers, understanding their needs, and empowering them to set big goals with ServiceTitan as the ultimate tool to achieve the extraordinary in their business.

You will serve as the preferred CSM to a designated list of customers assigned to the CSM Team and partner with these customers to optimize their use of ServiceTitan to drive business results. In doing so you will be a key driver ensuring retention and growth of ServiceTitan’s revenue. You will interact with these customers both as their success point of contact and by leveraging tools to consistently engage in proactive touchpoints to continue pacing their journey with ServiceTitan.

As a member of the CSM Team, you will be passionate about delivering customer transformations and answering questions like:

  • What’s the most valuable transformation I can offer my customer?

  • What’s the fastest way I can deliver that value to them?

  • How can my communication make their life easier?

  • How can I build a long-term relationship with them and truly make them feel at home with the ServiceTitan family?

What you'll do:

  • Account Ownership: Act as a “preferred CSM” to approximately 100 accounts assigned to CSM Team, serving as the main point of contact for the customer, our executive team, and any internal partners regarding these accounts

  • Relationship Management: commit to exceeding customer expectations, maintain long-term, senior-level relationships with your account’s POCs, take ownership of challenging customer situations, manage them effectively, and see them through to resolution

  • Drive Value and ROI: guide customers to maximize their business through an intimate understanding of the ServiceTitan platform, with the ability to resolve complex issues and create comprehensive, customer-facing value plans to demonstrate ROI of ServiceTitan to key stakeholders

  • Reactive Engagement: act as the primary point of contact for customer inquiries and issues, working closely with internal teams to drive timely resolutions

  • Proactive Engagement: Proactively reach out to customers through phone calls and written communication to understand their goals, and roadblocks, and ensure their needs are met Utilize reactive and proactive outreach in addition to developing strategies to work with and speak to all customers in your care on a regular cadence

  • Data Analysis: Utilize data to track customer success metrics and leverage user engagement data to design targeted campaigns that proactively engage with customers who are not utilizing key features of ServiceTitan vital to achieving their desired outcomes (digital success campaigns, remote workshops, proactive customer calls, etc.)

  • Mitigate Escalations and Churn Risk: Monitor account health and flag risk behaviors to engage with customers proactively before escalations or churn risks arise in addition to owning and defusing challenging customer situations, should they arise, turning them into an opportunity for positive outcomes and increased customer loyalty

  • Facilitate Resolutions: Approach all customer interactions with a positive, can-do attitude, identify customer pain points, and work with cross-functional teams to provide effective solutions,

  • Provide Product Training: Provide training and guidance to customers, ensuring they utilize our software effectively, drive customer engagement in webinars, ember, spark or community

  • Create Promoters: Seek ways to improve customer satisfaction and raise customer advocacy (NPS), by finding new ways to continuously improve our customers’ experience, both in the use of our product and through improved internal processes

  • Project Management: break down complex issues and stay highly organized in managing customer accounts, ensure timely follow-ups, and document interactions

  • Gross Revenue Retention: Monitor customer usage and engage in renewal discussions (both core and pro products) to ensure long-term satisfaction, and account retention and maximize up-selling and cross-selling opportunities

  • Skills in product training, and comfortable “re-re-selling” the customer on ServiceTitan

  • Strong de-escalation and problem-solving skills.

  • Highly skilled in written and verbal communication

  • Proven ability to multi-task and manage multiple projects at a time with strong attention to detail

  • Self-starter that thrives in an entrepreneurial, fast-paced environment with the demonstrated capacity to lead, motivate and work well with others

  • Quick thinking, fast learning, and solution-oriented, with an ability to think outside the box and see things through to resolution

  • Self-motivated and able to work effectively in a remote setting

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented

  • Project management skills and experience are a plus.

  • Exceptional organizational and time management skills

  • Empathetic with a customer-focused approach

  • Passion for phone-based customer interactions

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Project management

  • Sales

  • Data or Business performance analytics

  • Operational use of SalesForce, Gainsight, and Tableau

  • Highly proficient in ServiceTitan workflows and best practices

  • Able to work PST/MST hours

Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. jobs.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox CorporationUnder the FOX banner, we produce and distribute content through some of the world’s leading and most valued brands, including: FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations and Tubi Media Group. We empower a diverse range of creators to imagine and develop culturally significant content, while building an organization that thrives on creative ideas, operational expertise and strategic thinking.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Want to be the growth partner to chart-topping podcasts like The Huberman Lab, Pod Save America and My Favorite Murder? Great! We’re looking for a Creator Success Specialist for Supercast.


Supercast powers premium subscriptions for the world’s top podcasts and creators. We help creators like Huberman Lab, This American Life, Kill Tony, and My Favorite Murder build direct relationships with their audiences and generate recurring revenue through exclusive content and community.


Following our recent acquisition by Red Seat Ventures (a Fox Corp. company), Supercast is entering a new phase of investment and expansion. Building on our success with podcast subscriptions, we’re evaluating a broader toolkit for podcast-first creators, as well as new ways for creators to engage and monetize their audiences.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Creator Success Specialistto help shape this next chapter, reporting to our Creator Success Lead. You’ll be responsible for onboarding VIP creators to make as much money as possible, as quickly as possible, as well as working with existing creators to break through ceilings. The foundation is set, with existing playbooks, a strong industry reputation, and a tight-knit team that is ready to support you every step of the way.

We believe the next generation of media companies will be creator-led, and our mission is to build the operating system for creator-led media businesses.


WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Onboard VIP podcasters by understanding their requirements, guiding them through a personalized launch plan and removing friction and ambiguity wherever possible.
  • Serve as a strategic growth partner to VIP podcasters, acting as an extension of their team. Proactively audit their sales funnel and recommend campaign and promotion strategies. Take ownership of implementation by executing approved initiatives on the creator’s behalf, from setup through launch and beyond.
  • Become an expert in the business of podcasting and a true partner to our creators. Through your expertise, you will be able to find opportunities to make the lives of our creators better.
  • Solve technical questions, with assistance from other team members, including those on topics like plugins, embeds, and API & zapier integrations.
  • Be the customer champion, liaising with internal teams to ensure a great creator experience and sharing insights that will make our product even better.
  • Build customer-facing content and processes to make the creator experience even better.

WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 3+ years experience in customer success, account management or client-facing project management.
  • A natural advisor, who has previously become an expert in something and then used that knowledge to help others in their journey
  • Strong all-round expertise in selling digital goods, ideally with experience in areas like subscription, email marketing, content/social marketing and product launches.
  • A strong project manager who can run a tight ship and is not afraid to put their foot down when needed.
  • An owner mentality, someone who wears many hats, with a strong bias towards action. The details are important to you and you have a healthy dose of paranoia.
  • A tremendous appetite for learning. You’ll become an expert in the business of podcasts, ranging from content creation to marketing, in order to successfully coach creators and make their lives better.
  • Persuasive communication skills, with a knack for driving results, aligning people and making complex things sound easy.
  • Passion for the creator economy.You’ve witnessed the rise of creator-led media and are excited about shaping the tools for the most successful creators in the ecosystem.

We’re especially interested in candidates who have built products used by creators, media companies, or subscription businesses.


WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING AT SUPERCAST

  • You’ll be directly shaping how podcast creators build sustainable businesses with their audiences, working directly with some of the most influential voices in podcasting.
  • Following our acquisition by Red Seat Ventures (a Fox Corp. company), we’re investing heavily in product and expanding the platform to support the next generation of creator tools.

jobs.title: Conseiller Commercial en formation - Freelance H/F
jobs.excerpt: Fondée en 2019 à Paris, Atelier PG forme à la pâtisserie et au cake design des personnes qui ont décidé de changer de vie, en grande majorité des femmes en reconversion.
jobs.description:
Fondée en 2019 à Paris, Atelier PG forme à la pâtisserie et au cake design des personnes qui ont décidé de changer de vie, en grande majorité des femmes en reconversion. Notre formation phare, le CAP Pâtissier, se suit 100 % à distance ou en format hybride, avec une partie pratique dans notre atelier parisien.

Plus de 4 000 élèves formés, une note de 5,0 sur plus de 1 200 avis Google, plus de 94 000 abonnés sur Instagram et une communauté, la PG Family, qui se retrouve chaque semaine en live. Chez nous, on ne vend pas seulement un diplôme : on apporte de la confiance, de la motivation, un réseau et beaucoup d'entraide, pour que le projet de chaque élève devienne réalité.

Chaque semaine, des femmes nous contactent parce qu'elles rêvent de faire de la pâtisserie leur métier. Beaucoup hésitent : est-ce le bon moment ? Vont-elles y arriver ? Comment financer leur formation ? Le premier échange avec nous compte énormément : c'est souvent là qu'elles osent se lancer. C'est là que tu entres en jeu. Pour accompagner notre croissance, nous recrutons deux Conseillers commerciaux formation (H/F) qui les aideront à prendre la bonne décision, avec écoute, honnêteté et énergie.

🎯 Tes missions:

En tant que Conseiller(ère) commercial(e), tu seras en charge d'accompagner les personnes qui ont demandé un rendez-vous jusqu'à une décision claire, puis jusqu'à leur entrée en formation.

Tu travailleras en lien direct avec Natacha, notre Directrice des opérations et avec l'équipe : setting, acquisition et CSM qui accompagnent nos élèves.

1. Préparer tes rendez-vous

  • Tu reçois des rendez-vous entrants : des personnes qui ont rempli notre formulaire, souvent pré-qualifiées par notre équipe de setting. Pas de prospection à froid.

  • Tu lis la note de passage avant chaque rendez-vous pour repartir de là, sans refaire toute la découverte.

2. Mener des rendez-vous qui aident à décider

  • Tu mènes au minimum 10 rendez-vous par semaine, en visio ou au téléphone (45 minutes en moyenne).

  • Tu fais parler la personne de son projet, de ses envies et de ses peurs, avant de parler prix.

  • Tu réponds à toutes ses questions sur la formation : contenu, stages obligatoires, calendrier d'examens, déroulé du CAP.

  • Tu conclus chaque rendez-vous par une décision ou une prochaine étape datée. Et quand ce n'est pas le bon moment pour elle, tu sais le lui dire.

3. Trouver le bon financement, chiffres à l'appui

  • Tu fais le calcul en direct avec la personne : solde CPF, reste à charge, mensualité.

  • Tu l'orientes vers le financement adapté à sa situation (CPF, France Travail, reclassement, autofinancement…), en cherchant toujours la solution la plus juste pour elle. Le traitement administratif des dossiers est automatisé : ton rôle est de bien l'expliquer.

  • Tu impliques le ou la conjoint(e) quand la décision se prend à deux.

4. Suivre chaque dossier jusqu'à l'entrée en formation

  • Tu restes disponible après le rendez-vous pour répondre aux questions, par WhatsApp (écrit ou vocal) ou par téléphone.

  • Tu envoies un récapitulatif WhatsApp le jour même. Quand la personne n'a pas encore pris sa décision, tu conviens avec elle d'une prochaine étape datée et tu la recontactes au bon moment.

  • Tu tiens le CRM à jour et tu notes l'issue de chaque rendez-vous sous 24 h.

5. Rendre compte et améliorer

  • Tu présentes tes chiffres chaque semaine : rendez-vous, ventes, rendez-vous perdus et pourquoi.

  • Tu proposes des améliorations : un meilleur message, une relance, une idée d'opération… tu es acteur(rice) de la performance commerciale.

  • Tu contribues à construire avec nous des pratiques de vente écrites et communes à toute l'équipe.

🔎 Profil recherché:

💼 Expérience:

  • Tu as au moins un an d'expérience en closing, ou deux ans en vente B2C, en visio ou au téléphone, avec des résultats concrets à présenter.

  • Tu connais tes chiffres et tu peux les partager avec leur base : rendez-vous tenus, taux de conversion, panier moyen, encaissé, rétractations.

  • Tu as déjà vendu un produit qui demande de comprendre le détail : une formation, un diplôme, une offre avec plusieurs options de financement, ou un produit haut de gamme vendu à un public féminin.

  • Tu viens de la vente terrain ? C'est bienvenu : ta connaissance de l'humain compte plus que le secteur.

  • La vente de formations certifiantes ou financées par le CPF est un vrai plus.

  • Tu as toi-même vécu une reconversion, tu as un parcours dans les métiers du soin ou de l'accompagnement, tu es passionné(e) de pâtisserie… Et si tu as été élève chez nous, c'est un vrai atout.

🔨 Compétences:

  • Tu t'appropries vite un produit riche (la formation, le CAP, les financements) et tu sais l'expliquer simplement.

  • Tu es à l'aise avec les chiffres : tu calcules un reste à charge et une mensualité en direct, sans erreur, et sans jamais proposer plus que ce qui est raisonnable pour la personne.

  • Tu sais mener une découverte, traiter les objections avec bienveillance et amener à une décision claire.

  • Tu es rigoureux(se) dans ton suivi : CRM à jour, relances datées, aucune personne laissée sans prochaine étape.

  • Tu es à l'aise avec les outils digitaux : CRM (nous utilisons Pipedrive, une expérience sur un autre CRM suffit), WhatsApp, Slack, Notion, Google Meet.

  • Tu utilises déjà l'IA, ou tu as très envie de t'en servir, pour préparer tes rendez-vous et tes relances.

  • Tu écris avec chaleur et positivité : avec nos prospectes comme avec nos élèves, on cultive une relation proche et conviviale, à l'écrit comme à l'oral.

🤝🏻 Qualités personnelles:

  • Tu as un tempérament solaire, souriant et énergique : les personnes se sentent à l'aise avec toi dès les premières minutes.

  • Tu es à l'écoute et empathique : tu comprends les doutes de quelqu'un qui hésite à changer de vie, et ses contraintes (vie de famille, emploi en parallèle).

  • Tu motives sans forcer : tu rassures et tu montres que c'est possible, en t'appuyant sur les parcours d'anciennes élèves.

  • Tu es honnête : tu préfères dire « ce n'est pas le moment » plutôt que signer une vente qui ne tiendra pas.

  • Tu considères chaque personne avec le même respect, quels que soient son métier, son parcours ou sa façon de s'exprimer.

  • Tu es moteur : tu portes tes résultats, tu rends des comptes sans qu'on te le demande et tu arrives avec des solutions plutôt qu'avec des problèmes.

  • Tu es curieux(se) : tu as envie de comprendre dans le détail ce que tu vends.

  • Tu es fiable et tu t'engages dans la durée.

❌ Cette mission n'est pas pour toi si :

  • Tu vends avec de la fausse urgence, des promesses que tu ne peux pas tenir ou de la pression.

  • Tu préfères réciter un script plutôt que comprendre le produit et la personne en face de toi.

  • Tu juges vite les prospects, sans chercher de solution avec eux.

  • Tu n'as pas de chiffres à partager sur tes résultats.

  • Tu fonctionnes par « challenges » : quelques jours à fond, puis plus aucune disponibilité pendant une ou deux semaines. Chez nous, les rendez-vous arrivent tous les jours.

  • Tu n'es disponible ni en milieu de journée ni en fin de journée, quand nos prospectes le sont.

  • Chaque nouvel outil est pour toi un obstacle.

👉 Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • Tu donneras du sens à tes ventes : tu aideras des personnes à oser changer de vie et à réaliser un projet qui leur tient à cœur.

  • Tu vendras un produit reconnu, noté 5,0 sur plus de 1 200 avis, avec 93 % de réussite au CAP en 2026, porté par une marque forte et une communauté très engagée.

  • Tu recevras des rendez-vous entrants : pas de prospection à froid.

  • Tu vendras sans pression ni manipulation, dans le respect des personnes. Un beau produit, bien compris, se vend plus facilement.

  • Tu seras formé(e) avant tes premiers rendez-vous : deux semaines de formation au produit et au financement, avec un programme jour par jour.

  • Tu feras partie de l'équipe : canaux Slack, réunion d'équipe mensuelle, team buildings, événements avec nos élèves (brunchs, remises de diplôme).

  • Tu rejoindras une entreprise en pleine croissance avec de nouveaux produits à venir.

  • Tu organiseras ton emploi du temps librement, 100 % à distance. Et si tu habites en Île-de-France, tu seras le ou la bienvenu(e) à l'atelier.

📅 Modalités :

  • Type de contrat : Freelance

  • Temps de travail : l'équivalent d'un mi-temps au minimum (environ 15 à 20 h par semaine), avec au moins 10 rendez-vous réalisés par semaine.

  • Disponibilités : des créneaux en milieu de journée et en fin de journée, quand nos prospectes sont disponibles. Le week-end est un plus.

  • Organisation : 100 % à distance, possibilité de venir à l'atelier à Paris

  • Démarrage : dès que possible

  • Rémunération : à la commission

⚒️ Process de recrutement :

  1. Candidature via formulaire

  2. Entretien visio avec l'équipe Golden Hire

  3. Mise en situation

  4. Prise de références

  5. Entretien final avec la COO, Natacha, à l'atelier ou en visio

Tu te reconnais dans ce profil et tu as envie d'aider des femmes à vivre de leur passion ? Postule dès maintenant, nous avons hâte de découvrir ton profil !

jobs.excerpt: GaggleAMP is a profitable SaaS company that has led the employee-advocacy category for over a decade.
jobs.description:
GaggleAMP is a profitable SaaS company that has led the employee-advocacy category for over a decade. We're hiring our second Account Executive: a full-cycle closer who builds their own pipeline, qualifies hard, sells on value and holds price.

The role

You'll be our second seller and the benchmark for the sales team that follows.

What you'll own

  • A $1M new-ARR quota. At our deal sizes, that's roughly 2 to 4 new customers a month. Marketing sends some leads, but about half of your pipeline will come from your own prospecting.
  • Qualification. Confirm fit, find the person who controls the budget and build a value case before you invest your time. Walk away quickly when those aren't there.
  • Value-led discovery. Tie our impact to the buyer's own numbers, such as pipeline generated from social or paid spend we offset, before price comes up.
  • Price. We don't discount. You sell at list price and let poor-fit deals go.
  • An honest forecast. Deals move forward when the buyer does something real, and your CRM stays current.
  • Clean handoffs with Marketing, Implementation and Customer Success.

Why join

  • Real ownership of your pipeline, your qualification calls and your deal strategy.
  • A value story that wins and real pricing power, plus a sales framework you'll help shape.
  • A profitable company. No venture clock, no death-march growth targets, and a category we've led for over a decade.

How you work

  • You disqualify without drama. A clean no is a good outcome, and you can tell us about a recent deal you walked away from.
  • You build value cases in dollars from what the buyer tells you. When a buyer has no hard number, you can still put a dollar value on reach and traffic.
  • You tie price to value instead of defending it or offering a discount.
  • You advance deals on buyer commitment, not because a call went well or a demo got booked.
  • You understand the importance of getting to the decision maker to close deals.
  • You get leverage from your tools. You use AI tools (such as ChatGPT or Claude) and prospecting tools (such as Apollo) every week to sell smarter.

Location

Fully remote within the United States.

Requirements

Requirements

  • You have carried and closed a new-business quota, running deals yourself from discovery to signature.
  • You are familiar with AI tools and use them in your selling every week.

Nice to have

  • You have sold SaaS or subscription software.
  • You have sold at a small or lean company and have sourced your own pipeline. Here, we target a 50/50 inbound/outbound split.

Benefits

Compensation

$160,000+ OTE with uncapped commission.

Benefits

  • Medical, Dental & Vision insurance (after 30 days).
  • Matching 401K (after 6 months).
  • Join an exciting and dynamic company with a strong leadership team and culture.
  • Grow professionally by gaining powerful experience managing relationships in the digital marketing space.
  • Have the opportunity to contribute and directly impact the growth and direction of the company you work for.

GaggleAMP provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.
