jobs.title: PPC Marketing Specialist
jobs.excerpt: Everyone can run a search campaign.  Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.
jobs.description:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like

  • Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
  • Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
  • Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
  • Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
  • Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
  • Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
  • Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
  • Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
  • Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
  • Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

You are a fit if

  • You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
  • You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
  • You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
  • You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
  • You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
  • You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.
  • Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.

You are not a fit if

  • "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
  • You want to be told what to do this week.
  • You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
  • You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.

Benefits

Why this role is exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

You will own NetSuite OneWorld across roughly 20 global subsidiaries - alongside FloQast for close management and Zip for intake-to-procure - as the dedicated domain owner protecting how our accounting and finance processes work end to end.
This is not a reactive ticket-taking desk. Finance and business teams will bring you requests ("add a custom field", "change this approval rule", "reopen a closed period"). Your job is to understand the accounting flow behind the request, spot when a proposed change will break downstream revenue recognition, reconciliations, or audit controls, and guide stakeholders to the right process and configuration fix.

You do not need to be a software developer to succeed here - you have a dedicated internal software engineering team (Fusion) within Business Systems Engineering that builds and maintains heavy custom code and cross-system integrations, and a Business Intelligence team that models analytical reporting in BigQuery rather than crowding NetSuite with brittle reports. Reporting to the Manager of Enterprise Systems, you will have real room to shape how global finance operations scale across DoiT.

jobs.description:
We're hiring a Business & Data Analyst to support the consolidation of acquired screening and adjacent HR tech businesses into Veremark. You'll work under the direction of our M&A PMO, delivering analysis and data tasks against our established integration playbook.

Veremark is a background screening and workforce trust technology company. Employers use us to run pre-employment checks, to verify criminal records, right to work, references, identity, credit and more, through our platform and integrate us with their ATS and HR systems.

You'll sit in the PMO's lean core team, taking direction from the Program Director and supporting the operations, HR and finance leads, product and engineering. Your job is the data: understanding what each acquired platform holds, getting it into Veremark correctly, and showing it's right. You'll also make each integration quicker than the last, by building reusable mappings, queries and checks.

What you'll do

Profile and map

  • Profile each acquired platform's data with SQL: volumes, client usage, active vs dormant accounts, data quality and the edge cases the documentation misses.

  • Build and maintain field-level mappings between the two data models, covering check types, client configurations, candidate records and history.

  • Raise gaps between what the source holds and what Veremark needs, with evidence, so the product team can decide.

Migrate and prove

  • Validate and reconcile each client cohort before and after migration: counts, key values, statuses and outcomes.

  • Log every difference and trace it to a cause: the source data, the mapping or the expectation.

  • Prepare the evidence pack that lets a cohort be signed off, and support UAT with the people who check it.

Integrations and commercial data

  • Keep an inventory of each client's ATS/HRIS integrations, API consumers and webhooks, and their migration status.

  • Map products, price books and contract terms, and help Finance reconcile billing between each acquired platform and Veremark.

Report

  • Own the migration dashboards for every integration in progress and contribute to the Programme Director's weekly update.

  • Give Customer Success and Sales the client data they need to plan each move.

  • Use AI to work faster: query data with prompts, draft and review SQL, generate first-pass mappings and documentation, and automate routine checks, always verifying results against the source.

Make each integration faster

  • Build a reusable library of profiling and reconciliation SQL, mapping templates and sign-off checklists.

  • Feed what you learn back into the integration playbook after each deal.

  • Where needed, review a target company's data before a deal closes, so we know what we're taking on.

Must have

    • 3+ years as a data analyst, with hands-on work on at least one data migration, platform consolidation or system implementation. Tell us what you moved, how much, and what went wrong.

    • Strong SQL: joins, CTEs, window functions and aggregation, used to profile unfamiliar data and reconcile a source against a target.

    • Confident with AI and new tools: you already use AI in your daily work, for example querying data with prompts, drafting and reviewing SQL with an LLM, or using AI features in your BI tool. You know where it saves time, and you check what it produces against the data.

    • Data mapping and validation: you've written field-level mappings, tested migrated data against them and investigated the differences.

    • Reporting: dashboards in Looker, Metabase or similar that non-technical people use.

    • Enough BA craft to work with the product team: documenting current and future state, writing clear requirements, and supporting UAT.

    • Clear communication: you can explain a data problem to a client success manager and a finance lead.

    • Comfortable working to a playbook: you follow an agreed process and flag what doesn't fit, rather than reinventing it, and help improve it after each deal.

Nice to have

    • Python for data cleansing and profiling

    • Experience with billing, pricing or contract data, or with systems like NetSuite or a CRM

    • Background in HR tech, background screening, fintech or another regulated industry

    • Familiarity with ATS/HRIS platforms such as Workday, Greenhouse or Bullhorn, and with APIs and webhooks

    • Working knowledge of GDPR, data residency and audit evidence

    • Previous post-acquisition or post-merger integration work

We are an all-remote organisation with ~200+ people spread across the world. We value Trust, Integrity, Data and Experience in everything we do - from the way we collaborate to the products we create.

We’re focused on transforming the industry while partnering with many of the leading technology platforms in the People & Talent ecosystem.

And we’re growing fast. Having recently been ranked in Deloitte’s Tech Fast 50 for the second year running, we’re looking for brilliant people, fast thinkers and passionate change-drivers to join our expanding team.

What We Offer:

  • A supportive, team-driven culture focused on collaboration and excellence.
  • Structured onboarding, tools, and resources to help you succeed.
  • Opportunities for career growth within the Candidate Support function.
  • Remote work
  • A chance to directly impact the candidate journey in a meaningful way

Veremark is a remote-first HR tech scale-up on a mission to help the world trust faster.

We started with background and reference checking, pioneering an entirely new approach through Verepass - a blockchain solution which facilitates instant verification by enabling candidates to own, manage, and share their securely-held and verified career credentials.

We have recently launched our second product - a Whistleblowing platform with end-to-end encryption enabling employees to report issues safely and anonymously.

But this is just the beginning. Join us and become part of the journey using technology to help the world trust faster.

jobs.description:
About Sadie Hotels

Sadie is building voice AI for hotels. Sadie Voice AI answers guest calls 24/7, handles routine inquiries and takes bookings through integrations with hotel systems. We're headquartered in Montreal, part of Valsoft, and work with hospitality businesses in international markets.

We're looking for a Business Development Manager to win new customers across North America, with a focus on the West Coast. It's a full-cycle sales role selling mainly to independent hotels, hotel management companies and regional hotel groups.

You'll build your own pipeline, run consultative sales conversations, give product demos and take opportunities through to close. You'll work closely with Sales Leadership, Marketing, Partnerships, Product and Customer Success.

AI should be part of how you sell. Use it to research accounts, prepare for calls and write outreach. You're responsible for the quality of the result.

What we value

  • Sound judgment about which deals to pursue.
  • Owning your number and finishing work without being chased.
  • Understanding how hotels make money and caring about results.
  • Curiosity about what a prospect actually needs.
  • The honesty to call a deal at risk early, including your own.

What you'll do

Win new business

Prospect and qualify new opportunities through outbound outreach, inbound leads, industry relationships, events and partner referrals. Build relationships with hotel owners, general managers, operations and revenue leaders, and other decision-makers.

Run discovery conversations to understand each prospect's operational problems and commercial priorities. Give demos that show what Sadie does for direct bookings, operational efficiency and guest experience. Write proposals, negotiate commercial terms and close. Meet or beat your individual sales and revenue targets.

The hotel buys Sadie, but the guest is the caller. A deal that oversells what the product does today costs the hotel on every bad call, so the business case you build has to hold up after go-live.

Own the full sales cycle

Take opportunities from first outreach and qualification through proposal, negotiation and close. Keep a healthy, well-qualified pipeline in HubSpot, with accurate records, next steps and forecasts.

Work with leadership on pricing, deal structure and commercial strategy. Hand each new customer over cleanly to the implementation and Customer Success teams.

Develop the North American market

Identify high-potential regions, hotel segments, management companies and buyer profiles. Build territory plans and targeted account strategies.

Build relationships across the North American hospitality community and represent Sadie at conferences, trade shows and networking events.

Work across the business

Work with Marketing and Partnerships on campaigns, events, integration launches and lead generation. Work with Product and Customer Success to answer prospect questions and help customers succeed. Help improve Sadie's sales playbooks, messaging and processes.

What you'll bring

  • 3+ years of B2B sales experience.
  • A record of running the full sales cycle and closing new business.
  • Experience selling to independent hotels, hotel management companies or regional hotel groups.
  • A solid understanding of hotel operations, commercial priorities and how hotels buy.
  • Confidence running discovery calls and demos with senior decision-makers.
  • Strong prospecting, relationship-building, negotiation and closing skills.
  • You're organized and self-directed, and you work well where things move fast and you own the outcome.
  • Experience managing pipeline and forecasting in a CRM such as HubSpot.
  • You're comfortable traveling within North America for customer meetings, conferences and industry events.
  • Professional fluency in English.
  • You use AI tools with judgment and check what they produce.

Useful experience

  • Sales experience in hospitality SaaS, hotel technology, travel technology or at an OTA
  • An established network in the North American hotel industry
  • Selling a PMS, CRS, channel manager, revenue management platform, booking engine or other hospitality technology
  • Understanding how PMS, CRS, channel managers, booking engines and revenue management platforms work together
  • Talking through integrations, data flows and system capabilities with operational and technical stakeholders

Who will enjoy this role

You like building your own pipeline and want to own a territory. When a general manager says their front desk already handles the phones, you ask how many calls go unanswered at 11 p.m. and what those bookings are worth.

In one week you might prospect a management company's operations lead, demo Sadie to an independent hotel's owner, work through a pricing question with leadership and spend two days at a hospitality conference.

You'll work remotely, mostly on your own, with a quota to hit. The West Coast is a priority market, and much of the pipeline is yours to build.

Why this role matters

Sadie is building voice AI for hotels. Hotels run with small teams and lose bookings and upsells to calls nobody answers. Sadie answers those calls and has a clear effect on both operations and revenue.

North America is a priority growth market. You'll own a meaningful part of it, work directly with leadership, and help shape Sadie's North American go-to-market strategy. There's room to take on more as Sadie grows.

Genau diese Mischung macht dich für unsere Teilnehmenden glaubwürdig.

Aufgaben

So sieht deine Woche aus

  • Dienstag bis Donnerstag, 9:00–12:00 Uhr – Unterricht: Du unterrichtest live online im virtuellen Klassenraum nach unserem fertigen Lehrplan. Du erklärst KI-Tools und Automatisierungen am Beispiel des Versicherungsalltags und zeigst live, wie es geht.

  • Dienstag bis Donnerstag, 13:00–15:30 Uhr – Lernbegleitung: In der Selbstlernphase bist du Ansprechpartner:in. Du beantwortest Fragen, hilfst bei Übungen, gibst Feedback auf Praxisaufgaben und merkst früh, wenn jemand hängt.

  • Montag und Freitag – flexibel: Zeit zur Vorbereitung. Du arbeitest dich in Themen ein, ergänzt Beispiele, hältst Inhalte aktuell und erledigst die Dokumentation für die Maßnahme.

Was du konkret machst

  • Unterrichten: Du setzt den Lehrplan um (Präsentation steht).

  • Motivieren: Du machst Mut, feierst Fortschritte und sorgst dafür, dass deine Gruppe dranbleibt, auch wenn es mal zäh wird.

  • Begleiten: Du behältst den Lernfortschritt deiner Gruppe im Blick und gehst aktiv auf Teilnehmende zu, die zurückfallen.

  • Aktuell halten: KI-Tools ändern sich schnell. Du testest Neues und meldest, was in den Lehrplan gehört.

  • Rückmeldung geben: Du sagst uns, was im Unterricht funktioniert und was nicht. So werden unsere Weiterbildungen mit jeder Gruppe besser.

Qualifikation

Spaß an Menschen und am Lehren – das Herz dieser Stelle

  • Du arbeitest gern mit Menschen. Du hast Spaß daran, sie zu motivieren und ihnen Wissen beizubringen.

  • Du freust dich, wenn bei jemandem der Knoten platzt, und gibst nicht auf, bis es so weit ist.

  • Du kannst Dinge einfach erklären und bleibst geduldig, auch beim dritten Nachfragen.

  • Erfahrung als Trainer:in, Dozent:in, Ausbilder:in oder in der Einarbeitung von Kolleg:innen ist ein Plus.

Bezug zur Versicherungsbranche – Pflicht

  • Du hast in der Versicherungsbranche gearbeitet (z. B. Vermittlung, Maklerbüro, Innendienst, Versicherer) oder eine Ausbildung bzw. ein Studium mit Versicherungsbezug gemacht (z. B. Kaufmann/-frau für Versicherungen und Finanzanlagen, Versicherungsfachwirt:in, Studium Versicherungswesen).

  • Unsere Teilnehmenden kommen ausschließlich aus der Versicherungsbranche. Du sprichst ihre Sprache.

KI und Automatisierung – Pflicht

  • Du nutzt KI-Tools wie ChatGPT oder Claude im Alltag und kannst zeigen, wofür.

  • Automatisierung reizt dich. Erfahrung mit Tools wie Make, Airtable und Claude ist ein Plus.

Verfügbarkeit

  • Dienstag bis Donnerstag 9:00–15:30 Uhr bist du fest verfügbar. Das ist für diese Stelle Pflicht.

  • Start: 1. Dezember 2026 oder 1. Januar 2027

Benefits

  • Fertiger Lehrplan: Präsentationen, Übungen und Ablauf stehen. Du startest nicht bei null.

  • Strukturierte Einarbeitung: Du bekommst Zeit, dich in Inhalte und Tools einzuarbeiten, bevor du unterrichtest.

  • Planbare Woche: Feste Unterrichtszeiten Di–Do, Montag und Freitag flexibel.

  • 30–40 Stunden: Du entscheidest mit, wie viel Zeit du einbringst.

  • 100 % Remote: Arbeite von dort, wo du am besten arbeitest.

  • Sinnvolle Arbeit: Du hilfst Menschen aus der Versicherungsbranche, mit KI ihren Arbeitsalltag zu verändern.

  • Wachsender Markt: KI und Automatisierung in der Versicherungsbranche stehen erst am Anfang. Du bist vorne mit dabei.

  • Kurze Wege: Flache Hierarchien, schnelle Entscheidungen.

jobs.excerpt: heyData is building a compliance platform that guides companies — from 10-person startups to 400-person multi-entity organisations — step by step to audit-ready outcomes across ISO 27001, NIS2, GDPR and more.
jobs.description:
heyData is building a compliance platform that guides companies — from 10-person startups to 400-person multi-entity organisations — step by step to audit-ready outcomes across ISO 27001, NIS2, GDPR and more. Compliance is a knowledge and process problem, and AI is one of the most powerful tools we have to solve it.

We're growing our AI team. As an AI Engineer (all genders), you'll identify where AI can eliminate manual work, build the systems that make it happen, and own those systems end-to-end. You'll work directly with the other AI Engineers, Product, Engineering and our compliance experts to discover real problems and ship solutions. This is a builder role. Most of your time goes into shipping AI-powered features that customers and internal teams use, so infrastructure decisions need to be pragmatic today and extensible tomorrow.

Your Mission

Discover and define AI opportunities

  • Work with the AI team, Product, the VP of Engineering, the Engineering Team Lead and compliance experts to identify pain points and manual workflows that AI can automate.

  • Translate fuzzy problem descriptions into clear AI feature specs: what the system does, what data it needs, how success is measured.

  • Push back when AI is not the right solution, and propose alternatives.

Build and ship AI-powered features

  • Design and implement AI features on foundation models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral), customised with RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, and fine-tuning where justified.

  • Expose AI services as RESTful APIs consumed by the rest of the application (NestJS/VueJS stack on AWS EKS).

  • Build data ingestion and transformation pipelines that feed AI systems with heyData's internal data and customer data, handled in line with GDPR.

  • Integrate AI agents and multi-step workflows where appropriate, using frameworks like LangChain or LlamaIndex pragmatically.

Own the AI lifecycle

  • Manage the full lifecycle of every AI system you build: development, deployment, monitoring, retraining.

  • Set up CI/CD pipelines for AI models integrated into our existing AWS infrastructure.

  • Monitor model quality in production: detect drift, evaluate output quality, trigger retraining when needed.

  • Document your systems so the team can understand, operate and extend them.

Experiment and measure

  • Design and run AI/ML experiments with clear hypotheses, appropriate evaluation metrics and statistically sound interpretation.

  • Communicate findings to non-technical stakeholders in plain language.

  • Follow developments in model providers, tooling and evaluation frameworks, and bring relevant ones to the team.

Your Profile

Experience

  • Around 10 years of software engineering experience, at least 3 years of it building and operating production AI/ML systems.

  • Proven track record shipping LLM-powered features to real users.

  • Hands-on experience with foundation model APIs: OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Mistral. Familiarity with AWS Bedrock or Google Vertex AI.

  • Production experience with RAG: vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector), embedding model selection, chunking strategies, retrieval evaluation.

jobs.excerpt: The Licensing Specialist is responsible for obtaining, maintaining, and documenting all pharmacy licenses, permits, registrations, and payor enrollments for the pharmacy locations operated by CareTria.
jobs.description:
The Licensing Specialist is responsible for obtaining, maintaining, and documenting all pharmacy licenses, permits, registrations, and payor enrollments for the pharmacy locations operated by CareTria. Each pharmacy dispenses prescription medications, including controlled substances, specialty drugs, and temperature-controlled products, by mail order to patients in all 50 states, the District of Columbia, and U.S. territories. This role manages pharmacy and personnel licensure, Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) and state controlled substance registrations, and assists with pharmacy benefit manager (PBM), government payor, and Medicaid managed care organization (MCO) enrollment and credentialing for both locations. This role also verifies the registration and licensure status of the pharmacies’ drug suppliers, including manufacturer U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) registration, state wholesale distributor licensure, and wholesale distributor reporting to FDA under the Drug Supply Chain Security Act (DSCSA).

As the organization’s sole licensing resource, the Licensing Specialist works closely with the Pharmacy Compliance Officer, the Pharmacists-in-Charge at each location, Legal, Operations, Contracting, and Human Resources (HR) to prevent lapses in licensure and enrollment and to maintain audit readiness.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Pharmacy Licensure

  • Apply for, renew, and maintain resident and non-resident pharmacy licenses and permits for each pharmacy in all 50 states, District of Columbia (DC), Puerto Rico, Guam, the U.S. Virgin Islands, and other applicable territories.

  • Maintain separate, accurate license records for each pharmacy, ensuring that license numbers, addresses, expiration dates, and pharmacist-in-charge (PIC) designations are clearly defined between locations.

  • Identify and obtain any state-specific licenses, permits, or designations tied to specialty pharmacy operations and limited-distribution drug dispensing.

  • File change notifications (ownership, officers, PIC, address, doing business as (DBA), corporate structure) within each jurisdiction’s required timeframe for each pharmacy.

Controlled Substances

  • Manage DEA registrations for each pharmacy, including applications, renewals, modifications, and change-of-address requests, along with all corresponding state controlled substance registrations and permits.

  • Coordinate with the Pharmacy Compliance Officer and each PIC on registrant changes and regulatory inspections.

Personnel Licensure

  • Track pharmacist, pharmacy technician, and PIC licenses, and registrations across all applicable jurisdictions, for staff at the pharmacies.

  • Perform primary source verification at hire, annually, and at renewal and monitor for disciplinary actions.

  • Process state-specific licensure and registration requirements for new pharmacists and technicians in coordination with HR.

  • Maintain PIC designation records for each pharmacy and manage PIC transition notifications to boards of pharmacy.

  • Track staff who are licensed to work at each location and ensure that state requirements for each are met.

  • Conduct recurring exclusion and sanctions screening (Office of Inspector General (OIG) List of Excluded Individuals/Entities (LEIE), , and state Medicaid exclusion lists) in coordination with Human Resources.

Payor, PBM, Government Program, and MCO Enrollment

About OpenSesame

OpenSesame is the trusted partner for Workforce Reinvention in the age of AI. OpenSesame delivers integrated software, curated and customizable content, and expert services – embedded into existing learning, HR, and work systems – to help organizations expand their human+AI potential and thrive through change.

Learn more:

Internship Overview

OpenSesame seeks passionate, driven students and new graduates who already use AI to build and solve problems to join our paid summer internship program. You'll gain hands-on experience at a fast-growing, remote-first B2B SaaS company developing AI-powered products that help organizations upskill their people and fuel long-term growth.

In this immersive program, you'll join the Accounting and Finance team and contribute to meaningful projects that support OpenSesame's financial growth and success. Whether you're supporting accounting processes that keep our financial records accurate or analyzing data to forecast company performance, you'll play an important role in maintaining OpenSesame's financial health and helping us grow responsibly.

AI is how we work here, not a side topic. You'll have access to AI tools, including Claude, and we'll encourage you to use them to research, prototype, analyze, and build. You'll explore how AI and automation are transforming financial analysis, reporting, and process improvement, while collaborating across departments and connecting with company leadership.

Intern AI Hackathon

As part of your internship you will have the opportunity to participate in our first intern AI hackathon this summer. You'll team up with interns from other departments to pitch, build with AI, and present a working product idea that improves how OpenSesame works or serves customers.

About the Accounting and Finance Team

At OpenSesame, our Finance and Accounting team works hand in hand to drive growth and ensure financial excellence. Together, they turn data into strategy—managing forecasting, planning, payroll, and reporting to guide smart business decisions and maintain our financial health.

Interns gain hands-on experience with key SaaS metrics like recurring revenue, ARR, and churn, while supporting reconciliations, AR collections, and expense management. Guided by data and AI-driven insights, the team keeps improving how we forecast, report, and operate, helping power OpenSesame's continued success.

Performance-Based Objectives

By 2 Weeks

  • Learn OpenSesame's financial systems and processes.
  • Get set up with our internal AI tools and learn how the team uses them day to day.
  • Gain exposure to SaaS financial models and recurring revenue concepts.
  • Assist with reconciliations and ensuring financial records are accurate.

By 30 Days

  • Take responsibility for managing tasks such as AR collections emails, expense reimbursement transactions, and bank reconciliations.
  • Support the Finance team in updating forecasting models and analyzing historical trends.
  • Contribute to financial reports and provide insights for decision-making.
  • Use AI tools, including Claude, to automate data analysis, streamline reconciliations, and enhance reporting accuracy.
  • Join the intern hackathon team and build a working prototype (see above).
  • Learn more about our organization-wide training program, OpenSesame Qualified.

By 60 Days

  • Take ownership of a project that improves accuracy, efficiency, or visibility in accounting or finance workflows, integrating data or AI-driven findings.
  • Present your findings to the Finance & Accounting team or leadership, highlighting measurable impact and key takeaways.

Not selected for this role? You’re still in the running. We’ll review your application for alignment with our other open internships. If we see a potential fit, we’ll reach out to you directly.

Application and Creative Project

Before you start, check out our Creative Project guide. It walks through what we're looking for below in more detail.

To apply, submit one application, which includes a link to your creative project. We want to see how you think and what you've built, so your creative project must be a video (5 minutes or less), shared as a YouTube link (unlisted is fine). Applications without a working YouTube link will not be reviewed.

We care more about your curiosity and how you think than a polished result, so don't let your experience level stop you from applying.

You can talk to the camera, or walk us through slides, a demo, or a screen recording. How you show it is up to you. In your video, please cover:

  • How do you see OpenSesame fitting into your career journey or long-term goals?
  • What strengths, skills, or perspectives do you bring to OpenSesame to make an impact and contribute to our mission?
  • Show us something you've built with AI. What problem did you solve, and what excites you about where AI is taking learning and work?
    • Haven't built anything with AI yet? Make something today! Try an AI tool, experiment with a new idea, and show us or walk us through how you did it.
    • Feel free to share something from your personal life, work, school, or anywhere else. Share whatever feels right to you.

We're drawn to curiosity, creativity, growth mindset and authentic expression. Keep it concise and focused.

Additional Program Details

Application closes: Sunday, February 14th, 2027

Program dates: Anticipated start June 17, 2027 through August 28th, 2027. We can adjust up to two weeks earlier for students returning to school before the program concludes.

Commitment: Full-time (40 hours/week)

Eligibility and location: Must be a current student enrolled in a college/university program or have graduated within the past 12 months (undergraduate, postgraduate, or associate programs accepted). This position is fully remote and can be based anywhere in the U.S.

Compensation: $20 an hour

Equipment: Interns must have a personal computer with specs suitable for the work and access to consistent high-speed internet during working hours.

Opportunities and expectations: OpenSesame's internship program is immersive and growth-focused, pairing each intern with a dedicated mentor and offering meaningful, hands-on projects that make an impact. You'll also take part in professional development sessions, networking opportunities, the intern hackathon, and book club discussions, receive volunteer time off to give back to your community, and gain full access to our course catalog for your own learning and development.

Interview process: After the application review, selected candidates will be invited to a virtual OpenSesame webinar to learn more about our company, culture, and internship program. Following the event, selected candidates will move forward to interviews with the hiring manager and team for the department they're being considered for.

Equal Employment Opportunity: OpenSesame is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer that values and welcomes diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of various legally protected characteristics, including criminal history, and strive to provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. We prioritize safety and security and may use your information accordingly, and you can contact us for assistance or accommodations during the job application process.

CPRA (California candidates): When you submit your application, OpenSesame may collect and use your personal information in accordance with our privacy policy and the CPRA. This may include personal details and employment history, and will only be used for employment-related purposes. We may share this information with third-party service providers, but we will not sell it to third parties. If you have any questions or concerns, please contact us, and for more information on your rights under the CPRA, refer to our privacy policy or the California Attorney General's website.

  • Run business reviews worth the customer’s time: Come with the numbers, show what has changed since you last met, and leave with decisions.

  • Grow the accounts you hold: Find where more of the fleet or more of the product would genuinely help, open that conversation, and bring in the Account Executive for the commercial step.

  • Catch problems while they are still small: Your main contact moves on, or the same complaint comes up for the third time. You will see these before anyone else, so flag them early and come with a view on what to do about it.

  • Bring what you hear back into the company: You talk to more customers in a week than most of us do in a month. Patterns in what they ask for reach product and leadership while there is still time to act.

  • Improve how we run accounts: Say when our process is getting in the way, and fix what you can yourself. How we track health, hand over and review accounts will keep changing as we grow within the UniSea Group.

What good looks like in your first six months

  • Month 1: You know the product well enough to demonstrate it, and you have spoken to everyone in your portfolio.

  • Month 2: For each account you can say what usage looks like, who your champion is, and where the biggest risk sits.

  • Month 3: You have run a business review on your own, and the customer acted on something in it.

  • Month 4–5: You have turned round an account that was drifting, and you have opened at least one serious conversation about expanding.

  • Month 6: You hold your portfolio without supervision. Leadership can forecast renewals from what you have recorded, and the customers in your accounts come to you first.

  • You work from the data. You look at usage before you decide where your week goes, and you can build the numbers that show a customer what they are getting.

  • You reach out first. Nothing in your portfolio goes quiet for a month without you noticing.

  • You are organised across many things at once. Follow-ups, reviews and renewal dates land on time without anyone chasing you.

  • Maritime, logistics, industrial or other complex B2B experience is an advantage.

  • You speak fluent English. Additional languages relevant to our markets are an advantage.

  • You can work remotely with discipline, your working day overlaps substantially with Central European Time, and you are willing to travel to customers and industry events.

What we offer

We give feedback early, directly and to the person, and we will expect the same from you.

  • A short line to the people who decide things. The team is small enough that what you learn from your accounts can change what we build and how we sell, often inside the same quarter.

  • A larger business behind you. Being part of the UniSea Group brings the reach and stability of an established maritime software group, while the team you work in keeps its own pace.

jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced, true full stack Developer/Tester who can own an application end to end: Angular front-end, .NET API and backend services, SQL Server data layer, and automated testing. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable building a UI component, designing an API contract, writing a performant stored procedure, and authoring the test suite that validates all three. This role also integrates agentic AI workflows into the application stack, orchestrating existing AI/LLM services rather than training or fine-tuning models. Candidates should expect to move fluidly across the full stack on any given day, not specialize in a single layer.

Frontend Development (Angular)

  • Design and build responsive, maintainable Angular applications and components, including state management, routing, and reusable component libraries.
  • Consume and integrate REST APIs into the UI, handling loading states, error handling, and data validation.
  • Build UI components that surface agentic AI features (chat interfaces, recommendation panels, agent status/monitoring dashboards, etc.) within existing or new applications.
  • Collaborate with design/UX to translate requirements into polished, accessible interfaces.

API & Backend Development (.NET)

  • Design and develop backend services and APIs in .NET (C#), following REST/gRPC best practices for consumption by the Angular front-end and downstream systems.
  • Architect and implement integration layers connecting Python-based agentic services with .NET applications (via APIs, message queues, or SDKs).
  • Apply solid software design principles (SOLID, dependency injection, clean architecture) to keep backend services maintainable and testable.
  • Ensure secure, scalable, and maintainable integration patterns across all application layers.

Database Engineering (SQL Server)

  • Design, optimize, and maintain SQL Server databases supporting transactional application data and agentic workflow data (logging, agent state, audit trails, metadata).
  • Write and tune complex stored procedures, queries, indexes, and ETL processes for both application and agentic workflow needs.
  • Own data model design decisions in partnership with backend and API development.

Testing & Quality Assurance

  • Build and maintain automated test suites using Playwright for UI and end-to-end testing across the full application stack.
  • Write unit and integration tests for .NET services and APIs as part of the standard development workflow, not as a separate hand-off.
  • Develop testing strategies specific to agentic systems (prompt regression testing, output validation, agent behavior testing, edge-case/adversarial testing).
  • Participate in code reviews, CI/CD pipeline maintenance, and release quality gates.

Agentic AI Integration

  • Integrate with third-party or internally hosted AI/LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Azure OpenAI, Bedrock, Vertex AI) to power agentic capabilities within applications.
  • Write Python-based scripts/services for agent orchestration using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or similar, and wire them into the .NET/Angular application stack.

Cloud & Infrastructure

  • Deploy, monitor, and manage application services and supporting infrastructure on AWS and/or GCP (e.g., Lambda/Cloud Functions, container services, storage, IAM).
  • Collaborate with DevOps to ensure scalable, cost-efficient, and secure cloud deployments across the full stack.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of professional experience in .NET / C# development (API and backend services).
  • 7+ years of experience with SQL Server (database design, optimization, stored procedures, performance tuning).
  • 3+ years of hands-on Angular UI development experience, including component architecture, state management, and consuming REST APIs.
  • Demonstrated true full stack ownership: comfortable working across Angular, API design, .NET backend, SQL Server, and test automation without needing to hand off between specialists.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience building or integrating agentic AI workflows/systems that orchestrate existing AI/LLM APIs (not model training or fine-tuning).
  • Experience with Playwright (or similar) for automated UI/end-to-end testing, and writing unit/integration tests for backend services.
  • Practical experience with agentic AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or custom agent orchestration).
  • Proficiency in Python for scripting and AI service integration.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS and/or GCP cloud platforms for deploying and managing application workloads.
  • Strong understanding of REST API design and service-to-service integration patterns.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work across the full stack, from UI to database, without silos.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have

  • Experience consuming LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Azure OpenAI, Bedrock, Vertex AI) within application workflows.
  • Experience with vector databases and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architectures as a consumer of these services.
  • Knowledge of containerization (Docker/Kubernetes).
  • Experience with prompt engineering and agent evaluation/observability tools.
  • Background in enterprise application modernization projects that incorporate agentic AI capabilities.

loan, and delayed-draw facilities and the related interest rate swaps – and is responsible for the
accounting review and execution of quarterly joint venture (JV) and fund distributions. The position is also
a key contributor to corporate, borrower-entity, and lender financial reporting.


This role partners closely with Treasury, Project Finance, Asset Management, Portfolio Accounting, and
FP&A, and serves as the primary accounting point of contact for lenders, administrative agents,
depository banks, and auditors on debt and distribution matters. This is an exciting, fast-paced industry
requiring creative thinking and problem-solving skills to succeed.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

    Debt Accounting & Facility Management

  • Own accounting for all debt facilities, including borrowings, repayments, prepayments, and modifications (ASC 470)
  • Maintain debt schedules for principal, interest, fees, and deferred financing costs
  • Manage the debt service calendar, validate lender invoices, and ensure timely payment
  • Prepare flow-of-funds and reserve support for loan draws and closings
  • Prepare withdrawal/transfer certificates to release cash from restricted and reserve accounts
  • Monitor reserve account funding levels and release conditions
  • Manage bank accounts and lender notice lists for debt and JV entities
  • Reconcile swap settlements and valuations, and record hedge accounting entries (ASC 815)

    • JV & Fund Distributions

  • Review and approve quarterly JV and tax equity fund distributions before release
  • Provide debt service amounts by facility and fund to Asset Management
  • Prepare distribution flow-of-funds and reconcile distributions to the GL and bank
  • Maintain the distribution process memo, checklist, and controls

    • Financial Reporting & Lender Compliance

  • Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements for corporate, borrower, and JV entities
  • Own lender reporting, compliance certificates, and covenant calculations
  • Oversee month-end and year-end close for corporate, debt, and JV activity
  • Lead audit support for debt, derivatives, and distributions
  • Document procedures and drive process improvements
  • Lead and mentor accounting staff
  • Perform other accounting duties as required or assigned

REQUIRED COMPETENCIES

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting or finance required
  • 5-10 years of progressive accounting experience, including debt accounting and financial reporting
  • Working knowledge of GAAP for debt (ASC 470), derivatives and hedging (ASC 815), and consolidation (ASC 810)
  • Experience reading and applying credit agreements, operating agreements, and cash distribution waterfalls
  • Strong proficiency in MS Excel and Sage Intacct or equivalent accounting software
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, and comfort serving as a point of contact for lenders, banks, and auditors
  • Must be detail-oriented with hands-on execution capability

PREFERRED COMPETENCIES

  • CPA license a plus
  • Prior experience in the solar, renewable energy, or project finance industry a plus
  • Experience with tax equity partnerships, JV structures, or fund distribution waterfalls
  • Experience with lender compliance and covenant reporting across multiple facilities
  • Prior management experience
  • Self-starter with strong self-motivation and a proven capacity to work in a fast-paced, highly fluid environment
Recruitment Agency Notice:
We appreciate your interest in partnering with us; however, we are not seeking recruitment agency support for this role.

ABOUT PIVOT

Pivot Energy is a national renewable energy provider that develops, finances, builds, owns, and manages solar and energy storage projects that help decarbonize our nation’s electricity, increase equitable access to clean energy for local communities, and provide real cost-savings to American businesses and
families.
We are fiercely dedicated to accelerating the rapid transition taking place in the energy industry to a more decentralized and cleaner approach to power generation. We are committed to positively contributing to the local communities and people we serve with more than clean energy. We believe global warming poses an existential threat to our planet and that we have a responsibility to help mitigate the threat. Our portfolio includes projects that reduce energy burden for income-limited families, create workforce pathways for under-represented groups within the solar industry, and include robust community investment opportunities.
As a Certified B Corporation and one of Denver’s “Best Places to Work”, we believe that company success is driven by a healthy environment, thriving society, and workplace where all individuals are respected. We evaluate every internal decision on environmental, social, and governance (ESG) factors to determine if our actions will result in a net positive impact on the community, our employees, customers, shareholders, and the environment. Learn more in our annual ESG Report.
At Pivot, our core values guide our work internally and externally:
·Impact – We hold ourselves accountable to having a measurable impact on our people, communities, and the planet
·Balance – Put family first; work hard/have fun
·Determination – Find ways to be successful no matter how difficult the challenge
·Professionalism – Impress everyone we touch, be a team player
·Honesty – Be truthful and transparent, externally and internally
·Kindness – Create an environment where kindness, empathy, and vulnerability are embraced

DIVERSITY, EQUITY, INCLUSION and JUSTICE STATEMENT

At Pivot, we are proactively developing and maintaining an inclusive culture, rooted in mutual respect, that supports a workforce of different generations, races, gender identities, sexual orientations, ability statuses, religions, and cultures to work collaboratively together for greater impact. We seek to build a team that invests in relationship building, celebrates each other’s successes, and makes space for the unique contributions and working styles people bring into Pivot.
Pivot invests in company-wide trainings, assessments, and programs to advance internal inclusion and equity practices, such as employee allyship building, cross-cultural communications, and equitable hiring and management protocols to increasingly recognize bias and ensure mutual respect and belonging.

EEO STATEMENT

Pivot Energy is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to increasing the diversity of its workforce. We actively work to cultivate an inclusive culture that welcomes, empowers, and enables equitable career growth for employees regardless of background.

jobs.description:
Under the direction of the VP, Account Services, the Account Director will serve as the primary contact for assigned clients regarding the strategic and tactical planning, design, and execution of industry-leading publication and medical communication initiatives. The Account Director consistently provides excellent customer service, as well as represents client needs and goals within the organization to ensure quality. This individual is also responsible for the financial aspects of client relationships, including compliance to contract/agreements, statements of work, purchase orders, invoices, forecasting, and receivables. The Account Director is required to understand client challenges and lead internal and external core teams to conceptualize, design, and deliver novel solutions for our clients’ needs in a manner that is consistent with the values and reputation of Synchrony. Accountabilities include assigned client development, relationships, and satisfaction; overall strategy, development, and execution of assigned Accounts/Client Services activities; and management of account finances.

Job Duties

Account Services

  • Under the direction of the VP, Account Services, lead strategic publication and medical communication planning initiatives
  • Establish relationships with team members in order to effectively lead and serve as a resource for cross-functional teams in support of client needs and expectations for all Synchrony clients
  • Monitor and manage assigned activities to ensure timely delivery of products and services
  • Develop, present, and sell high-quality deliverables
  • Make recommendations to senior management to ensure that Synchrony core teams have appropriate resources and support to meet the needs of our clients and our commitments
  • Work with other team members to ensure that Synchrony is meeting its goals, objectives, and corporate values

Business Development

  • Assist in business development opportunities and initiatives necessary to increase revenue to meet and exceed company goals
  • Actively seek new business opportunities within current and new clients
  • Assist in the implementation of corporate strategies and cross-selling initiatives
  • Lead teams and resources to create and submit RFPs and proposals (proposal writing is required); participate in developing and delivering presentations for new business opportunities
  • Develop client(s) scope of service or project agreements

Accounts Financial Management

  • Manage the financial aspects of client relationships including compliance to contract/master service agreement(s), project proposals (statements of work, project initiation forms, project agreements, etc), purchase orders, invoices, forecasting, receivables, and reporting
  • As client liaison, develop project proposals based on input from internal teams (with account leadership) including (but not limited to):
    • Budgets (e.g., invoicing schedule in alignment with client master service agreement)
    • Scope of service (e.g., including assumptions, deliverables, timeline)
  • Serve as the primary contact with finance department for quarterly and yearly project and client portfolio tracking, forecasting, and reconciliation of assigned activities
  • Use project-tracking software to set up and manage projects internally, enter project budgets, trigger invoices, track project expenses, and work with team members to track project hours
  • Prepare project reconciliations
  • Trigger invoices for submission to the client
  • Ensure that all invoices and reconciliations are accurate and occurring at the appropriate project milestones and in a timely manner
  • Review profit/loss reports (budget versus actual report from finance system, final reconciliations) with project managers and other members of team to determine potential for cost-savings; work with appropriate personnel to address cost concerns
  • Review project detail reports with project managers weekly (or as needed) to identify incorrectly recorded, and/or potentially out-of-scope project hours; address or communicate as appropriate
  • Work with team to identify, analyze, and proactively communicate timeline and budget risks
  • Recognize and evaluate requests for out-of-scope work and alert client in timely manner, work with team to estimate additional budget needed to complete out-of-scope work, and create and process amendments to project proposal for client when necessary

Internal and External Relationships

  • Attend and lead aspects of weekly client status, internal team status, new project kick-off, and post-conference debriefing meetings
  • Review all major deliverables (i.e., project briefs, drafts, status reports, etc.) to ensure quality standards and client expectations are met
  • Foster and develop collaboration between departments, internal groups, and individuals to ensure innovative and collaborative solutions to client needs
  • Represent the organization in a professional and appropriate manner in all forms of communication (speaking, writing, appearance) whether in person or virtually
  • Facilitate communication between team members and clients necessary to maintain strong relationships and effective account management via various methods (email, IM, phone, face-to-face)
  • Be a positive force for enhancing the work culture, consensus-building, and internal communications
  • Resolve conflict and celebrate success; set clear team priorities; explain client/brand objectives and strategies; define success in terms of the whole team
  • Keep senior management apprised of critical client concerns and opportunities; provide brand review meeting content
  • Keep senior management apprised of critical internal Synchrony issues, concerns, and opportunities
  • Attend client meetings and congresses, and communicate key learnings to team and client
  • Actively participate in client presentations, selling and communicating the agency's point of view
  • Monitor industry and therapeutic area best practices and advances to ensure that Synchrony and our clients are at the cutting edge or leading the field
  • Support the agency activities of senior management, as needed

Key Competencies

  • Effective interpersonal skills, with a strong focus on account services, strategic medical/publications, and businesses processes
  • Ability to manage outcomes to win-win resolution
  • High level of integrity, confidentiality, professionalism, and accountability
  • A well-defined sense of diplomacy, including solid negotiation, conflict resolution, maturity, and people management skills
  • Ability to present ideas and supporting rationale to internal and external teams in an effective manner
  • Demonstrated ability to manage key constituent relationships
  • Able to identify key issues; creatively and strategically overcome challenges or obstacles towards a positive resolution; demonstrated ability to apply learning
  • Ability to oversee, manage, and support priorities and workflow to ensure high-quality project execution according to project timelines and budgets
  • Effective attention to detail, strong writing skills with a solid handle on proper grammar and punctuation, and a high degree of accuracy
  • Sound analytical thinking, planning, prioritization, and execution skills
  • Strong communication skills both verbally and in writing
  • Strong presentation and persuasion skills: Can develop a clear point of view and tell a meaningful “story”; is effective in a variety of settings and group sizes with clients, peers, subordinates, and management; confidently expresses both data/facts, plus more controversial topics; commands attention and can manage group dynamics
  • Demonstrated knowledge of Good Publications Practices
  • Proven ability to conduct internet research specifically around clinical trials/investigators/investigative agents and pharmaceutical companies/biotechs
  • Skilled at Microsoft Office, specifically Excel and PowerPoint

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree required (life sciences, communications, or marketing preferred)
  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience of Account Services support or related experience in the pharmaceutical publication planning or medical communications industry
  • ISMPP CMPP preferred
  • History of successful management of more than ~2 million dollars of fee/year
  • Must be able to travel up to 25 percent of the time
  • Specific industry and/or therapeutic expertise is required
  • Substantial experience leading at least 3 of the following activities: publications activities, medical education activities, medical communications campaigns, strategic communications planning, advisory boards, key clinical expert identification and development

Working Conditions

  • Ability to travel as client needs require
  • Significant communication with clients and internal teams, including presentations
  • Ability to commit to extra and/or nontraditional hours as client needs require

Synchrony places high value on the well-being of its employees; therefore, Synchrony team members are eligible for a comprehensive array of benefits, including competitive salaries, generous paid time off, excellent health insurance, family leave, and a 401(k) plan with employer matching.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Be part of something great!

Synchrony Group is an independently owned network of companies, headquartered in West Chester, PA.

At Synchrony, we are dedicated to providing the highest quality products and services in the medical communications industry. Our vision is to create the highest value for our clients and the most opportunity for our team members, while working together to improve the lives of patients. Collectively, we are leaders in strategic planning, development, and execution of best-in-class programs that address medical needs, maximize strategic objectives, and make significant scientific and clinical contributions. Our passion and commitment to improving outcomes for our clients, healthcare professionals, and patients drives us to exceed expectations in everything we do.

Synchrony consists of integrated groups of medical-scientific, clinical, creative, commercial, and industry experts. Synchrony Healthcare Communications specializes in branded and disease state marketing/promotional campaigns and initiatives.Our teams reflect our commitment to excellence—we’re smart, enthusiastic, and driven. We align the skills, experiences, and perspectives of diverse individuals to achieve unparalleled results in an environment of respect and mutual support. Above all, we are passionate about changing the world and improving the lives of patients.

Our success is built on the foundation of our team, and we’re always striving to strengthen our foundation. More than just seeking out the best and brightest to join us, we also create a work environment in which employees are respected and encouraged to grow.

Are you looking to be part of something great? We’d like to meet you!

jobs.title: Senior Node.js Developer (Ukraine)
jobs.excerpt: Who We Are Flosum is a bootstrapped, profitable B2B SaaS company building the leading Salesforce-native DevSecOps, Data Protection, and Security platform.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Flosum is a bootstrapped, profitable B2B SaaS company building the leading Salesforce-native DevSecOps, Data Protection, and Security platform. Our solutions are trusted by Fortune 500 enterprises in the most heavily regulated industries on the planet — financial services, healthcare, government, and insurance.

We’re not a startup burning cash and chasing vanity metrics. We’re a proven, scaling business that reached profitability on our own terms. As a Salesforce Summit Partner and Innovation Award winner, we’ve earned our seat at the table alongside the biggest names in enterprise software.

Built 100% on the Salesforce platform. Serving enterprises that demand zero compromise on security, compliance, and reliability.

Why This Role Exists

We are entering an aggressive growth phase — expanding our product surface, deepening our platform capabilities, and accelerating our delivery velocity. We need senior-caliber Node.js developers who can own significant parts of our architecture and ship production code that enterprise customers depend on daily.

This is not a staff augmentation seat. You will work directly with engineering leadership, product managers, and the CEO. Your decisions will have real consequences, your opinions will be heard, and your craftsmanship will be visible to the customers who rely on our platform.

What You’ll Build

  • High-performance backend services and APIs powering enterprise-grade SaaS applications
  • Scalable, secure Node.js micro services and integrations within the Salesforce ecosystem
  • Modern front-end experiences using Vue.js and TypeScript that serve demanding enterprise users
  • CI/CD pipeline tooling, automation frameworks, and developer productivity infrastructure
  • Real-time data processing and event-driven architectures handling sensitive enterprise data at scale

Requirements

Read this section carefully. We are specific about what we need because we are serious about who we hire.

Non-Negotiable Technical Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional Node.js development in production environments — not tutorials, not side projects, not bootcamp exercises. Real production systems serving real users at scale.
  • Expert-level understanding of asynchronous programming, event loops, streams, and the Node.js runtime. You should be able to explain backpressure, the differences between setImmediate and process.nextTick, and why unhandled promise rejections are dangerous — without Googling it.
  • Deep experience with TypeScript in production codebases. We write typed code, and we expect you to understand why.
  • Strong command of RESTful API design, authentication patterns (OAuth 2.0, JWT), and API security best practices for enterprise environments.
  • Proven experience with SQL and NoSQL databases, query optimization, data modeling, and understanding the performance implications of schema decisions at scale.
  • Proficiency with Git workflows, code review practices, automated testing (unit, integration, and end-to-end), and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Solid understanding of containerization (Docker), cloud services (AWS/GCP/Azure), and infrastructure-as-code principles.

Highly Preferred (These Will Set You Apart)

  • Salesforce development experience: Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, or Salesforce API integrations. If you know both Node.js and Salesforce, you are a rare and extremely valuable candidate to us.
  • Experience building or contributing to Salesforce ISV (AppExchange) products.
  • Vue.js front-end development experience, particularly with Vue 3 Composition API and state management.
  • Experience working in B2B SaaS companies serving enterprise customers with strict compliance requirements (SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP, GDPR).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/DevSecOps toolchains and practices in the Salesforce ecosystem.

The Kind of Person We’re Looking For

Skills get you in the door. Mindset determines whether you thrive here:

Missionary, Not Mercenary

You care about what you’re building and why. You take ownership not because someone assigned it to you, but because that’s who you are. When something is broken at 2 AM, you don’t check whether it’s “your responsibility” — you fix it.

Builder, Not a Bystander

You don’t wait for perfect specifications. You dig in, ask hard questions, propose solutions, and ship. You would rather have a working prototype by Friday than a polished slide deck by next quarter.

Craftsperson Under Pressure

Enterprise customers depend on our uptime and data integrity. You write code that doesn’t just work — it survives. You understand that in regulated industries, your code is your reputation.

Direct Communicator

You say what you think, respectfully and clearly. If a technical decision is wrong, you speak up — regardless of who made it. We value candor over politeness-at-the-expense-of-quality.

This Is a Long-Term Commitment

Let us be direct: we are not looking for contractors who jump between projects every few months. We are building a world-class engineering team, and we invest heavily in the people who join us. In return, we expect commitment.

This role is designed as a long-term, full-time engagement. You will grow with us. You will own systems end-to-end. You will see the direct impact of your work in how Fortune 500 companies build, protect, and deploy on Salesforce.

If you’re looking for a short-term gig while you wait for something else, this isn’t the role. If you want to build something that matters and be part of a team that’s scaling from strong to dominant, keep reading.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation commensurate with your experience and impact
  • Direct collaboration with the founding team and engineering leadership — your voice will carry weight from day one
  • A profitable, stable company with aggressive growth plans — no funding anxiety, no runway clock
  • The opportunity to work on enterprise-grade products used by some of the largest organizations in the world
  • Meaningful technical challenges: security, compliance, scale, and reliability at the intersection of Node.js and Salesforce
  • A culture that rewards ownership, speed, and craftsmanship over politics and hierarchy
  • Remote-first flexibility with a results-oriented work environment
