jobs.title: Manager, Software Engineering
jobs.excerpt: Who We Are At Murmuration, we believe that America’s promise is shaped and reshaped by the best ideas and ideals of its communities, and the dreams of the people who believe in a better life for themselves, their families, and each other.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Murmuration, we believe that America’s promise is shaped and reshaped by the best ideas and ideals of its communities, and the dreams of the people who believe in a better life for themselves, their families, and each other.

We help organizations build power in their communities in four key ways: we organize a network of values-aligned partners; we provide deep, data-driven insights into people, places, and perspectives; we develop tools that make organizing and engagement easy and more effective; and we offer services that strengthen our partners’ capacity to lead change in their communities.

We envision an America where every community has what it needs to help people lead healthy, free, and dignified lives. We work to redesign the systems and structures we all depend on — how we learn, live, govern, and solve problems — so that they are just, equitable, resilient, and rooted in shared responsibility. By strengthening the ties that hold communities together, we aim for civic life defined by collective action and care, with effective leadership that truly represents everyone.

We are a collaborative, curious, and creative team of organizers, scientists, teachers, technologists, campaign veterans, and more who share the unwavering belief that we can use our gifts in service of transforming America — together. We’ve built our team guided by the belief that the whole is greater than the sum of its parts. And so we support each other relentlessly — rallying together to face challenges the same way we celebrate each other’s wins.

About the Position

Do you see yourself as a mission-driven leader ready to join a team built on trust and open communication, where you’ll guide the growth of its engineers and help set the technical direction for a platform with an impact that matters?

We are seeking a Manager, Software Engineering who believes that engineering teams do their best work when they trust each other, understand why their work matters, and have a manager who clears and illuminates the path for them. In this role, you will lead and mentor an already high-performing team of data engineers as they design, develop, and maintain the core data platform and data pipelines that power Murmuration’s Organizer web application - a tool our users rely on to organize and engage with their communities. By fostering a collaborative and innovative development environment, you will see your impact in the team’s successful delivery of new features and performance improvements that directly translate to our users’ increased organizing power.

We are looking for an engineering leader who has a proven track record of balancing people management, technical leadership, and hands-on engagement. You will oversee all engineering design plans for your team, using product requirements, platform knowledge, and systems thinking to provide guidance, feedback, and approval. You will manage project timelines and help prioritize tasks to ensure successful team delivery. You will be expected to build a first-hand understanding of the platform and the effort behind your team’s work by remaining hands-on: contributing to the code, reviewing code, and helping engineers clear technical hurdles.

Job Level: M3

What You’ll Do

Manage a High-Performing Engineering Team

  • Manage a team of up to six engineers, ensuring each individual has a clear understanding of how their work aligns with our engineering vision and benefits our Partners;
  • Cultivate an inclusive, high-trust culture aligned with Murmuration and engineering values;
  • Manage performance directly and early with support from your manager and the People Team; and
  • Help shape the team as needed by taking part in our hiring process and identifying and onboarding great engineers.

Oversee Sprint Execution & Project Management

  • Own the software development lifecycle for the Organizer data platform team, ensuring the platform we provide is performant, stable, scalable, and maintainable;
  • Oversee Scrum/Agile practices that keep sprint goals aligned with engineering and product commitments;
  • Lead effective retrospectives, turning what the team learns into process and culture improvements across the division;
  • Create project plans in partnership with product and other technical leaders, then guide projects through implementation by working with the team to understand and unblock issues and keeping leadership informed of project status; and
  • Identify process and technical challenges and drive solutions that improve both team effectiveness and team health.

Provide Architectural & Technical Guidance

  • Partner with senior engineers to set the technical direction for the core data platform, weighing near-term delivery against long-term needs;
  • Ensure your team’s designs fit coherently within the broader data platform and Murmuration’s engineering architecture; and
  • Advocate for performance improvements and technical debt reduction alongside new feature work.

Facilitate Cross-Team Communication & Collaboration

  • Work with product team members to clarify requirements and communicate tradeoffs among scope, timeline, and complexity;
  • Coordinate with other engineering teams on dependencies and shared systems so work integrates smoothly; and
  • Communicate team progress, risks, and blockers clearly and early to stakeholders and your manager.

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience managing a team of three or more software engineers;
  • Experience mentoring and growing engineers, as well as building inclusive, collaborative teams;
  • Experience leading projects from planning through delivery;
  • 5+ years of experience as an individual contributor, including data engineering experience;
  • Experience in both functional and object-oriented programming (e.g., Python, Scala, Java);
  • Production experience with the AWS data stack or equivalent (e.g., Lambda, ECS, Glue, Athena);
  • Experience with data pipeline development and orchestration (e.g., Airflow, Step Functions, Kafka);
  • Experience designing data architectures and data models with strong SQL and/or NoSQL experience;
  • Experience owning production data systems, including incident response and reliability; and
  • Experience with modern software delivery practices, including Git branching workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing and deployment.

Nice to Haves

  • Familiarity with Voter File Data and other political data, and/or
  • A background in political tech, civic tech, advocacy, or mission-driven organizations.

Talented Engineering Managers come from all walks of life and career. If you are passionate about civic engagement and technology, please apply, even if you do not check every box!

Benefits

Location and Compensation

The Manager, Software Engineering role is a full-time, salaried position with a comprehensive benefits package (detail below), open to candidates anywhere in the United States.

The starting salary for this position is $196,105. We set compensation using market data and apply it consistently across the organization to ensure fairness and transparency for everyone in similar roles.

Our Culture of Care

We work hard to create a culture of care to ensure that our staff are best equipped to lead happy, healthy, and balanced lives. To that end, we offer a comprehensive benefits package which includes:

  • Health, vision, and dental insurance with 100% of premiums covered for you and qualifying family members;
  • Retirement benefits with a 5% employer match;
  • A flexible unlimited PTO plan;
  • Generous paid parental leave;
  • Pre-tax commuter benefits;
  • A company laptop;
  • A flexible remote work environment;
  • A home office setup stipend for all new employees;
  • Monthly reimbursement for remote work expenses;
  • A yearly professional development fund;
  • Mental health and wellness benefits through Calm and Better Help;
  • Yearly in-person staff retreats; and
  • A welcoming culture that celebrates diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging.

At Murmuration, we believe a vibrant, representative democracy depends on the inclusion of diverse voices, lived experiences, and perspectives. The best ideas don’t come from a single person or ideology — they emerge at the intersection of different backgrounds, identities, and viewpoints. We are proud of our commitment to building an organization and culture shaped by respect, empathy, and collaboration, where our team’s diversity fuels innovation, civic engagement, and meaningful change. We welcome new colleagues who will help us nurture this collective effort. Join us.

An Equal-Opportunity Employer with a Commitment to Diversity

Murmuration is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and as an organization committed to diversity and the perspective of all voices, we consider applicants equally of race, gender, color, sexual orientation, religion, marital status, disability, political affiliation and national origin. We reasonably accommodate staff members and/or applicants with disabilities, provided they are otherwise able to perform the essential functions of the job.

Note: Murmuration is two organizations working together to pursue our mission of amplifying the power of civic engagement: Murmuration Research Institute, a 501(c)(3) that conducts research to identify, design, and create the data, tools, and insights that build healthier and more equitable communities; and Murmuration, Inc., a 501(c)(4) that supports organizations working across the country on the nation’s most challenging issues with access to data, tools, and research that build healthier and more equitable communities.

Job Title: DevOps Engineer

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Client Business Hours (with flexibility for deployments, incident response, and on-call rotations)

About the Role

Our client is seeking a highly skilled DevOps Engineer to build, maintain, and optimize cloud infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and system reliability across production environments.

This role requires deep expertise in cloud platforms, automation, CI/CD, container orchestration, monitoring, and infrastructure security. The DevOps Engineer will play a critical role in ensuring systems remain scalable, secure, resilient, and highly available while enabling development teams to ship code efficiently and safely.

The ideal candidate is proactive, automation-driven, calm under pressure, and passionate about improving infrastructure reliability and operational efficiency.

Responsibilities

Cloud Infrastructure Management

  • Provision, configure, and maintain infrastructure on AWS, GCP, or Azure cloud platforms
    • Implement Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) using Terraform, Pulumi, or CloudFormation
    • Configure networking, compute, storage, IAM, and cloud security policies
    • Optimize infrastructure performance, scalability, and cost efficiency

CI/CD & Deployment Automation

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or CircleCI
    • Automate build, testing, deployment, and rollback workflows across environments
    • Ensure zero-downtime deployments and reliable release processes
    • Improve deployment speed, consistency, and operational reliability

Containerization & Kubernetes

  • Manage Docker containers and Kubernetes clusters for microservices deployment
    • Monitor cluster health, resource allocation, and workload performance
    • Optimize orchestration strategies for scalability and reliability
    • Troubleshoot container and deployment-related issues across environments

Monitoring, Logging & Incident Response

  • Implement observability and monitoring solutions using Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or New Relic
    • Configure centralized logging and alerting pipelines using ELK Stack, Splunk, or similar tools
    • Participate in incident response and on-call rotations
    • Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement preventive solutions post-incident

Security & Compliance

  • Apply infrastructure security best practices including IAM, encryption, secrets management, and least-privilege access
    • Support compliance requirements such as SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, or GDPR where applicable
    • Conduct vulnerability scans, patch management, and security hardening activities
    • Ensure infrastructure remains secure, compliant, and audit-ready

Collaboration & Process Improvement

  • Partner closely with development teams to improve deployment workflows and automation
    • Support developers with infrastructure troubleshooting and environment management
    • Identify opportunities to improve reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency
    • Maintain clear documentation for infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and operational procedures

What Makes You a Perfect Fit

  • Strong problem solver who thrives at the intersection of development and operations
    • Calm, analytical, and methodical during incidents and high-pressure situations
    • Passionate about automation, infrastructure scalability, and reliability engineering
    • Strong communicator who collaborates effectively across technical teams
    • Proactive mindset focused on preventing issues before they impact production

Required Experience & Skills

  • 3+ years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or Infrastructure Engineering
    • Proficiency with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
    • Strong experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines
    • Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes
    • Infrastructure-as-Code expertise with Terraform, Pulumi, or CloudFormation
    • Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or New Relic
    • Scripting experience with Python, Bash, or similar languages
    • Strong understanding of cloud security best practices and infrastructure reliability

Preferred Experience & Skills

  • Experience with microservices and distributed systems
    • Familiarity with serverless technologies (AWS Lambda, Cloud Functions)
    • Experience managing production-grade Kubernetes environments
    • Cloud certifications such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, CKA, or equivalent
    • Background supporting SaaS, fintech, healthcare, or enterprise applications

What Does a Typical Day Look Like?

A DevOps Engineer’s day revolves around keeping systems secure, automated, scalable, and reliable. You will:

  • Review monitoring dashboards and respond to infrastructure alerts or incidents
    • Improve CI/CD pipelines to streamline testing and deployment workflows
    • Provision or optimize infrastructure using Terraform or cloud-native tools
    • Troubleshoot deployment issues and collaborate with developers on production releases
    • Monitor Kubernetes clusters and containerized services for performance and reliability
    • Document workflows, update runbooks, and improve operational processes
    • Analyze logs, metrics, and incidents to proactively prevent future issues

In essence: you are responsible for ensuring infrastructure remains secure, scalable, automated, and capable of supporting fast, reliable product delivery.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

• System uptime ≥ 99.9%

  • Faster and more reliable deployment frequency
    • Reduced MTTR (Mean Time to Recovery) during incidents
    • Infrastructure cost optimization and efficiency improvements
    • Deployment success rate and rollback reduction
    • Positive developer feedback on infrastructure reliability and deployment speed

What We Offer

  • Full-time remote position aligned with U.S. business hours
    • Flexible schedule for deployments and incident response
    • Opportunity to work with modern cloud infrastructure and cutting-edge DevOps tooling
    • Exposure to complex infrastructure and scalability challenges
    • Professional growth in DevOps, SRE, and cloud engineering

• Competitive compensation package

Interview Process

  • Initial Phone Screen

  • Technical Assessment (e.g., design a CI/CD pipeline or provision infrastructure with Terraform)
    • Client Interview with Engineering/DevOps Leadership

jobs.excerpt: Healthcare is complex.  We’re here to change that.

Healthcare is complex. We’re here to change that.

RVO Health is a health technology company on a mission to make health easier to navigate, more accessible, and more affordable for everyone.

Here, you'll help over 40 million people every month, with a team that genuinely cares about the work and each other.

At a Glance

RVO Health is building integrated products that power data-driven digital experiences for our brands, partners, and teams. We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist who can do two things well: build the recommendation models that shape how millions of users discover our content, and engineer the LLM-powered applications, agents, and evaluations that bring AI into real workflows.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. You may own projects that span building and improving recommendation models to designing and evaluating AI agents. The ideal candidate is comfortable across the full stack, from feature engineering and model training to backend services and production architecture, and cares about work that is accurate, reliable, maintainable, and secure.

This role reports to the Director of Data Science and works closely with data scientists, data engineers, AI Ops, security, IT, platform engineering, and business stakeholders.

What You’ll Do

Recommendation systems

  • Model development: Design, build, and deploy robust recommendation models using machine learning and predictive analytics. Your work will directly influence product decisions and strategic direction.
  • Model optimization: Continuously improve existing models by incorporating new data, refining algorithms, and applying new techniques, with a focus on predictive accuracy, reliability, and efficiency.
  • Data exploration: Collect and mine data from disparate sources, and dig into the processes that create that data.

AI engineering

  • AI agents and applications: Design, build, and iterate on LLM-powered agents and assistants integrated with enterprise tools such as Outlook, Slack, and internal data sources.
  • Evaluation: Develop and maintain evaluation pipelines and feedback loops that measure and improve the quality and reliability of AI systems.
  • APIs and integrations: Build and maintain APIs, backend services, and integrations that connect models and AI capabilities to the tools teams already use.
  • Reusable frameworks: Contribute to a repeatable framework for building new AI assistants, and help build a marketplace of shared skills and plugins.
  • Technology evaluation: Assess new models, tools, and libraries and recommend when and how to adopt them.
  • Responsible AI: Identify and mitigate risks related to AI outputs, data handling, and responsible use.

Across both

  • Production readiness: Partner with AI Ops, security, IT, and platform engineering to make sure models and AI systems are production-grade, secure, and observable.
  • Stakeholder engagement: Work with business stakeholders to find high-value opportunities, translate workflows into technical requirements, and define the right scope and success metrics.
  • Results communication: Explain complex data science and AI concepts, and model outcomes, clearly to non-technical audiences.
  • Documentation: Contribute to technical documentation, runbooks, and onboarding materials that help the team scale what gets built.
  • Collaborative teamwork: Work with data scientists, data engineers, and cross-functional teams in an agile environment to deliver projects on time.

What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience as a data scientist or ML engineer, including at least 1 year building LLM-powered applications
  • Expert knowledge of machine learning and statistical modeling, with hands-on experience building recommender systems
  • Experience building and deploying models and applications in cloud infrastructure
  • Experience designing evaluation methods for AI systems, from offline metrics to human feedback loops

About the role

The Technical Account Manager owns the day-to-day operational relationship with operator and aggregator clients from go-live onward. They give each client a single technical contact who knows their setup, freeing Account Management to focus on commercial growth. They are accountable for the quality of client configurations and for making changes quickly and accurately, within the standards set by Operations and Compliance, escalating any exceptions.

This is not a commercial, first-line support or approval role: the TAM carries no revenue target, handles complex and recurring tickets rather than all of them, and follows published configuration standards rather than setting them.

Responsibilities

Client ownership after go-live

  • Act as the primary technical and operational contact for newly onboarded clients.
  • Act as the main stakeholder on integration channels after go-live, picking up operational requests and routing anything commercial to the Account Manager.
  • Monitor the period after go-live for latency and early signs of problems that would affect a successful launch, and escalate before the client reports them.
  • Manage key accounts from an operational perspective, supporting clients through changes to their setup.

Operational configuration and change

  • Own financial limit changes and RTP updates, applying the current Booming standards and escalating any request that falls outside them.
  • Own tournament configuration where this sits with Customer Success rather than with the Account Manager.
  • Handle general client requests such as media files and thumbnails, which clients may now request directly from the TAM.
  • Handle setup changes: new currencies, new configurations, account migrations and account splits.

Issue resolution and escalation

  • Handle daily operational queries and lead the resolution of higher complexity issues across Operations, Platform and SRE.
  • Keep the client informed in plain language during an incident, with content routed through the agreed communication channel.
  • Translate operator needs into clear, prioritised internal requests that an engineer can act on without a second conversation.

Process and improvement

  • Monitor internal operational processes: ticket flow, SLAs, escalation paths and release communication.
  • Identify recurring issues and gaps, propose improvements, and implement the ones that are agreed.
  • Keep the client-facing operational documentation current for the accounts in scope.

Requirements

Experience

  • 3+ years in a technical account management, technical support or operations role in B2B software, ideally iGaming or another integration-heavy environment.
  • Experience owning client relationships after go-live, including incident communication to a demanding counterparty.
  • Experience working to SLAs and defending them internally.

Technical

  • Comfortable with APIs, integration patterns and reading logs well enough to triage before escalating.
  • Able to work in a ticketing and documentation stack (Jira, Confluence) and in internal configuration tooling.
  • Able to read and sanity-check configuration data: game options, limits, currencies, jurisdiction settings.
  • SQL or equivalent query ability is an advantage, for checking a claim before raising it.

Communication

  • Writes clearly under pressure, in a way that does not create commitments the company has not made.
  • Holds a position with a client when the answer is no, and escalates rather than improvising an exception.
  • Works across Account Management, Operations, Platform and Compliance without owning any of them.

Nice to have

  • iGaming operator or aggregator integration experience.
  • Familiarity with regulated market configuration differences across jurisdictions.
  • Experience improving a support or operations process and measuring the result.

Good to know

What does success in the first 6 months looks like:

  • Named operator accounts have a single technical contact and a documented, current setup.
  • Operational request volume reaching Account Managers drops measurably against the current baseline.
  • Complex issues are resolved inside SLA, with recurring causes identified and at least two fixed at source.
  • Configuration changes are executed without a compliance or limit error.
  • Clients hear about launch-affecting issues from the TAM before they raise them.

ROLE TITLE

Senior Executive Assistant & Client Success Operations Manager

We are looking for Virtual Professionals based in the Philippines.

  • This is a fully remote position for the role of Senior Executive Assistant & Client Success Operations Manager.
  • Applications with an introduction video attached will be prioritized.
  • Due to the fully remote nature of the role, it is important that candidates are comfortable communicating on video calls.

ROLE SUMMARY

CourageToLead.com Inc. is a rapidly growing executive and business coaching company. We are looking for a Senior Executive Assistant & Client Success Operations Manager who can independently manage the operational details that keep the CEO, coaching team, clients, and business administration running smoothly.

This is a hands-on operational role combining executive assistance, client lifecycle management, financial administration, CRM oversight, and internal coordination.

You will manage the operational process behind approximately 6–8 new client onboardings every week, maintain accurate client records, monitor payment and commission workflows, oversee GoHighLevel processes, manage executive communications and scheduling, and ensure that outstanding tasks and internal commitments do not get overlooked.

When a new client signs up, you are responsible for making sure the payment is verified, the CRM is updated, the correct coach is assigned, credentials are prepared, and the client receives the appropriate welcome communication.

When a payment discrepancy appears, a client cannot access a program, an automation fails, or an internal deadline is approaching, you are expected to investigate, take the appropriate action, and coordinate resolution without waiting for someone to tell you what to do next.

You will also manage the CEO's inbox and calendar, prepare financial administration and accounting handoffs, and maintain visibility over operational priorities.

This is not an entry-level administrative position. You must already know how to manage multiple business workflows independently, exercise sound judgment, handle confidential information, and communicate professionally with executive-level clients. The CEO should not have to repeatedly check whether routine responsibilities have been completed.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Client Onboarding & Success Operations

  • When a new client enrolls, coordinate the complete onboarding process for approximately 6–8 new clients per week.
  • Verify that the required payment has been received before proceeding with the applicable onboarding steps.
  • Set up and update client records in GoHighLevel, ensuring that the correct information, program details, and lifecycle status are recorded.
  • Coordinate coach assignments, client credentials, welcome communications, and onboarding requirements.
  • Track each client's progress through onboarding, active participation, milestones, renewals, upgrades, graduation, and offboarding.
  • When clients report access problems or administrative concerns, investigate the issue, resolve routine matters, and coordinate escalations with coaches or account managers when necessary.
  • Coordinate office hours, mastermind sessions, invitations, scheduling, and client follow-ups.
  • Monitor outstanding onboarding requirements and follow up until each item is completed.

2. Payment Processing & Financial Administration

  • Maintain the company's payment and booking link library, ensuring that the correct approved links are available to the sales team.
  • When payment links or booking processes change, communicate approved updates to sales closers so outdated information is not used.
  • Reconcile monthly payment processor statements against company financial records.
  • Reconcile company credit card statements and identify discrepancies requiring clarification.
  • Prepare weekly coach and sales closer commission calculations using accurate payment and transaction records.
  • Coordinate approved vendor payments and maintain the supporting financial documentation.
  • Organize financial records and prepare complete documentation for accounting handoffs to the bookkeeper and CPA.
  • Flag missing transactions, inconsistent figures, duplicate entries, and other financial discrepancies rather than passing incomplete records forward.

3. CRM, Systems & Automation Management

  • Maintain accurate client information, program records, and lifecycle statuses inside GoHighLevel / LeadConnector.
  • Monitor onboarding and client lifecycle automations to ensure that expected processes are functioning.
  • When an automation or CRM workflow does not perform as expected, investigate the issue, identify what is affected, troubleshoot routine problems, and coordinate technical escalation when necessary.
  • Conduct regular system audits to identify outdated records, missing information, workflow gaps, and process inconsistencies.
  • Identify repetitive manual tasks and recommend practical opportunities to streamline them.
  • Maintain and update SOPs so recurring operational processes are documented and consistently followed.
  • Use approved AI tools, particularly Claude, to support productivity, organize information, improve documentation, and reduce unnecessary manual work.

4. Executive Email, Calendar & Administrative Support

  • Monitor and manage the CEO's inbox, identify important messages, draft routine responses, and flag matters requiring the CEO's attention or decision.
  • Distinguish routine administrative communications from urgent, sensitive, or high-priority matters that require escalation.
  • Coordinate meetings, calendar invitations, travel arrangements, filming sessions, and other executive engagements.
  • Conduct weekly calendar reviews to identify scheduling conflicts, missing appointments, preparation requirements, and upcoming commitments.
  • Follow through on scheduling changes and ensure relevant participants receive accurate updates.
  • Support the Head of Coaching with occasional administrative coordination and special projects as assigned.

5. Internal Communication & Operational Accountability

  • Monitor Slack throughout working hours and respond to internal messages within one hour.
  • Coordinate follow-ups across coaching, sales, accounting, and technical teams to keep operational tasks moving.
  • When a deadline, unresolved issue, or dependency threatens completion, follow up with the responsible person and escalate when necessary.
  • Maintain visibility over outstanding tasks, pending decisions, deadlines, and unresolved operational issues.
  • Ensure that requests do not disappear in Slack conversations or remain unattended without a clear next step.
  • Provide Start-of-Day (SOD) and End-of-Day (EOD) reports as required, communicating completed work, priorities, pending items, and issues requiring attention.

REQUIREMENTS (NON-NEGOTIABLE)

Senior-Level Operational Experience

  • Minimum 5 years of professional experience in executive assistance, client success, business operations, or a closely related operational role.
  • Demonstrated experience independently managing multiple responsibilities and business workflows.
  • Proven ability to manage recurring processes without requiring daily supervision or repeated reminders.
  • Experience supporting executives, managing client operations, or coordinating multiple internal departments.
  • Coaching, consulting, or service-based business experience is preferred.

AI & Technical Proficiency

  • Strong working knowledge of AI productivity tools, particularly Claude.
  • Comfortable using AI to improve documentation, organize information, and streamline repetitive administrative work.
  • Strong technological adaptability and the ability to learn and troubleshoot unfamiliar systems.
  • GoHighLevel / LeadConnector experience is strongly preferred.

Communication & Professional Judgment

  • Excellent written and spoken English.
  • Able to communicate professionally with executive-level clients, internal team members, coaches, and external service providers.
  • Capable of drafting polished business communications without requiring extensive editing.
  • Able to distinguish what can be handled independently from what requires approval or escalation.
  • Comfortable handling confidential executive, client, and financial information.
  • Responsive, organized, and consistent with follow-through.

Financial & Organizational Accuracy

  • Practical experience with Stripe or similar payment platforms.
  • Experience with payment reconciliation, financial tracking, spreadsheets, and commission calculations.
  • Strong numerical accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Able to identify discrepancies, verify information, and maintain reliable financial records.
  • Capable of managing multiple deadlines and tracking outstanding items without losing visibility.

Cultural Alignment

  • Comfortable working within a faith-driven, purpose-driven organization.
  • Demonstrates integrity, professionalism, genuine client care, and composure under pressure.
  • Respects the confidentiality and trust required when supporting a CEO and working with executive-level clients.

TOOLS

The role requires practical familiarity with the following systems:

  1. GoHighLevel / LeadConnector – CRM, client records, onboarding, and automations.
  2. Stripe / EasyPay Direct – Payment administration and transaction tracking.
  3. Google Workspace – Gmail, Calendar, Sheets, and Drive.
  4. Slack – Internal communication and operational coordination.
  5. Claude – AI-assisted productivity, documentation, and workflow improvement.
  6. Loom – Process instructions, walkthroughs, and operational updates.
  7. Spreadsheets – Financial reconciliation, commission calculations, and client tracking.

WHAT WE ACTUALLY CARE ABOUT

  • You close operational loops. When something is assigned, you track it through completion rather than assuming someone else will handle the next step.
  • You catch discrepancies before they become problems. You verify payments, records, commissions, and client information instead of simply processing what is provided.
  • You can manage multiple workflows simultaneously. Six to eight new client onboardings per week, financial deadlines, executive scheduling, and internal requests must remain organized.
  • You know when to act and when to escalate. You resolve routine issues independently but recognize when financial, technical, or executive decisions require approval.
  • You communicate with precision. Your messages, reports, records, and follow-ups make it clear what happened, what remains outstanding, and what needs attention.
  • You improve how work gets done. You use systems, SOPs, spreadsheets, and AI tools to reduce repetitive work and prevent recurring operational mistakes.

WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

  • This is not a basic virtual assistant position focused on completing isolated administrative tasks after receiving instructions.
  • This is not a passive inbox and calendar management role. You are expected to own client operations, financial administration, CRM accuracy, and internal follow-through.
  • This is not a position for someone who needs the CEO to prioritize every task, remind them of deadlines, or check whether routine work was completed.
  • This is not a bookkeeping or accounting position. You will prepare reconciliations, commission records, payment documentation, and accounting handoffs, but the bookkeeper and CPA remain responsible for their respective accounting functions.
  • This is not a technical developer position. You must monitor and troubleshoot routine CRM and automation issues, while coordinating complex technical problems with the appropriate team.

POSITION DETAILS

  • Work Arrangement: Fully remote.
  • Working Hours: Full-time, aligned with US business hours.
  • Work Environment: Performance-driven, with asynchronous workflows and regular internal communication.
  • Communication Expectations: Slack responses within one hour during working hours. SOD/EOD reporting as required.
  • Engagement Structure: Contractor arrangement through Scale Virtually.
  • Accountability: Ownership of assigned operational workflows, accuracy of records, responsiveness, and consistent follow-through.

APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

We are looking for experienced operators, not applicants who simply describe themselves as proactive, organized, or detail-oriented.

To be considered:

  1. Submit your updated resume outlining your executive support, client operations, financial administration, and systems experience.
  2. Include a short introduction video explaining your relevant experience and the types of business operations you have independently managed.
  3. Describe your hands-on experience with GoHighLevel, Stripe or similar payment platforms, Google Workspace, Slack, and Claude. Clearly distinguish between tools you have used professionally and those you have only studied.
  4. Answer the following practical question:

A new client has enrolled, but the payment record does not match the amount shown in the sales information. The client is expecting their onboarding credentials, and the assigned coach is waiting for confirmation. At the same time, you have several other clients scheduled for onboarding that day.

Explain exactly what you would do, in what order, what you would verify, who you would communicate with, and what you would not proceed with until the discrepancy is resolved.

We are assessing your ability to prioritize, protect the accuracy of client and financial records, communicate clearly, and move work forward without creating additional problems.

Applications that demonstrate relevant hands-on experience, independent operational ownership, and clear decision-making will be prioritized.

Benefits

  • Paid Time Off
  • HMO
  • Fully Remote Work

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

As a member of the AI model team, you will drive innovation in training and optimizing multimodal agents with a focus on real-world, interactive deployment. Your work will span the full agent development lifecycle - from data curation, interactive sandbox environments, and training pipeline design to model evaluation and optimization - with the goal of building multimodal agentic models that are both highly capable and practical to deploy locally at scale.

You will work across a wide spectrum of multimodal architectures integrating perception, reasoning, and tool execution across digital environments, applying state-of-the-art research to improve visual grounding, multi-step task completion, and adaptability to unseen interfaces. We expect you to bring a research-driven mindset combined with strong engineering discipline - someone who can identify the right technique for a given problem, implement it rigorously, and measure its impact clearly.

You will work closely with a small, high-caliber team where your contributions will have direct and meaningful impact. If you are passionate about pushing the boundaries of what multimodal agentic AI can achieve in production environments, this is your opportunity.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct end-to-end research and engineering on multimodal agentic models capable of perceiving, reasoning, and acting across real-world digital environments - including desktop operating systems, web browsers, and mobile devices.

  • Design and scale post-training and online reinforcement learning pipelines (SFT, multi-turn GRPO/PPO) across multi-node GPU infrastructure, covering asynchronous rollouts, reward design, deterministic/learned verifiers, and safeguards against reward hacking.

  • Architect high-concurrency interactive sandboxes (VMs, containers, and emulators) with fast snapshotting, deterministic resets, and reproducible evaluation frameworks to measure multi-step task completion and visual grounding.

  • Build and optimize local agentic harnesses that coordinate multi-model orchestration, memory, planning, and cross-device task execution.

  • Research and implement test-time adaptation and continual learning methods to enable rapid generalization to unseen applications and dynamic user interfaces.

  • Develop scalable multimodal agentic datasets, including synthetic trajectory generation, fine-grained UI grounding, and automated trajectory filtering and verification.

  • Drive model efficiency and local deployability on consumer hardware via knowledge distillation, quantization, and runtime optimization without degrading grounding or reasoning accuracy.

  • Translate frontier multimodal agentic research into production improvements, contribute to open-source ecosystems, and publish findings in top-tier AI conferences where applicable.

Requirements

  • Degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field (MS/PhD preferred), or equivalent practical research and engineering experience.

  • Strong hands-on experience training or post-training multimodal/vision-language models (SFT, distillation, or online RL such as GRPO/PPO) with measurable gains on agentic, visual grounding, or reasoning benchmarks.

  • Proficiency in Python, PyTorch, and distributed training or high-throughput rollout/inference infrastructure (e.g., FSDP/Megatron, Slurm, verl, vLLM/SGLang).

  • Deep hands-on in one or more of: online agentic RL & verifiers, high-concurrency OS/browser/mobile sandboxing, local agentic harnesses or test-time adaptation.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior Compensation Analyst to own our compensation discipline end to end: pay bands and benchmarking, compensation cycles, headcount and cost modeling with Finance, and variable compensation for the revenue team.

This is a build-and-run role. You'll bring specialist compensation expertise in-house and be the person managers, recruiters, and employees rely on for compensation decisions that are consistent, transparent, competitive, and financially sound.

Key Responsibilities

Bands & Benchmarking

  • Market pricing: Lead global benchmarking against sources such as OpenComp, Radford, Pave, Mercer, and Levels.fyi, with a consistent approach to pricing roles across functions and locations.
  • Bands & job architecture: Build and refine pay and equity bands, including sales OTE, and own role-family mapping, leveling, and the annual band refresh.
  • Executive compensation: Build and maintain executive compensation and recommendations for leadership review.
  • Compensation philosophy: Translate our philosophy into clear guidance for managers, recruiters, and employees.

Compensation Programs & Decisions

  • Compensation cycles: Run merit, promotion, and adjustment cycles end to end (annual/semi-annual plus off-cycle): calendar, budget models, manager guidance, calibration, exceptions, and accurate handoff to Payroll and Equity Administration.
  • Offers & pay decisions: Be the primary partner for offers, promotions, and adjustments, weighing market data, internal equity, and budget, with clear approval paths for exceptions.
  • Variable & equity compensation: Partner on sales incentive design, quota and commission modeling, and plan documentation (refreshed semi-annually), and with Legal on equity grant processes.

Finance Partnership & Analysis

  • Headcount planning: Map every new and changed requisition to a band, model compensation costs against the headcount plan, and feed the quarterly hiring operating review.
  • Leadership decisions: Model the cost and employee impact of proposed program changes; present a recommendation and its trade-offs, then own execution.
  • Pay equity: Assess compression and inconsistencies across teams, levels, and locations, and recommend actions with People leadership and Legal.

jobs.excerpt: About Foodsmart: Foodsmart is the leading Foodcare platform in the U.
jobs.description:
About Foodsmart:
Foodsmart is the leading Foodcare platform in the U.S., built to deliver nutrition-driven healthcare at scale. Powered by a national network of Registered Dietitians, Foodsmart combines personalized clinical nutrition care, behavior change tools, and food benefits to improve member health outcomes while lowering healthcare costs.

Our platform is designed to foster healthier food choices, drive lasting behavior change, and deliver sustainable health outcomes. Through our highly personalized, digital platform, we guide more than 3 million members—including those in employer-sponsored health plans, regional and national Medicaid managed care organizations, Medicare Advantage plans, and commercial insurers—on a tailored journey to eating well while saving time and money.

Foodsmart seamlessly integrates dietary assessments and nutrition counseling with online food ordering and cost-effective meal planning for the entire family, optimizing ingredients both at home and on the go. We partner with national and regional retailers across the U.S., many of whom accept SNAP/EBT, making healthier food more accessible. Additionally, we assist members with SNAP enrollment and management, providing tangible access to nutritious food. In 2024, Foodsmart secured a $200 million investment from TPG’s Rise Fund, which supports entrepreneurs dedicated to achieving the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals. This investment helps us expand our reach, particularly to low-income workers who are disproportionately affected by diet-related diseases.

At Foodsmart, our mission is to make nutritious food accessible and affordable for everyone, regardless of economic status. We are committed to a set of core values that shape our culture and work environment:

👥 Customer First - You start with the member and work backwards.
🚀 Make It Happen - You act with urgency, use data, and hold high standards.
🤝 One Team - You collaborate with respect and commit as a group.

Whether you're a dietitian, a commercial leader, or a technologist, working at Foodsmart means being part of a team that is passionate, supportive, and driven by a shared purpose. Join us in transforming the way people access and enjoy healthy food.

About the Role:

As the Food Operations Manager, you'll be the face of Foodsmart's food operations to our health plan and payer clients, and the person who makes sure members get the right food, on time. You'll report to the Senior Director of Client Operations and help lead the team that runs our food benefit programs end to end.

Foodsmart’s food benefit programs connect clinical nutrition care to real food getting to members’ homes. That means working closely with health plan clients, food vendors, and our clinical teams, with data moving between all of them. You’ll own how that work runs day to day, make sure it works for members and clients, and dig into why when it doesn’t. This role suits someone who is confident with clients, rigorous about root causes, great at organizing complex processes, and comfortable with ambiguity in a growing, evolving program.

You will:

  • Design and own the workflows that run food operations, both internally and together with clients: define how food is assessed, approved, and shipped, explain why each step exists and what data we need from the client and what we provide, and secure client buy-in
  • Bring internal teams together to follow those workflows consistently, and organize and standardize processes and SOPs across the food operations team
  • Oversee the flow from clinician assessment through payer approval to vendor fulfillment, and make sure every handoff works
  • Coordinate with our multiple food vendors and operationalize processes across all of them, holding them to service and quality standards
  • Lead vendor change management: when something changes, such as a file design, get buy-in from every vendor, explain what is happening, and coordinate timing with them before implementing
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to troubleshoot and implement our new food benefit management (FBM) system, including testing, rollout, and team training
  • Manage data exchanges with clients and vendors, including SFTP file transfers and file design, and resolve data quality issues
  • Serve as a client-facing lead for food operations, speaking with payer and health plan clients about incidents, program performance, and escalations with confidence and clarity
  • Manage and resolve escalations from clients, vendors, and internal teams, and keep everyone updated until each one is closed
  • Run root cause analysis when food doesn't ship correctly, and drive the fixes that keep it from happening again
  • Dig into operational data in Excel to find out what's going on, and build reports for the team, clients, and business reviews
  • Lead and develop the food operations team, balance workload among team members, and manage internal escalations
  • Flag risks, trends, and client feedback to leadership so we can improve our programs

You are:

  • Able to design a workflow and explain it clearly to a client: what the workflow is, why it works the way it does, what data we need from them, and what data we will provide in return
  • Someone who can get internal teams to adopt and follow new processes, working well with Product, Engineering, clinical, and vendor teams and winning buy-in from people who don't report to you
  • Highly organized and a true project manager, capable of bringing structure to messy processes and making them repeatable
  • Confident and polished with clients, and comfortable owning a conversation about an incident or escalation
  • Curious and rigorous, and keep digging into the data until you find the root cause
  • Committed to following through and responding on time
  • A manager who can lead with fairness and empathy while keeping workloads balanced across a team
  • Interested in our mission to expand access to nutritious food for underserved communities
  • Motivated to set clear success metrics and the plan to achieve them
  • Collaborative, positive, and easy to partner with

You have:

  • Bachelor's degree, or higher
  • 6-8+ years of experience in operations, client or account management, or program management, ideally in healthcare, health tech, or fulfillment and logistics
  • 2+ years of experience managing a leading a team
  • Experience handling client escalations and incidents, including root cause analysis
  • Experience designing workflows and standardizing processes
  • Basic understanding Knowledge of data exchanges, including SFTP and file design, and experience working with product and engineering teams
  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, such as pivot tables and lookups, and experience building reports from raw data
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Experience implementing or testing a new software system is a plus
  • Experience with food benefits, SNAP/EBT, or grocery and meal fulfillment is a plus
  • Familiarity with healthcare payers, such as Medicaid or Medicare Advantage plans, is a plus

About our benefits and perks:

✅ Remote-First Company

✅ Unlimited PTO

✅ Flexible & remote location

✅ Healthcare Coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision)
✅ 401k & bonus

✅ Registered Dietitian Sessions

Every day, billions of people search for music, shows, and apps across global platforms. They type a query expecting to find exactly what they're looking for. But those search results only make sense if AI understands not just the words people search for, but the cultural meaning behind them. Your deep knowledge of how people in your market actually consume media — which shows matter to which communities, how music preferences shift across regions, what streaming platforms mean to your culture — is the bridge between what people search for and what algorithms learn to recommend. That cultural translation is irreplaceable.

A Day in the Life of a Media Search Analyst

In this role, you will evaluate how well media search results align with real user intent across multiple search modalities. Your analytical judgment determines whether AI systems understand not just what people search for, but why they search, and whether the results truly serve their cultural and entertainment context.

jobs.description:
About American Promise, Inc.
American Promise is a cross-partisan organization working to address the problem of unlimited money in American politics with the passage and ratification of the For Our Freedom Amendment to the U.S. Constitution.

Our team is passionate, collaborative, courageous, adaptable, and fun. We love setting big goals and learning lessons on the way to achieving them. We work to ensure that our staff, donors, volunteers, and supporters reflect the tremendous diversity of the American people as we strive together on the most American of national projects: amend the US Constitution so that our government reflects our wishes rather than those of the powerful, wealthy elite.

If you’re excited to contribute your passion, skills, and experience to our urgent and historic effort, then please apply as specified for each open position below.

Potential Applicants – please note that all open positions at American Promise will be listed on this page. Any other job openings you may see online that are not also listed on this page are not sponsored by the organization. See this FBI notice for more information about the potential for employment scams.

About the role

The Chief Public Affairs Officer (CPAO) leads the federal and public affairs work of American Promise, which comprises American Promise Inc., a non-profit 501(c)(4) organization, and American Promise Education Fund, a non-profit 501(c)(3) organization.

The CPAO provides leadership, management, and strategic planning for American Promise’s congressional affairs and public affairs. This includes federal political strategy and relationships with Members of Congress and their staff, and engagement with influential public officials and constituencies: former legislators, governors, secretaries of state, attorneys general and their national associations. The CPAO ensures that American Promise has the political and DC-level expertise needed to secure the proposal of the For Our Freedom Amendment, and the senior public validators needed to build momentum toward ratification.

The CPAO works hand-in-hand with the Chief Campaigns Officer (CCO), who leads state campaigns, coalitions, and research. Together, the CPAO and CCO are responsible for ensuring that progress in the states translates into regional, national, and federal progress. The CPAO also works closely with the legal team on legal and constitutional strategy.

Public affairs at American Promise is distinct from Communications. The CPAO builds and manages relationships with officials, validators and their organizations; the Chief Communications Officer leads messaging, media, and public communications. The two coordinate closely wherever federal and public affairs work has a public face.

This full-time position requires a seasoned strategist with deep relationships in federal and state government, strong judgment and communication skills, and a commitment to building cross-partisan support for the For Our Freedom Amendment.

Reports to: Chief Program Officer & General Counsel

What you'll do

Strategy

  • Develop, steer, and refine American Promise’s federal political strategy for the proposal of the For Our Freedom Amendment, in partnership with the legal team on legal and constitutional substance.
  • With the CCO, maintain a single integrated state-to-federal strategy, so that state progress is converted into congressional support and congressional dynamics inform state priorities.
  • With the CCO, oversee our coalitions and mobilization functions to leverage partners, other organizations, and the public in support of our state and federal efforts.
  • Develop a public affairs strategy that engages former legislators, governors, secretaries of state, attorneys general and other senior officials as validators and champions of the amendment.
  • Advise the Chief Program Officer and senior leadership on the federal and national political landscape, and on risks and opportunities affecting the amendment campaign.

Operations

  • Lead and manage the congressional affairs and public affairs functions, including staff, consultants, and advisors.
  • Build and maintain relationships with Members of Congress, committee and leadership staff, and congressional caucuses across the political spectrum.
  • Build and maintain relationships with organizations of state and former officials, such as associations of governors, secretaries of state, attorneys general and former Members of Congress.
  • Use state campaign wins, data and relationships, provided by the CCO’s team, to recruit congressional cosponsors and senior validators.
  • Coordinate with the Chief Communications Officer on federal and public affairs messaging, and with the legal team to ensure federal advocacy and lobbying activities comply with applicable law.

Leadership

  • Partner with the Chief Program Officer, CCO, and other members of the senior leadership team on high-level organizational management, a coherent strategic framework and budget setting.
  • Represent and communicate about American Promise and its mission with internal and external audiences.
  • Develop the congressional and public affairs team and build federal-level capability as American Promise scales.

Engagement & Representation

  • Represent American Promise with Members of Congress, senior officials and national organizations, and at national meetings, conferences, in the media and at other key events, alongside the CEO, President, Chief Program Officer, and other senior leaders.
  • Cultivate a cross-partisan network of senior public figures who can speak credibly for the amendment.

Qualifications

Candidates should be highly organized, detail-oriented, and adept at handling multiple projects simultaneously in a high-volume, fast-paced environment. Candidates should be trustworthy, collaborative, and demonstrate sound judgment.

  • A commitment to and excitement for American Promise’s mission, goal, and values.
  • Minimum of 10 years of related, progressively responsible experience in federal government affairs, congressional service, public affairs, or senior political strategy.
  • Established relationships with Members of Congress and their staff, and with state and former officials, across the political spectrum.
  • Working knowledge of the legislative process, including the process for proposing a constitutional amendment.
  • Experience leading teams, consultants, or advisors.
  • Discretion and the ability to operate comfortably with senior officials across the political spectrum.
  • Demonstrated success working in cultures defined by excellence, professionalism, trust, and respect.
  • A deep understanding of American Promise’s political strategy for proposal and ratification of a constitutional amendment.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, including the ability to connect with others, listen, relate, and collaborate to the collective satisfaction of the participants.
  • Excellent communication and public speaking skills, including the ability to distill complex political and strategic issues into language accessible to a wide range of audiences.
  • Excellent critical thinking, risk analysis, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent organizational and leadership abilities, with the ability to grasp the big picture while paying attention to detail.
  • Demonstrated cultural competence and sensitivity, and a commitment to uniting people of widely different backgrounds and political views in pursuing a common goal.
  • Demonstrated integrity, sound judgment, adaptability, reliability, collaboration, a commitment to learning, and a sense of humor.

Who We Are

We are the first publicly-traded biotech or pharmaceutical company to take the form of a public benefit corporation. Our public benefit purpose is to provide a brighter future for patients through the development of novel pharmaceutical therapies; and technologies that expand the availability of transplantable organs.

United Therapeutics (Nasdaq: UTHR) seeks to travel down the corridors of indifference to develop treatments for rare, deadly diseases. We were founded in 1996 by a family seeking a cure for their daughter’s pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH). Today, we have six FDA-approved therapies that treat PAH, pulmonary hypertension associated with interstitial lung disease (PH-ILD) and neuroblastoma, a rare pediatric cancer. Our near-term pipeline seeks to develop additional therapies for PAH and pulmonary fibrosis (PF).

The cure for end-stage life-threatening diseases like PAH, PH-ILD, PF, and many others is an organ transplant, but only a small percentage of donated organs are available to address the vast need. For this reason, we are working to create manufactured organs to address the shortage of kidneys, hearts, lungs, and livers available for transplant. We believe an unlimited supply of tolerable, transplantable organs will eliminate the transplant waiting list and cure end-stage organ diseases for which transplant is not currently an option.

You are a strategic healthcare policy and reimbursement leader with deep expertise navigating the evolving U.S. healthcare landscape and translating complex policy developments into actionable business strategies. • Manage prizes, bonuses and tier rewards within budget.
• Manage prizes, bonuses and tier rewards within budget.
• Measure each contest's lift and keep what works.

Keep affiliates posting

Measure and report

Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multi-cloud problems and drive efficiency.
With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, and Ingram Micro, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.

The OpportunityWe are modernizing how we run our financial systems and bringing end-to-end technical ownership in-house. As our NetSuite Systems Engineer, you will own DoiT's financial systems architecture - centered on NetSuite OneWorld across roughly 20 global subsidiaries, alongside FloQast for close management and Zip for intake-to-procure - as a hands-on systems owner and builder, not a ticket-queue administrator.
Business teams will often come to you with pre-baked solutions ("build a custom script for this", "add another approval field"). Your job is to uncover the accounting or operational problem behind the request, protect the integrity of our financial data model, and engineer a clean, durable fix so nobody has to do the same manual work twice.
You will not operate on an island. Within Business Systems Engineering, you own the configuration, domain logic, and SuiteCloud customization inside our financial engines, while partnering directly with our internal Fusion software engineering team on event-driven cross-system integrations and with our Business Intelligence team to model analytical data in BigQuery rather than inside NetSuite saved-search silos. Reporting to the Manager of Enterprise Systems, you will shape how global finance operations scale across DoiT.

What You'll Own

  • End-to-end financial systems ownership: Own the architecture, configuration, domain rules, and operational health of NetSuite OneWorld, FloQast, and Zip across multi-subsidiary, multi-currency operations.
  • SuiteCloud engineering and process automation: Eliminate recurring manual work across order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, revenue recognition, intercompany reconciliations, and month-end close by choosing the simplest durable build tier - native NetSuite configuration first, SuiteFlow where declarative logic fits, and modular SuiteScript 2.x or RESTlets where code is warranted.
  • Composable integration and warehouse seams: Partner with our Fusion engineering team to expose clean interfaces and connect NetSuite to Salesforce, DealHub CPQ, billing systems, and banking platforms through a central, version-controlled integration layer, and ensure financial datasets flow cleanly into BigQuery for analytics and AI consumption.
  • Software engineering discipline (NetSuite as code): Manage customizations, scripts, workflows, and role definitions through sandbox validation, SuiteCloud Development Framework (SDF), and Git pull-request workflows with clear auditability and SOX segregation of duties.
  • Technology partnership with Finance: Act as the trusted technical advisor to Accounting, FP&A, Revenue, and Treasury - translating financial requirements into sound system design and pushing back constructively with clear alternatives when a requested shortcut would compromise data integrity or audit controls.
  • AI-leveraged building: Use modern AI coding and automation tools daily to draft and refactor SuiteScript, accelerate root-cause investigation, and validate configuration changes faster.

    What You'll Bring
  • 4+ years of hands-on NetSuite OneWorld ownership and SuiteCloud engineering in a multi-subsidiary, multi-currency environment, including:
  • production development in SuiteScript 2.x (User Event, Scheduled, Map/Reduce, Client scripts, and RESTlets) alongside declarative SuiteFlow workflows and SuiteQL / saved searches;
  • core financial modules including General Ledger, Advanced Revenue Management (ARM / ASC 606), Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, intercompany accounting, and subsidiary structures;
  • custom records, fields, forms, role hierarchies, permissions, and SOX-ready segregation of duties;
  • integrating NetSuite with external CRM, CPQ, procurement, or billing platforms via REST/SOAP web services, webhooks, or iPaaS tools.
  • Solid working fluency in core corporate finance processes: quote-to-cash, procure-to-pay, revenue recognition, bank reconciliation, and month-end close.
  • Architectural seam judgment: clear reasoning on what belongs as native ERP configuration, what justifies custom SuiteScript, what belongs in an external integration service, and why analytical reporting belongs in a cloud data warehouse like BigQuery.
  • Proven automation track record: demonstrated history of replacing manual finance work with reliable automation, backed by concrete before-and-after outcomes.
  • AI-assisted engineering and SDLC hygiene: daily comfort with modern AI coding assistants (such as Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot) and structured change management (sandbox-to-production deployments, SDF, or Git).
  • Direct, collaborative communication: able to hold substantive technical discussions with software engineers and stand your ground constructively with senior finance stakeholders.
  • Language and work authorization: fluent English and authorization to work remotely from your country of residence (we do not provide visa sponsorship).

    Nice to Have
  • Hands-on ownership of FloQast, Zip, DealHub CPQ, or Salesforce-to-NetSuite order-to-cash flows.
  • Experience in a B2B SaaS, cloud consumption, or multi-entity post-acquisition environment.
  • Familiarity with SQL, Python, or cloud data warehouses (BigQuery or Snowflake).
  • NetSuite SuiteCloud Developer, Application Developer, or Administrator certification.

Are you a Do'er?

Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.
We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Flosum is a bootstrapped, profitable B2B SaaS company building the leading Salesforce-native DevSecOps, Data Protection, and Security platform. Our solutions are trusted by Fortune 500 enterprises in the most heavily regulated industries on the planet — financial services, healthcare, government, and insurance.

We’re not a startup burning cash and chasing vanity metrics. We’re a proven, scaling business that reached profitability on our own terms. As a Salesforce Summit Partner and Innovation Award winner, we’ve earned our seat at the table alongside the biggest names in enterprise software.

Built 100% on the Salesforce platform. Serving enterprises that demand zero compromise on security, compliance, and reliability.

Why This Role Exists

We are entering an aggressive growth phase — expanding our product surface, deepening our platform capabilities, and accelerating our delivery velocity. We need senior-caliber Node.js developers who can own significant parts of our architecture and ship production code that enterprise customers depend on daily.

This is not a staff augmentation seat. You will work directly with engineering leadership, product managers, and the CEO. Your decisions will have real consequences, your opinions will be heard, and your craftsmanship will be visible to the customers who rely on our platform.

What You’ll Build

  • High-performance backend services and APIs powering enterprise-grade SaaS applications
  • Scalable, secure Node.js micro services and integrations within the Salesforce ecosystem
  • Modern front-end experiences using Vue.js and TypeScript that serve demanding enterprise users
  • CI/CD pipeline tooling, automation frameworks, and developer productivity infrastructure
  • Real-time data processing and event-driven architectures handling sensitive enterprise data at scale

Requirements

Read this section carefully. We are specific about what we need because we are serious about who we hire.

Non-Negotiable Technical Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional Node.js development in production environments — not tutorials, not side projects, not bootcamp exercises. Real production systems serving real users at scale.
  • Expert-level understanding of asynchronous programming, event loops, streams, and the Node.js runtime. You should be able to explain backpressure, the differences between setImmediate and process.nextTick, and why unhandled promise rejections are dangerous — without Googling it.
  • Deep experience with TypeScript in production codebases. We write typed code, and we expect you to understand why.
  • Strong command of RESTful API design, authentication patterns (OAuth 2.0, JWT), and API security best practices for enterprise environments.
  • Proven experience with SQL and NoSQL databases, query optimization, data modeling, and understanding the performance implications of schema decisions at scale.
  • Proficiency with Git workflows, code review practices, automated testing (unit, integration, and end-to-end), and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Solid understanding of containerization (Docker), cloud services (AWS/GCP/Azure), and infrastructure-as-code principles.

Highly Preferred (These Will Set You Apart)

  • Salesforce development experience: Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, or Salesforce API integrations. If you know both Node.js and Salesforce, you are a rare and extremely valuable candidate to us.
  • Experience building or contributing to Salesforce ISV (AppExchange) products.
  • Vue.js front-end development experience, particularly with Vue 3 Composition API and state management.
  • Experience working in B2B SaaS companies serving enterprise customers with strict compliance requirements (SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP, GDPR).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/DevSecOps toolchains and practices in the Salesforce ecosystem.

The Kind of Person We’re Looking For

Skills get you in the door. Mindset determines whether you thrive here:

Missionary, Not Mercenary

Moring.ai builds enterprise AI that runs in production for regulated industries: financial services and other compliance-heavy organizations. We ship AI applications and agents inside our customers' own cloud environments, wired into the systems they already run. Not slideware, not demos.

We are building an Agentic AI platform for a large financial services enterprise. It lets developers inside that organization build and deploy agentic AI workflows: Python applications that call LLMs, use tools, and run as agents on Kubernetes. The platform includes an LLM gateway, an agent runtime, MCP servers for tools and data, a skills registry, retrieval, evaluation, observability, and the identity and governance controls a bank needs before it says yes.

We are hiring a Senior AI Platform Architect to own this platform's architecture. You have 12–15 years of experience, and you have built platforms before: a cloud platform, a developer platform, a container platform, or an internal platform other engineers build on. You know AWS well and Kubernetes very well, because the platform runs on Kubernetes and so do the agents. This is a hands-on role. You will write design documents, review code, build reference implementations, and make the architecture calls that the engineering team follows. You will also present and defend the architecture to the customer's architects and security teams.

What You'll Do
  • Own the end-to-end architecture of the AI platform: gateway, agent runtime, MCP layer, skills and asset registry, retrieval, evals, observability, identity, and governance.

  • Design the AWS foundation the platform sits on: EKS, IAM, networking, private endpoints, and infrastructure-as-code, built for a regulated enterprise with restricted egress.
  • Define the identity model for agents: how an agent authenticates as itself, acts on behalf of a user without gaining more access than that user has, and leaves an audit trail.
  • Define the developer experience: how a developer in the customer's organization goes from an idea to a deployed agent, with the right guardrails and the least friction.
  • Set the patterns for MCP servers, skills, tools, and prompts so they are reusable, versioned, and governed.
  • Write architecture documents and reference implementations, and review the team's designs and code against them.
  • Present the architecture to the customer's chief architect, platform teams, and security and model risk reviewers, and incorporate their constraints into the design.
