Why Keyrus, Why Now!

Keyrus is an international group of 3,000 experts across 30 countries, built on a single conviction: AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does.

For more than 30 years, we have helped organizations build the data foundations that power intelligent systems. Today, we go further by designing and operationalizing intelligence that delivers measurable business value.

Building AI capabilities is only part of the challenge. Real transformation happens when those capabilities work within existing business systems, data environments, workflows, and processes.

Technology amplifies. Keyrus culture differentiates. Industrial discipline connects the two.

Role details

• Location: Colombia (Remote)

  • Modality: Full time / Permanent contract

What you'll architect

As a Senior Data Engineer, you'll be the technical lead on modern data platform work for our clients. You'll build the pipelines, models and lakehouse layers that analytics and business teams rely on every day. You'll also be the engineer in the room who asks the hard questions, flags risks early and explains trade-offs in plain language.

This is a consulting role. You'll work directly with client data, analytics and IT teams, in English, often during US business hours.

Your responsibilities

  • Build and run lakehouse pipelines on Databricks, using dbt for transformation and managed ingestion tools such as Fivetran.
    • Design data models (dimensional, Data Vault or medallion) that analytics and BI teams can use with confidence.
    • Lead migrations and integrations from legacy databases and warehouses into a modern platform.
    • Build quality, testing and monitoring into every pipeline so issues are caught before business users find them.
    • Apply access controls and data protection, including masking and role-based access, in line with governance standards.
    • Tune performance and cloud costs, and recommend improvements proactively.
    • Write clear documentation and runbooks so other teams can support and extend your work.
    • Guide other engineers through code reviews, shared standards and mentoring.

Who you are

You're a hands-on engineer who takes ownership. You don't wait for perfect requirements. You ask questions, propose an approach and keep stakeholders informed. You're consultative and you care as much about the work being used as about it being built well.

What you bring

Experience

  • 6+ years in data engineering, including at least 2 leading technical work on client or cross-team projects.

• Strong SQL and Python.

  • Hands-on Databricks experience (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, workflows) and dbt.
    • Experience migrating data from relational sources such as SQL Server, Oracle or Aurora.
    • Solid grasp of data modeling, testing and CI/CD for data.

Consulting and communication skills

  • Advanced English (C1 or above), spoken and written, and confidence leading conversations with US-based stakeholders.
    • Ability to clarify business requirements and translate them into actionable technical solutions.
    • Ability to communicate technical decisions, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations in plain language.
    • Proactive problem-solving, initiative, and a solution-oriented mindset.
    • Strong ownership of technical delivery and cross-functional collaboration.

Nice to have

  • Azure or AWS data services, including Azure Data Factory or Airflow for orchestration.
    • Streaming or change data capture (Kafka, Event Hubs, Kinesis).
    • Infrastructure as code (Terraform or Bicep).
    • Experience supporting Power BI or Tableau teams with semantic or reporting layers.

• Databricks or cloud certifications.

  • Previous experience in the Insurance or Healthcare industries.

What makes you successful

  • You independently deliver scalable, reliable, and secure data solutions aligned with business needs.
    • You anticipate risks, propose sustainable solutions, and continuously improve data quality, performance, and cloud costs.
    • You demonstrate a consulting mindset through effective communication, initiative, and ownership of client outcomes.
    • You act as a technical reference, mentor other engineers, and promote engineering best practices.

What we offer at Keyrus

• 100% remote work

  • International and multicultural projects
    • Opportunities to work with leading technologies in the Digital Commerce ecosystem
    • Access to training programs and continuous professional development
    • Professional growth opportunities and internal mobility
    • A culture built on collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning

About Keyrus

At Keyrus, we help organizations move from experimental to industrialized AI, from isolated agents to orchestrated systems, and from insight to execution.

As Architects of Intelligence, we design the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, embedding intelligence into business processes so that it creates sustainable, measurable value.

Powered by our proprietary Human Orchestrated Model™ (HOM), we architect reliable:

• Intelligence Foundations

jobs.excerpt: About Panorama: Panorama Education is a technology company building the leading platform for student insight and action in K-12.
jobs.description:
About Panorama:

Panorama Education is a technology company building the leading platform for student insight and action in K-12. We help modern school systems understand what students need and take effective action. By bringing together academics, attendance, behavior, and engagement data with AI, we give educators the full picture of every student and the intelligence to decide what to do next. As a mission-driven company supporting 15 million students in 2,000 districts nationwide, the work we do has a direct line to student outcomes every day. Join us and help shape what education looks like for the next generation.



About the Role:

As a Lead Security Engineer at Panorama, you'll be a hands-on technical leader responsible for securing our applications and cloud infrastructure that power our platform and protect student data. You'll work across our AWS environment and product engineering teams to identify risks and design, build and deliver practical security improvements through code and automation.

This role combines strong engineering skills, security expertise, and pragmatic judgment. You'll own complex technical projects from design through delivery, partner closely with engineers across squads, and help make security a natural part of how we build and operate our platform.

Requirements

Cloud & Application Security

  • Design, write, test, and deploy infrastructure-as-code to enforce security controls in AWS (e.g., Terraform, CDK).
  • Design and implement systemic security controls across AWS and web applications, ranging from code and access management to network security, asset configuration, and encryption.
  • Lead threat modeling and architecture reviews with engineers to proactively address security risks during design.
  • Partner with Security Operations and engineering teams to address systemic vulnerabilities, improve security controls, and prevent recurring issues.

Security Engineering & Automation

  • Build reusable security tools, automated controls and developer guardrails that make it easier for engineers to develop secure software.
  • Partner with Security Operations to improve detection and response capabilities, reduce manual operational work, and strengthen security controls through automation.
  • Embed security by default across Panorama's platform, protecting student data while enabling efficient, secure development practices.
  • Leverage AI, automation, and other tools to improve security engineering effectiveness and accelerate delivery.

Technical Leadership & Delivery

  • Independently scope, design and deliver complex security engineering projects, coordinating dependencies, managing tradeoffs, and proactively communicating delivery risks.
  • Make pragmatic technical decisions that meaningfully reduce security risk while balancing engineering effort, developer experience, and operational complexity.
  • Share deep security expertise and engineering best practices to solve complex challenges, support security policies, and help teams achieve their goals.
  • Actively seek out and incorporate feedback from teammates with diverse backgrounds and experiences to strengthen collaboration and build better solutions.

Our Ideal Candidate Has:

  • 7+ years of experience in security engineering, application security, cloud security, or software engineering, with significant hands-on security experience.
  • Strong programming skills in at least one modern language, such as Ruby, Python, Go, or JavaScript, with a track record of personally building and deploying production-quality security tools or controls.
  • Deep hands-on experience designing, implementing, and operating security controls in production AWS environments, particularly IAM, networking, encryption, monitoring, and infrastructure-as-code.
  • Experience securing web applications and APIs, including authentication, authorization, and sensitive data handling.
  • Experience implementing security automation, CI/CD security controls, and secure software development practices, including solutions that prevent or systematically remediate vulnerabilities.
  • Experience leading threat modeling, security reviews, or complex technical security projects.
  • Strong technical judgment and the ability to independently scope, coordinate, and deliver projects across multiple engineering teams.
  • A proactive, collaborative approach to problem-solving and a commitment to protecting student data.

Additional experience that would be valuable, but is not required:

  • Experience securing AI-powered applications, including LLM integrations, agent workflows, or prompt injection risks.
  • Experience with multi-tenant SaaS platforms and data isolation.
  • Experience supporting SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar compliance programs.
  • Familiarity with K-12 privacy requirements such as FERPA or COPPA.
  • Relevant security certifications or active involvement in the security community.

Senior Full Stack Engineer (Python, FastAPI & AI-Assisted Development) – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Client Business Hours (with flexibility for sprint reviews, deployments, and production support)

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Senior Full Stack Engineer to architect, build, and scale a modern tax filing platform from the ground up.

This isn’t just another software engineering role.

You’ll own the architecture, backend services, frontend experience, and key technical decisions behind a mission-critical platform where security, accuracy, reliability, and scalability are essential.

You’ll work extensively with AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor and Claude Code to accelerate development while maintaining exceptional engineering standards and code quality.

If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges, building scalable systems, and taking ownership from architecture through deployment, this role is built for you.

What You’ll Own

Full-Stack Application Development

  • Design, build, and maintain production-grade web applications.
  • Develop secure backend services using Python and FastAPI.
  • Build intuitive, responsive frontend interfaces for complex workflows.
  • Design scalable REST APIs and service architectures.
  • Integrate frontend and backend systems seamlessly.

System Architecture & Technical Design

  • Own end-to-end application architecture.
  • Design scalable data models and service boundaries.
  • Build systems optimized for long-term maintainability.
  • Drive technical decisions that improve scalability, reliability, and performance.
  • Identify architectural risks and recommend practical solutions.

Backend Development

  • Develop secure REST APIs using FastAPI.
  • Build business logic for workflow-driven applications.
  • Integrate third-party APIs and external services.
  • Optimize API performance and application responsiveness.
  • Develop reliable background jobs and asynchronous processing workflows.

Frontend Development

  • Build user-friendly interfaces for:
    • Forms
    • Dashboards
    • Workflow management
  • Develop responsive, reusable UI components using modern JavaScript frameworks.
  • Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs.
  • Improve usability while maintaining accessibility and performance.

AI-Assisted Software Development

  • Utilize Cursor and Claude Code throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Build AI-assisted workflows that improve engineering productivity.
  • Use AI to accelerate:
    • Development
    • Debugging
    • Testing
    • Documentation
  • Continuously improve engineering workflows using emerging AI tools.

Testing, Quality & Reliability

  • Develop and maintain:
    • Unit tests
    • Integration tests
    • End-to-end tests
  • Maintain high code quality standards.
  • Improve system stability and reliability.
  • Refactor code to reduce technical debt and improve maintainability.

Security & Data Integrity

  • Implement robust validation and error handling.
  • Ensure secure handling of sensitive user information.
  • Follow best practices for:
    • Authentication
    • Authorization
    • Input validation
  • Build systems where data integrity and accuracy are critical.

Documentation & Collaboration

  • Document architecture decisions and technical implementations.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers, Engineers, and stakeholders across time zones.
  • Participate in:
    • Sprint planning
    • Technical discussions
    • Code reviews
  • Communicate risks, blockers, and recommendations proactively.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Ownership mentality with a passion for building high-quality software.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently.
  • Comfortable making architectural decisions.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Passion for continuous learning and AI-assisted engineering.
  • Strong focus on scalability, maintainability, and clean code.

Required Experience & Skills

Experience

  • 5+ years of professional Full Stack Software Engineering experience.
  • Proven experience designing and delivering production-grade web applications.

Backend Skills

  • Strong expertise in:
    • Python
    • FastAPI
    • REST API development
  • Experience building workflow-driven or form-heavy applications.
  • Experience with:
    • PostgreSQL or similar relational databases
    • API integrations
    • Git

Frontend Skills

  • Strong experience with modern JavaScript frameworks.
  • Experience building responsive web applications and complex user interfaces.

AI & Development Tools

  • Hands-on experience using:
    • Cursor
    • Claude Code
    • AI-assisted software development tools

Communication

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience in:
    • FinTech
    • Tax software
    • Compliance platforms
    • Financial systems
  • Experience building highly secure applications.
  • Familiarity with distributed engineering teams and asynchronous collaboration.
  • Experience designing scalable cloud-based architectures.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Review sprint priorities and overnight updates.
  • Build backend APIs and frontend features.
  • Design scalable application architecture.
  • Implement workflow logic and business rules.
  • Use Cursor and Claude Code to accelerate development.
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams.
  • Write automated tests and review pull requests.
  • Document technical decisions and deployment updates.

In short: You’ll architect, build, and continuously improve a mission-critical software platform while owning technical execution from architecture through production.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • High-quality features delivered on schedule.
  • Secure, reliable, and scalable application performance.
  • Low production defect rates.
  • Strong automated test coverage.
  • Well-documented, maintainable code.
  • Positive collaboration across engineering and product teams.

Why Join Us?

  • Architect and build a mission-critical platform from the ground up.
  • High ownership with meaningful technical impact.
  • Work with modern AI-assisted software development tools.
  • Solve complex engineering challenges at scale.
  • Fully remote work environment with flexible collaboration.
  • Growth opportunities into:
    • Staff Engineer
    • Technical Lead
    • Engineering Manager
    • Software Architect

Interview Process

  1. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  2. Technical Assessment
  3. Client Interview
  4. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

After submitting your application, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record a short 3–5 minute Intro Video. This is the first step in our hiring process and can be completed whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of multiple initial screening calls, you’ll have one opportunity to introduce yourself, discuss your full stack engineering background, highlight your experience with Python, FastAPI, frontend development, system architecture, and AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor or Claude Code, and share examples of complex systems you’ve built or scaled. Your video will be reviewed by the hiring team before moving to the technical assessment and client interview.

You can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it—only your final version will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after applying.

Apply Now

If you’re passionate about building scalable software, leveraging AI to improve engineering workflows, and taking ownership of complex technical challenges from architecture through deployment, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help build the next generation of secure, high-impact software solutions.
